internal sealed class SR
{
	private static SR loader;

	[ThreadStatic]
	private static Dictionary<DynamicResourceString.ID, DynamicResourceString> _dynamicResourceStrings;

	private ResourceManager[] resources;

	private SR()
	{
		string text = "Infragistics.Windows.strings";
		string[] array = text.Split(';');
		int num = 0;
		string[] array2 = array;
		foreach (string text2 in array2)
		{
			if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
			{
				num++;
			}
		}
		resources = new ResourceManager[num];
		Assembly assembly = GetType().Assembly;
		int num2 = 0;
		string[] array3 = array;
		foreach (string text3 in array3)
		{
			if (text3 != null && text3.Length > 0)
			{
				resources[num2++] = new ResourceManager(text3, assembly);
			}
		}
	}

	public static DynamicResourceString GetDynamicResourceString(string name, object[] args, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		lock (typeof(SR))
		{
			DynamicResourceString.ID key = new DynamicResourceString.ID(culture, name, args);
			DynamicResourceString value = null;
			if (_dynamicResourceStrings == null)
			{
				_dynamicResourceStrings = new Dictionary<DynamicResourceString.ID, DynamicResourceString>();
			}
			else
			{
				_dynamicResourceStrings.TryGetValue(key, out value);
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				value = new InternalDynamicResourceString(ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer, culture, name, args);
				_dynamicResourceStrings.Add(key, value);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

	private static SR GetLoader()
	{
		if (loader == null)
		{
			lock (typeof(SR))
			{
				if (loader == null)
				{
					loader = new SR();
				}
			}
		}
		return loader;
	}

	public static string GetString(string name)
	{
		return GetString(null, name);
	}

	public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetString(null, name, args);
	}

	public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
	{
		return GetString(culture, name, null);
	}

	public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: true, culture, name, args);
	}

	private static string GetStringHelper(bool allowCustomizedStrings, CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		string text = null;
		if (allowCustomizedStrings)
		{
			text = ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer.GetCustomizedString(name);
		}
		if (text == null)
		{
			SR sR = GetLoader();
			if (sR == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			text = sR.GetString(name, culture);
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
		}
		if (args != null && args.Length != 0 && text.Length > 2)
		{
			try
			{
				text = string.Format(null, text, args);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}
		return text;
	}

	private string GetString(string name, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		ResourceManager[] array = resources;
		foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
		{
			string text = resourceManager.GetString(name, culture);
			if (text != null)
			{
				return text;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}

	public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name)
	{
		return GetUncustomizedString(null, name);
	}

	public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetUncustomizedString(null, name, args);
	}

	public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
	{
		return GetUncustomizedString(culture, name, null);
	}

	public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
	{
		return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: false, culture, name, args);
	}

	public static object GetObject(string name)
	{
		return GetObject(null, name);
	}

	public static object GetObject(CultureInfo culture, string name)
	{
		return GetLoader()?.GetObject(name, culture);
	}

	private object GetObject(string name, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		ResourceManager[] array = resources;
		foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
		{
			object obj = resourceManager.GetObject(name, culture);
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return obj;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}
}
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
internal sealed class LocalizedCategoryAttribute : CategoryAttribute
{
	public LocalizedCategoryAttribute(string category)
		: base(category)
	{
	}

	protected override string GetLocalizedString(string value)
	{
		return SR.GetUncustomizedString(null, value);
	}
}
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
internal sealed class LocalizedDescriptionAttribute : DescriptionAttribute
{
	private bool loaded;

	public override string Description
	{
		get
		{
			if (!loaded)
			{
				loaded = true;
				base.DescriptionValue = SR.GetUncustomizedString(null, base.Description);
			}
			return base.Description;
		}
	}

	public LocalizedDescriptionAttribute(string description)
		: base(description)
	{
	}
}
internal sealed class InternalDynamicResourceString : DynamicResourceString
{
	internal InternalDynamicResourceString(ResourceCustomizer customizer, CultureInfo cultureInfo, string resourceName, object[] args)
		: base(customizer, cultureInfo, resourceName, args)
	{
	}

	protected override string GetStringFromResource(string resourceName, CultureInfo culture)
	{
		return SR.GetString(culture, resourceName, null);
	}
}

		private static readonly ResourceSetLocator g_Location;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static ResourceDictionary g_ResourcesInternal;

		public override string Grouping => Location.Grouping;

		public override string Theme => Location.Theme;

		public override ResourceDictionary Resources => ResourcesInternal;

		private static ResourceSetLocator Location => g_Location;

		private static ResourceDictionary ResourcesInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (g_ResourcesInternal == null)
				{
					g_ResourcesInternal = Utilities.CreateResourceSetDictionary(g_Location.Assembly, g_Location.ResourcePath);
				}
				return g_ResourcesInternal;
			}
		}

		static EditorBrushes()
		{
			g_Location = new T();
		}
	}

		public override ResourceDictionary Resources
		{
			get
			{
				ResourceDictionary resourcesInternal = ResourcesInternal;
				VerifyResources();
				return resourcesInternal;
			}
		}

		public static ResourceSetLocator Location
		{
			get
			{
				if (g_Location == null)
				{
					g_Location = new T();
				}
				return g_Location;
			}
		}

		private static ResourceDictionary ResourcesInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (g_ResourcesInternal == null)
				{
					g_ResourcesInternal = Utilities.CreateResourceSetDictionary(Location.Assembly, Location.ResourcePath);
				}
				return g_ResourcesInternal;
			}
		}

		internal class ComboEditorDefaultConverter : ValueEditorDefaultConverter
		{
			private static ComboEditorDefaultConverter _converter;

			private static ComboEditorDefaultConverter _displayTextConverter;

			public static ComboEditorDefaultConverter Converter
			{
				get
				{
					if (_converter == null)
					{
						_converter = new ComboEditorDefaultConverter(isDisplayTextConverter: false);
					}
					return _converter;
				}
			}

			public static ComboEditorDefaultConverter DisplayTextConverter
			{
				get
				{
					if (_displayTextConverter == null)
					{
						_displayTextConverter = new ComboEditorDefaultConverter(isDisplayTextConverter: true);
					}
					return _displayTextConverter;
				}
			}

			protected ComboEditorDefaultConverter(bool isDisplayTextConverter)
				: base(isDisplayTextConverter)
			{
			}

			protected override object ConvertHelper(bool convertingBack, object value, Type targetType, ValueEditor valueEditor, IFormatProvider formatProvider, string format)
			{
				XamComboEditor xamComboEditor = valueEditor as XamComboEditor;
				ComboBoxItemsProvider comboBoxItemsProvider = xamComboEditor?.ItemsProvider;
				if (comboBoxItemsProvider != null)
				{
					int selectedIndex = xamComboEditor.SelectedIndex;
					if (!convertingBack)
					{
						string text = comboBoxItemsProvider.GetDisplayTextFromDataValue(value, selectedIndex);
						if (_isDisplayTextConverter && string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && (value == null || DBNull.Value == value))
						{
							text = xamComboEditor.NullText;
						}
						return text;
					}
					string text2 = value as string;
					if (text2 == null)
					{
						text2 = ((value != null) ? value.ToString() : string.Empty);
					}
					if (comboBoxItemsProvider.GetDataValueFromDisplayText(text2, partialMatch: false, selectedIndex, out var dataValue))
					{
						if (dataValue != null && !targetType.IsInstanceOfType(dataValue))
						{
							return CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(dataValue, targetType, formatProvider, format);
						}
						return dataValue;
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertHelper(convertingBack, value, targetType, valueEditor, formatProvider, format);
			}
		}

			{

				}
			}
		}

		private class MemberPathEvaluator
		{
			private string _memberPath;

			private bool _isMemberPathEmpty;

			private Type _componentType;

			private PropertyDescriptor _pd;

			public MemberPathEvaluator(string memberPath)
			{
				_memberPath = memberPath;
				_isMemberPathEmpty = string.IsNullOrEmpty(memberPath);
			}

			public bool GetMemberValue(object dataItem, out object val)
			{
				val = null;
				if (_isMemberPathEmpty)
				{
					val = dataItem;
					return true;
				}
				if (dataItem != null)
				{
					if (null == _componentType || !_componentType.IsInstanceOfType(dataItem))
					{
						_componentType = dataItem.GetType();
						try
						{
							_pd = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(_componentType)?.Find(_memberPath, ignoreCase: false);
						}
						catch
						{
							_pd = null;
						}
					}
					if (_pd != null)
					{
						try
						{
							val = _pd.GetValue(dataItem);
							return true;
						}
						catch
						{
							_pd = null;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public bool GetMemberValueAsString(object dataItem, out string val)
			{
				val = null;
				object val2;
				bool memberValue = GetMemberValue(dataItem, out val2);
				if (memberValue)
				{
					val = ((val2 == null || val2 is string) ? ((string)val2) : val2.ToString());
				}
				return memberValue;
			}
		}

			{

					_itemsProvider.DirtyCachedItems();
				}
			}

			internal void Dispose()
			{
				HookUnhookDataItems(hook: false);
			}

			internal void HookUnhookDataItems(bool hook)
			{
				if (_items != null)
				{
					ItemHolder[] items = _items;
					foreach (ItemHolder itemHolder in items)

					}
				}
			}

			{
				if (managerType == typeof(PropertyChangedEventManager))
				{
					OnDataItemPropertyChanged(sender, e as PropertyChangedEventArgs);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private class IndexComparer : IComparer, IComparer<int>
		{
			private CachedInfo _cachedInfo;

			private bool _compareByDisplayText;

			private ItemHolder[] _items;

			public IndexComparer(CachedInfo cachedInfo, bool compareByDisplayText)
			{
				_cachedInfo = cachedInfo;
				_items = cachedInfo._items;
				_compareByDisplayText = compareByDisplayText;
			}

			public int Compare(object xObj, object yObj)
			{
				int x = (int)xObj;
				int y = (int)yObj;
				return Compare(x, y);
			}

			public int Compare(int x, int y)
			{
				ItemHolder itemHolder = _items[x];
				ItemHolder itemHolder2 = _items[y];
				if (_compareByDisplayText)
				{
					return CompareDisplayText(_cachedInfo._itemsProvider, itemHolder._displayText, itemHolder2._displayText);
				}
				return CompareHelper(_cachedInfo, itemHolder._dataValue, itemHolder2._dataValue, _cachedInfo._compareDataValuesAsText);
			}

			internal static int CompareHelper(CachedInfo cacheInfo, object x, object y, bool compareAsText)
			{
				IComparer valueComparer = cacheInfo._itemsProvider.ValueComparer;
				if (valueComparer != null)
				{
					return valueComparer.Compare(x, y);
				}
				if (x == null || DBNull.Value == x)
				{
					if (y == null || DBNull.Value == y)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return -1;
				}
				if (y == null || DBNull.Value == y)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (compareAsText)
				{
					string strA = x.ToString();
					string strB = y.ToString();
					return string.CompareOrdinal(strA, strB);
				}
				return Comparer<object>.Default.Compare(x, y);
			}

			public static int CompareDisplayText(ComboBoxItemsProvider itemsProvider, string x, string y)
			{
				return itemsProvider.DisplayTextComparer?.Compare(x, y) ?? string.Compare(x, y, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}

			public static object ConvertDataValue(CachedInfo cacheInfo, object value, Type targetType)
			{
				if (targetType == typeof(string) && value != null)
				{
					return value.ToString();
				}
				return CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, targetType, null, null);
			}

			public static bool DataValueEquals(CachedInfo cacheInfo, object x, object y)
			{
				IComparer valueComparer = cacheInfo._itemsProvider.ValueComparer;
				if (valueComparer != null)
				{
					return valueComparer.Compare(x, y) == 0;
				}
				if (x != null && y != null && x.GetType() == y.GetType())
				{
					return object.Equals(x, y);
				}
				return CompareHelper(cacheInfo, x, y, compareAsText: true) == 0;
			}

			public static bool DisplayTextEquals(ComboBoxItemsProvider itemsProvider, string x, string y)
			{
				return CompareDisplayText(itemsProvider, x, y) == 0;
			}

			public static bool DisplayTextEquals(ComboBoxItemsProvider itemsProvider, string searchText, string overallText, bool partial)
			{
				if (partial)
				{
					if (searchText.Length > overallText.Length)
					{
						return false;
					}
					overallText = overallText.Substring(0, searchText.Length);
				}
				return DisplayTextEquals(itemsProvider, searchText, overallText);
			}
		}

		private void DirtyCachedItems()
		{
			if (!base.Dispatcher.CheckAccess())
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(DirtyCachedItems));
				return;
			}
			if (_cachedInfo != null)
			{
				_cachedInfo.Dispose();
				_cachedInfo = null;
			}
			SetValue(VersionProperty, 1 + (int)GetValue(VersionProperty));
		}

		private bool FindItemHolderFromDataValueHelper(object dataValue, int preferredIndex, out ItemHolder itemHolder)
		{
			itemHolder = null;
			if (!VerifyCachedItems())
			{
				return false;
			}
			CachedInfo cachedInfo = _cachedInfo;
			bool flag = cachedInfo._canUseBinarySearch;
			if (flag && null != cachedInfo._compareType && !cachedInfo._compareDataValuesAsText && dataValue != null && DBNull.Value != dataValue)
			{
				object obj = IndexComparer.ConvertDataValue(cachedInfo, dataValue, cachedInfo._compareType);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					dataValue = obj;
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			ItemHolder[] items = cachedInfo._items;
			if (preferredIndex >= 0 && preferredIndex < items.Length)
			{
				ItemHolder itemHolder2 = items[preferredIndex];
				if (IndexComparer.DataValueEquals(cachedInfo, dataValue, itemHolder2._dataValue))
				{
					itemHolder = itemHolder2;
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				int[] dataValueIndex = cachedInfo._dataValueIndex;
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = items.Length - 1;
				while (num <= num2)
				{
					int num3 = (num + num2) / 2;
					ItemHolder itemHolder3 = items[dataValueIndex[num3]];
					int num4 = IndexComparer.CompareHelper(cachedInfo, dataValue, itemHolder3._dataValue, cachedInfo._compareDataValuesAsText);
					if (num4 == 0)
					{
						itemHolder = itemHolder3;
						break;
					}
					if (num4 < 0)
					{
						num2 = num3 - 1;
					}
					else
					{
						num = num3 + 1;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (ItemHolder itemHolder4 in items)
				{
					if (IndexComparer.DataValueEquals(cachedInfo, dataValue, itemHolder4._dataValue))
					{
						itemHolder = itemHolder4;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool FindItemHolderFromDisplayTextHelper(string displayText, bool partial, int startIndex, int preferredIndex, out ItemHolder itemHolder)
		{
			itemHolder = null;
			if (!VerifyCachedItems())
			{
				return false;
			}
			ItemHolder[] items = _cachedInfo._items;
			if (preferredIndex >= startIndex && preferredIndex < items.Length)
			{
				ItemHolder itemHolder2 = items[preferredIndex];
				if (IndexComparer.DisplayTextEquals(this, displayText, itemHolder2._displayText, partial))
				{
					itemHolder = itemHolder2;
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (_cachedInfo._canUseBinarySearch)
			{
				int[] displayTextIndex = _cachedInfo._displayTextIndex;
				int num = startIndex;
				int num2 = items.Length - 1;
				int i = (num + num2) / 2;
				while (num <= num2)
				{
					i = (num + num2) / 2;
					ItemHolder itemHolder3 = items[displayTextIndex[i]];
					int num3 = IndexComparer.CompareDisplayText(this, displayText, itemHolder3._displayText);
					if (num3 == 0)
					{
						itemHolder = itemHolder3;
						break;
					}
					if (num3 < 0)
					{
						num2 = i - 1;
					}
					else
					{
						num = i + 1;
					}
				}
				if (itemHolder == null && partial)
				{
					for (; i < items.Length; i++)
					{
						ItemHolder itemHolder4 = items[displayTextIndex[i]];
						if (IndexComparer.DisplayTextEquals(this, displayText, itemHolder4._displayText, partial: true))
						{
							itemHolder = itemHolder4;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}

	internal class WeakBindingListChangedHandler<TOwner> where TOwner : class
	{
		private Action<TOwner, object, ListChangedEventArgs> _handler;

		private WeakReference _owner;

		private IBindingList _bindingList;

		internal WeakBindingListChangedHandler(Action<TOwner, object, ListChangedEventArgs> handler, TOwner owner, IBindingList bindingList)
		{
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(bindingList);
			CoreUtilities.ValidateNotNull(handler);
			_owner = new WeakReference(owner);
			_bindingList = bindingList;
			_handler = handler;
			bindingList.ListChanged += OnListChanged;
		}

		private void OnListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			TOwner val = (TOwner)CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_owner);
			if (val != null)
			{
				_handler(val, sender, e);
			}
			else
			{
				Unhook();
			}
		}

		internal void Unhook()
		{
			_bindingList.ListChanged -= OnListChanged;
		}
	}

		{
			private WeakSet<XamComboEditor> _comboEditors = new WeakSet<XamComboEditor>();

			[ThreadStatic]
			private static WeakDictionary<CollectionView, ComboBox_ItemsSourceWrapper> _CachedWrappers;

			private static readonly FieldInfo ItemCollectionCollectionViewField;

			private static readonly Type CollectionViewProxyType;

			private static readonly FieldInfo CollectionViewProxyIndexerField;

			private static readonly Type IndexedEnumerableType;

			private static readonly MethodInfo InvalidateEnumeratorMethod;

			private static bool _canInvalidateCollectionViewProxy;

			private WeakSet<ComboBox> _combos = new WeakSet<ComboBox>();

			static ComboBox_ItemsSourceWrapper()
			{
				try
				{
					ItemCollectionCollectionViewField = typeof(ItemCollection).GetField("_collectionView", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
					CollectionViewProxyType = Type.GetType("MS.Internal.Data.CollectionViewProxy, " + typeof(CollectionView).Assembly.FullName, throwOnError: false);
					CollectionViewProxyIndexerField = ((CollectionViewProxyType == null) ? null : CollectionViewProxyType.GetField("_indexer", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic));
					IndexedEnumerableType = Type.GetType("MS.Internal.Data.IndexedEnumerable, " + typeof(CollectionView).Assembly.FullName, throwOnError: false);
					InvalidateEnumeratorMethod = ((IndexedEnumerableType == null) ? null : IndexedEnumerableType.GetMethod("InvalidateEnumerator", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic));
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				_canInvalidateCollectionViewProxy = InvalidateEnumeratorMethod != null && CollectionViewProxyIndexerField != null && ItemCollectionCollectionViewField != null;
			}

			private ComboBox_ItemsSourceWrapper(XamComboEditor comboEditor, CollectionView itemsSource)
				: base(itemsSource)
			{
				Utils.ValidateNull(comboEditor);
				_comboEditors.Add(comboEditor);
			}

			public static ComboBox_ItemsSourceWrapper Create(XamComboEditor comboEditor, CollectionView itemsSource)
			{
				ComboBox_ItemsSourceWrapper value = null;
				if (_CachedWrappers == null)
				{
					_CachedWrappers = new WeakDictionary<CollectionView, ComboBox_ItemsSourceWrapper>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: true, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: true);
				}
				else
				{
					_CachedWrappers.TryGetValue(itemsSource, out value);
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = new ComboBox_ItemsSourceWrapper(comboEditor, itemsSource);
					_CachedWrappers[itemsSource] = value;
				}
				else
				{
					value._comboEditors.Add(comboEditor);
				}
				return value;
			}

			protected override void OnSourceCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				foreach (XamComboEditor comboEditor in _comboEditors)
				{
					if (comboEditor != null)
					{
						bool isInitializingComboBox = comboEditor._isInitializingComboBox;
						comboEditor._isInitializingComboBox = true;
						try
						{
							base.OnSourceCollectionChanged(sender, e);
						}
						finally
						{
							comboEditor._isInitializingComboBox = isInitializingComboBox;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			protected override void RaiseCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				foreach (XamComboEditor comboEditor in _comboEditors)
				{
					if (comboEditor != null && comboEditor._lastComboBox != null)
					{
						_combos.Add(comboEditor._lastComboBox);
					}
				}
				foreach (ComboBox combo in _combos)
				{
					InvalidateEnumerator(combo.Items);
				}
				base.RaiseCollectionChanged(e);
			}

			private static void InvalidateEnumerator(ItemCollection ic)
			{
				if (!_canInvalidateCollectionViewProxy)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					if (ItemCollectionCollectionViewField.GetValue(ic) is ICollectionView collectionView && CollectionViewProxyType.IsAssignableFrom(collectionView.GetType()))
					{
						object value = CollectionViewProxyIndexerField.GetValue(collectionView);
						if (value != null && IndexedEnumerableType.IsAssignableFrom(value.GetType()))
						{
							InvalidateEnumeratorMethod.Invoke(value, null);
						}
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_canInvalidateCollectionViewProxy = false;
				}
				catch (MemberAccessException)
				{
					_canInvalidateCollectionViewProxy = false;
				}
			}

			ICollectionView ICollectionViewFactory.CreateView()
			{
				return this;
			}

		private class ImeEventHandler
		{
			internal readonly WeakReference _editor;

			internal bool _textInputPending;

			internal int _bypassedOnTextChanged;

			internal ImeEventHandler(XamComboEditor editor)
			{
				_editor = new WeakReference(editor);
			}

			private XamComboEditor GetEditorHelper()
			{
				return (XamComboEditor)CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_editor);
			}

			internal void Hook(TextBox textBox)
			{
				TextCompositionManager.AddPreviewTextInputStartHandler(textBox, OnTextBox_TextInputStart);
				TextCompositionManager.AddPreviewTextInputHandler(textBox, OnTextBox_TextInput);
			}

			internal void Unhook(TextBox textBox)
			{
				TextCompositionManager.RemovePreviewTextInputStartHandler(textBox, OnTextBox_TextInputStart);
				TextCompositionManager.RemovePreviewTextInputHandler(textBox, OnTextBox_TextInput);
			}

			internal void OnTextBox_TextInputStart(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs args)
			{
				XamComboEditor editorHelper = GetEditorHelper();
				if (editorHelper != null)
				{
					_textInputPending = true;
				}
			}

			internal void OnTextBox_TextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs args)
			{
				if (_textInputPending)
				{
					_textInputPending = false;
					XamComboEditor editorHelper = GetEditorHelper();
					if (editorHelper != null && _bypassedOnTextChanged > 0)
					{
						_bypassedOnTextChanged = 0;
						editorHelper.ProcessTextBox_TextChanged();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		static XamComboEditor()
		{
			ExecutingCommandEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ExecutingCommand", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<ExecutingCommandEventArgs>), typeof(XamComboEditor));
			ExecutedCommandEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ExecutedCommand", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<ExecutedCommandEventArgs>), typeof(XamComboEditor));
			DropDownOpenedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("DropDownOpened", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<RoutedEventArgs>), typeof(XamComboEditor));
			DropDownClosedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("DropDownClosed", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(EventHandler<RoutedEventArgs>), typeof(XamComboEditor));
			EditPortionWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("EditPortionWidth", typeof(double), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN));
			ComboBoxStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ComboBoxStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, OnComboBoxStyleChanged, null));
			ComboEditorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ComboEditor", typeof(XamComboEditor), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null));
			ComboEditorComboBoxStyleKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(XamComboEditor), "ComboEditorComboBoxStyleKey");
			DisplayValuePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("DisplayValue", typeof(object), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None));
			DisplayValueProperty = DisplayValuePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			DisplayValueSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DisplayValueSource", typeof(DisplayValueSource), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(DisplayValueSource.DisplayText, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, OnDisplayValueSourceChanged));
			DisplayValueTemplateKey = new StaticPropertyResourceKey(typeof(XamComboEditor), "DisplayValueTemplateKey");
			DropDownButtonDisplayModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DropDownButtonDisplayMode", typeof(DropDownButtonDisplayMode), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(DropDownButtonDisplayMode.MouseOver, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null));
			DropDownButtonStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DropDownButtonStyle", typeof(Style), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null));
			DropDownButtonVisibilityPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("DropDownButtonVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(Visibility.Collapsed, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null));
			DropDownButtonVisibilityProperty = DropDownButtonVisibilityPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			DropDownResizeModeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DropDownResizeMode", typeof(PopupResizeMode), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(PopupResizeMode.Both, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null));
			IsDropDownOpenProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsDropDownOpen", typeof(bool), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, OnIsDropDownOpenChanged, OnCoerceIsDropDownOpen));
			IsEditableProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsEditable", typeof(bool), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, ValueEditor.OnVisualStatePropertyChanged));
			ItemsProviderProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemsProvider", typeof(ComboBoxItemsProvider), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, OnItemsProviderChanged, OnItemsProviderCoerced));
			ItemsSourceProperty = ComboBoxItemsProvider.ItemsSourceProperty.AddOwner(typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnItemsSourceChanged));
			DisplayMemberPathProperty = ComboBoxItemsProvider.DisplayMemberPathProperty.AddOwner(typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnDisplayMemberPathChanged));
			ValuePathProperty = ComboBoxItemsProvider.ValuePathProperty.AddOwner(typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnValuePathChanged));
			LimitToListProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("LimitToList", typeof(bool), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnLimitToListChanged));
			MaxDropDownHeightProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MaxDropDownHeight", typeof(double), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ComboBox.MaxDropDownHeightProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null), ValidateMaxDropDownHeight);
			MaxDropDownWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MaxDropDownWidth", typeof(double), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.PositiveInfinity, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null), ValidateMaxDropDownWidth);
			MinDropDownWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MinDropDownWidth", typeof(double), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null), ValidateMinDropDownWidth);
			MinDropDownWidthResolvedPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("MinDropDownWidthResolved", typeof(double), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null));
			MinDropDownWidthResolvedProperty = MinDropDownWidthResolvedPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			PreDropDownAreaTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PreDropDownAreaTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			PostDropDownAreaTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PostDropDownAreaTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			SelectedIndexProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SelectedIndex", typeof(int), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(-1, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Journal, OnSelectedIndexChanged, OnCoerceSelectedIndex));
			SelectedItemProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SelectedItem", typeof(object), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.BindsTwoWayByDefault, OnSelectedItemChanged, OnCoerceSelectedItem));
			SelectedItemChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("SelectedItemChanged", RoutingStrategy.Bubble, typeof(RoutedPropertyChangedEventHandler<object>), typeof(XamComboEditor));
			TextAlignmentResolvedPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("TextAlignmentResolved", typeof(TextAlignment), typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(TextAlignment.Left, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null));
			TextAlignmentResolvedProperty = TextAlignmentResolvedPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ValueEditor.ValueTypeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(object)));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(XamComboEditor)));
			Control.HorizontalContentAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnHorizontalContentAlignmentChanged));
			KeyboardNavigation.TabNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.Local));
			KeyboardNavigation.ControlTabNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.None));
			KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.None));
			Control.VerticalContentAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamComboEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(VerticalAlignment.Center));
			DependencyPropertyDescriptor dependencyPropertyDescriptor = DependencyPropertyDescriptor.FromName("IsTextSearchCaseSensitive", typeof(ComboBox), typeof(ComboBox));
			if (dependencyPropertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				s_IsTextSearchCaseSensitiveProperty = dependencyPropertyDescriptor.DependencyProperty;
			}
			Infragistics.Themes.ThemeManager.RegisterControl(typeof(XamComboEditor));
		}

		public XamComboEditor()
		{
			try
			{
				_license = LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(XamComboEditor), this) as UltraLicense;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
			}
			InitializeCachedPropertyValues();
		}

		protected virtual void OnExecutingCommand(ExecutingCommandEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEventHelper(args);
		}

		internal bool RaiseExecutingCommand(ExecutingCommandEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = ExecutingCommandEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnExecutingCommand(args);
			return !args.Cancel;
		}

		protected virtual void OnExecutedCommand(ExecutedCommandEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEventHelper(args);
		}

			args.Source = this;

		public override bool CanEditType(Type type)
		{
			return type == typeof(string);
		}

		public override bool CanRenderType(Type type)
		{
			return type == typeof(string);
		}

		internal override bool ConvertTextToValueHelper(string text, out object value, out Exception error)
		{
			if (!base.ConvertTextToValueHelper(text, out value, out error))
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					ComboBoxItemsProvider itemsProvider = ItemsProvider;
					if (itemsProvider != null)
					{
						int selectedIndex = SelectedIndex;
						object foundListItem;
						int num = itemsProvider.FindListItemFromDisplayText(text, partial: false, 0, selectedIndex, out foundListItem);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override void InitializeValueProperties()
		{
			if (Utils.IsValuePropertySet(SelectedIndexProperty, this) && SelectedIndex >= 0)
			{
				CoerceValue(SelectedIndexProperty);
				SyncValueProperties(SelectedIndexProperty, SelectedIndex);
			}
			else if (Utils.IsValuePropertySet(SelectedItemProperty, this) && SelectedItem != null)
			{
				SyncValueProperties(SelectedItemProperty, SelectedItem);
			}
			else
			{
				base.InitializeValueProperties();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool IsExtentBasedOnValue(Orientation orientation)
		{
			if (orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override string OnCoerceText(string text)
		{
			string result = base.OnCoerceText(text);
			OnCoerceValueProperty(ValueEditor.TextProperty, text);
			return result;
		}

		protected override object OnCoerceValue(object val)
		{
			object result = base.OnCoerceValue(val);
			OnCoerceValueProperty(ValueEditor.ValueProperty, val);
			return result;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new XamComboEditorAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnEditModeStarted(EditModeStartedEventArgs args)
		{
			InitializeComboBoxValue(onlyUpdateWhenInEditMode: false);
			base.OnEditModeStarted(args);
		}

		protected override void OnFocusSiteChanged()
		{
			base.OnFocusSiteChanged();
			ComboBox lastComboBox = _lastComboBox;
			_lastComboBox = base.FocusSite as ComboBox;
			OnComboBoxChanged(lastComboBox);
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			CoerceValue(ItemsProviderProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.IsInEditMode && base.IsReadOnly)
			{
				switch (e.Key)
				{
				case Key.Prior:
				case Key.Next:
				case Key.End:
				case Key.Home:
				case Key.Left:
				case Key.Up:
				case Key.Right:
				case Key.Down:
				case Key.F2:
				case Key.Oem5:
					e.Handled = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			base.OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			DependencyProperty property = e.Property;
			if (UIElement.IsMouseOverProperty == property || DropDownButtonDisplayModeProperty == property || ValueEditor.IsInEditModeProperty == property)
			{
				UpdateDropDownButtonVisibility();
			}
			else if (FrameworkElement.ActualWidthProperty == property || MinDropDownWidthProperty == property || EditPortionWidthProperty == property)
			{
				UpdateMinDropDownWidthResolved();
			}
			else if (TextEditorBase.DisplayTextProperty == property)
			{
				InitializeDisplayValue();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnValueTypeChanged(Type newType)
		{
			base.OnValueTypeChanged(newType);
			CoerceValue(ItemsProviderProperty);
		}

		protected override void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			base.SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			if (IsEditable && base.IsEditingAllowed)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Editable", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Uneditable", useTransitions);
			}
		}

		internal override bool SyncValuePropertiesOverride(DependencyProperty prop, object newValue, out Exception error)
		{
			error = null;
			ValueChangeSource source;
			if (ValueEditor.ValueProperty == prop)
			{
				source = ValueChangeSource.Value;
			}
			else if (ValueEditor.TextProperty == prop)
			{
				source = ValueChangeSource.Text;
			}
			else if (SelectedItemProperty == prop)
			{
				source = ValueChangeSource.SelectedItem;
			}
			else
			{
				if (SelectedIndexProperty != prop)
				{
					return base.SyncValuePropertiesOverride(prop, newValue, out error);
				}
				source = ValueChangeSource.SelectedIndex;
			}
			OnValueChanged_SyncProperties(source, newValue, calledFromSyncValuePropertiesOverride: true);
			return true;
		}

		internal override void RaiseDropDownClosedIfPending()
		{
			if (_isClosePending)
			{
				_isClosePending = false;
				RaiseDropDownClosed(new RoutedEventArgs());
			}
		}

		internal override bool ShouldToggleDropDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (!IsEditable)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (GetTemplateChild("PART_Content") ?? GetTemplateChild("PART_TextBlock") ?? GetTemplateChild("TextBlock")) as FrameworkElement;
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					frameworkElement = Utilities.GetParent(frameworkElement) as FrameworkElement;
				}
				if (frameworkElement != null && Utils.IsMouseOverElement(frameworkElement, e))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					ComboBox comboBox = ComboBox;
					if (comboBox != null)
					{
						if (comboBox.ActualWidth <= 0.0 || comboBox.ActualHeight <= 0.0)
						{
							UpdateLayout();
						}
						if (Utils.IsMouseOverElement(comboBox, e))
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				flag = base.ShouldToggleDropDown(e);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected override bool ValidateCurrentValue(out Exception error)
		{
			if (!base.ValidateCurrentValue(out error))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (LimitToList && SelectedIndex < 0 && (!Utils.IsValueEmpty(base.Value) || !Utils.IsValueEmpty(base.Text)))
			{
				error = new Exception(Utils.GetString("LMSG_ItemDoesNotExist", base.Value));
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool ValidateFocusSite(object focusSite, out Exception errorMessage)
		{
			if (!base.ValidateFocusSite(focusSite, out errorMessage))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(focusSite is ComboBox))
			{
				errorMessage = new NotSupportedException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_5", focusSite.GetType().Name));
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ValidateValue(object value, out Exception error)
		{
			if (!base.ValidateValue(value, out error))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (LimitToList && !Utils.IsValueEmpty(value))
			{
				ComboBoxItemsProvider itemsProvider = ItemsProvider;
				if (itemsProvider == null || itemsProvider.FindListItemFromDataValue(value, -1, out var _) < 0)
				{
					error = new Exception(Utils.GetString("LMSG_ItemDoesNotExist", value));
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void OnItemsProviderChanged(DependencyObject dependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamComboEditor xamComboEditor = (XamComboEditor)dependencyObject;
			ComboBoxItemsProvider comboBoxItemsProvider = (ComboBoxItemsProvider)e.NewValue;
			xamComboEditor.VerifyInternalItemsProvider(fromItemsProviderCoerced: false, comboBoxItemsProvider);
			xamComboEditor.InitializeComboBoxItemsSource(xamComboEditor.ComboBox);
			Dispatcher dispatcher = xamComboEditor.Dispatcher;
			if (dispatcher != null && xamComboEditor.SupportsAsyncOperations)
			{
				dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.DataBind, new Utils.MethodInvoker(xamComboEditor.OnItemsProviderItemsChanged));
			}
			else
			{
				xamComboEditor.OnItemsProviderItemsChanged();
			}
			if (comboBoxItemsProvider != null)
			{
				xamComboEditor._itemsProviderVersionTracker = new PropertyValueTracker(comboBoxItemsProvider, ComboBoxItemsProvider.VersionProperty, xamComboEditor.OnItemsProviderItemsChanged, callAsynchronously: true);
			}
			else
			{
				xamComboEditor._itemsProviderVersionTracker = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnItemsProviderItemsChanged()
		{
			if (Utilities.DisconnectedItem != null && base.DataContext == Utilities.DisconnectedItem)
			{
				InvalidateProperty(ValueEditor.ValueProperty);
			}
			object value = base.Value;
			if (!Utils.IsValueEmpty(value))
			{
				SyncValueProperties(ValueEditor.ValueProperty, value);
				return;
			}
			if (!Utils.IsValueEmpty(base.Text))
			{
				SyncValueProperties(ValueEditor.TextProperty, base.Text);
				return;
			}
			if (_selectedItemCoerced)
			{
				CoerceValue(SelectedItemProperty);
			}
			else if (_selectedIndexCoerced)
			{
				CoerceValue(SelectedIndexProperty);
			}
			value = base.Value;
			if (value == null && base.IsInitialized)
			{
				SyncValueProperties(ValueEditor.ValueProperty, null);
			}
		}

		private static object OnItemsProviderCoerced(DependencyObject dependencyObject, object valueAsObject)
		{
			XamComboEditor xamComboEditor = (XamComboEditor)dependencyObject;
			xamComboEditor.VerifyInternalItemsProvider(fromItemsProviderCoerced: true, valueAsObject as ComboBoxItemsProvider);
			if (xamComboEditor._internalItemsProvider != null)
			{
				return xamComboEditor._internalItemsProvider;
			}
			return valueAsObject;
		}

		{

			xamComboEditor.VerifyInternalItemsProvider(fromItemsProviderCoerced: false, xamComboEditor.ItemsProvider);
		}

		private void VerifyInternalItemsProvider(bool fromItemsProviderCoerced, ComboBoxItemsProvider currentItemsProvider)
		{
			if (!base.IsInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable itemsSource = ItemsSource;
			if ((!fromItemsProviderCoerced || currentItemsProvider == null) && _internalItemsProvider != null && itemsSource != null && _internalItemsProvider.ItemsSource == itemsSource)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (currentItemsProvider == null || currentItemsProvider == _internalItemsProvider)
			{
				if (itemsSource != null)
				{
					_internalItemsProvider = CreateInternalItemsProvider();
					if (!fromItemsProviderCoerced)
					{
						CoerceValue(ItemsProviderProperty);
					}
					return;
				}
				Type valueType = base.ValueType;
				if (valueType != null && valueType.IsValueType)
				{
					Type underlyingType = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(valueType);
					if (underlyingType != null && underlyingType.IsEnum)
					{
						if (_internalItemsProviderEnumType != valueType)
						{
							_internalItemsProvider = CreateInternalEnumItemsProvider(valueType, underlyingType);
						}
						if (_internalItemsProviderEnumType != null)
						{
							if (!fromItemsProviderCoerced)
							{
								CoerceValue(ItemsProviderProperty);
							}
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				_internalItemsProviderEnumType = null;
				_internalItemsProvider = null;
				if (!fromItemsProviderCoerced && !IsClone)
				{
					ClearValue(ItemsProviderProperty);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				_internalItemsProviderEnumType = null;
				_internalItemsProvider = null;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateMinDropDownWidthResolved()
		{
			double num = MinDropDownWidth;
			if (0.0 == num)
			{
				double editPortionWidth = EditPortionWidth;
				if (editPortionWidth > 0.0)
				{
					num = editPortionWidth;
					ComboBox comboBox = ComboBox;
					if (comboBox != null)
					{
						Thickness margin = comboBox.Margin;
						num += margin.Left + margin.Right + 7.0;
					}
				}
			}
			SetValue(MinDropDownWidthResolvedPropertyKey, num);
		}

		private static object OnCoerceSelectedIndex(DependencyObject dependencyObject, object valueAsObject)

			bool selectedIndexCoerced = false;
			if (xamComboEditor.IsInitialized)
			{
				int num2 = xamComboEditor.ItemsProvider?.Items.Count ?? 0;
				if (num < 0 || num >= num2)

					selectedIndexCoerced = num >= 0;
					num = -1;
				}
			}
			xamComboEditor._selectedIndexCoerced = selectedIndexCoerced;
			xamComboEditor.OnCoerceValueProperty(SelectedIndexProperty, num);

		}

			}
		}

		private ComboBoxItemsProvider CreateInternalEnumItemsProvider(Type valueType, Type enumType)
		{
			if (base.Host == null)
			{
				return CreateAndInitializeInternalEnumItemsProvider(valueType, enumType);
			}
			if (_EnumProviderMap == null)
			{
				_EnumProviderMap = new WeakDictionary<Type, ComboBoxItemsProvider>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: false, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: true);
			}
			if (!_EnumProviderMap.TryGetValue(valueType, out var value) || value == null)
			{
				value = CreateAndInitializeInternalEnumItemsProvider(valueType, enumType);
				_EnumProviderMap[valueType] = value;
			}
			else
			{
				_internalItemsProviderEnumType = valueType;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private ComboBoxItemsProvider CreateAndInitializeInternalEnumItemsProvider(Type valueType, Type enumType)
		{
			ComboBoxItemsProvider comboBoxItemsProvider = new ComboBoxItemsProvider();
			ObservableCollection<ComboBoxDataItem> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<ComboBoxDataItem>();
			_internalItemsProviderEnumType = valueType;
			Dictionary<object, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, string>();
			FieldInfo[] fields = enumType.GetFields(BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
			bool flag = false;
			int i = 0;
			for (int num = fields.Length; i < num; i++)
			{
				FieldInfo fieldInfo = fields[i];
				object value = fieldInfo.GetValue(null);
				object[] customAttributes = fieldInfo.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: false);
				string value2 = null;
				if (customAttributes != null)
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					for (int j = 0; j < customAttributes.Length; j++)
					{
						if (customAttributes[j] is ObsoleteAttribute)
						{
							flag2 = true;
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
						if (customAttributes[j] is DescriptionAttribute descriptionAttribute)
						{
							value2 = descriptionAttribute.Description;
						}
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2))
				{
					value2 = fieldInfo.Name;
				}
				dictionary[value] = value2;
			}
			TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(valueType);
			if (converter != null)
			{
				HashSet<object> hashSet = (flag ? new HashSet<object>() : null);
				foreach (object standardValue in converter.GetStandardValues())
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						if (hashSet.Contains(standardValue))
						{
							continue;
						}
						hashSet.Add(standardValue);
					}
					string value3 = null;
					if (standardValue == null)
					{
						if (converter.CanConvertTo(typeof(string)))
						{
							try
							{
								value3 = converter.ConvertTo(null, typeof(string)) as string;
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value3))
						{
							value3 = Utils.GetString("Nullable_Enum_NullValue_Literal");
						}
						observableCollection.Add(new ComboBoxDataItem(null, value3));
						continue;
					}
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(standardValue, out value3))
					{
						if (converter.CanConvertTo(typeof(string)))
						{
							try
							{
								value3 = converter.ConvertTo(standardValue, typeof(string)) as string;
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value3))
						{
							value3 = standardValue.ToString();
						}
					}
					observableCollection.Add(new ComboBoxDataItem(standardValue, value3));
				}
			}
			comboBoxItemsProvider.ItemsSource = new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<ComboBoxDataItem>(observableCollection);
			return comboBoxItemsProvider;
		}

		private ComboBoxItemsProvider CreateInternalItemsProvider()
		{
			IEnumerable itemsSource = ItemsSource;
			if (itemsSource == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (base.Host == null)
			{
				return CreateAndInitializeNewItemsProvider();
			}
			if (_ItemsProviderMap == null)
			{
				_ItemsProviderMap = new WeakDictionary<ItemsProviderKey, ComboBoxItemsProvider>(manageKeysAsWeakReferences: false, manageValuesAsWeakReferences: true);
			}
			ItemsProviderKey key = new ItemsProviderKey(DisplayMemberPath, ValuePath, itemsSource);
			if (!_ItemsProviderMap.TryGetValue(key, out var value) || value == null)
			{
				value = CreateAndInitializeNewItemsProvider();
				_ItemsProviderMap[key] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void OnComboBox_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ComboBox comboBox = ComboBox;
			if (comboBox == null || !base.IsInEditMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!base.IsReadOnly)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				int selectedIndex = comboBox.SelectedIndex;
				if (_lastComboBoxTextBox != null && selectedIndex >= 0)
				{
					ComboBoxItemsProvider itemsProvider = ItemsProvider;
					if (itemsProvider != null)
					{
						string displayText = itemsProvider.GetDisplayText(comboBox.SelectedItem, selectedIndex);
						if (displayText != _lastComboBoxTextBox.Text)
						{
							flag = true;
							_preferredIndexToMatch = selectedIndex;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					OnValueChanged_SyncProperties(ValueChangeSource.ComboBoxSelectedIndex, comboBox.SelectedIndex, calledFromSyncValuePropertiesOverride: false);
					if (!_bypassNextComboTextChanged)
					{
						_bypassNextComboTextChanged = true;
						base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Utils.MethodInvoker(ClearBypassNextComboTextChanged));
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				comboBox.SelectedIndex = SelectedIndex;
			}
		}

		private void OnComboBoxChanged(ComboBox oldComboBox)
		{
			ComboBox comboBox = ComboBox;
			if (oldComboBox != null)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, EditPortionWidthProperty);
				oldComboBox.SelectionChanged -= OnComboBox_SelectionChanged;
				oldComboBox.DropDownOpened -= OnComboBox_DropDownOpened;
				oldComboBox.DropDownClosed -= OnComboBox_DropDownClosed;
				if (_itemTemplateSetOnComboBox)
				{
					_itemTemplateSetOnComboBox = false;
					oldComboBox.ClearValue(ItemsControl.ItemTemplateProperty);
				}
			}
			if (_lastComboBoxTextBox != null)
			{
				_lastComboBoxTextBox.SelectionChanged -= OnTextBox_SelectionChanged;
				_lastComboBoxTextBox.TextChanged -= OnTextBox_TextChanged;
				if (_imeEventHandler != null)
				{
					_imeEventHandler.Unhook(_lastComboBoxTextBox);
				}
				_lastComboBoxTextBox = null;
			}
			if (comboBox != null)
			{
				comboBox.SetValue(FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty, ComboBoxStyleKey);
				comboBox.ApplyTemplate();
				InitializeComboBoxItemsSource(comboBox);
				comboBox.SelectionChanged += OnComboBox_SelectionChanged;
				comboBox.DropDownOpened += OnComboBox_DropDownOpened;
				comboBox.DropDownClosed += OnComboBox_DropDownClosed;
				_lastComboBoxTextBox = Utilities.GetDescendantFromName(this, "PART_EditableTextBox") as TextBox;
				if (_lastComboBoxTextBox != null)
				{
					_lastComboBoxTextBox.SelectionChanged += OnTextBox_SelectionChanged;
					_lastComboBoxTextBox.TextChanged += OnTextBox_TextChanged;
					if (_imeEventHandler == null)
					{
						_imeEventHandler = new ImeEventHandler(this);
					}
					_imeEventHandler.Hook(_lastComboBoxTextBox);
				}
				Binding binding = Utilities.CreateBindingObject(FrameworkElement.ActualWidthProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, comboBox);
				SetBinding(EditPortionWidthProperty, binding);
				InitializeComboBoxItemTemplateHelper();
			}
			InitializeComboBoxValue(onlyUpdateWhenInEditMode: true);
		}

		private void OnTextBox_SelectionChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool inOnComboBoxSelectionChanged = _inOnComboBoxSelectionChanged;

			{

			}
		}

		{

		}

		private void ProcessTextBox_TextChanged()
		{
			if (_lastComboBoxTextBox != null && base.IsInEditMode && !base.IsReadOnly && (!_bypassNextComboTextChanged || base.Text != _lastComboBoxTextBox.Text))
			{
				if (_imeEventHandler != null && _imeEventHandler._textInputPending)
				{
					_imeEventHandler._bypassedOnTextChanged++;
				}
				else
				{
					OnValueChanged_SyncProperties(ValueChangeSource.ComboBoxText, _lastComboBoxTextBox.Text, calledFromSyncValuePropertiesOverride: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool? OnValueChanged_SyncPropertiesHelper(ValueChangeSource source, object value)
		{
			ComboBoxItemsProvider itemsProvider = ItemsProvider;

			int num = -1;

			{
				preferredIndex = _preferredIndexToMatch;
				_preferredIndexToMatch = -1;
			}
			int num2;
			switch (source)

					num = itemsProvider.FindListItemFromDataValue(obj, preferredIndex, out foundListItem);
					text = ((num < 0) ? itemsProvider.GetDisplayTextFromDataValue(value, preferredIndex) : itemsProvider.GetDisplayText(foundListItem, num));
				}
				else
				{
					ConvertValueToText(value, out text, out var _);
				}
				break;
			case ValueChangeSource.SelectedItem:
				if (itemsProvider != null)

					num = itemsProvider.GetItemIndex(value);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						foundListItem = value;
						obj = itemsProvider.GetDataValue(foundListItem, num);
						text = itemsProvider.GetDisplayText(foundListItem, num);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ValueChangeSource.SelectedIndex:
				if (itemsProvider != null)

					num = (int)value;
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						foundListItem = itemsProvider.GetItemAtIndex(num);
						obj = itemsProvider.GetDataValue(foundListItem, num);
						text = itemsProvider.GetDisplayText(foundListItem, num);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ValueChangeSource.ComboBoxSelectedIndex:
				flag = true;

					num = comboBox.SelectedIndex;
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						foundListItem = itemsProvider.GetItemAtIndex(num);
						obj = itemsProvider.GetDataValue(foundListItem, num);
						text = itemsProvider.GetDisplayText(foundListItem, num);
					}
					else if (_lastComboBoxTextBox != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_lastComboBoxTextBox.Text))
					{
						return OnValueChanged_SyncPropertiesHelper(ValueChangeSource.ComboBoxText, _lastComboBoxTextBox.Text);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ValueChangeSource.ComboBoxText:
				if (comboBox == null)

					goto case ValueChangeSource.Text;

				num2 = ((!comboBox.IsTextSearchEnabled) ? 1 : 0);
				goto IL_019e;
			case ValueChangeSource.Text:
				{
					num2 = 0;
					goto IL_019e;
				}
				IL_019e:

				if (num >= 0)

					foundListItem = itemsProvider.GetItemAtIndex(num);
					if (s_IsTextSearchCaseSensitiveProperty != null && _lastComboBox != null && (bool)_lastComboBox.GetValue(s_IsTextSearchCaseSensitiveProperty))
					{
						string displayText = itemsProvider.GetDisplayText(foundListItem, num);
						if (string.Compare(text, displayText, ignoreCase: false) == 0)
						{
							obj = itemsProvider.GetDataValue(foundListItem, num);
							text = displayText;
						}
						else
						{
							num = -1;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						obj = itemsProvider.GetDataValue(foundListItem, num);
						text = itemsProvider.GetDisplayText(foundListItem, num);
					}
				}

					flag2 = false;
				}
				else
				{
					obj = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? null : value);
					value = obj;
					if (ValueChangeSource.ComboBoxText != source)
					{
						return OnValueChanged_SyncPropertiesHelper(ValueChangeSource.Value, obj);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			Sync_SetValueHelper(SelectedIndexProperty, num, source);
			Sync_SetValueHelper(SelectedItemProperty, foundListItem, source);
			if (flag2 ?? true)
			{
				Sync_SetValueHelper(ValueEditor.ValueProperty, obj, source);
			}
			Sync_SetValueHelper(ValueEditor.TextProperty, text, source);

			if ((valueToDisplayTextConverter != null || (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2) && (value == null || DBNull.Value == value))) && ConvertValueToDisplayText(obj, out var text2, out var _))

		private void OnValueChanged_SyncProperties(ValueChangeSource source, object value, bool calledFromSyncValuePropertiesOverride)
		{
			if (_inOnValueChanged_SyncProperties || _isInitializingComboBox || !base.InternalIsInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			_inOnValueChanged_SyncProperties = true;
			BeginSyncValueProperties();
			try
			{
				bool? flag = OnValueChanged_SyncPropertiesHelper(source, value);
				if (!calledFromSyncValuePropertiesOverride && flag.HasValue && !flag.Value)
				{
					ValidateCurrentValue();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_inOnValueChanged_SyncProperties = false;
				EndSyncValueProperties();
			}
		}

		private void Sync_SetValueHelper(DependencyProperty prop, object value, ValueChangeSource changeSource)
		{
			DependencyProperty dependencyProperty = null;
			switch (changeSource)
			{
			case ValueChangeSource.Value:
				dependencyProperty = ValueEditor.ValueProperty;
				break;
			case ValueChangeSource.Text:
				dependencyProperty = ValueEditor.TextProperty;
				break;
			case ValueChangeSource.SelectedItem:
				dependencyProperty = SelectedItemProperty;
				break;
			case ValueChangeSource.SelectedIndex:
				dependencyProperty = SelectedIndexProperty;
				break;
			}
			if (prop != null && (prop == dependencyProperty || base.InternalIsInitializing))
			{
				object value2 = GetValue(prop);
				if ((value != null && value.GetType().IsPrimitive) ? Utils.AreEqual(value, value2) : (value == value2))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(this, prop, value);
		}

		private void InitializeComboBoxValue(bool onlyUpdateWhenInEditMode)
		{
			bool isInitializingComboBox = _isInitializingComboBox;
			_isInitializingComboBox = true;
			try
			{
				if (onlyUpdateWhenInEditMode && !base.IsInEditMode)
				{
					return;
				}
				ComboBox comboBox = ComboBox;
				if (comboBox != null)
				{
					if (SelectedIndex >= 0)
					{
						comboBox.SelectedIndex = SelectedIndex;
						return;
					}
					comboBox.SelectedIndex = -1;
					comboBox.Text = base.Text;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_isInitializingComboBox = isInitializingComboBox;
			}
		}

		public void SelectAll()
		{
			SelectionStart = 0;
			SelectionLength = TextLength;
		}

		long ICommandHost.GetCurrentState(long statesToQuery)
		{
			ComboEditorStates comboEditorStates = (ComboEditorStates)0L;
			if (base.IsInEditMode)
			{
				comboEditorStates |= ComboEditorStates.IsInEditMode;
			}
			if (IsDropDownOpen)
			{
				comboEditorStates |= ComboEditorStates.IsDropDownOpen;
			}
			return (long)comboEditorStates & statesToQuery;
		}

		bool ICommandHost.CanExecute(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = commandInfo.RoutedCommand;
			if (ComboEditorCommands.NotACommand == routedCommand)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (routedCommand != null)
			{
				return routedCommand.OwnerType == typeof(ComboEditorCommands);
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool ICommandHost.Execute(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = commandInfo.RoutedCommand;
			if (routedCommand != null)
			{
				return ExecuteCommandImpl(routedCommand, commandInfo.Parameter);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ExecuteCommandImpl(RoutedCommand command, object commandParameter)
		{
			if (command == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("command");
			}
			if (!Commands<XamComboEditor>.IsMinimumStatePresentForCommand(this, command))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ExecutingCommandEventArgs e = new ExecutingCommandEventArgs(command);
			if (!RaiseExecutingCommand(e))
			{
				return !e.ContinueKeyRouting;
			}
			bool flag = (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) != 0;
			bool flag2 = (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) != 0;
			bool flag3 = Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.Tab);
			bool flag4 = false;
			if (ComboEditorCommands.NotACommand == command)
			{
				flag4 = true;
			}
			else if (ComboEditorCommands.ToggleDropDown == command)
			{
				ToggleDropDown();
				flag4 = true;
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				RaiseExecutedCommand(new ExecutedCommandEventArgs(command));
			}
			return flag4;
		}
	}

		internal static ImageSource ImageSourceFromRawData(object rawData, Uri baseUri)
		{
			if (rawData is ImageSource)
			{
				return rawData as ImageSource;
			}
			if (rawData is Uri)
			{
				if (null != baseUri)
				{
					Uri uriSource = new Uri(baseUri, (Uri)rawData);
					return new BitmapImage(uriSource);
				}
				return new BitmapImage((Uri)rawData);
			}
			if (rawData is string)
			{
				string text = Uri.EscapeUriString((string)rawData);
				if (Uri.IsWellFormedUriString(text, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute))
				{
					try
					{
						Uri result = null;
						if ((null == baseUri && Uri.TryCreate(text, UriKind.RelativeOrAbsolute, out result)) || (null != baseUri && Uri.TryCreate(baseUri, text, out result)))
						{
							return new BitmapImage(result);
						}
						return null;
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (rawData is byte[])
			{
				try
				{
					BitmapImage bitmapImage = new BitmapImage();
					using (MemoryStream streamSource = new MemoryStream((byte[])rawData))
					{
						bitmapImage.BeginInit();
						bitmapImage.StreamSource = streamSource;
						bitmapImage.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
						bitmapImage.EndInit();
					}
					if (bitmapImage.CanFreeze)
					{
						bitmapImage.Freeze();
					}
					return bitmapImage;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SyncImageSourceResolved()
		{
			SetValue(ImageSourceResolvedPropertyKey, ImageSourceFromRawData(ImageSource, BaseUri));
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(CalendarDateRangeConverter))]
	public struct CalendarDateRange : IEquatable<CalendarDateRange>, IComparable<CalendarDateRange>
	{
		private DateTime _start;

		private DateTime _end;

		public DateTime Start
		{
			get
			{
				return _start;
			}
			set
			{
				_start = value;
			}
		}

		public DateTime End
		{
			get
			{
				return _end;
			}
			set
			{
				_end = value;
			}
		}

		public CalendarDateRange(DateTime date)
			: this(date, date)
		{
		}

		public CalendarDateRange(DateTime start, DateTime end)
		{
			_start = start;
			_end = end;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _start.GetHashCode() ^ _end.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is CalendarDateRange)
			{
				return this == (CalendarDateRange)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(CalendarDateRange range1, CalendarDateRange range2)
		{
			if (range1._start == range2._start)
			{
				return range1._end == range2._end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(CalendarDateRange range1, CalendarDateRange range2)
		{
			return !(range1 == range2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
		}

		public bool Contains(DateTime date)
		{
			CalendarDateRange calendarDateRange = Normalize(this);
			if (date >= calendarDateRange._start)
			{
				return date <= calendarDateRange._end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Contains(CalendarDateRange range)
		{
			Utils.ValidateNull("range", range);
			range.Normalize();
			CalendarDateRange calendarDateRange = Normalize(this);
			if (range._start >= calendarDateRange._start)
			{
				return range._end <= calendarDateRange._end;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IntersectsWith(CalendarDateRange range)
		{
			Utils.ValidateNull("range", range);
			range.Normalize();
			CalendarDateRange calendarDateRange = Normalize(this);
			if (!(calendarDateRange._end < range._start))
			{
				return !(calendarDateRange._start > range._end);
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void Normalize()
		{
			if (_end < _start)
			{
				DateTime start = _start;
				_start = _end;
				_end = start;
			}
		}

		public static CalendarDateRange Normalize(CalendarDateRange range)
		{
			range.Normalize();
			return range;
		}

		public void RemoveTime()
		{
			_start = _start.Date;
			_end = _end.Date;
		}

		internal static CalendarDateRange FromString(string value, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			culture = culture ?? CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			string[] array = value.Split('-');
			if (array.Length >= 1 && array.Length <= 2)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string text in array2)
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || text.Trim().Length == 0)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(typeof(DateTime));
					DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)converter.ConvertFromString(null, culture, array[0]);
					DateTime end = ((array.Length == 2) ? ((DateTime)converter.ConvertFromString(null, culture, array[1])) : dateTime);
					return new CalendarDateRange(dateTime, end);
				}
			}
			throw new FormatException(GetString("LE_InvalidDateRangeString", value));
		}

		internal static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return GetString(name, null);
		}

		internal static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return SR.GetString(name, args);
		}

		internal string ToString(CultureInfo culture)
		{
			culture = culture ?? CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			bool flag = _start.TimeOfDay != TimeSpan.Zero || _end.TimeOfDay != TimeSpan.Zero;
			string text = (flag ? "r" : "d");
			DateTime dateTime = _start;
			DateTime dateTime2 = _end;
			if (flag)
			{
				dateTime = dateTime.ToUniversalTime();
				dateTime2 = dateTime2.ToUniversalTime();
			}
			if (dateTime == dateTime2)
			{
				return dateTime.ToString(text, culture);
			}
			return dateTime.ToString(text, culture) + "-" + dateTime2.ToString(text, culture);
		}

		public bool Equals(CalendarDateRange other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}

		public int CompareTo(CalendarDateRange other)
		{
			int num = _start.CompareTo(other._start);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				num = _end.CompareTo(other._end);
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class CalendarDateRangeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			Utils.ValidateNull("value", value);
			string text = value as string;
			if (text == null)
			{
				GetConvertFromException(value);
			}
			return CalendarDateRange.FromString(text, culture);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			Utils.ValidateNull("value", value);
			Utils.ValidateNull("destinationType", destinationType);
			if (!(value is CalendarDateRange))
			{
				GetConvertToException(value, destinationType);
			}
			CalendarDateRange calendarDateRange = (CalendarDateRange)value;
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return calendarDateRange.ToString(culture);
			}
			if (destinationType != typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(CalendarDateRange.GetString("LE_CannotConvertType", typeof(CalendarDateRange), CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(destinationType).FullName));
			}
			if (calendarDateRange.Start == calendarDateRange.End)
			{
				return new InstanceDescriptor(typeof(CalendarDateRange).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(DateTime) }), new object[1] { calendarDateRange.Start });
			}
			return new InstanceDescriptor(typeof(CalendarDateRange).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(DateTime),
				typeof(DateTime)
			}), new object[2] { calendarDateRange.Start, calendarDateRange.End });
		}
	}
	public sealed class CalendarDateRangeCollection : ObservableCollectionExtended<CalendarDateRange>
	{
		private XamMonthCalendar _owner;

		private CalendarDateRange[] _combinedRanges;

		internal CalendarDateRangeCollection(XamMonthCalendar owner)
		{
			Utils.ValidateNull("owner", owner);
			_owner = owner;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			_combinedRanges = null;
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			_combinedRanges = null;
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		private DateTime? GetNextAvailableDate(ref DateTime start, ref DateTime end, int index)
		{
			int disabledDaysOfWeek = (int)_owner.DisabledDaysOfWeek;
			DateTime dateTime = start;
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = _owner.CalendarManager.Calendar;
			for (int i = Math.Max(0, index - 1); i < _combinedRanges.Length; i++)
			{
				CalendarDateRange calendarDateRange = _combinedRanges[i];
				if (calendarDateRange.End < dateTime)
				{
					continue;
				}
				while (dateTime < calendarDateRange.Start)
				{
					if ((disabledDaysOfWeek & (1 << (int)calendar.GetDayOfWeek(dateTime))) == 0)
					{
						return dateTime;
					}
					if (dateTime == end)
					{
						return null;
					}
					dateTime = dateTime.AddTicks(864000000000L);
				}
				if (end <= calendarDateRange.End)
				{
					return null;
				}
				dateTime = calendarDateRange.End.AddTicks(864000000000L);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++)
			{
				if ((disabledDaysOfWeek & (1 << (int)calendar.GetDayOfWeek(dateTime))) == 0)
				{
					return dateTime;
				}
				if (dateTime == end)
				{
					break;
				}
				dateTime = dateTime.AddTicks(864000000000L);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private DateTime? GetPreviousAvailableDate(ref DateTime start, ref DateTime end, int index)
		{
			int disabledDaysOfWeek = (int)_owner.DisabledDaysOfWeek;
			DateTime dateTime = end;
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = _owner.CalendarManager.Calendar;
			int num = Array.BinarySearch(_combinedRanges, new CalendarDateRange(end, end));
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			int num2 = _combinedRanges.Length - 1;
			int num3 = Math.Max(0, index - 1);
			while (num2 >= num3)
			{
				CalendarDateRange calendarDateRange = _combinedRanges[num2];
				if (!(calendarDateRange.End < start) && !(calendarDateRange.Start > end))
				{
					if (calendarDateRange.Start <= start)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (calendarDateRange.Start <= dateTime && calendarDateRange.End >= dateTime)
					{
						dateTime = calendarDateRange.Start.AddTicks(-864000000000L);
					}
					else
					{
						while (dateTime > calendarDateRange.End)
						{
							if ((disabledDaysOfWeek & (1 << (int)calendar.GetDayOfWeek(dateTime))) == 0)
							{
								return dateTime;
							}
							if (dateTime == start)
							{
								return null;
							}
							dateTime = dateTime.AddTicks(-864000000000L);
						}
						if (end <= calendarDateRange.End)
						{
							return null;
						}
						dateTime = calendarDateRange.End.AddTicks(864000000000L);
					}
				}
				num2--;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
			{
				if ((disabledDaysOfWeek & (1 << (int)calendar.GetDayOfWeek(dateTime))) == 0)
				{
					return dateTime;
				}
				if (dateTime == start)
				{
					break;
				}
				dateTime = dateTime.AddTicks(-864000000000L);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void InitializeCombinedRanges()
		{
			CalendarDateRange[] array = new CalendarDateRange[base.Count];
			CopyTo(array, 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i].Normalize();
				array[i].RemoveTime();
			}
			Array.Sort(array);
			int num = -1;
			for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
			{
				CalendarDateRange calendarDateRange = array[j];
				if (num >= 0 && calendarDateRange.Start.Subtract(array[num].End).Ticks <= 864000000000L)
				{
					if (calendarDateRange.End > array[num].End)
					{
						array[num].End = calendarDateRange.End;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num++;
					array[num] = calendarDateRange;
				}
			}
			Array.Resize(ref array, num + 1);
			_combinedRanges = array;
		}

		private void VerifyCombinedRanges()
		{
			if (_combinedRanges == null)
			{
				InitializeCombinedRanges();
			}
		}

		internal void AddAvailableDates(CalendarDateRange range, List<DateTime> dates)
		{
			int disabledDaysOfWeek = (int)_owner.DisabledDaysOfWeek;
			CalendarManager calendarManager = _owner.CalendarManager;
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = calendarManager.Calendar;
			CalendarMode minCalendarMode = _owner.MinCalendarMode;
			bool flag = minCalendarMode != CalendarMode.Days;
			VerifyCombinedRanges();
			int num = Array.BinarySearch(_combinedRanges, new CalendarDateRange(range.Start, range.End));
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			DateTime dateTime = range.Start;
			DateTime end = range.End;
			for (int i = Math.Max(0, num - 1); i < _combinedRanges.Length; i++)
			{
				CalendarDateRange calendarDateRange = _combinedRanges[i];
				if (calendarDateRange.End < dateTime)
				{
					continue;
				}
				while (dateTime < calendarDateRange.Start)
				{
					if ((disabledDaysOfWeek & (1 << (int)calendar.GetDayOfWeek(dateTime))) == 0)
					{
						dates.Add(dateTime);
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						dateTime = calendarManager.AddItemOffset(calendarManager.GetItemStartDate(dateTime, minCalendarMode), 1, minCalendarMode);
					}
					if (dateTime >= end)
					{
						return;
					}
					dateTime = dateTime.AddTicks(864000000000L);
				}
				if (end <= calendarDateRange.End)
				{
					return;
				}
				dateTime = calendarDateRange.End.AddTicks(864000000000L);
			}
			while (dateTime <= end)
			{
				if ((disabledDaysOfWeek & (1 << (int)calendar.GetDayOfWeek(dateTime))) == 0)
				{
					dates.Add(dateTime);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					dateTime = calendarManager.AddItemOffset(calendarManager.GetItemStartDate(dateTime, minCalendarMode), 1, minCalendarMode);
				}
				if (dateTime >= end)
				{
					break;
				}
				dateTime = dateTime.AddTicks(864000000000L);
			}
		}

		internal DateTime? GetAvailableDate(DateTime start, DateTime end, bool next)
		{
			VerifyCombinedRanges();
			CalendarDateRange calendarDateRange = new CalendarDateRange(start, end);
			int num = Array.BinarySearch(_combinedRanges, calendarDateRange);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			if (num > 0 && _combinedRanges[num - 1].Contains(calendarDateRange))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (num < _combinedRanges.Length && _combinedRanges[num].Contains(calendarDateRange))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (next)
			{
				return GetNextAvailableDate(ref start, ref end, num);
			}
			return GetPreviousAvailableDate(ref start, ref end, num);
		}
	}
