	[DesignTimeVisible(false)]
	public class CalendarDayOfWeek : Control
	{
		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey CaptionPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CaptionProperty;

		internal static readonly DependencyProperty DayOfWeekHeaderVersionProperty;

		[Bindable(true)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		public string Caption => (string)GetValue(CaptionProperty);

		static CalendarDayOfWeek()
		{
			CaptionPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Caption", typeof(string), typeof(CalendarDayOfWeek), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, CoerceCaption));
			CaptionProperty = CaptionPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			DayOfWeekHeaderVersionProperty = XamMonthCalendar.DayOfWeekHeaderVersionProperty.AddOwner(typeof(CalendarDayOfWeek), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnDayOfWeekHeaderVersionChanged));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(CalendarDayOfWeek), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(CalendarDayOfWeek)));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(CalendarDayOfWeek), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			Control.HorizontalContentAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(CalendarDayOfWeek), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.HorizontalAlignmentCenterBox));
			Control.VerticalContentAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(CalendarDayOfWeek), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.VerticalAlignmentCenterBox));
			FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(CalendarDayOfWeek), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnDataContextChanged));
			XamMonthCalendar.MonthCalendarPropertyKey.OverrideMetadata(typeof(CalendarDayOfWeek), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnMonthCalendarChanged));
		}

		private static void OnDataContextChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CalendarDayOfWeek calendarDayOfWeek = target as CalendarDayOfWeek;
			calendarDayOfWeek.CoerceValue(CaptionProperty);
		}

		private static void OnMonthCalendarChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CalendarDayOfWeek calendarDayOfWeek = target as CalendarDayOfWeek;
			if (e.NewValue is XamMonthCalendar source)
			{
				calendarDayOfWeek.SetBinding(DayOfWeekHeaderVersionProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(DayOfWeekHeaderVersionProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, source));
			}
			else
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(calendarDayOfWeek, DayOfWeekHeaderVersionProperty);
			}
			calendarDayOfWeek.CoerceValue(CaptionProperty);
		}

		private static object CoerceCaption(DependencyObject target, object valu)
		{
			CalendarDayOfWeek calendarDayOfWeek = target as CalendarDayOfWeek;
			object dataContext = calendarDayOfWeek.DataContext;
			if (!(dataContext is DayOfWeek))
			{
				return null;
			}
			XamMonthCalendar monthCalendar = XamMonthCalendar.GetMonthCalendar(calendarDayOfWeek);
			if (monthCalendar == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			DayOfWeekHeaderFormat dayOfWeekHeaderFormat = monthCalendar.DayOfWeekHeaderFormat;
			CultureInfo cultureInfo = monthCalendar.CurrentCulture ?? CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			return CalendarManager.GetDayOfWeekCaption(dayOfWeekHeaderFormat, (DayOfWeek)dataContext, cultureInfo.DateTimeFormat);
		}

		private static void OnDayOfWeekHeaderVersionChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CalendarDayOfWeek calendarDayOfWeek = target as CalendarDayOfWeek;
			calendarDayOfWeek.CoerceValue(CaptionProperty);
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(CalendarDimensionsConverter))]
	public struct CalendarDimensions : IEquatable<CalendarDimensions>
	{
		private int _rows;

		private int _columns;

		public int Columns
		{
			get
			{
				return _columns;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_columns != value)
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(XamMonthCalendar.GetString("LE_InvalidCalendarDimensions"));
					}
					_columns = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public int Rows
		{
			get
			{
				return _rows;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_rows != value)
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(XamMonthCalendar.GetString("LE_InvalidCalendarDimensions"));
					}
					_rows = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public CalendarDimensions(int rows, int columns)
		{
			if (rows < 0 || columns < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(XamMonthCalendar.GetString("LE_InvalidCalendarDimensions"));
			}
			_rows = rows;
			_columns = columns;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return _columns.GetHashCode() ^ _rows.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is CalendarDimensions)
			{
				return this == (CalendarDimensions)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(CalendarDimensions item1, CalendarDimensions item2)
		{
			if (item1._rows == item2._rows)
			{
				return item1._columns == item2._columns;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(CalendarDimensions item1, CalendarDimensions item2)
		{
			return !(item1 == item2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ToString(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
		}

		internal static CalendarDimensions FromString(string value, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			culture = culture ?? CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			string[] array = value.Split(new string[1] { culture.TextInfo.ListSeparator }, StringSplitOptions.None);
			if (array.Length == 2 && array[0].Trim().Length > 0 && array[1].Trim().Length > 0)
			{
				TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(typeof(int));
				int rows = (int)converter.ConvertFromString(null, culture, array[0]);
				int columns = (int)converter.ConvertFromString(null, culture, array[1]);
				return new CalendarDimensions(rows, columns);
			}
			throw new FormatException(XamMonthCalendar.GetString("LE_InvalidDimensionsString", value));
		}

		internal string ToString(CultureInfo culture)
		{
			culture = culture ?? CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			string listSeparator = culture.TextInfo.ListSeparator;
			return _rows.ToString(culture) + listSeparator + _columns.ToString(culture);
		}

		public bool Equals(CalendarDimensions other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}
	}
	public class CalendarDimensionsConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(string)))
			{
				return destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			Utils.ValidateNull("value", value);
			string text = value as string;
			if (text == null)
			{
				GetConvertFromException(value);
			}
			return CalendarDimensions.FromString(text, culture);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			Utils.ValidateNull("value", value);
			Utils.ValidateNull("destinationType", destinationType);
			if (!(value is CalendarDimensions))
			{
				GetConvertToException(value, destinationType);
			}
			CalendarDimensions calendarDimensions = (CalendarDimensions)value;
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return calendarDimensions.ToString(culture);
			}
			if (destinationType != typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(XamMonthCalendar.GetString("LE_CannotConvertType", typeof(CalendarDimensions), CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(destinationType).FullName));
			}
			return new InstanceDescriptor(typeof(CalendarDimensions).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
			{
				typeof(int),
				typeof(int)
			}), new object[2] { calendarDimensions.Rows, calendarDimensions.Columns });
		}
	}

		public CalendarItem()
			: this(DateTime.Today, DateTime.Today, null)
		{
		}

		internal CalendarItem(DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate, CalendarItemGroup group)
		{
			SetValue(StartDatePropertyKey, startDate);
			SetValue(EndDatePropertyKey, endDate);
			_group = group;
		}

		internal int CompareTo(DateTime date)
		{
			if (date < StartDate)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (date > EndDate)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal bool ContainsDate(DateTime date)
		{
			if (date >= StartDate)
			{
				return date <= EndDate;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void FormatTitle()
		{
			XamMonthCalendar monthCalendar = XamMonthCalendar.GetMonthCalendar(_group);
			CalendarMode currentCalendarMode = CalendarItemGroup.GetCurrentCalendarMode(this);
			if (monthCalendar == null || !monthCalendar.CurrentCultureHasMultipleEras || !FormatTitleWithEra(monthCalendar))
			{
				CultureInfo cultureInfo = monthCalendar?.CurrentCulture;
				if (cultureInfo == null)
				{
					cultureInfo = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
				}
				DateTime startDate = StartDate;
				DateTime endDate = EndDate;
				bool flag = false;
				string text = null;
				switch (currentCalendarMode)
				{
				default:
					text = "{0:%d}";
					break;
				case CalendarMode.Months:
					text = "{0:MMM}";
					break;
				case CalendarMode.Years:
					text = "{0:yyyy}";
					break;
				case CalendarMode.Decades:
				case CalendarMode.Centuries:
					flag = true;
					text = "{0:yyyy}-\n{1:yyyy}";
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					Title = string.Format(cultureInfo, text, new object[2] { startDate, EndDate });
				}
				else
				{
					Title = string.Format(cultureInfo, text, new object[1] { startDate });
				}
			}
		}

		private bool FormatTitleWithEra(XamMonthCalendar control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DateTime startDate = StartDate;
			DateTime endDate = EndDate;
			CultureInfo currentCulture = control.CurrentCulture;
			if (currentCulture == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = currentCulture.DateTimeFormat.Calendar;
			if (calendar.Eras.Length < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			string text = null;
			CalendarMode currentCalendarMode = CalendarItemGroup.GetCurrentCalendarMode(this);
			int era = calendar.GetEra(startDate);
			int era2 = calendar.GetEra(EndDate);
			switch (currentCalendarMode)
			{
			case CalendarMode.Days:
			{
				text = "{0:%d}";
				if (_group == null || _group.IsGroupForSizing || era2 == _group.FirstDateOfGroupEra)
				{
					break;
				}
				DateTime time = control.CalendarManager.AddDays(startDate, -1);
				if (calendar.GetEra(time) != era2)
				{
					string abbreviatedEraName = currentCulture.DateTimeFormat.GetAbbreviatedEraName(era2);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(abbreviatedEraName) && abbreviatedEraName.Length == 1)
					{
						Title = abbreviatedEraName;
						return true;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case CalendarMode.Months:
				if (era != era2)
				{
					flag = true;
					text = "{1:gg}";
				}
				else
				{
					text = control.EraFormatMonthFormat ?? "{0:MMM}";
				}
				break;
			case CalendarMode.Years:
				if (era != era2)
				{
					text = "{0:yy}-\r\n{1:gg}";
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					text = "{0:yy}";
				}
				break;
			case CalendarMode.Decades:
				text = ((era == era2) ? "{0:yy}-\r\n{1:yy}" : "{0:yy}-\r\n{1:gg}");
				flag = true;
				break;
			}
			if (text != null)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					Title = string.Format(currentCulture, text, new object[2] { startDate, EndDate });
				}
				else
				{
					Title = string.Format(currentCulture, text, new object[1] { startDate });
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual void Recycle(DateTime start, DateTime end)
		{
			SetValue(StartDatePropertyKey, start);
			SetValue(EndDatePropertyKey, end);
			ClearValue(IsTodayPropertyKey);
			ClearValue(ContainsTodayPropertyKey);
			ClearValue(IsSelectedPropertyKey);
			ClearValue(ContainsSelectedDatesPropertyKey);
			ClearValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
			ClearValue(IsLeadingOrTrailingItemPropertyKey);
			ClearValue(IsActivePropertyKey);
		}

		protected virtual void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (!base.IsEnabled)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Disabled", useTransitions);
			}
			else if (base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "MouseOver", "Normal");
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions);
			}
			if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "Focused", "Unfocused");
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Unfocused", useTransitions);
			}
			CalendarItemGroup.GoToCalendarState(this, useTransitions);
			if (IsSelected)
			{
				if (IsSelectionActive)
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Selected", useTransitions);
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "SelectedUnfocused", useTransitions);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Unselected", useTransitions);
			}
			if (IsActive)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Active", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Inactive", useTransitions);
			}
			if (IsToday)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Today", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "RegularDay", useTransitions);
			}
		}

		internal static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is CalendarItem calendarItem)
			{
				calendarItem.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;

		private void InitializeWeekNumbers()
		{
			CalendarManager calendarManager = CalendarManager;
			DateTime? dateTime = ((_group != null) ? _group.FirstDateOfGroup : ((DateTime?)null));
			bool flag = CurrentCalendarMode == CalendarMode.Days && dateTime.HasValue && Items.Count > 0;
			if (!flag && _weekNumbersInternal.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_weekNumbersInternal.Clear();
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			DateTime dateTime2 = _group.FirstDate;
			DateTime lastDate = _group.LastDate;
			calendarManager.GetItemRowColumn(dateTime2, CalendarMode.Days, dateTime.Value, _group.ShowLeadingDates, out var colOffset, out var _);
			int offset = 7 - colOffset;
			for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
			{
				int weekNumberForDate = calendarManager.GetWeekNumberForDate(dateTime2);
				if (i <= 0 || _weekNumbersInternal[i - 1] != weekNumberForDate)
				{
					_weekNumbersInternal.Add(weekNumberForDate);
					dateTime2 = calendarManager.AddItemOffset(dateTime2, offset, CalendarMode.Days);
					offset = 7;
					if (dateTime2 > _group.LastDate)
					{
						break;
					}
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ReinitializeEnabledState()
		{

				}
			}
		}

		private void ReinitializeSelectedState()
		{
			XamMonthCalendar monthCalendar = XamMonthCalendar.GetMonthCalendar(this);
			if (monthCalendar != null)
			{
				bool isNavigationMode = monthCalendar.IsNavigationMode;
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _itemsInternal.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					CalendarItem calendarItem = _itemsInternal[i];
					bool flag = monthCalendar.SelectedDates.ContainsSelection(calendarItem.StartDate, calendarItem.EndDate);
					bool flag2 = (isNavigationMode ? calendarItem.IsActive : flag);
					calendarItem.SetValue(CalendarItem.IsSelectedPropertyKey, flag2 ? KnownBoxes.TrueBox : KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
					calendarItem.SetValue(CalendarItem.ContainsSelectedDatesPropertyKey, flag ? KnownBoxes.TrueBox : KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ReinitializeStyle()
		{

			if (monthCalendar != null)
			{
				bool flag = CurrentCalendarMode == CalendarMode.Days;
				Style style = (flag ? monthCalendar.CalendarDayStyle : monthCalendar.CalendarItemStyle);
				StyleSelector styleSelector = (flag ? monthCalendar.CalendarDayStyleSelector : monthCalendar.CalendarItemStyleSelector);
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _itemsInternal.Count; i < count; i++)
				{

		private void ReinitializeTodayState()
		{
			XamMonthCalendar monthCalendar = XamMonthCalendar.GetMonthCalendar(this);
			if (monthCalendar != null)
			{
				DateTime today = DateTime.Today;
				bool isMinCalendarMode = monthCalendar.IsMinCalendarMode;
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _itemsInternal.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					CalendarItem calendarItem = _itemsInternal[i];
					bool flag = calendarItem.StartDate <= today && today <= calendarItem.EndDate;
					calendarItem.SetValue(CalendarItem.IsTodayPropertyKey, (isMinCalendarMode && flag) ? KnownBoxes.TrueBox : DependencyProperty.UnsetValue);
					calendarItem.SetValue(CalendarItem.ContainsTodayPropertyKey, flag ? KnownBoxes.TrueBox : DependencyProperty.UnsetValue);
				}
			}
		}

		internal CalendarItem GetItem(DateTime date)
		{
			IList<CalendarItem> items = Items;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = items.Count - 1;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				int num3 = num + (num2 - num) / 2;
				int num4 = items[num3].CompareTo(date);
				if (num4 == 0)
				{
					return items[num3];
				}
				if (num4 > 0)
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void InitializeGroup(CalendarItemGroup group)
		{
			if (_group != group)
			{
				if (_group != null)
				{
					_group.UnregisterItemArea(this);
				}
				_group = group;
				if (_group != null && group == base.TemplatedParent)
				{
					_group.RegisterItemArea(this);
				}
			}
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.InitializeItems()
		{
			InitializeItems();
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.InitializeWeekNumbers()
		{
			InitializeWeekNumbers();
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.InitializeFirstItemOffset()
		{
			InitializeFirstItemOffset();
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.InitializeRowColCount()
		{
			InitializeCalendarModeSettings(CurrentCalendarMode);
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.ReinitializeItems(CalendarItemChange change)
		{
			switch (change)
			{
			case CalendarItemChange.Enabled:
				ReinitializeEnabledState();
				break;
			case CalendarItemChange.Style:
				ReinitializeStyle();
				break;
			case CalendarItemChange.Selection:
				ReinitializeSelectedState();
				break;
			case CalendarItemChange.Today:
				ReinitializeTodayState();
				break;
			default:
				((ICalendarItemArea)this).InitializeItems();
				break;
			}
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.PrepareForAnimationAction(CalendarAnimation action)
		{
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.PerformAnimationAction(CalendarAnimation action)
		{
		}

		CalendarItem ICalendarItemArea.GetItem(DateTime date)
		{
			return GetItem(date);
		}

				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			return _areas[index];
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			Size result = default(Size);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _areas.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				CalendarItemArea calendarItemArea = _areas[i];
				calendarItemArea.Measure(availableSize);
				Size desiredSize = calendarItemArea.DesiredSize;
				if (desiredSize.Width > result.Width)
				{
					result.Width = desiredSize.Width;
				}
				if (desiredSize.Height > result.Height)
				{
					result.Height = desiredSize.Height;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (_group != null)
			{
				if (_group.IsGroupForSizing)
				{
					InitializeSizingGroupPanel();
				}
				else
				{
					((ICalendarItemArea)this).InitializeItems();
				}
			}
			base.OnInitialized(e);
		}

		protected override void OnVisualParentChanged(DependencyObject oldParent)
		{
			if (base.TemplatedParent is CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup)
			{
				InitializeGroup(calendarItemGroup);
			}
			base.OnVisualParentChanged(oldParent);
		}

		private static void AddFadeAnimation(Duration duration, bool isNew, Storyboard sb)
		{
			DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation();
			doubleAnimation.SetValue(isNew ? DoubleAnimation.ToProperty : DoubleAnimation.FromProperty, 1.0);
			doubleAnimation.SetValue(isNew ? DoubleAnimation.FromProperty : DoubleAnimation.ToProperty, 0.0);
			doubleAnimation.Duration = duration;
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation, new PropertyPath(UIElement.OpacityProperty));
			sb.Children.Add(doubleAnimation);
		}

		private static void AddVisibilityAnimation(Storyboard sb, Duration duration)
		{
			ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames objectAnimationUsingKeyFrames = new ObjectAnimationUsingKeyFrames();
			DiscreteObjectKeyFrame keyFrame = new DiscreteObjectKeyFrame(KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox, KeyTime.FromPercent(0.0));
			DiscreteObjectKeyFrame keyFrame2 = new DiscreteObjectKeyFrame(KnownBoxes.VisibilityHiddenBox, KeyTime.FromPercent(1.0));
			objectAnimationUsingKeyFrames.KeyFrames.Add(keyFrame);
			objectAnimationUsingKeyFrames.KeyFrames.Add(keyFrame2);
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(objectAnimationUsingKeyFrames, new PropertyPath(UIElement.VisibilityProperty));
			objectAnimationUsingKeyFrames.Duration = duration;
			sb.Children.Add(objectAnimationUsingKeyFrames);
		}

		private void ClearPreviousAnimations()
		{
			CalendarItemArea oldArea = OldArea;
			CalendarItemArea currentArea = CurrentArea;
			RemoveStoryboard(ref _sbOldArea, oldArea);
			RemoveStoryboard(ref _sbNewArea, currentArea);
			oldArea.ClearValue(UIElement.RenderTransformProperty);
			currentArea.ClearValue(UIElement.RenderTransformProperty);
			oldArea.ClearValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty);
			currentArea.ClearValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty);
		}

		private CalendarItemArea CreateItemArea(int index, CalendarMode? mode)
		{
			if (index >= _areas.Count)
			{
				_areas.AddRange(new CalendarItemArea[1 + index - _areas.Count]);
			}
			if (_areas[index] == null)
			{
				CalendarItemArea calendarItemArea = (_areas[index] = new CalendarItemArea());
				CalendarItemArea calendarItemArea3 = calendarItemArea;
				((ISupportInitialize)calendarItemArea3).BeginInit();
				if (mode.HasValue)
				{
					CalendarItemGroup.SetCurrentCalendarMode(calendarItemArea3, mode.Value);
				}
				calendarItemArea3.InitializeGroup(_group);
				AddVisualChild(calendarItemArea3);
				AddLogicalChild(calendarItemArea3);
				((ISupportInitialize)calendarItemArea3).EndInit();
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
			return _areas[index];
		}

		private static Storyboard CreateFadeStoryboard(Duration duration, bool isNew, CalendarItemArea area)
		{
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			storyboard.Duration = duration;
			storyboard.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
			AddFadeAnimation(duration, isNew, storyboard);
			if (!isNew)
			{
				AddVisibilityAnimation(storyboard, duration);
			}
			return storyboard;
		}

		private static Storyboard CreateScrollStoryboard(CalendarItemArea area, bool scrollLeft, bool isNew, double offset, Duration duration, bool isScrollDirectionVertical)
		{
			TranslateTransform renderTransform = new TranslateTransform();
			area.RenderTransform = renderTransform;
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			storyboard.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
			DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation();
			doubleAnimation.From = ((!isNew) ? 0.0 : (scrollLeft ? offset : (0.0 - offset)));
			doubleAnimation.To = (isNew ? 0.0 : (scrollLeft ? (0.0 - offset) : offset));
			doubleAnimation.Duration = duration;
			if (isScrollDirectionVertical)
			{
				Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation, new PropertyPath("(0).(1)", UIElement.RenderTransformProperty, TranslateTransform.YProperty));
			}
			else
			{
				Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation, new PropertyPath("(0).(1)", UIElement.RenderTransformProperty, TranslateTransform.XProperty));
			}
			storyboard.Children.Add(doubleAnimation);
			if (!isNew)
			{
				AddVisibilityAnimation(storyboard, duration);
			}
			return storyboard;
		}

		private static Storyboard CreateZoomStoryboard(CalendarItem referenceItem, bool zoomOut, Duration duration, bool isNew, CalendarItemArea area)
		{
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			storyboard.Duration = duration;
			storyboard.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
			if (referenceItem != null)
			{
				TransformGroup transformGroup = new TransformGroup();
				ScaleTransform value = new ScaleTransform();
				TranslateTransform value2 = new TranslateTransform();
				transformGroup.Children.Add(value);
				transformGroup.Children.Add(value2);
				area.RenderTransform = transformGroup;
				double num = referenceItem.ActualWidth / area.ActualWidth;
				double num2 = referenceItem.ActualHeight / area.ActualHeight;
				if (isNew == zoomOut)
				{
					num = 1.0 / num;
					num2 = 1.0 / num2;
				}
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation(isNew ? num : 1.0, isNew ? 1.0 : num, duration);
				Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation, new PropertyPath("(0).(1)[0].(2)", UIElement.RenderTransformProperty, TransformGroup.ChildrenProperty, ScaleTransform.ScaleXProperty));
				storyboard.Children.Add(doubleAnimation);
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation2 = new DoubleAnimation(isNew ? num2 : 1.0, isNew ? 1.0 : num2, duration);
				Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation2, new PropertyPath("(0).(1)[0].(2)", UIElement.RenderTransformProperty, TransformGroup.ChildrenProperty, ScaleTransform.ScaleYProperty));
				storyboard.Children.Add(doubleAnimation2);
				Point point = referenceItem.TransformToVisual(area).Transform(default(Point));
				if (isNew == zoomOut)
				{
					point.X *= 0.0 - num;
					point.Y *= 0.0 - num2;
				}
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation3 = new DoubleAnimation(isNew ? point.X : 0.0, isNew ? 0.0 : point.X, duration);
				Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation3, new PropertyPath("(0).(1)[1].(2)", UIElement.RenderTransformProperty, TransformGroup.ChildrenProperty, TranslateTransform.XProperty));
				storyboard.Children.Add(doubleAnimation3);
				DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation4 = new DoubleAnimation(isNew ? point.Y : 0.0, isNew ? 0.0 : point.Y, duration);
				Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(doubleAnimation4, new PropertyPath("(0).(1)[1].(2)", UIElement.RenderTransformProperty, TransformGroup.ChildrenProperty, TranslateTransform.YProperty));
				storyboard.Children.Add(doubleAnimation4);
			}
			AddFadeAnimation(duration, isNew, storyboard);
			if (!isNew)
			{
				AddVisibilityAnimation(storyboard, duration);
			}
			return storyboard;
		}

		private bool HasItemArea(int index)
		{
			if (index < _areas.Count)
			{
				return _areas[index] != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void InitializeGroup(CalendarItemGroup group)
		{
			if (_group == group)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (_group != null)
			{
				_group.UnregisterItemArea(this);
			}
			_group = group;
			if (_group != null)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = _areas.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					_areas[i].InitializeGroup(group);
				}
				if (group == base.TemplatedParent)
				{
					_group.RegisterItemArea(this);
				}
				if (group.IsGroupForSizing)
				{
					InitializeSizingGroupPanel();
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeSizingGroupPanel()
		{
			if (base.IsInitialized && _group != null && _group.IsGroupForSizing)
			{
				int currentCalendarMode = (int)_group.CurrentCalendarMode;
				int num = 4;
				CreateItemArea(0, null);
				int num2 = num - currentCalendarMode;
				for (int i = 1; i <= num2; i++)
				{
					CalendarMode calendarMode = (CalendarMode)(i + currentCalendarMode);
					CalendarItemArea d = CreateItemArea(i, calendarMode);
					CalendarItemGroup.SetCurrentCalendarMode(d, calendarMode);
				}
				for (int num3 = _areas.Count - 1; num3 > num2; num3--)
				{
					CalendarItemArea child = _areas[num3];
					_areas.RemoveAt(num3);
					RemoveVisualChild(child);
					RemoveLogicalChild(child);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnCurrentCalendarModeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CalendarItemAreaPanel calendarItemAreaPanel = (CalendarItemAreaPanel)d;
			if (calendarItemAreaPanel._group != null && calendarItemAreaPanel._group.IsGroupForSizing)
			{
				calendarItemAreaPanel.InitializeSizingGroupPanel();
			}
			else if (calendarItemAreaPanel._areas.Count > 1)
			{
				calendarItemAreaPanel.CurrentArea.SetValue(CalendarItemGroup.CurrentCalendarModePropertyKey, e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		private static void RemoveStoryboard(ref Storyboard sb, CalendarItemArea area)
		{
			if (sb != null)
			{
				sb.Stop(area);
				sb.Remove(area);
				sb = null;
			}
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.InitializeItems()
		{
			if (base.IsInitialized)
			{
				if (HasItemArea(_areaIndex))
				{
					((ICalendarItemArea)CurrentArea).InitializeItems();
				}
				else
				{
					CreateItemArea(_areaIndex, null);
				}
			}
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.InitializeWeekNumbers()
		{
			((ICalendarItemArea)CurrentArea).InitializeWeekNumbers();
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.InitializeFirstItemOffset()
		{
			((ICalendarItemArea)CurrentArea).InitializeFirstItemOffset();
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.InitializeRowColCount()
		{
			foreach (CalendarItemArea area in _areas)
			{
				((ICalendarItemArea)area)?.InitializeRowColCount();
			}
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.ReinitializeItems(CalendarItemChange change)
		{
			((ICalendarItemArea)CurrentArea).ReinitializeItems(change);
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.PrepareForAnimationAction(CalendarAnimation action)
		{
			if (!_pendingAnimation.HasValue)
			{
				ClearPreviousAnimations();
				_areaIndex = ((_areaIndex == 0) ? 1 : 0);
				CreateItemArea(_areaIndex, null);
				_pendingAnimation = action;
				OldArea.SetValue(CalendarItemGroup.CurrentCalendarModePropertyKey, CalendarItemGroup.GetCurrentCalendarMode(this));
				CurrentArea.SetValue(CalendarItemGroup.CurrentCalendarModePropertyKey, CalendarItemGroup.GetCurrentCalendarMode(this));
				CurrentArea.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
			}
		}

		void ICalendarItemArea.PerformAnimationAction(CalendarAnimation action)
		{
			if (action != _pendingAnimation)
			{
				return;
			}
			_pendingAnimation = null;
			((ICalendarItemArea)this).InitializeItems();
			CalendarItemArea oldArea = OldArea;
			CalendarItemArea currentArea = CurrentArea;
			CalendarDateRange? groupRange = oldArea.GroupRange;
			CalendarDateRange? groupRange2 = currentArea.GroupRange;
			Storyboard storyboard = null;
			Storyboard storyboard2 = null;
			XamMonthCalendar monthCalendar = XamMonthCalendar.GetMonthCalendar(this);
			bool flag = false;
			if (groupRange.HasValue && groupRange2.HasValue && base.IsVisible)
			{
				if (groupRange != groupRange2)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (oldArea.CurrentCalendarMode != currentArea.CurrentCalendarMode && (oldArea.FirstItemColumnOffset != currentArea.FirstItemColumnOffset || oldArea.FirstItemRowOffset != currentArea.FirstItemRowOffset || oldArea.ItemRows != currentArea.ItemRows || oldArea.ItemColumns != currentArea.ItemColumns || oldArea.Items.Count != currentArea.Items.Count))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Duration duration = new Duration(new TimeSpan(3333333L));
				switch (action)
				{
				case CalendarAnimation.ZoomIn:
				case CalendarAnimation.ZoomOut:
				{
					UpdateLayout();
					CalendarItem calendarItem = null;
					bool flag2 = action == CalendarAnimation.ZoomOut;
					if (groupRange2 == groupRange)
					{
						calendarItem = ((!flag2) ? oldArea.GetItem(groupRange2.Value.Start) : currentArea.GetItem(groupRange.Value.Start));
					}
					else if (groupRange2.Value.Contains(groupRange.Value) || flag2)
					{
						calendarItem = currentArea.GetItem(groupRange.Value.Start);
					}
					else if (groupRange.Value.Contains(groupRange2.Value) || !flag2)
					{
						calendarItem = oldArea.GetItem(groupRange2.Value.Start);
					}
					if (calendarItem == null && monthCalendar != null)
					{
						DateTime date = (flag2 ? groupRange.Value.Start : groupRange2.Value.Start);
						foreach (CalendarItemGroup group in monthCalendar.GetGroups())
						{
							if (group.ItemArea is CalendarItemAreaPanel calendarItemAreaPanel && this != calendarItemAreaPanel)
							{
								CalendarItemArea calendarItemArea = (flag2 ? calendarItemAreaPanel.CurrentArea : calendarItemAreaPanel.OldArea);
								calendarItem = calendarItemArea.GetItem(date);
								if (calendarItem != null)
								{
									break;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					storyboard = CreateZoomStoryboard(calendarItem, flag2, duration, isNew: false, oldArea);
					storyboard2 = CreateZoomStoryboard(calendarItem, flag2, duration, isNew: true, currentArea);
					break;
				}
				case CalendarAnimation.Fade:
					storyboard = CreateFadeStoryboard(duration, isNew: false, oldArea);
					storyboard2 = CreateFadeStoryboard(duration, isNew: true, currentArea);
					break;
				case CalendarAnimation.Scroll:
				{
					bool scrollLeft = groupRange.Value.End < groupRange2.Value.Start;
					bool isScrollDirectionVertical = false;
					double offset;
					if (monthCalendar != null && monthCalendar.ScrollDirection == Orientation.Vertical)
					{
						offset = base.ActualHeight;
						isScrollDirectionVertical = true;
					}
					else
					{
						offset = base.ActualWidth;
					}
					storyboard = CreateScrollStoryboard(oldArea, scrollLeft, isNew: false, offset, duration, isScrollDirectionVertical);
					storyboard2 = CreateScrollStoryboard(currentArea, scrollLeft, isNew: true, offset, duration, isScrollDirectionVertical);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			if (monthCalendar != null && (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin || monthCalendar.IsKeyboardFocused))
			{
				monthCalendar.FocusActiveItemWithDelay();
			}
			oldArea.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
			currentArea.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			_sbOldArea = storyboard;
			_sbNewArea = storyboard2;
			storyboard?.Begin(oldArea, HandoffBehavior.Compose, isControllable: true);
			storyboard2?.Begin(currentArea, HandoffBehavior.Compose, isControllable: true);
		}

		CalendarItem ICalendarItemArea.GetItem(DateTime date)
		{
			return ((ICalendarItemArea)CurrentArea).GetItem(date);
		}
	}

		internal class GroupInitializationHelper : IDisposable
		{
			private IList<CalendarItemGroup> _groups;

			private bool _preventedAnimations;

			internal GroupInitializationHelper(IList<CalendarItemGroup> groups)
				: this(groups, preventAnimations: true)
			{
			}

			internal GroupInitializationHelper(IList<CalendarItemGroup> groups, bool preventAnimations)
			{
				_groups = groups;
				_preventedAnimations = preventAnimations;
				foreach (CalendarItemGroup group in groups)
				{
					group.SuspendAnimations(preventAnimations);
					group.SuspendInitializeImpl();
				}
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				foreach (CalendarItemGroup group in _groups)
				{
					group.ResumeInitializeImpl();
				}
				foreach (CalendarItemGroup group2 in _groups)
				{
					group2.ResumeAnimations(_preventedAnimations);
				}
			}
		}

		static CalendarItemGroup()
		{
			CalendarModeInternalProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CalendarModeInternal", typeof(CalendarMode), typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(CalendarMode.Days, OnCalendarModeInternalChanged));
			ReferenceDateProperty = XamMonthCalendar.ReferenceDateProperty.AddOwner(typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnReferenceDateChanged));
			CurrentCalendarModePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("CurrentCalendarMode", typeof(CalendarMode), typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(CalendarMode.Days, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits, OnCurrentCalendarModeChanged));
			CurrentCalendarModeProperty = CurrentCalendarModePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FirstDateOfGroupPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("FirstDateOfGroup", typeof(DateTime?), typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnFirstDateOfGroupChanged));
			FirstDateOfGroupProperty = FirstDateOfGroupPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			IsLeadingGroupProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsLeadingGroup", typeof(bool), typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsLeadingOrTrailingGroupChanged));
			IsTrailingGroupProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsTrailingGroup", typeof(bool), typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, OnIsLeadingOrTrailingGroupChanged));
			LastDateOfGroupPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("LastDateOfGroup", typeof(DateTime?), typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnLastDateOfGroupChanged));
			LastDateOfGroupProperty = LastDateOfGroupPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ReferenceGroupOffsetProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ReferenceGroupOffset", typeof(int), typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0, OnReferenceGroupOffsetChanged));
			ShowLeadingDatesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowLeadingDates", typeof(bool), typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox, OnShowLeadingDatesChanged));
			ScrollNextButtonVisibilityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ScrollNextButtonVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox));
			ScrollPreviousButtonVisibilityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ScrollPreviousButtonVisibility", typeof(Visibility), typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox));
			ShowTrailingDatesProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowTrailingDates", typeof(bool), typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.TrueBox, OnShowTrailingDatesChanged));
			TitlePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyUtilities.RegisterReadOnly("Title", typeof(string), typeof(CalendarItemGroup), null, null);
			TitleProperty = TitlePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(CalendarItemGroup)));
			UIElement.FocusableProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			XamMonthCalendar.MonthCalendarPropertyKey.OverrideMetadata(typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnMonthCalendarChanged));
			UIElement.IsEnabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(CalendarItemGroup), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnVisualStatePropertyChanged));
		}

		public CalendarItemGroup()
			: this(CalendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(DateTime.Today, CalendarMode.Days, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.Calendar, DayOfWeekFlags.None), isSizingGroup: false)
		{
		}

		internal CalendarItemGroup(DateTime? firstDate, bool isSizingGroup)
		{
			_isSizingGroup = isSizingGroup;
			SetValue(FirstDateOfGroupPropertyKey, firstDate);
		}

		private static void OnCalendarModeInternalChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = (CalendarItemGroup)d;
			CalendarAnimation value = (IsZoomFocus(calendarItemGroup) ? (((CalendarMode)e.NewValue > (CalendarMode)e.OldValue) ? CalendarAnimation.ZoomOut : CalendarAnimation.ZoomIn) : CalendarAnimation.Fade);
			calendarItemGroup.PrepareForAnimation(value);
			calendarItemGroup.SetValue(CurrentCalendarModePropertyKey, e.NewValue);
			calendarItemGroup.OnCalendarModeChanged();
			calendarItemGroup.PerformPendingAnimation(value);
		}

		private static void OnReferenceDateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = (CalendarItemGroup)d;
			CalendarAnimation? action = ((e.NewValue != null && e.OldValue != null) ? new CalendarAnimation?(CalendarAnimation.Scroll) : ((CalendarAnimation?)null));
			calendarItemGroup.PrepareForAnimation(action);
			calendarItemGroup.InitializeFirstDateOfGroup();
			calendarItemGroup.PerformPendingAnimation(action);
		}

		private static void OnCurrentCalendarModeChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup)
			{
				calendarItemGroup.FormatTitle();
			}
		}

		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableForType(typeof(CalendarItem))]
		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableForType(typeof(CalendarItemArea))]
		[AttachedPropertyBrowsableForType(typeof(CalendarItemGroup))]
		public static CalendarMode GetCurrentCalendarMode(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (CalendarMode)d.GetValue(CurrentCalendarModeProperty);
		}

		internal static void SetCurrentCalendarMode(DependencyObject d, CalendarMode mode)
		{
			d.SetValue(CurrentCalendarModePropertyKey, mode);
		}

		private static void OnFirstDateOfGroupChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = (CalendarItemGroup)d;
			calendarItemGroup.SuspendInitialize();
			try
			{
				calendarItemGroup.InitializeLastDateOfGroup();
				calendarItemGroup.InitializeItems();
				calendarItemGroup.FormatTitle();
			}
			finally
			{
				calendarItemGroup.ResumeInitialize();
			}
			calendarItemGroup.InvalidateItemGroupPanelArrange();
		}

		private static void OnIsLeadingOrTrailingGroupChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = (CalendarItemGroup)d;
			if (calendarItemGroup._control != null)
			{
				calendarItemGroup._control.CoerceValue(XamMonthCalendar.ReferenceDateProperty);
				calendarItemGroup.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		private static void OnLastDateOfGroupChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = d as CalendarItemGroup;
			calendarItemGroup.InvalidateItemGroupPanelArrange();
		}

		private static void OnReferenceGroupOffsetChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = (CalendarItemGroup)d;
			XamMonthCalendar monthCalendar = XamMonthCalendar.GetMonthCalendar(calendarItemGroup);
			if (monthCalendar != null && !calendarItemGroup.IsGroupForSizing)
			{
				monthCalendar.OnGroupOffsetChanged(calendarItemGroup, (int)e.OldValue, (int)e.NewValue);
			}
			calendarItemGroup.InitializeFirstDateOfGroup();
		}

		private static void OnShowLeadingDatesChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((CalendarItemGroup)d).InitializeItems();
		}

		private static void OnShowTrailingDatesChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((CalendarItemGroup)d).InitializeItems();
		}

		internal int CompareDate(DateTime date)
		{
			date = date.Date;
			DateTime value = date;
			DateTime? firstDateOfGroup = FirstDateOfGroup;
			if (value < firstDateOfGroup)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			value = date;
			firstDateOfGroup = LastDateOfGroup;
			if (value > firstDateOfGroup)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private void FormatTitle()
		{
			bool flag = _control != null && _control.CurrentCultureHasMultipleEras;
			DateTime? firstDateOfGroup = FirstDateOfGroup;
			if (!firstDateOfGroup.HasValue)
			{
				Title = null;
				return;
			}
			DateTime dateTime = firstDateOfGroup.Value;
			DateTime? lastDateOfGroup = LastDateOfGroup;
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = null;
			CalendarManager calendarManager = ((_control != null) ? _control.CalendarManager : null);
			if (calendarManager != null)
			{
				dateTimeFormatInfo = calendarManager.DateTimeFormat;
			}
			if (dateTimeFormatInfo == null)
			{
				dateTimeFormatInfo = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.DateTimeFormat;
			}
			int era = dateTimeFormatInfo.Calendar.GetEra(firstDateOfGroup.Value);
			int era2 = dateTimeFormatInfo.Calendar.GetEra(lastDateOfGroup.Value);
			_firstDateOfGroupEra = era;
			bool flag2 = false;
			string format;
			switch (GetCurrentCalendarMode(this))
			{
			default:
				format = "{0:y}";
				if (!flag)
				{
					break;
				}
				switch (_control.EraDisplayMode)
				{
				default:
				{
					DateTime? activeDate = _control.ActiveDate;
					if (activeDate.HasValue)
					{
						DateTime? dateTime2 = activeDate;
						DateTime? dateTime3 = firstDateOfGroup;
						if ((dateTime2.HasValue & dateTime3.HasValue) && dateTime2.GetValueOrDefault() > dateTime3.GetValueOrDefault() && activeDate <= lastDateOfGroup)
						{
							dateTime = activeDate.Value;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case EraDisplayMode.LastDayOfMonth:
					dateTime = calendarManager?.GetGroupEndDate(dateTime, CalendarMode.Days) ?? lastDateOfGroup.Value;
					break;
				case EraDisplayMode.FirstDayOfMonth:
					break;
				}
				break;
			case CalendarMode.Months:
				if (flag)
				{
					if (era == era2)
					{
						format = "{0:ggy}";
						break;
					}
					format = "{0:ggy} - {1:gg}";
					flag2 = true;
				}
				else
				{
					format = "{0:yyyy}";
				}
				break;
			case CalendarMode.Years:
			case CalendarMode.Decades:
			case CalendarMode.Centuries:
				format = ((!flag) ? "{0:yyyy}-{1:yyyy}" : ((era != era2) ? "{0:ggy} - {1:ggy}" : "{0:ggy} - {1:yy}"));
				flag2 = true;
				break;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				Title = string.Format(dateTimeFormatInfo, format, new object[2] { dateTime, lastDateOfGroup.Value });
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Title = string.Format(dateTimeFormatInfo, format, new object[1] { dateTime });
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				Title = string.Format(dateTimeFormatInfo, format, new object[1] { firstDateOfGroup.Value });
			}
		}

		internal CalendarItem GetItem(DateTime date)
		{
			if (_itemArea == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _itemArea.GetItem(date);
		}

		private static bool IsZoomFocus(CalendarItemGroup c)
		{
			return XamMonthCalendar.GetMonthCalendar(c)?.IsZoomFocusGroup(c) ?? false;
		}

		internal void OnCalendarChange(MonthCalendarChange change)
		{
			bool flag = change != MonthCalendarChange.CurrentModeChanged;
			try
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					SuspendInitialize();
				}
				switch (change)
				{
				case MonthCalendarChange.WeekRuleChanged:
					if (_itemArea != null)
					{
						_itemArea.InitializeWeekNumbers();
					}
					break;
				case MonthCalendarChange.FirstDayOfWeekChanged:
					InitializeItems();
					break;
				case MonthCalendarChange.DaysOfWeekChanged:
					InitializeItems();
					if (_itemArea != null)
					{
						_itemArea.InitializeRowColCount();
					}
					break;
				case MonthCalendarChange.ActiveDayChange:
					if (_control != null && _control.CurrentCultureHasMultipleEras && _control.EraDisplayMode == EraDisplayMode.ActiveDate)
					{
						FormatTitle();
					}
					break;
				case MonthCalendarChange.EraDisplayMode:
					if (_control != null && _control.CurrentCultureHasMultipleEras)
					{
						FormatTitle();
					}
					break;
				case MonthCalendarChange.MinDateChanged:
				case MonthCalendarChange.MaxDateChanged:
					InitializeFirstDateOfGroup();
					InitializeLastDateOfGroup();
					InitializeItems();
					break;
				case MonthCalendarChange.DisabledDatesChanged:
					if (_itemArea != null)
					{
						_itemArea.ReinitializeItems(CalendarItemChange.Enabled);
					}
					break;
				case MonthCalendarChange.LanguageChanged:
					InitializeFirstDateOfGroup();
					InitializeLastDateOfGroup();
					InitializeItems();
					break;
				case MonthCalendarChange.ItemStyleChange:
					if (_itemArea != null)
					{
						_itemArea.ReinitializeItems(CalendarItemChange.Style);
					}
					break;
				case MonthCalendarChange.SelectionChanged:
					if (_itemArea != null)
					{
						_itemArea.ReinitializeItems(CalendarItemChange.Selection);
					}
					break;
				case MonthCalendarChange.WorkdaysChanged:
					InitializeItems();
					break;
				case MonthCalendarChange.CurrentModeChanged:
					if (!IsGroupForSizing)
					{
						XamMonthCalendar monthCalendar = XamMonthCalendar.GetMonthCalendar(this);
						if (monthCalendar != null)
						{
							CalendarModeInternal = monthCalendar.CurrentCalendarMode;
						}
					}
					break;
				case MonthCalendarChange.TodayChanged:
					if (_itemArea != null)
					{
						_itemArea.ReinitializeItems(CalendarItemChange.Today);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					ResumeInitialize();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RegisterItemArea(ICalendarItemArea itemArea)
		{
			_itemArea = itemArea;
			if (_itemArea != null)
			{
				InitializeItems();
			}
		}

		private void ResumeAnimations(bool preventedAnimations)
		{
			if (preventedAnimations)
			{
				_preventAnimationCount--;
			}
			_suspendAnimationCount--;
			if (_suspendAnimationCount == 0)
			{
				PerformPendingAnimation(_pendingAnimation);
			}
		}

		internal void ResumeInitialize()
		{
			ResumeInitializeImpl();
			ResumeAnimations(preventedAnimations: true);
		}

		private void ResumeInitializeImpl()
		{
			_suspendInitializeCount--;
			if (_suspendInitializeCount == 0 && _initializeNeeded)
			{
				InitializeItems();
			}
		}

		private void SuspendAnimations(bool preventAnimations)
		{
			_suspendAnimationCount++;
			if (preventAnimations)
			{
				_preventAnimationCount++;
			}
		}

		internal void SuspendInitialize()
		{
			SuspendInitializeImpl();
			SuspendAnimations(preventAnimations: true);
		}

		private void SuspendInitializeImpl()
		{
			_suspendInitializeCount++;
		}

		internal void UnregisterItemArea(ICalendarItemArea itemArea)
		{
			if (itemArea == _itemArea)
			{
				_itemArea = null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (!base.IsEnabled)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Disabled", useTransitions);
			}
			else if (base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "MouseOver", "Normal");
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions);
			}
			if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "Focused", "Unfocused");
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Unfocused", useTransitions);
			}
			GoToCalendarState(this, useTransitions);
		}

		internal static void GoToCalendarState(Control control, bool useTransitions)
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(control, GetCurrentCalendarMode(control) switch
			{
				CalendarMode.Centuries => "Century", 
				CalendarMode.Decades => "Decade", 
				CalendarMode.Years => "Year", 
				CalendarMode.Months => "Month", 
				_ => "Day", 
			}, useTransitions);
		}

		internal static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup)
			{
				calendarItemGroup.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}

		private DateTime? CoerceMinMaxDate(DateTime? date)
		{
			if (date.HasValue && _control != null)
			{
				date = _control.CoerceMinMaxDate(date.Value);
			}
			return date;
		}

		private void InitializeControl(XamMonthCalendar control)
		{
			if (control == _control)
			{
				return;
			}
			_control = control;
			if (control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SuspendInitialize();
			try
			{
				CalendarMode calendarModeInternal = CalendarModeInternal;
				if (IsGroupForSizing)
				{
					SetBinding(CalendarModeInternalProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamMonthCalendar.MinCalendarModeProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, control));
				}
				else
				{
					SetBinding(CalendarModeInternalProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamMonthCalendar.CurrentCalendarModeProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, control));
				}
				if (IsGroupForSizing)
				{
					SetBinding(ReferenceDateProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamMonthCalendar.MeasureDateProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, control));
				}
				else
				{
					SetBinding(ReferenceDateProperty, Utilities.CreateBindingObject(XamMonthCalendar.ReferenceDateProperty, BindingMode.OneWay, control));
				}
				if (calendarModeInternal == CalendarModeInternal)
				{
					OnCalendarModeChanged();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeInitialize();
			}
		}

		private void InitializeItems()
		{
			if (!base.IsInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsInitializeSuspended)
			{
				_initializeNeeded = true;
				return;
			}
			_initializeNeeded = false;
			if (_itemArea != null)
			{
				_itemArea.InitializeItems();
			}
		}

		private void InitializeFirstDateOfGroup()
		{
			DateTime date = ReferenceDate ?? CalendarManager.CoerceMinMaxDate(DateTime.Today);
			CalendarMode calendarModeInternal = CalendarModeInternal;
			date = CalendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(date, calendarModeInternal);
			DateTime? dateTime = CalendarManager.TryAddGroupOffset(date, ReferenceGroupOffset, calendarModeInternal, adjustForStart: true);
			if (dateTime.HasValue && _control != null)
			{
				if (!IsGroupForSizing && (dateTime > _control.MaxDate || CalendarManager.GetGroupEndDate(dateTime.Value, calendarModeInternal) < _control.MinDate))
				{
					dateTime = null;
				}
				dateTime = CoerceMinMaxDate(dateTime);
			}
			SetValue(FirstDateOfGroupPropertyKey, dateTime);
		}

		private void InitializeLastDateOfGroup()
		{
			DateTime? firstDateOfGroup = FirstDateOfGroup;
			DateTime? date = (firstDateOfGroup.HasValue ? new DateTime?(CalendarManager.GetGroupEndDate(firstDateOfGroup.Value, CalendarModeInternal)) : ((DateTime?)null));
			date = CoerceMinMaxDate(date);
			DateTime? lastDateOfGroup = LastDateOfGroup;
			SetValue(LastDateOfGroupPropertyKey, date);
			if (lastDateOfGroup != date)
			{
				InitializeItems();
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateItemGroupPanelArrange()
		{
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this) is CalendarItemGroupPanel calendarItemGroupPanel)
			{
				calendarItemGroupPanel.InvalidateArrange();
			}
		}

		private void OnCalendarModeChanged()
		{
			SuspendInitialize();
			try
			{
				InitializeFirstDateOfGroup();
				InitializeLastDateOfGroup();
				if (_itemArea != null)
				{
					_itemArea.InitializeRowColCount();
				}
				InitializeItems();
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeInitialize();
			}
		}

		private static void OnMonthCalendarChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = (CalendarItemGroup)d;
			calendarItemGroup.InitializeControl(e.NewValue as XamMonthCalendar);
			if (e.OldValue != null)
			{
				((XamMonthCalendar)e.OldValue).UnregisterGroup(calendarItemGroup);
			}
			if (e.NewValue != null)
			{
				((XamMonthCalendar)e.NewValue).RegisterGroup(calendarItemGroup);
			}
		}

		private void PerformPendingAnimation(CalendarAnimation? action)
		{
			if (action.HasValue && _itemArea != null)
			{
				CalendarAnimation? calendarAnimation = action;
				CalendarAnimation? pendingAnimation = _pendingAnimation;
				if (calendarAnimation.GetValueOrDefault() == pendingAnimation.GetValueOrDefault() && calendarAnimation.HasValue == pendingAnimation.HasValue && _suspendAnimationCount == 0)
				{
					_pendingAnimation = null;
					_itemArea.PerformAnimationAction(action.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		private void PrepareForAnimation(CalendarAnimation? action)
		{
			if (_itemArea != null && _preventAnimationCount == 0 && AllowAnimation && !_pendingAnimation.HasValue && action.HasValue)
			{
				_pendingAnimation = action;
				_itemArea.PrepareForAnimationAction(action.Value);
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_hasVisualStateGroups = VisualStateUtilities.GetHasVisualStateGroups(this);
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: false);
			FormatTitle();
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new CalendarItemGroupAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			InitializeItems();
			base.OnInitialized(e);
		}

		protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (FirstDateOfGroup.HasValue && LastDateOfGroup.HasValue)
			{
				return string.Format(CalendarManager.DateTimeFormat, "CalendarItemGroup {0:d}-{1:d}", new object[2] { FirstDateOfGroup, LastDateOfGroup });
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}
	}

		internal CalendarManager CalendarManager
		{
			get
			{
				XamMonthCalendar monthCalendar = XamMonthCalendar.GetMonthCalendar(this);
				if (monthCalendar == null)
				{
					return CalendarManager.CurrentCulture;
				}
				return monthCalendar.CalendarManager;
			}
		}

		private CalendarItemGroup ItemGroupForSizing
		{
			get
			{
				if (_itemGroupForSizing == null)
				{
					_itemGroupForSizing = new CalendarItemGroup(null, isSizingGroup: true);
					((ISupportInitialize)_itemGroupForSizing).BeginInit();
					_itemGroupForSizing.Name = "GroupForSizing";
					_itemGroupForSizing.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
					AddVisualChild(_itemGroupForSizing);
					AddLogicalChildHelper(_itemGroupForSizing);
					((ISupportInitialize)_itemGroupForSizing).EndInit();
				}
				return _itemGroupForSizing;
			}
		}

		private void AdjustDimensions(ref Size finalSize, ref CalendarDimensions dims, ref Size itemSize, ref int requiredGroups)
		{
			CalendarDimensions calendarDimensions = dims;

			dims.Columns = Math.Max(1, Math.Max(calendarDimensions.Columns, (int)Math.Round(finalSize.Width / itemSize.Width, 8)));
			dims.Rows = Math.Max(1, Math.Max(calendarDimensions.Rows, (int)Math.Round(finalSize.Height / itemSize.Height, 8)));
			requiredGroups = dims.Columns * dims.Rows;
			if (num <= 0 || requiredGroups <= num)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num2 = requiredGroups - num;
			while (num2 > 0)
			{
				int num3 = num2;
				if ((dims.Columns == calendarDimensions.Columns || dims.Rows >= dims.Columns) && dims.Rows > calendarDimensions.Rows && num2 >= dims.Columns)
				{
					dims.Rows--;
					num2 -= Math.Min(num2, dims.Columns);
				}
				if ((dims.Rows == calendarDimensions.Rows || dims.Columns >= dims.Rows) && dims.Columns > calendarDimensions.Columns && num2 >= dims.Rows)
				{
					dims.Columns--;
					num2 -= Math.Min(num2, dims.Rows);
				}
				if (num3 == num2)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			requiredGroups = num;
		}

		private static void CalculateOffset(ref Size finalSize, ref CalendarDimensions dims, ref Size itemSize, HorizontalAlignment hAlign, VerticalAlignment vAlign, out double xOffset, out double yOffset)
		{
			if (dims.Columns > 0)
			{
				switch (hAlign)
				{
				default:
					xOffset = (finalSize.Width - itemSize.Width * (double)dims.Columns) / 2.0;
					break;
				case HorizontalAlignment.Left:
					xOffset = 0.0;
					break;
				case HorizontalAlignment.Right:
					xOffset = finalSize.Width - itemSize.Width * (double)dims.Columns;
					break;
				case HorizontalAlignment.Stretch:
					xOffset = (finalSize.Width - (double)dims.Columns * itemSize.Width) / (double)(dims.Columns + 1);
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				xOffset = 0.0;
			}
			if (dims.Rows > 0)
			{
				switch (vAlign)
				{
				default:
					yOffset = (finalSize.Height - itemSize.Height * (double)dims.Rows) / 2.0;
					break;
				case VerticalAlignment.Top:
					yOffset = 0.0;
					break;
				case VerticalAlignment.Bottom:
					yOffset = finalSize.Height - itemSize.Height * (double)dims.Rows;
					break;
				case VerticalAlignment.Stretch:
					yOffset = (finalSize.Height - (double)dims.Rows * itemSize.Height) / (double)(dims.Rows + 1);
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				yOffset = 0.0;
			}
		}

		}
