		internal DateTime? TryAddGroupOffset(DateTime date, int offset, CalendarMode mode, bool adjustForStart)
		{
			try
			{
				switch (mode)
				{
				default:
					date = base.Calendar.AddMonths(date, offset);
					break;
				case CalendarMode.Months:
					date = base.Calendar.AddYears(date, offset);
					break;
				case CalendarMode.Years:
				case CalendarMode.Decades:
				case CalendarMode.Centuries:
				{
					int num = (int)Math.Pow(10.0, (double)(1 + (mode - 2)));
					date = base.Calendar.AddYears(date, offset * num);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				if (offset < 0)
				{
					DateTime? dateTime = TryAddGroupOffset(date, offset + 1, mode, adjustForStart: false);
					if (dateTime.HasValue)
					{
						DateTime? dateTime2 = dateTime;
						DateTime minSupportedDateTime = base.Calendar.MinSupportedDateTime;
						if (dateTime2.HasValue && dateTime2.GetValueOrDefault() > minSupportedDateTime && dateTime <= date)
						{
							date = base.Calendar.MinSupportedDateTime;
							if (adjustForStart)
							{
								date = GetGroupStartDate(date, mode);
							}
							return date;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (adjustForStart)
			{
				date = GetGroupStartDate(date, mode);
			}
			return date;
		}

		internal DateTime AddGroupOffset(DateTime date, int offset, CalendarMode mode, bool adjustForStart)
		{
			DateTime? dateTime = TryAddGroupOffset(date, offset, mode, adjustForStart);
			if (!dateTime.HasValue)
			{
				dateTime = CalendarHelper.GetMinMax(base.Calendar, offset < 0).Date;
				if (adjustForStart)
				{
					dateTime = GetGroupStartDate(dateTime.Value, mode);
				}
			}
			return dateTime.Value;
		}

		internal DateTime? TryAddItemOffset(DateTime date, int offset, CalendarMode mode)
		{
			try
			{
				switch (mode)
				{
				default:
					date = base.Calendar.AddDays(date, offset);
					break;
				case CalendarMode.Months:
					date = base.Calendar.AddMonths(date, offset);
					break;
				case CalendarMode.Years:
				case CalendarMode.Decades:
				case CalendarMode.Centuries:
				{
					int num = (int)Math.Pow(10.0, (double)(mode - 2));
					date = base.Calendar.AddYears(date, offset * num);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return date;
		}

		internal DateTime AddItemOffset(DateTime date, int offset, CalendarMode mode)
		{
			DateTime? dateTime = TryAddItemOffset(date, offset, mode);
			if (!dateTime.HasValue)
			{
				dateTime = ((offset >= 0) ? new DateTime?(base.Calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime.Date) : new DateTime?(base.Calendar.MinSupportedDateTime.Date));
			}
			return dateTime.Value;
		}

		private static DateTime FindVisibleDate(DateTime date, DayOfWeekFlags hiddenDays, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar, int offset)
		{
			try
			{
				while (CalendarHelper.IsSet(hiddenDays, calendar.GetDayOfWeek(date)))
				{
					date = calendar.AddDays(date, offset);
				}
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				date = ((offset <= 0) ? calendar.MinSupportedDateTime : calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime);
			}
			return date;
		}

		private int GetDateCount(CalendarMode mode, bool includeLeadingDates, bool includeTrailingDates, ref DateTime firstDate)
		{
			DateTime dateTime = firstDate;
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = base.Calendar;
			DateTime groupStartDate = GetGroupStartDate(dateTime, mode, calendar, DayOfWeekFlags.None);
			DateTime groupEndDate = GetGroupEndDate(dateTime, mode, calendar, DayOfWeekFlags.None);
			int num4;
			switch (mode)
			{
			case CalendarMode.Days:
				num4 = GetDaysInMonth(dateTime);
				break;
			case CalendarMode.Months:
			{
				int year = calendar.GetYear(dateTime);
				int era = calendar.GetEra(dateTime);
				num4 = calendar.GetMonthsInYear(year, era);
				break;
			}
			default:
			{
				double num = Math.Pow(10.0, (double)(mode - 2));
				int num2 = (int)Math.Floor((double)calendar.GetYear(groupEndDate) / num);
				int num3 = (int)Math.Floor((double)calendar.GetYear(groupStartDate) / num);
				num4 = 1 + num2 - num3;
				break;
			}
			}
			if (includeLeadingDates)
			{
				switch (mode)
				{
				case CalendarMode.Days:
				{
					int num5 = GetDayOfWeekNumber(groupStartDate, honorDisabledDays: false);
					if (num5 == 0 && Math.Ceiling((double)GetDaysInMonth(dateTime) / 7.0) <= 5.0)
					{
						num5 += 7;
					}
					firstDate = AddDays(groupStartDate, -num5).Date;
					num4 += groupStartDate.Subtract(firstDate).Days;
					break;
				}
				case CalendarMode.Years:
				case CalendarMode.Decades:
				case CalendarMode.Centuries:
				{
					int years = -(int)Math.Pow(10.0, (double)(mode - 2));
					firstDate = AddYears(groupStartDate, years).Date;
					if (firstDate < dateTime)
					{
						num4++;
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			if (includeTrailingDates)
			{
				switch (mode)
				{
				case CalendarMode.Days:
				{
					int num6 = num4;
					num4 += 6 - GetDayOfWeekNumber(groupEndDate, honorDisabledDays: false);
					if (num6 == 35 || GetDayOfWeekNumber(groupStartDate, honorDisabledDays: false) != 0)
					{
						int num7 = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)num4 / 7.0);
						num4 += 7 * (6 - num7);
					}
					break;
				}
				default:
					num4++;
					break;
				case CalendarMode.Months:
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!includeLeadingDates && mode == CalendarMode.Days && groupStartDate < firstDate)
			{
				num4 -= firstDate.Subtract(groupStartDate).Days;
			}
			return num4;
		}

		public int GetDayOfWeekNumber(DateTime date)
		{
			return GetDayOfWeekNumber(date, DayOfWeekFlags.None, _firstDayOfWeek);
		}

		public int GetDayOfWeekNumber(DateTime date, bool honorDisabledDays)
		{
			DayOfWeekFlags hiddenDays = (honorDisabledDays ? _hiddenDays : DayOfWeekFlags.None);
			return GetDayOfWeekNumber(date, hiddenDays, _firstDayOfWeek);
		}

		internal static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return GetString(name, null);
		}

		internal static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return SR.GetString(name, args);
		}

		internal static int GetItemColumnCount(CalendarMode mode)
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			default:
				return 7;
			case CalendarMode.Months:
				return 4;
			case CalendarMode.Years:
			case CalendarMode.Decades:
			case CalendarMode.Centuries:
				return 4;
			}
		}

		internal DateTime[] GetItemDates(DateTime date, CalendarMode mode, bool includeLeadingDates, bool includeTrailingDates, DateTime minDate, DateTime maxDate)
		{
			DateTime firstDate = date;
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = base.Calendar;
			int dateCount = GetDateCount(mode, includeLeadingDates, includeTrailingDates, ref firstDate);
			DateTime[] array = new DateTime[dateCount];
			DateTime dateTime = firstDate;
			DayOfWeekFlags dayOfWeekFlags = ((mode == CalendarMode.Days) ? _hiddenDays : DayOfWeekFlags.None);
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < dateCount; i++)
			{
				if (dayOfWeekFlags == DayOfWeekFlags.None || !CalendarHelper.IsSet(dayOfWeekFlags, calendar.GetDayOfWeek(dateTime)))
				{
					DateTime itemEndDate = GetItemEndDate(dateTime, mode);
					if (!(itemEndDate < minDate) && !(dateTime > maxDate))
					{
						array[num] = dateTime;
						num++;
					}
				}
				dateTime = AddItemOffset(dateTime, 1, mode);
				dateTime = GetItemStartDate(dateTime, mode);
				if ((num == 0 && dateTime <= GetItemEndDate(firstDate, mode)) || (num > 0 && dateTime <= GetItemEndDate(array[num - 1], mode)))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (array.Length > num)
			{
				Array.Resize(ref array, num);
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal void GetItemRowColumn(DateTime date, CalendarMode mode, DateTime groupStartDate, bool showsLeadingDates, out int colOffset, out int rowOffset)
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case CalendarMode.Days:
			{
				rowOffset = 0;
				colOffset = GetDayOfWeekNumber(date, honorDisabledDays: true);
				DateTime groupStartDate2 = GetGroupStartDate(groupStartDate, mode, base.Calendar, DayOfWeekFlags.None);
				int dayOfWeekNumber = GetDayOfWeekNumber(groupStartDate2, honorDisabledDays: false);
				if (dayOfWeekNumber == 0 && (!showsLeadingDates || date >= groupStartDate2) && GetDaysInMonth(groupStartDate2) < 35)
				{
					rowOffset = 1;
				}
				if (date > groupStartDate2)
				{
					int num4 = GetDayOfMonth(date) - 1;
					num4 += dayOfWeekNumber;
					rowOffset += num4 / 7;
				}
				break;
			}
			case CalendarMode.Months:
			{
				int num3 = base.Calendar.GetMonth(date) - 1;
				colOffset = num3 % 4;
				rowOffset = num3 / 4;
				break;
			}
			default:
			{
				double num = Math.Pow(10.0, (double)(mode - 2));
				int num2 = ((int)Math.Floor((double)base.Calendar.GetYear(date) / num) + 1) % 10;
				colOffset = num2 % 4;
				rowOffset = num2 / 4;
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		internal static string GetDayOfWeekCaption(DayOfWeekHeaderFormat format, DayOfWeek day, DateTimeFormatInfo formatInfo)
		{
			formatInfo = formatInfo ?? CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.DateTimeFormat;
			string text;
			if (format == DayOfWeekHeaderFormat.Abbreviated)
			{
				text = formatInfo.AbbreviatedDayNames[(int)day];
			}
			else
			{
				text = formatInfo.DayNames[(int)day];
				switch (format)
				{
				case DayOfWeekHeaderFormat.SingleCharacter:
					text = GetShortDayOfWeekCaption(text, 1, formatInfo);
					break;
				case DayOfWeekHeaderFormat.TwoCharacters:
					text = GetShortDayOfWeekCaption(text, 2, formatInfo);
					break;
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static string GetDayOfWeekCaption(string dayOfWeek, int index, int length)
		{
			int[] array = StringInfo.ParseCombiningCharacters(dayOfWeek);
			int num = array.Length;
			if (index >= array.Length)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (num <= length)
			{
				return dayOfWeek;
			}
			if (num == index + length)
			{
				return dayOfWeek.Substring(array[index]);
			}
			return dayOfWeek.Substring(array[index], array[index + length] - array[index]);
		}

		internal string[] GetDayOfWeekCaptions(DayOfWeekHeaderFormat format)
		{
			string[] array = format switch
			{
				DayOfWeekHeaderFormat.Full => base.DateTimeFormat.DayNames, 
				DayOfWeekHeaderFormat.SingleCharacter => GetShortDaysOfWeek(1), 
				DayOfWeekHeaderFormat.TwoCharacters => GetShortDaysOfWeek(2), 
				_ => base.DateTimeFormat.AbbreviatedDayNames, 
			};
			int firstDayOfWeekResolved = (int)FirstDayOfWeekResolved;
			if (firstDayOfWeekResolved > 0)
			{
				string[] array2 = new string[firstDayOfWeekResolved];
				Array.Copy(array, 0, array2, 0, firstDayOfWeekResolved);
				Array.Copy(array, firstDayOfWeekResolved, array, 0, 7 - firstDayOfWeekResolved);
				Array.Copy(array2, 0, array, 7 - firstDayOfWeekResolved, firstDayOfWeekResolved);
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal DayOfWeek[] GetDaysOfWeek()
		{
			int firstDayOfWeekResolved = (int)FirstDayOfWeekResolved;
			List<DayOfWeek> list = new List<DayOfWeek>(VisibleDayCount);
			for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
			{
				DayOfWeek dayOfWeek = (DayOfWeek)((i + firstDayOfWeekResolved) % 7);
				if (!CalendarHelper.IsSet(HiddenDays, dayOfWeek))
				{
					list.Add(dayOfWeek);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal DateTime GetGroupEndDate(DateTime date, CalendarMode mode)
		{
			return GetGroupEndDate(date, mode, base.Calendar, _hiddenDays);
		}

		internal static DateTime GetGroupEndDate(DateTime date, CalendarMode mode, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar, DayOfWeekFlags hiddenDays)
		{
			int month = calendar.GetMonth(date);
			int num = calendar.GetYear(date);
			int era = calendar.GetEra(date);
			int daysInMonth = calendar.GetDaysInMonth(num, month, era);
			DateTime dateTime;
			try
			{
				switch (mode)
				{
				case CalendarMode.Months:
					month = calendar.GetMonthsInYear(num, era);
					daysInMonth = calendar.GetDaysInMonth(num, month, era);
					break;
				case CalendarMode.Years:
				case CalendarMode.Decades:
				case CalendarMode.Centuries:
				{
					int num2 = (int)Math.Pow(10.0, (double)(1 + (mode - 2)));
					num += num2 - 1 - num % num2;
					month = calendar.GetMonthsInYear(num, era);
					daysInMonth = calendar.GetDaysInMonth(num, month, era);
					break;
				}
				}
				dateTime = calendar.ToDateTime(num, month, daysInMonth, 0, 0, 0, 0, era);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				dateTime = calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime;
			}
			if (hiddenDays == (DayOfWeekFlags.Sunday | DayOfWeekFlags.Monday | DayOfWeekFlags.Tuesday | DayOfWeekFlags.Wednesday | DayOfWeekFlags.Thursday | DayOfWeekFlags.Friday | DayOfWeekFlags.Saturday))
			{
				return dateTime;
			}
			return FindVisibleDate(dateTime, hiddenDays, calendar, -1);
		}

		internal DateTime GetItemEndDate(DateTime date, CalendarMode mode)
		{
			return GetItemEndDate(date, mode, base.Calendar);
		}

		internal static DateTime GetItemEndDate(DateTime date, CalendarMode mode, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar)
		{
			int month = calendar.GetMonth(date);
			int num = calendar.GetYear(date);
			int era = calendar.GetEra(date);
			int day = calendar.GetDaysInMonth(num, month, era);
			try
			{
				switch (mode)
				{
				case CalendarMode.Days:
					day = calendar.GetDayOfMonth(date);
					break;
				case CalendarMode.Years:
					month = calendar.GetMonthsInYear(num, era);
					day = calendar.GetDaysInMonth(num, month, era);
					break;
				case CalendarMode.Decades:
				case CalendarMode.Centuries:
				{
					int num2 = (int)Math.Pow(10.0, (double)(1 + (mode - 3)));
					num += num2 - 1 - num % num2;
					month = calendar.GetMonthsInYear(num, era);
					day = calendar.GetDaysInMonth(num, month, era);
					break;
				}
				}
				return calendar.ToDateTime(num, month, day, 0, 0, 0, 0, era);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				return calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime;
			}
		}

		private string[] GetShortDaysOfWeek(int charCount)
		{
			string[] dayNames = base.DateTimeFormat.DayNames;
			string[] array = new string[7];
			for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
			{
				array[i] = GetShortDayOfWeekCaption(dayNames[i], charCount, base.DateTimeFormat);
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal static string GetShortDayOfWeekCaption(string dayOfWeek, int preferredChars, DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormat)
		{
			string text = null;
			int num = 0;
			do
			{
				text = GetDayOfWeekCaption(dayOfWeek, num, preferredChars);
				if (InUniqueDayOfWeekCaption(num, dayOfWeek, text, preferredChars, dateTimeFormat))
				{
					break;
				}
				num++;
			}
			while (text != null);
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = GetDayOfWeekCaption(dayOfWeek, num, preferredChars);
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal DateTime GetGroupStartDate(DateTime date, CalendarMode mode)
		{
			return GetGroupStartDate(date, mode, base.Calendar, _hiddenDays);
		}

		internal static DateTime GetGroupStartDate(DateTime date, CalendarMode mode, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar, DayOfWeekFlags hiddenDays)
		{
			int month = 1;
			int num = calendar.GetYear(date);
			int era = calendar.GetEra(date);
			switch (mode)
			{
			case CalendarMode.Days:
				month = calendar.GetMonth(date);
				break;
			case CalendarMode.Years:
			case CalendarMode.Decades:
			case CalendarMode.Centuries:
			{
				int num2 = (int)Math.Pow(10.0, (double)(1 + (mode - 2)));
				num -= num % num2;
				if (num < 1)
				{
					num = 1;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			DateTime dateTime;
			try
			{
				dateTime = calendar.ToDateTime(num, month, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, era);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				dateTime = calendar.MinSupportedDateTime;
			}
			if (hiddenDays == (DayOfWeekFlags.Sunday | DayOfWeekFlags.Monday | DayOfWeekFlags.Tuesday | DayOfWeekFlags.Wednesday | DayOfWeekFlags.Thursday | DayOfWeekFlags.Friday | DayOfWeekFlags.Saturday))
			{
				return dateTime;
			}
			return FindVisibleDate(dateTime, hiddenDays, calendar, 1);
		}

		internal DateTime GetItemStartDate(DateTime date, CalendarMode mode)
		{
			return GetItemStartDate(date, mode, base.Calendar);
		}

		internal static DateTime GetItemStartDate(DateTime date, CalendarMode mode, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar)
		{
			int month = 1;
			int num = calendar.GetYear(date);
			int era = calendar.GetEra(date);
			switch (mode)
			{
			case CalendarMode.Days:
				return date;
			case CalendarMode.Months:
				month = calendar.GetMonth(date);
				break;
			case CalendarMode.Years:
			case CalendarMode.Decades:
			case CalendarMode.Centuries:
			{
				int num2 = (int)Math.Pow(10.0, (double)(mode - 2));
				num -= num % num2;
				break;
			}
			}
			try
			{
				return calendar.ToDateTime(num, month, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, era);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException)
			{
				return calendar.MinSupportedDateTime;
			}
		}

		public int GetWeekNumberForDate(DateTime date)
		{
			int yearContainingWeek;
			return GetWeekNumberForDate(date, _weekRule, _firstDayOfWeek, out yearContainingWeek);
		}

		internal void InitializeCulture(CultureInfo cultureInfo)
		{
			if (cultureInfo == null)
			{
				cultureInfo = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			}
			Initialize(cultureInfo.Calendar, cultureInfo.DateTimeFormat);
		}

		private static bool InUniqueDayOfWeekCaption(int index, string dayOfWeek, string text, int length, DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormat)
		{
			string[] dayNames = dateTimeFormat.DayNames;
			foreach (string text2 in dayNames)
			{
				if (!(text2 == dayOfWeek) && text != GetDayOfWeekCaption(text2, index, length))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void VerifyCanChange()
		{
			if (this == currentCulture)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The shared current culture CalendarManager cannot be changed.");
			}
		}
	}

	internal sealed class CurrentDate : DependencyObject
	{
		private delegate void MethodInvoker();

		private static WeakList<CurrentDate> _instances;

		private static object _currentDate;

		private static readonly object Lock;

		private static DispatcherTimer _timer;

		private static bool _canHookSystemTime;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ValuePropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty;

		public EventHandler ValueChanged;

		[Bindable(true)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		public DateTime Value => (DateTime)GetValue(ValueProperty);

		static CurrentDate()
		{
			Lock = new object();
			_canHookSystemTime = true;
			ValuePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Value", typeof(DateTime), typeof(CurrentDate), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(DateTime.Today, OnValueChanged));
			ValueProperty = ValuePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			_currentDate = DateTime.Today;
			_instances = new WeakList<CurrentDate>();
		}

		public CurrentDate()
		{
			AddInstance(this);
		}

		private static void OnValueChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			CurrentDate currentDate = d as CurrentDate;
			currentDate.ValueChanged?.Invoke(currentDate, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private static void AddInstance(CurrentDate item)
		{
			lock (Lock)
			{
				_instances.Add(item);
				item.SetValue(ValuePropertyKey, _currentDate);
				if (_instances.Count == 1)
				{
					StartDateWatch(item.Dispatcher);
				}
				else if (_instances.Count % 20 == 0)
				{
					_instances.Compact();
					CurrentDate currentDate = _instances[0];
					if (currentDate == null)
					{
						EndDateWatch();
					}
					else if (currentDate.Dispatcher != _timer.Dispatcher)
					{
						EndDateWatch();
						StartDateWatch(currentDate.Dispatcher);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CheckForDateChange()
		{
			DateTime today = DateTime.Today;
			DateTime dateTime = (DateTime)_currentDate;
			if (!(today != dateTime))
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (Lock)
			{
				_currentDate = today;
				foreach (CurrentDate instance in _instances)
				{
					if (instance.CheckAccess())
					{
						instance.SetValue(ValuePropertyKey, _currentDate);
					}
					else
					{
						instance.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Send, new SendOrPostCallback(UpdateCurrentDate), instance);
					}
				}
				_instances.Compact();
				if (_instances.Count == 0)
				{
					EndDateWatch();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void EndDateWatch()
		{
			if (_timer != null)
			{
				DispatcherTimer timer = _timer;
				_timer = null;
				timer.Stop();
				UnhookSystemTimeChange();
			}
		}

		private static bool HookSystemTimeChange()
		{
			if (_canHookSystemTime)
			{
				try
				{
					HookSystemTimeChangeImpl();
					return true;
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_canHookSystemTime = false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static void HookSystemTimeChangeImpl()
		{
			SystemEvents.TimeChanged += OnSystemTimeChanged;
		}

		private static void OnSystemTimeChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CheckForDateChange();
		}

		private static void OnTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender == _timer)
			{
				CheckForDateChange();
			}
		}

		private static void StartDateWatch(Dispatcher dispatcher)
		{
			TimeSpan interval = (HookSystemTimeChange() ? DateTime.Today.AddDays(1.0).Subtract(DateTime.Now.Subtract(TimeSpan.FromMinutes(0.5))) : TimeSpan.FromMinutes(0.2));
			_timer = new DispatcherTimer(interval, DispatcherPriority.ContextIdle, OnTimerTick, dispatcher);
		}

		private static void UnhookSystemTimeChange()
		{
			if (_canHookSystemTime)
			{
				try
				{
					UnhookSystemTimeChangeImpl();
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					_canHookSystemTime = false;
				}
			}
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
		private static void UnhookSystemTimeChangeImpl()
		{
			SystemEvents.TimeChanged -= OnSystemTimeChanged;
		}

		private static void UpdateCurrentDate(object param)
		{
			if (param is CurrentDate currentDate)
			{
				currentDate.SetValue(ValuePropertyKey, _currentDate);
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class DayOfWeekToStringConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Length < 1 || values.Length > 2)
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			if (!(values[0] is DayOfWeek))
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			DayOfWeek day = (DayOfWeek)values[0];
			DayOfWeekHeaderFormat format = DayOfWeekHeaderFormat.Abbreviated;
			if (values.Length > 1)
			{
				if (!(values[1] is DayOfWeekHeaderFormat))
				{
					return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
				}
				format = (DayOfWeekHeaderFormat)values[1];
			}
			culture = culture ?? CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormat = culture.DateTimeFormat;
			return CalendarManager.GetDayOfWeekCaption(format, day, dateTimeFormat);
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return new object[1] { Binding.DoNothing };
		}
	}

		private static InputGestureCollection CreateGestureCombinations(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers)
		{
			InputGestureCollection inputGestureCollection = new InputGestureCollection();
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control | ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt | ModifierKeys.Control);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Shift);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Control);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.Alt);
			AddGesture(inputGestureCollection, key, modifiers, ModifierKeys.None);
			return inputGestureCollection;
		}

		private static void AddGesture(InputGestureCollection gestures, Key key, ModifierKeys gestureModifiers, ModifierKeys modifierToCheck)
		{
			if ((gestureModifiers & modifierToCheck) == modifierToCheck)
			{
				gestures.Add(new KeyGesture(key, modifierToCheck));
			}
		}

		protected override object GetKeyboardParameter(ICommandHost commandHost, RoutedCommand command, KeyEventArgs keyArgs)
		{
			Key key = keyArgs.Key;
			if (key == Key.System)
			{
				key = keyArgs.SystemKey;
			}
			switch (key)
			{
			case Key.Left:
			case Key.Up:
			case Key.Right:
			case Key.Down:
				return NavigationKeyParameter;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class SelectedDateCollection : ObservableCollection<DateTime>
	{
		private XamMonthCalendar _owner;

		private DateTime[] _sortedDates;

		internal SelectedDateCollection(XamMonthCalendar owner)
		{
			Utils.ValidateNull("owner", owner);
			_owner = owner;
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			DateTime[] array = new DateTime[base.Count];
			CopyTo(array, 0);
			InvalidateSortedDates();
			base.ClearItems();
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				RaiseSelectionChanged(new DateTime[0], array);
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, DateTime item)
		{
			item = item.Date;
			VerifyCanAdd(item);
			if (base.Count + 1 > _owner.MaxSelectedDatesResolved)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utils.GetString("LE_MaxSelectedDatesExceeded", base.Count + 1, _owner.MaxSelectedDatesResolved));
			}
			InvalidateSortedDates();
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			RaiseSelectionChanged(new DateTime[1] { item }, new DateTime[0]);
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			InvalidateSortedDates();
			_owner.SelectedDate = ((base.Items.Count == 0) ? ((DateTime?)null) : new DateTime?(base.Items[0]));
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			DateTime dateTime = base[index];
			InvalidateSortedDates();
			base.RemoveItem(index);
			RaiseSelectionChanged(new DateTime[0], new DateTime[1] { dateTime });
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, DateTime item)
		{
			item = item.Date;
			VerifyCanAdd(item);
			InvalidateSortedDates();
			DateTime dateTime = base[index];
			base.SetItem(index, item);
			RaiseSelectionChanged(new DateTime[1] { item }, new DateTime[1] { dateTime });
		}

		internal bool ContainsSelection(DateTime start, DateTime end)
		{
			if (start == end)
			{
				return IsSelected(start);
			}
			VerifySortedDates();
			int num = Array.BinarySearch(_sortedDates, start);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			num = ~num;
			int num2 = Array.BinarySearch(_sortedDates, end);
			if (num2 >= 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			num2 = ~num2;
			int i = num;
			for (int num3 = Math.Min(num2, _sortedDates.Length - 1); i <= num3; i++)
			{
				DateTime dateTime = _sortedDates[i];
				if (dateTime >= start && dateTime <= end)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void EnsureWithinMinMax()
		{
			if (base.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			VerifySortedDates();
			DateTime minDate = _owner.MinDate;
			DateTime maxDate = _owner.MaxDate;
			int num = Array.BinarySearch(_sortedDates, minDate);
			int num2 = Array.BinarySearch(_sortedDates, maxDate);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				num2 = ~num2;
				num2--;
			}
			int num3 = num2 - num + 1;
			if (num3 >= base.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<DateTime> list = new List<DateTime>(Math.Max(num3, 0));
			if (num3 > 0)
			{
				CalendarDateRange calendarDateRange = new CalendarDateRange(minDate, maxDate);
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = base.Items.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					DateTime dateTime = base.Items[i];
					if (calendarDateRange.Contains(dateTime))
					{
						list.Add(dateTime);
					}
				}
			}
			Reinitialize(list.ToArray());
		}

		internal bool IsSelected(DateTime date)
		{
			VerifySortedDates();
			return Array.BinarySearch(_sortedDates, date) >= 0;
		}

		private void RaiseSelectionChanged(IList<DateTime> selected, IList<DateTime> unselected)
		{
			_owner.OnSelectedStateChanged(selected, unselected);
			_owner.RaiseSelectedDatesChanged(new SelectedDatesChangedEventArgs(unselected, selected));
		}

		internal void Reinitialize(IList<DateTime> newSelection)
		{
			List<DateTime> list = new List<DateTime>();
			List<DateTime> list2 = new List<DateTime>();
			CalculateDelta(newSelection, list, list2);
			InvalidateSortedDates();
			base.Items.Clear();
			foreach (DateTime item in newSelection)
			{
				base.Items.Add(item);
			}
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Count"));
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Item[]"));
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			if (list.Count > 0 || list2.Count > 0)
			{
				RaiseSelectionChanged(list, list2);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateDelta(IList<DateTime> newSelection, List<DateTime> datesSelected, List<DateTime> datesUnselected)
		{
			if (newSelection.Count == 0)
			{
				datesUnselected.AddRange(this);
				return;
			}
			if (base.Count == 0)
			{
				datesSelected.AddRange(newSelection);
				return;
			}
			datesUnselected.AddRange(this);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = newSelection.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				DateTime date = newSelection[i].Date;
				if (IsSelected(date))
				{
					datesUnselected.Remove(date);
				}
				else
				{
					datesSelected.Add(date);
				}
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateSortedDates()
		{
			_sortedDates = null;
		}

		private void SyncSortedDates()
		{
			DateTime[] array = new DateTime[base.Count];
			CopyTo(array, 0);
			Array.Sort(array, Comparer<DateTime>.Default);
			_sortedDates = array;
		}

		private void VerifyCanAdd(DateTime date)
		{
			VerifySortedDates();
			if (Array.BinarySearch(_sortedDates, date) > 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Utils.GetString("LE_DateAlreadySelected", date));
			}
		}

		private void VerifySortedDates()
		{
			if (_sortedDates == null)
			{
				SyncSortedDates();
			}
		}

		public void AddRange(DateTime start, DateTime end, bool allowPartialSelection)
		{
			DateTime[] selectableDates = _owner.GetSelectableDates(new CalendarDateRange(start.Date, end.Date));
			if (selectableDates == null || selectableDates.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = selectableDates.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < selectableDates.Length; i++)
			{
				VerifyCanAdd(selectableDates[i]);
			}
			int maxSelectedDatesResolved = _owner.MaxSelectedDatesResolved;
			if (base.Count + num > maxSelectedDatesResolved)
			{
				if (!allowPartialSelection)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Utils.GetString("LE_MaxSelectedDatesExceeded", base.Count + num, maxSelectedDatesResolved));
				}
				num = maxSelectedDatesResolved - base.Count;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				base.Items.Add(selectableDates[j]);
			}
			InvalidateSortedDates();
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Count"));
			OnPropertyChanged(new PropertyChangedEventArgs("Item[]"));
			OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			RaiseSelectionChanged(selectableDates, new DateTime[0]);
		}

		public void Sort()
		{
			if (base.Count > 0)
			{
				VerifySortedDates();
				Reinitialize(_sortedDates);
			}
		}
	}

		private class CustomSingleSelectionStrategy : SelectionStrategySingle
		{
			private const int ScrollInterval = 250;

			protected override int AutoScrollHorizontalIntervalMax => 250;

			protected override int AutoScrollHorizontalIntervalMin => 250;

			protected override int AutoScrollVerticalIntervalMax => 250;

			protected override int AutoScrollVerticalIntervalMin => 250;

			protected override int PixelThresholdForHorizontalAutoScroll => 5;

			protected override int PixelThresholdForVerticalAutoScroll => 5;

			internal CustomSingleSelectionStrategy(ISelectionHost host)
				: base(host)
			{
				base.AllowToggle = false;
			}

			public override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(ISelectableItem item, MouseEventArgs e)
			{
				XamMonthCalendar xamMonthCalendar = base.SelectionHost as XamMonthCalendar;
				if (xamMonthCalendar != null)
				{
					xamMonthCalendar._shouldProcessActiveSelectionChanged = false;
				}
				try
				{
					base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(item, e);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (xamMonthCalendar != null)
					{
						bool flag = xamMonthCalendar._shouldProcessActiveSelectionChanged == true;
						xamMonthCalendar._shouldProcessActiveSelectionChanged = null;
						if (flag)
						{
							xamMonthCalendar.ProcessActiveSelectionStrategyChanged();
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal int MaxSelectedDatesResolved
		{
			get
			{
				SelectionType selectionTypeResolved = SelectionTypeResolved;
				if (SelectionStrategyBase.IsMultiSelectStrategy(selectionTypeResolved))
				{
					int num = MaxSelectedDates;
					if (num == 0)
					{
						num = int.MaxValue;
					}
					return num;
				}
				if (SelectionStrategyBase.IsSingleSelectStrategy(selectionTypeResolved))
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private MonthCalendarStates CurrentState
		{
			get
			{
				MonthCalendarStates monthCalendarStates = (MonthCalendarStates)0L;
				if (_groups.Count > 0)
				{
					CalendarItemGroup firstGroup = GetFirstGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: true, ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups: true);
					CalendarItemGroup lastGroup = GetLastGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: true, ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups: true);
					if (firstGroup != null && firstGroup.FirstDateOfGroup <= MinDate)
					{
						monthCalendarStates |= MonthCalendarStates.MinDateInView;
					}
					if (lastGroup != null && lastGroup.LastDateOfGroup >= MaxDate)
					{
						monthCalendarStates |= MonthCalendarStates.MaxDateInView;
					}
					if (CanActivate(DateTime.Today))
					{
						monthCalendarStates |= MonthCalendarStates.TodayIsEnabled;
					}
					if (ActiveDate.HasValue)
					{
						monthCalendarStates |= MonthCalendarStates.ActiveDate;
					}
					if (CurrentCalendarMode > MinCalendarMode)
					{
						monthCalendarStates |= MonthCalendarStates.CanZoomInCalendarMode;
					}
					if (CurrentCalendarMode < MaxCalendarMode && (!IsDateInView(MinDate, ignoreLeadingTrailingDates: true, ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups: false) || !IsDateInView(MaxDate, ignoreLeadingTrailingDates: true, ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups: false)))
					{
						monthCalendarStates |= MonthCalendarStates.CanZoomOutCalendarMode;
					}
					switch (CurrentCalendarMode)
					{
					case CalendarMode.Days:
						monthCalendarStates |= MonthCalendarStates.CalendarModeDays;
						break;
					case CalendarMode.Decades:
						monthCalendarStates |= MonthCalendarStates.CalendarModeDecades;
						break;
					case CalendarMode.Centuries:
						monthCalendarStates |= MonthCalendarStates.CalendarModeCenturies;
						break;
					case CalendarMode.Months:
						monthCalendarStates |= MonthCalendarStates.CalendarModeMonths;
						break;
					case CalendarMode.Years:
						monthCalendarStates |= MonthCalendarStates.CalendarModeYears;
						break;
					}
					if (IsMinCalendarMode)
					{
						monthCalendarStates |= MonthCalendarStates.MinCalendarMode;
					}
				}
				if (base.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft)
				{
					monthCalendarStates |= MonthCalendarStates.RightToLeft;
				}
				return monthCalendarStates;
			}
		}

		private CalendarItemGroup FirstGroup => GetFirstGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: true, ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups: false);

		private CalendarItemGroup LastGroup => GetLastGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: true, ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups: false);

		public XamMonthCalendar()
		{
			try
			{
				_license = LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(XamMonthCalendar), this) as UltraLicense;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
			}
			_calendarManager = new CalendarManager();
			_groups = new List<CalendarItemGroup>();
			_calendarManager.FirstDayOfWeek = FirstDayOfWeek;
			_calendarManager.WeekRule = WeekRule;
			_daysOfWeekInternal = new ObservableCollectionExtended<DayOfWeek>();
			_daysOfWeekInternal.CollectionChanged += OnDaysOfWeekChanged;
			_daysOfWeekInternal.ReInitialize(_calendarManager.GetDaysOfWeek());
			_daysOfWeek = new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<DayOfWeek>(_daysOfWeekInternal);
			_disabledDates = new CalendarDateRangeCollection(this);
			_disabledDates.CollectionChanged += OnDisabledDatesChanged;
			_selectedDates = new SelectedDateCollection(this);
			_selectedDatesSnapshot = new ObservableCollectionExtended<DateTime>();
			SetValue(MonthCalendarPropertyKey, this);
			_currentDateWatcher = new CurrentDate();
			CurrentDate currentDateWatcher = _currentDateWatcher;
			currentDateWatcher.ValueChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(currentDateWatcher.ValueChanged, new EventHandler(OnCurrentDateChanged));
			SetValue(TodayPropertyKey, _currentDateWatcher.GetValue(CurrentDate.ValueProperty));
		}

		private static object CoerceActiveDate(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			XamMonthCalendar xamMonthCalendar = (XamMonthCalendar)d;
			if (value == null)
			{
				value = xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDate ?? DateTime.Today;
			}
			if (value != null)
			{
				DateTime date = (DateTime)value;
				CalendarMode currentCalendarMode = xamMonthCalendar.CurrentCalendarMode;
				date = xamMonthCalendar._calendarManager.GetItemStartDate(date, currentCalendarMode);
				date = xamMonthCalendar.CoerceMinMaxDate(date);
				DateTime itemEndDate = xamMonthCalendar._calendarManager.GetItemEndDate(date, currentCalendarMode);
				itemEndDate = xamMonthCalendar.CoerceMinMaxDate(itemEndDate);
				value = xamMonthCalendar.GetActivatableDate(date, itemEndDate, next: true, currentCalendarMode);
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = xamMonthCalendar.GetClosestActivatableDate(date, itemEndDate);
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void OnActiveDateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamMonthCalendar xamMonthCalendar = (XamMonthCalendar)d;
			if (xamMonthCalendar == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			xamMonthCalendar.ClearPreferredNavInfo();
			if (e.NewValue is DateTime)
			{
				DateTime date = (DateTime)e.NewValue;
				if (!xamMonthCalendar._suppressBringActiveDateInView && !xamMonthCalendar.IsDateInView(date, ignoreLeadingTrailingDates: true))
				{
					if (xamMonthCalendar._shouldBringActiveDateIntoView.HasValue && xamMonthCalendar.IsDateInView(date, ignoreLeadingTrailingDates: false, ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups: false))
					{
						xamMonthCalendar._shouldBringActiveDateIntoView = true;
					}
					else
					{
						if (xamMonthCalendar._shouldBringActiveDateIntoView == true)
						{
							xamMonthCalendar._shouldBringActiveDateIntoView = false;
						}
						xamMonthCalendar.BringDateIntoView(date);
					}
					if (xamMonthCalendar.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
					{
						xamMonthCalendar.UpdateLayout();
					}
				}
				bool isNavigationMode = xamMonthCalendar.IsNavigationMode;
				if (e.OldValue is DateTime)
				{
					CalendarItem item = xamMonthCalendar.GetItem((DateTime)e.OldValue);
					if (item != null)
					{
						item.SetValue(CalendarItem.IsActivePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
						if (isNavigationMode)
						{
							item.SetValue(CalendarItem.IsSelectedPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
						}
					}
				}
				CalendarItem item2 = xamMonthCalendar.GetItem(date);
				if (item2 != null)
				{
					item2.SetValue(CalendarItem.IsActivePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					if (isNavigationMode)
					{
						item2.SetValue(CalendarItem.IsSelectedPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
					}
					if (xamMonthCalendar.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
					{
						item2.Focus();
					}
				}
				if (xamMonthCalendar.CurrentCalendarMode == CalendarMode.Days && xamMonthCalendar.EraDisplayMode == EraDisplayMode.ActiveDate)
				{
					xamMonthCalendar.NotifyGroupChange(MonthCalendarChange.ActiveDayChange);
				}
			}
			else if (e.OldValue is DateTime)
			{
				xamMonthCalendar.GetItem((DateTime)e.OldValue)?.SetValue(CalendarItem.IsActivePropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
			}
		}

		private static void OnItemStyleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((XamMonthCalendar)d).NotifyGroupChange(MonthCalendarChange.ItemStyleChange);
		}

		private static object CoerceCurrentCalendarMode(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			XamMonthCalendar xamMonthCalendar = (XamMonthCalendar)d;
			CalendarMode calendarMode = (CalendarMode)value;
			if (calendarMode < xamMonthCalendar.MinCalendarMode)
			{
				return xamMonthCalendar.GetValue(MinCalendarModeProperty);
			}
			if (calendarMode > xamMonthCalendar.MaxCalendarMode)
			{
				return xamMonthCalendar.MaxCalendarMode;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void OnCurrentCalendarModeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamMonthCalendar xamMonthCalendar = (XamMonthCalendar)d;
			xamMonthCalendar.ClearPreferredNavInfo();
			xamMonthCalendar.NotifyGroupChange(MonthCalendarChange.CurrentModeChanged);
			bool suppressBringActiveDateInView = xamMonthCalendar._suppressBringActiveDateInView;
			xamMonthCalendar._suppressBringActiveDateInView = true;
			try
			{
				xamMonthCalendar.CoerceValue(ActiveDateProperty);
			}
			finally
			{
				xamMonthCalendar._suppressBringActiveDateInView = suppressBringActiveDateInView;
			}
		}

		private static void OnMaxSelectedDatesChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

				DateTime[] array = new DateTime[xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDates.Count];

			}
		}

		private static void OnSelectedDateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamMonthCalendar xamMonthCalendar = (XamMonthCalendar)d;
			if (xamMonthCalendar == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.NewValue == null)
			{
				xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDates.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				if (xamMonthCalendar.SelectionType == SelectionType.None)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(GetString("LE_MaxSelectedDatesExceeded", 1, 0));
				}
				DateTime date = ((DateTime)e.NewValue).Date;
				if (xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDates.Count == 0 || xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDates[0] != date)
				{
					xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDates.Reinitialize(new DateTime[1] { date });
				}
			}
			if (e.NewValue != null && SelectionStrategyBase.IsSingleSelectStrategy(xamMonthCalendar.SelectionTypeResolved))
			{
				xamMonthCalendar.SetCurrentValue(ActiveDateProperty, e.NewValue);
			}
			else
			{
				xamMonthCalendar.CoerceValue(ActiveDateProperty);
			}
		}

		private static void OnSelectionTypeChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamMonthCalendar xamMonthCalendar = (XamMonthCalendar)d;
			SelectionType selectionTypeResolved = xamMonthCalendar.SelectionTypeResolved;
			if (SelectionStrategyBase.IsSingleSelectStrategy(selectionTypeResolved))
			{
				xamMonthCalendar._pivotDate = xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDate;
				if (xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDates.Count > 1)
				{
					xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDates.Reinitialize(new DateTime[1] { xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDates[0] });
				}
			}
			else if (!SelectionStrategyBase.IsMultiSelectStrategy(selectionTypeResolved))
			{
				xamMonthCalendar._pivotDate = null;
				xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDates.Clear();
			}
		}

			return Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SelectionType), value);
		}

				xamMonthCalendar._calendarManager.HiddenDays = hiddenDays;
				if (!xamMonthCalendar.InitializeDaysOfWeek())
				{
					xamMonthCalendar.NotifyGroupChange(MonthCalendarChange.DisabledDatesChanged);
				}
			}
		}

		public void BringDateIntoView(DateTime date)
		{
			BringDateIntoView(date, null);
		}

		internal void BringDateIntoView(DateTime date, CalendarItemGroup group)
		{
			int groupIndex = ((group == null) ? (-1) : _groups.IndexOf(group));
			BringDateIntoView(date, groupIndex, ignoreLeadingAndTrailingDates: true);
		}

		internal void BringDateIntoView(DateTime date, int groupIndex, bool ignoreLeadingAndTrailingDates)
		{
			if (_shouldBringActiveDateIntoView.HasValue)
			{
				_shouldBringActiveDateIntoView = false;
			}
			date = CoerceMinMaxDate(date);
			if (_groups.Count == 0)
			{
				ReferenceDate = date;
				return;
			}
			DateTime value;
			DateTime? referenceDate;
			if (groupIndex < 0)
			{
				if (!IsDateInView(date, ignoreLeadingAndTrailingDates))
				{
					if (_groups.Count == 1)
					{
						ReferenceDate = date;
						return;
					}
					CalendarMode currentCalendarMode = CurrentCalendarMode;
					DateTime groupStartDate = _calendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(date, currentCalendarMode);
					value = groupStartDate;
					referenceDate = ReferenceDate;
					CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = ((value < referenceDate) ? GetFirstGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: false) : GetLastGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: false));
					int referenceGroupOffset = calendarItemGroup.ReferenceGroupOffset;
					groupStartDate = _calendarManager.AddGroupOffset(groupStartDate, -referenceGroupOffset, currentCalendarMode, adjustForStart: true);
					ReferenceDate = groupStartDate;
				}
				return;
			}
			groupIndex = Math.Min(_groups.IndexOf(GetFirstGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: false)), Math.Max(_groups.IndexOf(GetLastGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: false)), groupIndex));
			CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup2 = _groups[groupIndex];
			DateTime? dateTime = null;
			DateTime? dateTime2 = null;
			if (calendarItemGroup2.FirstDateOfGroup.HasValue)
			{
				dateTime = (ignoreLeadingAndTrailingDates ? calendarItemGroup2.FirstDateOfGroup.Value : calendarItemGroup2.FirstDate);
			}
			if (calendarItemGroup2.LastDateOfGroup.HasValue)
			{
				dateTime2 = (ignoreLeadingAndTrailingDates ? calendarItemGroup2.LastDateOfGroup.Value : calendarItemGroup2.LastDate);
			}
			value = date;
			referenceDate = dateTime;
			if (value < referenceDate || dateTime2 < date || !dateTime.HasValue || !dateTime2.HasValue)
			{
				CalendarMode currentCalendarMode2 = CurrentCalendarMode;
				DateTime groupStartDate2 = _calendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(date, currentCalendarMode2);
				groupStartDate2 = _calendarManager.AddGroupOffset(date, -groupIndex, currentCalendarMode2, adjustForStart: true);
				ReferenceDate = groupStartDate2;
			}
		}

		public bool ExecuteCommand(RoutedCommand command)
		{
			return ExecuteCommandImpl(new ExecuteCommandInfo(command));
		}

		public bool ExecuteCommand(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			return ExecuteCommandImpl(commandInfo);
		}

		private bool ExecuteCommandImpl(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			Utils.ValidateNull("commandInfo", commandInfo);
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = commandInfo.RoutedCommand;
			object parameter = commandInfo.Parameter;
			object originalSource = commandInfo.OriginalSource;
			Utils.ValidateNull("command", routedCommand);
			if (!Commands<XamMonthCalendar>.IsMinimumStatePresentForCommand(this, routedCommand))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ExecutingCommandEventArgs e = new ExecutingCommandEventArgs(routedCommand);
			if (!RaiseExecutingCommand(e))
			{
				return !e.ContinueKeyRouting;
			}
			bool shiftKeyDown = (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) != 0;
			bool ctlKeyDown = (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) != 0;
			bool flag = false;
			if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.ScrollNextGroup || routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.ScrollPreviousGroup)
			{
				int numberOfGroups = ((routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.ScrollNextGroup) ? 1 : (-1));
				flag = ScrollGroups(AdjustGroupCountForScrollDirection(numberOfGroups));
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.ToggleActiveDateSelection)
			{
				flag = ToggleActiveDateSelection(shiftKeyDown, ctlKeyDown);
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.ScrollNextGroups || routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.ScrollPreviousGroups)
			{
				int num = ((parameter is int) ? AdjustGroupCountForScrollDirection((int)parameter) : (GetLastGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: false).ReferenceGroupOffset - GetFirstGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: false).ReferenceGroupOffset + 1));
				if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.ScrollPreviousGroups)
				{
					num *= -1;
				}
				flag = ScrollGroups(num);
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.ScrollToDate)
			{
				if (parameter is DateTime date)
				{
					CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = null;
					if (originalSource is DependencyObject)
					{
						calendarItemGroup = ((!(originalSource is CalendarItemGroup)) ? ((CalendarItemGroup)Utilities.GetAncestorFromType((DependencyObject)originalSource, typeof(CalendarItemGroup), allowSubclassOfType: true)) : ((CalendarItemGroup)originalSource));
					}
					BringDateIntoView(date, calendarItemGroup);
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.ActivateDate)
			{
				DateTime? dateValue = null;
				if (parameter is DateTime)
				{
					dateValue = (DateTime)parameter;
				}
				else
				{
					CalendarItem calendarItem = parameter as CalendarItem;
					if (calendarItem == null && originalSource is DependencyObject)
					{
						calendarItem = ((!(originalSource is CalendarItem)) ? ((CalendarItem)Utilities.GetAncestorFromType((DependencyObject)originalSource, typeof(CalendarItem), allowSubclassOfType: true)) : ((CalendarItem)originalSource));
					}
					if (calendarItem != null)
					{
						dateValue = calendarItem.StartDate;
					}
				}
				flag = ActivateDate(dateValue, useSelectionStrategy: false);
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.ActivateSelectedDate)
			{
				SetActiveDate(SelectedDate);
				flag = true;
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.Today)
			{
				flag = ActivateDate(DateTime.Today);
				if (CurrentCalendarMode == MinCalendarMode)
				{
					RaiseSelectionCommitted(new RoutedEventArgs());
				}
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.PreviousItem || routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.NextItem)
			{
				flag = ActivateDate(GetActivatableDate(ActiveDate, routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.PreviousItem, includeInitialDate: false));
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.PreviousItemRow || routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.NextItemRow)
			{
				if (ActiveDate.HasValue)
				{
					flag = NavigateRow(ActiveDate.Value, routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.NextItemRow);
				}
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.PreviousGroup || routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.NextGroup)
			{
				if (ActiveDate.HasValue)
				{
					flag = NavigateGroup(ActiveDate.Value, routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.NextGroup);
				}
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.FirstItemOfGroup)
			{
				if (ActiveDate.HasValue)
				{
					DateTime? activatableDate = GetActivatableDate(_calendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(ActiveDate.Value, CurrentCalendarMode), previousItem: false, includeInitialDate: true);
					flag = ActivateDate(activatableDate);
				}
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.LastItemOfGroup)
			{
				if (ActiveDate.HasValue)
				{
					DateTime? activatableDate2 = GetActivatableDate(_calendarManager.GetGroupEndDate(ActiveDate.Value, CurrentCalendarMode), previousItem: true, includeInitialDate: true);
					flag = ActivateDate(activatableDate2);
				}
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.FirstItemOfFirstGroup)
			{
				CalendarItemGroup firstGroup = GetFirstGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: false);
				if (firstGroup != null)
				{
					DateTime? activatableDate3 = GetActivatableDate(firstGroup.FirstDateOfGroup, previousItem: false, includeInitialDate: true);
					flag = ActivateDate(activatableDate3);
				}
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.LastItemOfLastGroup)
			{
				CalendarItemGroup lastGroup = GetLastGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: false);
				if (lastGroup != null)
				{
					DateTime? activatableDate4 = GetActivatableDate(lastGroup.LastDateOfGroup, previousItem: true, includeInitialDate: true);
					flag = ActivateDate(activatableDate4);
				}
			}
			else if (routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.ZoomOutCalendarMode || routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.ZoomInCalendarMode)
			{
				ChangeCalendarMode(routedCommand == MonthCalendarCommands.ZoomOutCalendarMode, parameter, originalSource);
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				RaiseExecutedCommand(new ExecutedCommandEventArgs(routedCommand));
			}
			if (parameter == MonthCalendarCommands.NavigationKeyParameter)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal bool CanActivate(DateTime date)
		{
			return GetActivatableItemDate(date, CurrentCalendarMode).HasValue;
		}

		internal bool CanActivate(DateTime start, DateTime end, CalendarMode mode)
		{
			return GetActivatableDate(start, end, next: true, mode).HasValue;
		}

		internal DateTime CoerceMinMaxDate(DateTime date)
		{
			date = date.Date;
			if (date > MaxDate)
			{
				date = MaxDate;
			}
			else if (date < MinDate)
			{
				date = MinDate;
			}
			return date;
		}

		internal void FocusActiveItemWithDelay()
		{
			if (!base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool preventFocusActiveItem = _preventFocusActiveItem;
			_preventFocusActiveItem = true;
			try
			{
				Focus();
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Render, new Utils.MethodInvoker(FocusActiveItem));
			}
			finally
			{
				_preventFocusActiveItem = preventFocusActiveItem;
			}
		}

		internal DateTime? GetActivatableDate(CalendarItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetActivatableDate(item.StartDate, item.EndDate, next: true, CurrentCalendarMode);
		}

		internal DateTime? GetActivatableDate(DateTime start, DateTime end, bool next)
		{
			return GetActivatableDate(start, end, next, CurrentCalendarMode);
		}

		internal DateTime? GetActivatableDate(DateTime start, DateTime end, bool next, CalendarMode mode)
		{
			if (end < MinDate || start > MaxDate)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (mode != MinCalendarMode)
			{
				if (!next)
				{
					return end;
				}
				return start;
			}
			DateTime start2 = CoerceMinMaxDate(start);
			DateTime end2 = CoerceMinMaxDate(end);
			int disabledDaysOfWeek = (int)DisabledDaysOfWeek;
			int daysOfWeek = GetDaysOfWeek(start2, end2);
			if ((disabledDaysOfWeek & daysOfWeek) == daysOfWeek)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return _disabledDates.GetAvailableDate(start2, end2, next);
		}

		private DateTime? GetActivatableItemDate(DateTime date, CalendarMode mode)
		{
			DateTime itemStartDate = CalendarManager.GetItemStartDate(date, mode);
			DateTime itemEndDate = CalendarManager.GetItemEndDate(date, mode);
			return GetActivatableDate(itemStartDate, itemEndDate, next: true, mode);
		}

		internal CalendarItemGroup GetGroup(DateTime date)
		{
			CalendarItemGroup result = null;
			if (_groups.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _groups.Count; i++)
				{
					CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = _groups[i];
					if (calendarItemGroup.Items.Count == 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (!calendarItemGroup.FirstDateOfGroup.HasValue || calendarItemGroup.FirstDate > date)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (calendarItemGroup.LastDate < date)
					{
						continue;
					}
					result = calendarItemGroup;
					if (calendarItemGroup.FirstDateOfGroup <= date)
					{
						DateTime value = date;
						DateTime? lastDateOfGroup = calendarItemGroup.LastDateOfGroup;
						if (value <= lastDateOfGroup)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal IEnumerable<CalendarItemGroup> GetGroups()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < _groups.Count; i++)
			{
				yield return _groups[i];
			}
		}

		internal DateTime[] GetSelectableDates(CalendarDateRange range)
		{
			range.Normalize();
			range.RemoveTime();
			if (range.End > MaxDate || range.Start < MinDate)
			{
				return new DateTime[0];
			}
			if (range.Start < MinDate)
			{
				range.Start = MinDate;
			}
			else if (range.End > MaxDate)
			{
				range.End = MaxDate;
			}
			List<DateTime> list = new List<DateTime>();
			_disabledDates.AddAvailableDates(range, list);
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal bool InternalSelectItem(ISelectableItem item, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select)
		{
			CalendarItem item2 = GetItem(item);
			DateTime? activatableDate = GetActivatableDate(item2);
			return InternalSelectItem(activatableDate, clearExistingSelection, select);
		}

		internal bool InternalSelectItem(DateTime? date, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select)
		{
			if (!date.HasValue && (!clearExistingSelection || _selectedDates.Count == 0))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (date.HasValue && select && !CanActivate(date.Value))
			{
				select = false;
			}
			if (date.HasValue && SelectedDates.IsSelected(date.Value) == select && (!clearExistingSelection || _selectedDates.Count == 0))
			{
				return true;
			}
			IList<DateTime> newSelection = CalculateNewSelection(date, clearExistingSelection, select);
			SelectedDates.Reinitialize(newSelection);
			return true;
		}

		internal bool InternalSelectRange(ISelectableItem item, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select)
		{
			CalendarItem item2 = GetItem(item);
			if (item2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!_pivotDate.HasValue)
			{
				SelectionHost.SetPivotItem(item2, isRangeSelect: false);
			}
			DateTime? activatableDate = GetActivatableDate(item2);
			IList<DateTime> newSelection = CalculateNewSelectionRange(activatableDate, clearExistingSelection, select);
			SelectedDates.Reinitialize(newSelection);
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsDateInView(DateTime date, bool ignoreLeadingTrailingDates)
		{
			return IsDateInView(date, ignoreLeadingTrailingDates, IsMinCalendarMode && !AllowLeadingAndTrailingGroupActivation);
		}

		internal bool IsDateInView(DateTime date, bool ignoreLeadingTrailingDates, bool ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups)
		{
			if (_groups.Count > 0)
			{
				CalendarItemGroup firstGroup = GetFirstGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: true, ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups);
				CalendarItemGroup lastGroup = GetLastGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: true, ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups);
				if (firstGroup != null && lastGroup != null)
				{
					DateTime dateTime = (ignoreLeadingTrailingDates ? firstGroup.FirstDateOfGroup.Value : firstGroup.FirstDate);
					DateTime dateTime2 = (ignoreLeadingTrailingDates ? lastGroup.LastDateOfGroup.Value : lastGroup.LastDate);
					if (date >= dateTime && date <= dateTime2)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void UnregisterGroup(CalendarItemGroup group)

				if (group == _groupForSizing)

					_groupForSizing = null;
				}
			}
			else

			}
		}

				UpdateSelectedState(datesUnselected, select: false);

			}
		}

		private static void InitializeCalendarCulture(XamMonthCalendar calendar, XmlLanguage language)
		{
			calendar._currentCulture = null;
			try
			{
				if (calendar._parentEditor != null && calendar._parentEditor.FormatProviderResolved is CultureInfo)
				{
					calendar._currentCulture = calendar._parentEditor.FormatProviderResolved as CultureInfo;
				}
				else if (DateFormatCultureOverride != null)
				{
					calendar._currentCulture = DateFormatCultureOverride;
				}
				else
				{
					calendar._currentCulture = Utilities.GetLanguageCultureInfo(calendar);
				}
			}
			catch (InvalidOperationException)
			{
				calendar._currentCulture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
			}
			calendar._eraFormatMonthFormat = null;
			calendar._currentCultureHasMultipleEras = calendar._currentCulture.DateTimeFormat.Calendar.Eras.Length > 1;
			if (calendar._currentCultureHasMultipleEras)
			{
				try
				{
					Hashtable foreignDateSymbols = null;
					XamMaskedEditor.GetNonstandardForeignDateMaskAndPostfixSymbols(calendar._currentCulture, ref foreignDateSymbols);
					char c = (char)foreignDateSymbols[typeof(MonthSection)];
					if (c > '\0')
					{
						StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
						stringBuilder.Append("{0:M");
						stringBuilder.Append(c);
						stringBuilder.Append("}");
						calendar._eraFormatMonthFormat = stringBuilder.ToString();
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			using (new CalendarItemGroup.GroupInitializationHelper(calendar._groups))
			{
				calendar.ClearPreferredNavInfo();
				calendar._calendarManager.InitializeCulture(calendar._currentCulture);
				calendar.CoerceAllDates();
				calendar.InitializeDaysOfWeek();
			}
		}

		private bool ActivateDate(DateTime? dateValue)
		{
			return ActivateDate(dateValue, useSelectionStrategy: true);
		}

		private bool ActivateDate(DateTime? dateValue, bool useSelectionStrategy)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (dateValue.HasValue)
			{
				DateTime? activatableItemDate = GetActivatableItemDate(dateValue.Value, CurrentCalendarMode);
				if (!activatableItemDate.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				DateTime value = dateValue.Value;
				bool flag = true;
				if (useSelectionStrategy)
				{
					if (!_pivotDate.HasValue)
					{
						_pivotDate = SelectedDate ?? ActiveDate;
					}
					BringDateIntoView(value);
					CalendarItem item = GetItem(value);
					if (item != null)
					{
						SelectionStrategyBase selectionStrategyForItem = SelectionHost.GetSelectionStrategyForItem(item);
						if (selectionStrategyForItem != null)
						{
							bool shiftKeyDown = (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) != 0;
							bool controlKeyDown = (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) != 0;
							result = selectionStrategyForItem.SelectItemViaKeyboard(item, shiftKeyDown, controlKeyDown, forceToggle: false);
							flag = false;
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					SetActiveDate(value);
					result = ActiveDate == activatableItemDate;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private int AdjustGroupCountForScrollDirection(int numberOfGroups)
		{
			if (ScrollDirection == Orientation.Vertical)
			{
				CalendarItemGroupPanel templateChild = Utilities.GetTemplateChild<CalendarItemGroupPanel>(this);
				if (templateChild != null && templateChild.Columns > 1)
				{
					numberOfGroups *= templateChild.Columns;
				}
			}
			return numberOfGroups;
		}

		internal IList<DateTime> CalculateNewSelection(DateTime? date, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select)
		{
			List<DateTime> list = new List<DateTime>();
			if (!clearExistingSelection)
			{
				list.AddRange(_selectedDates);
			}
			if (date.HasValue)
			{
				if (select)
				{
					if (CanActivate(date.Value))
					{
						list.Add(date.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list.Remove(date.Value);
				}
			}
			if (select)
			{
				EnsureItemsWithinMaxSelectedItemsBounds(list);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal IList<DateTime> CalculateNewSelectionRange(DateTime? date, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select)
		{
			List<DateTime> list = new List<DateTime>();
			if (!_pivotDate.HasValue)
			{
				return list;
			}
			if (date.HasValue)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				DateTime value = _pivotDate.Value;
				DateTime? dateTime = date;
				DateTime value2;
				DateTime value3;
				if (value <= dateTime)
				{
					value2 = _pivotDate.Value;
					value3 = date.Value;
				}
				else
				{
					flag = true;
					value2 = date.Value;
					value3 = _pivotDate.Value;
				}
				if (!clearExistingSelection)
				{
					foreach (DateTime item in _selectedDatesSnapshot)
					{
						if (item < value2 || item > value3)
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
				if (select)
				{
					int offset = 1;
					if (flag)
					{
						value2 = _pivotDate.Value;
						value3 = date.Value;
						offset = -1;
					}
					CalendarMode currentCalendarMode = CurrentCalendarMode;
					DateTime? dateTime2 = value2;
					while (dateTime2.HasValue && (flag || !(dateTime2 > value3)) && (!flag || !(dateTime2 < value3)))
					{
						DateTime? activatableItemDate = GetActivatableItemDate(dateTime2.Value, currentCalendarMode);
						if (activatableItemDate.HasValue)
						{
							list.Add(activatableItemDate.Value);
						}
						dateTime2 = _calendarManager.TryAddItemOffset(dateTime2.Value, offset, currentCalendarMode);
					}
				}
				if (select)
				{
					EnsureItemsWithinMaxSelectedItemsBounds(list);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void ChangeCalendarMode(bool zoomOut, object commandParameter, object originalSource)
		{
			CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = null;
			DateTime? dateTime = null;
			if (commandParameter is DateTime)
			{
				dateTime = (DateTime)commandParameter;
			}
			if (zoomOut)
			{
				calendarItemGroup = commandParameter as CalendarItemGroup;
				if (calendarItemGroup == null && originalSource is DependencyObject)
				{
					calendarItemGroup = ((!(originalSource is CalendarItemGroup)) ? ((CalendarItemGroup)Utilities.GetAncestorFromType((DependencyObject)originalSource, typeof(CalendarItemGroup), allowSubclassOfType: true)) : ((CalendarItemGroup)originalSource));
				}
				if (!dateTime.HasValue && calendarItemGroup != null)
				{
					dateTime = calendarItemGroup.FirstDateOfGroup;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CalendarItem calendarItem = commandParameter as CalendarItem;
				if (calendarItem == null && originalSource is DependencyObject)
				{
					calendarItem = ((!(originalSource is CalendarItem)) ? ((CalendarItem)Utilities.GetAncestorFromType((DependencyObject)originalSource, typeof(CalendarItem), allowSubclassOfType: true)) : ((CalendarItem)originalSource));
				}
				if (calendarItem != null)
				{
					calendarItemGroup = calendarItem.Group;
					if (!dateTime.HasValue)
					{
						dateTime = calendarItem.StartDate;
					}
				}
			}
			DateTime? dateTime2 = dateTime;
			if (calendarItemGroup == null && FocusWithinManager.CheckFocusWithinHelper(this))
			{
				if (ActiveDate.HasValue)
				{
					calendarItemGroup = GetGroup(ActiveDate.Value);
				}
				if (calendarItemGroup != null && !dateTime.HasValue)
				{
					dateTime2 = (dateTime = ActiveDate);
				}
			}
			int num = calendarItemGroup?.ReferenceGroupOffset ?? 0;
			int num2 = (zoomOut ? 1 : (-1));
			CalendarMode calendarMode = (CalendarMode)(num2 + (int)CurrentCalendarMode);
			using (new CalendarItemGroup.GroupInitializationHelper(_groups, preventAnimations: false))
			{
				try
				{
					_zoomFocusGroup = calendarItemGroup;
					CurrentCalendarMode = calendarMode;
				}
				finally
				{
					_zoomFocusGroup = null;
				}
				if (CurrentCalendarMode == calendarMode && dateTime2.HasValue)
				{
					DateTime dateTime3 = _calendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(dateTime2.Value, calendarMode);
					if (num != 0)
					{
						dateTime3 = _calendarManager.AddGroupOffset(dateTime3, -num, calendarMode, adjustForStart: true);
					}
					ReferenceDate = dateTime3;
				}
				CoerceValue(ReferenceDateProperty);
			}
			DateTime? dateTime4 = dateTime ?? ActiveDate;
			if (!dateTime4.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			CalendarItem item = GetItem(dateTime4.Value);
			if (item != null)
			{
				if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					item.Focus();
				}
				else
				{
					SetActiveDate(item.StartDate);
				}
			}
		}

		{
			XamMonthCalendar xamMonthCalendar = (XamMonthCalendar)d;
			if (!xamMonthCalendar.IsKeyboardFocused && xamMonthCalendar.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)

				return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;

			return newValue;
		}

		private void EnsureItemsWithinMaxSelectedItemsBounds(List<DateTime> newSelection)
		{
			int maxSelectedDatesResolved = MaxSelectedDatesResolved;
			int num = newSelection.Count - maxSelectedDatesResolved;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				newSelection.RemoveRange(newSelection.Count - num, num);
			}
		}

		private DateTime? GetActivatableDate(DateTime? date, bool previousItem, bool includeInitialDate)
		{
			return GetActivatableDate(date, previousItem, includeInitialDate, coerceMinMax: true);
		}

		private DateTime? GetActivatableDate(DateTime? date, bool previousItem, bool includeInitialDate, bool coerceMinMax)
		{
			DateTime? dateTime = date;
			if (dateTime.HasValue)
			{
				if (coerceMinMax)
				{
					dateTime = CoerceMinMaxDate(dateTime.Value);
				}
				CalendarMode currentCalendarMode = CurrentCalendarMode;
				DateTime dateTime2 = _calendarManager.GetItemStartDate(dateTime.Value, currentCalendarMode);
				DateTime itemEndDate = _calendarManager.GetItemEndDate(dateTime2, currentCalendarMode);
				int offset = ((!previousItem) ? 1 : (-1));
				dateTime = ((!includeInitialDate) ? ((DateTime?)null) : GetActivatableDate(dateTime2, itemEndDate, next: true));
				if (!dateTime.HasValue)
				{
					do
					{
						dateTime = _calendarManager.TryAddItemOffset(dateTime2, offset, currentCalendarMode);
						if (dateTime < MinDate || dateTime > MaxDate)
						{
							dateTime = null;
						}
						if (!dateTime.HasValue)
						{
							break;
						}
						dateTime2 = dateTime.Value;
						itemEndDate = _calendarManager.GetItemEndDate(dateTime2, currentCalendarMode);
						dateTime = GetActivatableDate(dateTime.Value, itemEndDate, next: true);
					}
					while (!dateTime.HasValue);
				}
			}
			return dateTime;
		}

		private DateTime? GetClosestActivatableDate(DateTime itemStart, DateTime itemEnd)
		{
			DateTime? activatableDate = GetActivatableDate(itemStart, MaxDate, next: true);
			DateTime? activatableDate2 = GetActivatableDate(MinDate, itemStart, next: false);
			bool flag = true;
			if (activatableDate.HasValue && activatableDate2.HasValue)
			{
				TimeSpan timeSpan = activatableDate.Value.Subtract(itemStart);
				TimeSpan timeSpan2 = itemEnd.Subtract(activatableDate2.Value);
				flag = timeSpan2 > timeSpan;
			}
			else if (activatableDate2.HasValue)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return activatableDate2;
			}
			return activatableDate;
		}

		private int GetDaysOfWeek(DateTime start, DateTime end)
		{
			if (start == end)
			{
				return 1 << (int)_calendarManager.Calendar.GetDayOfWeek(start);
			}
			if (end.Subtract(start).Days > 6)
			{
				return 127;
			}
			int num = 0;
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = _calendarManager.Calendar;
			int i = 0;
			for (int days = end.Subtract(start).Days; i < days; i++)
			{
				num |= 1 << (int)calendar.GetDayOfWeek(start);
				start = _calendarManager.AddDays(start, 1).Date;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private DateTime GetDefaultReferenceDate()
		{
			DateTime date = ActiveDate ?? DateTime.Today;
			return GetDefaultReferenceDate(date);
		}

		private DateTime GetDefaultReferenceDate(DateTime date)
		{
			CalendarMode currentCalendarMode = CurrentCalendarMode;
			date = CoerceMinMaxDate(date);
			date = _calendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(date, currentCalendarMode);
			date = CoerceMinMaxDate(date);
			if (_groups.Count > 0)
			{
				int referenceGroupOffset = GetLastGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: false, ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups: true).ReferenceGroupOffset;
				DateTime? dateTime = _calendarManager.TryAddGroupOffset(date, referenceGroupOffset, currentCalendarMode, adjustForStart: true);
				if (!dateTime.HasValue || dateTime.Value > MaxDate)
				{
					dateTime = _calendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(MaxDate, currentCalendarMode);
					DateTime? dateTime2 = _calendarManager.TryAddGroupOffset(dateTime.Value, -referenceGroupOffset, currentCalendarMode, adjustForStart: true);
					date = ((dateTime2.HasValue && !(dateTime2.Value < MinDate)) ? dateTime2.Value : _calendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(MinDate, currentCalendarMode));
				}
				int referenceGroupOffset2 = GetFirstGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups: false, ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups: true).ReferenceGroupOffset;
				if (referenceGroupOffset2 < 0)
				{
					DateTime? dateTime3 = _calendarManager.TryAddGroupOffset(date, referenceGroupOffset2, currentCalendarMode, adjustForStart: true);
					if (!dateTime3.HasValue || dateTime3 < MinDate)
					{
						dateTime3 = _calendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(MinDate, currentCalendarMode);
						DateTime? dateTime4 = _calendarManager.TryAddGroupOffset(dateTime3.Value, -referenceGroupOffset2, currentCalendarMode, adjustForStart: true);
						date = (dateTime4.HasValue ? dateTime4.Value : _calendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(MaxDate, currentCalendarMode));
					}
				}
				date = CoerceMinMaxDate(date);
			}
			return date;
		}

		private CalendarItemGroup GetFirstGroup(bool ignoreEmptyGroups)
		{
			return GetFirstGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups, !AllowLeadingAndTrailingGroupActivation);
		}

		private CalendarItemGroup GetFirstGroup(bool ignoreEmptyGroups, bool ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _groups.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = _groups[i];
				if ((!ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups || !calendarItemGroup.IsLeadingOrTrailingGroup) && (!ignoreEmptyGroups || calendarItemGroup.Items.Count > 0))
				{
					return calendarItemGroup;
				}
			}
			if (ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups)
			{
				return GetFirstGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups, ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups: false);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private ISelectableItem GetFirstLastItem(CalendarItem sourceItem, Point pt, CalendarItemGroup group)
		{
			CalendarItem[] array = new CalendarItem[2]
			{
				group.Items[0],
				group.Items[group.Items.Count - 1]
			};
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				GeneralTransform generalTransform = array[i].TransformToAncestor(this);
				Rect rect = new Rect(array[i].RenderSize);
				rect = generalTransform.TransformBounds(rect);
				if (!(pt.Y >= rect.Y) || !(pt.Y < rect.Bottom) || ((i != 0 || !(pt.X < rect.X)) && (i != 1 || !(pt.X >= rect.Right))))
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = _groups.IndexOf(group);
				if (i == 0 && sourceItem.StartDate < array[i].StartDate)
				{
					if (num > 0)
					{
						CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = _groups[num - 1];
						if (calendarItemGroup.Items.Count > 0)
						{
							return calendarItemGroup.Items[calendarItemGroup.Items.Count - 1];
						}
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (i == 1 && sourceItem.StartDate > array[i].StartDate)
				{
					if (num < _groups.Count - 1)
					{
						CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup2 = _groups[num + 1];
						if (calendarItemGroup2.Items.Count > 0)
						{
							return calendarItemGroup2.Items[0];
						}
					}
					continue;
				}
				return array[i];
			}
			return null;
		}
