			return GetLastGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups, !AllowLeadingAndTrailingGroupActivation);
		}

		private CalendarItemGroup GetLastGroup(bool ignoreEmptyGroups, bool ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups)
		{
			for (int num = _groups.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = _groups[num];
				if ((!ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups || !calendarItemGroup.IsLeadingOrTrailingGroup) && (!ignoreEmptyGroups || calendarItemGroup.Items.Count > 0))
				{
					return calendarItemGroup;
				}
			}
			if (ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups)
			{
				return GetLastGroup(ignoreEmptyGroups, ignoreLeadingTrailingGroups: false);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool HasOverlappingGroups()
		{
			if (_groups != null)
			{
				DateTime? dateTime = null;
				for (int i = 0; i < _groups.Count; i++)
				{
					CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = _groups[i];
					if (!calendarItemGroup.LastDateOfGroup.HasValue)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (dateTime.HasValue)
					{
						DateTime firstDate = calendarItemGroup.FirstDate;
						DateTime? dateTime2 = dateTime;
						if (firstDate <= dateTime2)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					dateTime = calendarItemGroup.LastDate;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool InitializeDaysOfWeek()
		{
			if (!base.IsInitialized)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DayOfWeek[] daysOfWeek = _calendarManager.GetDaysOfWeek();
			bool flag = daysOfWeek.Length != _daysOfWeekInternal.Count;
			if (!flag)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < daysOfWeek.Length; i++)
				{
					if (daysOfWeek[i] != _daysOfWeekInternal[i])
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				_daysOfWeekInternal.ReInitialize(daysOfWeek);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool NavigateGroup(DateTime date, bool next)
		{
			CalendarMode currentCalendarMode = CurrentCalendarMode;
			int num = (next ? 1 : (-1));
			if (_preferredGroupNavStart.HasValue)
			{
				date = _preferredGroupNavStart.Value;
				num += _preferredGroupOffset;
			}
			DateTime? dateTime2;
			while (true)
			{
				DateTime dateTime = CalendarManager.AddGroupOffset(date, num, currentCalendarMode, adjustForStart: false);
				DateTime groupStartDate = CalendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(dateTime, currentCalendarMode);
				DateTime groupEndDate = CalendarManager.GetGroupEndDate(dateTime, currentCalendarMode);
				DateTime itemEndDate = CalendarManager.GetItemEndDate(dateTime, currentCalendarMode);
				dateTime2 = (next ? GetActivatableDate(dateTime, groupEndDate, next: true) : GetActivatableDate(groupStartDate, itemEndDate, next: false));
				if (dateTime2.HasValue)
				{
					break;
				}
				dateTime2 = ((!next) ? GetActivatableDate(dateTime, groupEndDate, next: true) : GetActivatableDate(groupStartDate, itemEndDate, next: false));
				if (dateTime2.HasValue)
				{
					break;
				}
				if ((next && groupEndDate >= MaxDate) || (!next && groupStartDate <= MinDate))
				{
					return false;
				}
				num += (next ? 1 : (-1));
			}
			dateTime2 = GetActivatableDate(CalendarManager.GetItemStartDate(dateTime2.Value, currentCalendarMode), CalendarManager.GetItemEndDate(dateTime2.Value, currentCalendarMode), next: true);
			bool flag = ActivateDate(dateTime2);
			if (flag)
			{
				_preferredGroupOffset = num;
				_preferredGroupNavStart = date;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool NavigateRow(DateTime date, bool next)
		{
			CalendarMode currentCalendarMode = CurrentCalendarMode;
			int itemColumnCount = CalendarManager.GetItemColumnCount(currentCalendarMode);
			int offset = ((!next) ? (-itemColumnCount) : itemColumnCount);
			DateTime groupStartDate = CalendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(date, currentCalendarMode);
			CalendarManager.GetItemRowColumn(date, currentCalendarMode, groupStartDate, showsLeadingDates: false, out var colOffset, out var _);
			if (_preferredNavColumn >= 0 && colOffset != _preferredNavColumn)
			{
				date = CalendarManager.AddItemOffset(date, _preferredNavColumn - colOffset, currentCalendarMode);
				colOffset = _preferredNavColumn;
			}
			DateTime? dateTime3;
			while (true)
			{
				DateTime dateTime = CalendarManager.AddItemOffset(date, offset, currentCalendarMode);
				DateTime dateTime2 = CalendarManager.AddItemOffset(dateTime, -colOffset, currentCalendarMode);
				DateTime date2 = CalendarManager.AddItemOffset(dateTime, itemColumnCount - colOffset - 1, currentCalendarMode);
				date2 = CalendarManager.GetItemEndDate(date2, currentCalendarMode);
				DateTime itemEndDate = CalendarManager.GetItemEndDate(dateTime, currentCalendarMode);
				dateTime3 = ((!next) ? GetActivatableDate(dateTime, date2, next: true) : GetActivatableDate(dateTime2, itemEndDate, next: false));
				if (dateTime3.HasValue)
				{
					break;
				}
				dateTime3 = ((!next) ? GetActivatableDate(dateTime2, itemEndDate, next: false) : GetActivatableDate(dateTime, date2, next: true));
				if (dateTime3.HasValue)
				{
					break;
				}
				if ((next && date2 >= MaxDate) || (!next && dateTime2 <= MinDate))
				{
					return false;
				}
				date = dateTime;
			}
			dateTime3 = GetActivatableDate(CalendarManager.GetItemStartDate(dateTime3.Value, currentCalendarMode), CalendarManager.GetItemEndDate(dateTime3.Value, currentCalendarMode), next: true);
			bool flag = ActivateDate(dateTime3);
			if (flag && ShouldCachePreferredNavInfo(currentCalendarMode))
			{
				_preferredNavColumn = colOffset;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void NotifyGroupChange(MonthCalendarChange change)
		{
			if (_groupForSizing != null)
			{
				_groupForSizing.OnCalendarChange(change);
			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = _groups.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				_groups[i].OnCalendarChange(change);
			}
			if (change == MonthCalendarChange.DisabledDatesChanged)
			{
				CoerceValue(ActiveDateProperty);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessActiveSelectionStrategyChanged()
		{
			if (_shouldProcessActiveSelectionChanged == false)
			{
				_shouldProcessActiveSelectionChanged = true;
				return;
			}
			SelectionStrategyBase selectionStrategyBase = ((_activeStrategy == null) ? null : (CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_activeStrategy) as SelectionStrategyBase));
			bool? shouldBringActiveDateIntoView = _shouldBringActiveDateIntoView;
			if (selectionStrategyBase == null)
			{
				_shouldBringActiveDateIntoView = null;
			}
			else if (!_shouldBringActiveDateIntoView.HasValue)
			{
				_shouldBringActiveDateIntoView = false;
			}
			bool? flag = shouldBringActiveDateIntoView;
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (flag == true == flag2 && flag.HasValue && !_shouldBringActiveDateIntoView.HasValue && ActiveDate.HasValue)
			{
				BringDateIntoView(ActiveDate.Value);
			}
		}

		private bool ScrollGroups(int numberOfGroups)
		{
			if (_groups.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DateTime date = ReferenceDate ?? GetDefaultReferenceDate();
			DateTime minDate = MinDate;
			DateTime maxDate = MaxDate;
			CalendarMode currentCalendarMode = CurrentCalendarMode;
			date = _calendarManager.AddGroupOffset(date, numberOfGroups, currentCalendarMode, adjustForStart: true);
			if (date > maxDate)
			{
				DateTime dateTime = _calendarManager.AddGroupOffset(_calendarManager.GetGroupStartDate(maxDate, currentCalendarMode), -LastGroup.ReferenceGroupOffset, currentCalendarMode, adjustForStart: true);
				if (date > dateTime)
				{
					date = dateTime;
				}
			}
			if (date < minDate)
			{
				date = minDate;
			}
			DateTime? referenceDate = ReferenceDate;
			ReferenceDate = date;
			return !object.Equals(referenceDate, ReferenceDate);
		}

		private static bool ShouldCachePreferredNavInfo(CalendarMode mode)
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case CalendarMode.Years:
			case CalendarMode.Decades:
			case CalendarMode.Centuries:
				return false;
			case CalendarMode.Days:
			case CalendarMode.Months:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void SortGroups()
		{
			Comparison<CalendarItemGroup> comparison = (CalendarItemGroup g1, CalendarItemGroup g2) => g1.ReferenceGroupOffset.CompareTo(g2.ReferenceGroupOffset);
			IComparer<CalendarItemGroup> comparer = CoreUtilities.CreateComparer(comparison);
			CoreUtilities.SortMergeGeneric(_groups, comparer);
		}

		private bool ToggleActiveDateSelection(bool shiftKeyDown, bool ctlKeyDown)
		{
			DateTime value = ActiveDate.Value;
			CalendarItem item = GetItem(value);
			if (item != null)
			{
				SelectionStrategyBase selectionStrategyForItem = SelectionHost.GetSelectionStrategyForItem(item);
				if (selectionStrategyForItem != null && (selectionStrategyForItem.IsMultiSelect || selectionStrategyForItem.IsSingleSelect))
				{
					return selectionStrategyForItem.SelectItemViaKeyboard(item, shiftKeyDown, ctlKeyDown, forceToggle: true);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedState(IList<DateTime> dates, bool select)
		{
			if (dates == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object value = KnownBoxes.FromValue(select);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = dates.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				DateTime date = dates[i];
				CalendarItem item = GetItem(date);
				if (item != null)
				{
					item.SetValue(CalendarItem.IsSelectedPropertyKey, value);
					item.SetValue(CalendarItem.ContainsSelectedDatesPropertyKey, value);
				}
			}
		}

		{
			if (value is int)

				return (int)value > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

			}
			else

				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, FormatProviderProperty);

			OnCultureChanged();
			CoerceValue(ReferenceDateProperty);
		}

				RoutedCommand command = ((e.Delta < 0) ? MonthCalendarCommands.ScrollNextGroups : MonthCalendarCommands.ScrollPreviousGroups);
				e.Handled = ExecuteCommandImpl(new ExecuteCommandInfo(command, Math.Abs(e.Delta / 120), this));
			}
		}

		bool ISelectionHost.ActivateItem(ISelectableItem item, bool preventScrollItemIntoView)
		{
			CalendarItem item2 = GetItem(item);
			if (item2 != null && item2.IsEnabled)
			{
				DateTime? activatableDate = GetActivatableDate(item2);
				if (!activatableDate.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				DateTime value = activatableDate.Value;
				SetActiveDate(value);
				return GetItem(value)?.IsActive ?? false;
			}
			return false;
		}

			{
				ExecuteCommand(MonthCalendarCommands.ScrollNextGroup);
			}
		}

			}
		}

		AutoScrollInfo ISelectionHost.GetAutoScrollInfo(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			MonthCalendarStates currentState = CurrentState;
			SelectionStrategyBase selectionStrategyForItem = SelectionHost.GetSelectionStrategyForItem(item);
			bool flag = selectionStrategyForItem != null && selectionStrategyForItem.IsSingleSelect && !selectionStrategyForItem.IsMultiSelect;
			bool flag2 = flag && (currentState & MonthCalendarStates.MinDateInView) == 0;
			bool flag3 = flag && (currentState & MonthCalendarStates.MaxDateInView) == 0;
			AutoScrollInfo result = new AutoScrollInfo(this, flag2, flag2, flag3, flag3);
			result.ScrollOrientation = ScrollOrientation.Horizontal;
			return result;
		}

		ISelectableItem ISelectionHost.GetNearestCompatibleItem(ISelectableItem item, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CalendarItem calendarItem = item as CalendarItem;
			Point position = e.GetPosition(this);
			HitTestResult hitResult = null;
			HitTestResultCallback resultCallback = delegate(HitTestResult result)
			{
				hitResult = result;
				return HitTestResultBehavior.Stop;
			};
			HitTestFilterCallback filterCallback = delegate(DependencyObject hit)
			{
				if (Utils.IsUIElementOrUIElement3D(hit) && (false.Equals(hit.GetValue(UIElement.IsHitTestVisibleProperty)) || false.Equals(hit.GetValue(UIElement.IsVisibleProperty))))
				{
					return HitTestFilterBehavior.ContinueSkipSelfAndChildren;
				}
				return (hit is CalendarItem || !false.Equals(hit.GetValue(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty))) ? HitTestFilterBehavior.Continue : HitTestFilterBehavior.ContinueSkipSelfAndChildren;
			};
			VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(this, filterCallback, resultCallback, new PointHitTestParameters(position));
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = ((hitResult != null) ? hitResult.VisualHit : null);
			CalendarItem calendarItem2 = dependencyObject as CalendarItem;
			if (calendarItem2 == null && dependencyObject != null)
			{
				calendarItem2 = (CalendarItem)Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(dependencyObject, typeof(CalendarItem), allowSubclassOfType: true);
			}
			if (calendarItem2 != null)
			{
				ISelectableItem selectableItem = ((ISelectableElement)calendarItem2).SelectableItem;
				if (!SelectionHost.IsItemSelectableWithCurrentSelection(selectableItem))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!calendarItem2.IsEnabled && _pivotDate.HasValue)
				{
					DateTime? dateTime = ((!(_pivotDate.Value > calendarItem2.StartDate)) ? GetActivatableDate(_pivotDate.Value, calendarItem2.StartDate, next: false) : GetActivatableDate(calendarItem2.EndDate, _pivotDate.Value, next: true));
					if (dateTime.HasValue)
					{
						calendarItem2 = GetItem(dateTime.Value);
					}
				}
				return calendarItem2;
			}
			CalendarItemGroup calendarItemGroup = dependencyObject as CalendarItemGroup;
			if (calendarItemGroup == null)
			{
				calendarItemGroup = (CalendarItemGroup)Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(dependencyObject, typeof(CalendarItemGroup), allowSubclassOfType: true);
			}
			if (calendarItem != null && calendarItemGroup != null && calendarItemGroup.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				return GetFirstLastItem(calendarItem, position, calendarItemGroup);
			}
			return null;
		}

		ISelectableItem ISelectionHost.GetPivotItem(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			if (_pivotDate.HasValue)
			{
				return GetItem(_pivotDate.Value);
			}
			return null;
		}

		SelectionStrategyBase ISelectionHost.GetSelectionStrategyForItem(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			SelectionStrategyBase selectionStrategyBase = null;
			if (IsMinCalendarMode && _selectionStrategyFilter != null)
			{
				selectionStrategyBase = _selectionStrategyFilter.GetSelectionStrategyForItem(item);
			}
			if (selectionStrategyBase == null)
			{
				SelectionType currentSelectionTypeResolved = CurrentSelectionTypeResolved;
				selectionStrategyBase = ((currentSelectionTypeResolved != SelectionType.Single || _selectionStrategy is SelectionStrategySingle) ? (_selectionStrategy = SelectionStrategyBase.GetSelectionStrategy(currentSelectionTypeResolved, SelectionHost, _selectionStrategy)) : (_selectionStrategy = new CustomSingleSelectionStrategy(this)));
			}
			return selectionStrategyBase;
		}

		bool ISelectionHost.IsItemSelectableWithCurrentSelection(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			return item is CalendarItem;
		}

		bool ISelectionHost.IsMaxSelectedItemsReached(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			if (CurrentCalendarMode != MinCalendarMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int maxSelectedDatesResolved = MaxSelectedDatesResolved;
			return _selectedDates.Count >= maxSelectedDatesResolved;
		}

		void ISelectionHost.OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e, bool preventScrollItemIntoView)
		{
			if (!(e is MouseButtonEventArgs { ChangedButton: MouseButton.Left }))
			{
				return;
			}
			IInputElement inputElement = InputHitTest(e.GetPosition(this));
			CalendarItem calendarItem = inputElement as CalendarItem;
			if (calendarItem == null && inputElement is DependencyObject)
			{
				calendarItem = (CalendarItem)Utilities.GetAncestorFromType((DependencyObject)inputElement, typeof(CalendarItem), allowSubclassOfType: true);
			}
			if (calendarItem != null)
			{
				if (CurrentCalendarMode > MinCalendarMode)
				{
					ExecuteCommandImpl(new ExecuteCommandInfo(MonthCalendarCommands.ZoomInCalendarMode, calendarItem, calendarItem));
				}
				else
				{
					RaiseSelectionCommitted(new RoutedEventArgs());
				}
			}
		}

		{
		}

		bool ISelectionHost.SelectItem(ISelectableItem item, bool clearExistingSelection)
		{
			if (IsNavigationMode)
			{
				return SelectionHost.ActivateItem(item, preventScrollItemIntoView: false);
			}
			return InternalSelectItem(item, clearExistingSelection, select: true);
		}

		bool ISelectionHost.SelectRange(ISelectableItem item, bool clearExistingSelection)
		{
			if (IsNavigationMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return InternalSelectRange(item, clearExistingSelection, select: true);
		}

		void ISelectionHost.SetPivotItem(ISelectableItem item, bool isRangeSelect)
		{
			DateTime? pivotDate = _pivotDate;
			if (!isRangeSelect || !pivotDate.HasValue)
			{
				CalendarItem item2 = GetItem(item);
				if (item2 != null)
				{
					_pivotDate = item2.StartDate;
				}
				else
				{
					_pivotDate = null;
				}
			}
		}

		void ISelectionHost.SnapshotSelection(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			if (!IsNavigationMode)
			{
				_selectedDatesSnapshot.ReInitialize(_selectedDates);
			}
		}

		ISelectableItem ISelectionHost.TranslateItem(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			if (!(item is CalendarItem))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return item;
		}

			HasDisplayDataTemplateSelectorPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("HasDisplayDataTemplateSelector", typeof(bool), typeof(TemplateEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			HasDisplayDataTemplateSelectorProperty = HasDisplayDataTemplateSelectorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			DisplayDataTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DisplayDataTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeof(TemplateEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnDisplayDataTemplateSelectorChanged));
			HasEditDataTemplatePropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("HasEditDataTemplate", typeof(bool), typeof(TemplateEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			HasEditDataTemplateProperty = HasEditDataTemplatePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			EditDataTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("EditDataTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeof(TemplateEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnEditDataTemplateChanged));
			HasEditDataTemplateSelectorPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("HasEditDataTemplateSelector", typeof(bool), typeof(TemplateEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			HasEditDataTemplateSelectorProperty = HasEditDataTemplateSelectorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			EditDataTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("EditDataTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeof(TemplateEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnEditDataTemplateSelectorChanged));
			EditorPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("Editor", typeof(TemplateEditor), typeof(TemplateEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits | FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.OverridesInheritanceBehavior));
			EditorProperty = EditorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TemplateEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(TemplateEditor)));
			Control.HorizontalContentAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TemplateEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.HorizontalAlignmentStretchBox));
			Control.VerticalContentAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TemplateEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.VerticalAlignmentStretchBox));
			ValueEditor.ValueTypeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TemplateEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(object)));
		}

		public TemplateEditor()
		{
			SetValue(EditorPropertyKey, this);
		}

		public override bool CanEditType(Type type)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CanRenderType(Type type)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsExtentBasedOnValue(Orientation orientation)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			_focusBefore = GetTemplateChild("PART_FocusBefore") as FrameworkElement;
			_focusAfter = GetTemplateChild("PART_FocusAfter") as FrameworkElement;
			if (!base.IsEmbedded)
			{
				if (_focusBefore != null)
				{
					_focusBefore.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				if (_focusAfter != null)
				{
					_focusAfter.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnFocusSiteChanged()
		{
			base.OnFocusSiteChanged();
			if (_focusSite != null)
			{
				_focusSite.GotKeyboardFocus -= OnFocusSiteGotKeyboardFocus;
			}
			_focusSite = base.FocusSite as IInputElement;
			if (_focusSite != null)
			{
				_focusSite.GotKeyboardFocus += OnFocusSiteGotKeyboardFocus;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Tab && base.IsEmbedded)
			{
				bool next;
				if (Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.None)
				{
					next = true;
				}
				else
				{
					if (Keyboard.Modifiers != ModifierKeys.Shift)
					{
						return;
					}
					next = false;
				}
				IInputElement focusedElement = Keyboard.FocusedElement;
				if (MoveFocus(focusedElement, next) && focusedElement != Keyboard.FocusedElement && Keyboard.FocusedElement != _focusBefore && Keyboard.FocusedElement != _focusAfter)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
		}

		private static void OnDisplayDataTemplateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			d.SetValue(HasDisplayDataTemplatePropertyKey, (e.NewValue != null) ? KnownBoxes.TrueBox : DependencyProperty.UnsetValue);
		}

		private static void OnDisplayDataTemplateSelectorChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			target.SetValue(HasDisplayDataTemplateSelectorPropertyKey, (e.NewValue != null) ? KnownBoxes.TrueBox : DependencyProperty.UnsetValue);
		}

		private static void OnEditDataTemplateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			d.SetValue(HasEditDataTemplatePropertyKey, (e.NewValue != null) ? KnownBoxes.TrueBox : DependencyProperty.UnsetValue);
		}

		private static void OnEditDataTemplateSelectorChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			target.SetValue(HasEditDataTemplateSelectorPropertyKey, (e.NewValue != null) ? KnownBoxes.TrueBox : DependencyProperty.UnsetValue);
		}

		public static TemplateEditor GetEditor(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return (TemplateEditor)d.GetValue(EditorProperty);
		}

		private static bool MoveFocus(IInputElement src, bool next)
		{
			return MoveFocus(src, (!next) ? FocusNavigationDirection.Previous : FocusNavigationDirection.Next);
		}

		private static bool MoveFocus(IInputElement src, FocusNavigationDirection direction)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = src as FrameworkElement;
			TraversalRequest request = new TraversalRequest(direction);
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				return frameworkElement.MoveFocus(request);
			}
			if (src is FrameworkContentElement frameworkContentElement)
			{
				return frameworkContentElement.MoveFocus(request);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnFocusSiteGotKeyboardFocus(object sender, KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewFocus == _focusSite)
			{
				FocusNavigationDirection direction = ((Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.Tab) && Keyboard.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.Shift) ? FocusNavigationDirection.Last : FocusNavigationDirection.First);
				MoveFocus(_focusSite, direction);
			}
		}
	}
	[MarkupExtensionReturnType(typeof(object))]
	[Localizability(LocalizationCategory.None, Modifiability = Modifiability.Unmodifiable, Readability = Readability.Unreadable)]
	public class TemplateEditorValueBinding : MarkupExtension
	{
		private class DefaultConverter : IValueConverter
		{
			public static readonly DefaultConverter Instance = new DefaultConverter();

			private DefaultConverter()
			{
			}

			public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				if (value == null || value.GetType() == targetType || targetType == typeof(object))
				{
					return value;
				}
				try
				{
					return CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, targetType, culture, null);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return value;
				}
			}

			public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				return value;
			}
		}

		private Binding _binding;

		private BindingMode _bindingMode = BindingMode.Default;

		private IValueConverter _converter;

		private CultureInfo _converterCulture;

		private object _converterParameter;

		private bool _notifyOnSourceUpdated;

		private bool _notifyOnTargetUpdated;

		private bool _notifyOnValidationError;

		private string _stringFormat;

		private object _targetNullValue;

		private UpdateSourceTrigger _updateSourceTrigger = UpdateSourceTrigger.PropertyChanged;

		private bool _isSealed;

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public IValueConverter Converter
		{
			get
			{
				return _converter;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckIsSealed();
				_converter = value;
			}
		}

				_updateSourceTrigger = value;
			}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			if (serviceProvider != null && serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IProvideValueTarget)) is IProvideValueTarget { TargetObject: var targetObject, TargetProperty: var targetProperty })
			{
				Type type = null;
				object obj = null;
				string text;
				if (targetProperty == null)
				{
					text = null;
				}
				else if (targetProperty is DependencyProperty dependencyProperty)
				{
					text = dependencyProperty.Name;
					type = dependencyProperty.PropertyType;
					PropertyMetadata propertyMetadata;
					try
					{
						propertyMetadata = ((targetObject != null) ? dependencyProperty.GetMetadata(targetObject.GetType()) : null);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						propertyMetadata = dependencyProperty.DefaultMetadata;
					}
					obj = propertyMetadata?.DefaultValue;
				}
				else
				{
					PropertyInfo propertyInfo = targetProperty as PropertyInfo;
					if (propertyInfo != null)
					{
						text = propertyInfo.Name;
						type = propertyInfo.PropertyType;
					}
					else
					{
						text = targetProperty.GetType().Name;
					}
				}
				if (type != null && typeof(BindingBase).IsAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					throw new XamlParseException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_TemplateEditorValueBinding_InvalidUse_ToBinding", text));
				}
				if (_binding == null)
				{
					_binding = new Binding();
					_binding.Mode = _bindingMode;
					if (_converter != null)
					{
						_binding.Converter = _converter;
					}
					else if (type.IsValueType && type.IsPrimitive)
					{
						_binding.Converter = DefaultConverter.Instance;
					}
					_binding.ConverterCulture = _converterCulture;
					_binding.ConverterParameter = _converterParameter;
					_binding.NotifyOnSourceUpdated = _notifyOnSourceUpdated;
					_binding.NotifyOnTargetUpdated = _notifyOnTargetUpdated;
					_binding.NotifyOnValidationError = _notifyOnValidationError;
					_binding.Path = new PropertyPath("(0).(1)", TemplateEditor.EditorProperty, ValueEditor.ValueProperty);
					_binding.RelativeSource = RelativeSource.Self;
					_binding.StringFormat = _stringFormat;
					if (_targetNullValue != null)
					{
						_binding.TargetNullValue = _targetNullValue;
					}
					else if (obj != null)
					{
						_binding.TargetNullValue = obj;
					}
					_binding.UpdateSourceTrigger = _updateSourceTrigger;
					_isSealed = true;
				}
				return _binding.ProvideValue(serviceProvider);
			}
			return this;
		}

		private void CheckIsSealed()
		{
			if (_isSealed)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("LE_TemplateEditorValueBinding_IsSealed");
			}
		}
	}

		internal static bool AreEqual(object x, object y)
		{
			if (x != y)
			{
				if (x != null && y != null && x.GetType() == y.GetType())
				{
					return object.Equals(x, y);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static Exception GetTextToValueConversionError(Type targetType, string text)
		{
			bool flag = string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || text.Trim().Length == 0;
			string message = ((typeof(DateTime) == targetType) ? GetString(flag ? "LMSG_EnteredDateEmpty" : "LMSG_EnteredDateInvalid", text) : ((!IsNumericType(targetType)) ? GetString(flag ? "LMSG_EnteredValueEmpty" : "LMSG_EnteredValueInvalid", text) : GetString(flag ? "LMSG_EnteredNumberEmpty" : "LMSG_EnteredNumberInvalid", text)));
			return new Exception(message);
		}

		internal static DependencyObject HitTest(UIElement elem, Point location, Type elementType, bool allowSubclassOfType)
		{
			HitTestResult hitTestResult = VisualTreeHelper.HitTest(elem, location);
			if (hitTestResult != null && hitTestResult.VisualHit != null)
			{
				return Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(hitTestResult.VisualHit, elementType, allowSubclassOfType, elem);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool IsInfinityOrNaN(object val)
		{
			if (val is double d)
			{
				if (!double.IsNaN(d))
				{
					return double.IsInfinity(d);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (val is float f)
			{
				if (!float.IsNaN(f))
				{
					return float.IsInfinity(f);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsMouseOverButton(ValueEditor editor, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Source is DependencyObject descendant)
			{
				ButtonBase buttonBase = (ButtonBase)Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(descendant, typeof(ButtonBase), allowSubclassOfType: true, editor);
				if (buttonBase != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Utilities.GetAncestorFromName(descendant, "PART_SpinButtons") != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsNumericType(Type type)
		{
			if (type.IsPrimitive || type == typeof(decimal))
			{
				if (type != typeof(bool) && type != typeof(char))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool Exists(IEnumerable e, object item)
		{
			foreach (object item2 in e)
			{
				if (object.Equals(item, item2))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void RoundAndSplitHelper(decimal val, int fractionDigitsToRoundTo, out decimal integerPart, out decimal fractionPart)
		{
			decimal num = decimal.Truncate(val);
			int num2 = Math.Sign(val);
			decimal d = (decimal)num2 * (val - num);
			decimal num3 = Math.Round(d, Math.Min(fractionDigitsToRoundTo, 28));
			if (num3 >= 1.0m)
			{
				--num3;
				num += (decimal)num2;
			}
			integerPart = num;
			fractionPart = num3;
		}

		internal static void RoundAndSplitHelper(double val, int fractionDigitsToRoundTo, out double integerPart, out double fractionPart)
		{
			if (val >= -7.922816251426434E+28 && val <= 7.922816251426434E+28)
			{
				RoundAndSplitHelper((decimal)val, fractionDigitsToRoundTo, out var integerPart2, out var fractionPart2);
				integerPart = (double)integerPart2;
				fractionPart = (double)fractionPart2;
				return;
			}
			double num = Math.Truncate(val);
			double num2 = Math.Sign(val);
			double value = num2 * (val - num);
			double num3 = Math.Round(value, Math.Min(fractionDigitsToRoundTo, 15));
			if (num3 >= 1.0)
			{
				num3 -= 1.0;
				num += num2;
			}
			integerPart = num;
			fractionPart = num3;
		}

		internal static void SendLeftMouseButtonDownHelper(IInputElement elem, MouseEventArgs templateMouseArgs)
		{
			MouseButtonEventArgs e = new MouseButtonEventArgs(templateMouseArgs.MouseDevice, templateMouseArgs.Timestamp, MouseButton.Left, templateMouseArgs.StylusDevice);
			e.RoutedEvent = UIElement.MouseLeftButtonDownEvent;
			elem.RaiseEvent(e);
		}

		private static bool IsEnumFlags(Type enumType)
		{
			object[] customAttributes = enumType.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(FlagsAttribute), inherit: true);
			if (customAttributes != null)
			{
				return customAttributes.Length != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(enumType, enumVal) && !IsEnumFlags(enumType))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(argumentName, (int)enumVal, enumType);
			}
		}

				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
		}

		internal static TextAlignment ToTextAlignment(HorizontalAlignment horizAlign)
		{
			return horizAlign switch
			{
				HorizontalAlignment.Center => TextAlignment.Center, 
				HorizontalAlignment.Right => TextAlignment.Right, 
				HorizontalAlignment.Stretch => TextAlignment.Justify, 
				_ => TextAlignment.Left, 
			};
		}

		internal static double GetLineHeight(Control ctrl)
		{
			FontFamily fontFamily = ctrl.FontFamily;
			double fontSize = ctrl.FontSize;
			return fontFamily.LineSpacing * fontSize;
		}

		public static bool IsMouseOverElement(DependencyObject element, MouseEventArgs e)
		{

			{
				Point position = e.GetPosition(frameworkElement);
				if (new Rect(0.0, 0.0, frameworkElement.ActualWidth, frameworkElement.ActualHeight).Contains(position))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

	internal class ValidatedObservableCollection<T> : ObservableCollection<T>
	{
		public delegate void ValidateCallback(T item);

		private ValidateCallback _validationCallback;

		private bool _allowNull;

		public ValidatedObservableCollection(bool allowNull, ValidateCallback validationCallback)
		{
			_allowNull = allowNull;
			_validationCallback = validationCallback;
		}

		private void ValidateItem(T item)
		{
			if (!_allowNull && item == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("item");
			}
			if (_validationCallback != null)
			{
				_validationCallback(item);
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, T item)
		{
			ValidateItem(item);
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, T item)
		{
			ValidateItem(item);
			base.SetItem(index, item);
		}
	}

			{
				if (_cv is IList)
				{
					((IList)_cv)[index] = value;
					return;
				}
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public int Count => _cv.Count;

			}
		}

		}

			CurrentChangingEventManager.AddListener(_cv, this);
			CollectionChangedEventManager.AddListener(_cv, this);
		}

				this.CurrentChanging(this, e);

		}

		}

		{
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void ResumeRefresh()
		{
			if (_suspendRefreshCount <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			_suspendRefreshCount--;
			if (_suspendRefreshCount == 0)
			{
				if (_cvDeferRefreshObject != null)
				{
					_cvDeferRefreshObject.Dispose();
					_cvDeferRefreshObject = null;
				}
				RaiseCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}

		private void SuspendRefresh()
		{
			if (_suspendRefreshCount == 0)
			{
				_cvDeferRefreshObject = _cv.DeferRefresh();
			}
			_suspendRefreshCount++;
		}

		public bool Contains(object item)
		{
			return _cv.Contains(item);
		}

		public IDisposable DeferRefresh()
		{
			SuspendRefresh();
			return new DeferRefreshObject(this);
		}

		public void CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			IEnumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					object current = enumerator.Current;
					array.SetValue(current, index++);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(CurrentChangingEventManager))
			{
				OnSourceCurrentChanging(sender, e as CurrentChangingEventArgs);
				return true;
			}
			if (managerType == typeof(CurrentChangedEventManager))
			{
				OnSourceCurrentChanged(sender, e);
				return true;
			}
			if (managerType == typeof(CollectionChangedEventManager))
			{
				OnSourceCollectionChanged(sender, e as NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class HorizontalToTextAlignmentConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment)
			{
				switch (horizontalAlignment)
				{
				case HorizontalAlignment.Center:
					return TextAlignment.Center;
				case HorizontalAlignment.Right:
					return TextAlignment.Right;
				}
			}
			return TextAlignment.Left;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is TextAlignment textAlignment)
			{
				switch (textAlignment)
				{
				case TextAlignment.Center:
					return HorizontalAlignment.Center;
				case TextAlignment.Right:
					return HorizontalAlignment.Right;
				}
			}
			return HorizontalAlignment.Left;
		}
	}
	internal class SpinInfo
	{
		private enum IncrementType
		{
			Day,
			Month,
			Year,
			Log10,
			TimeSpan,
			NumbericAmount,
			Hour,
			Minute,
			Second,
			MonthOrMinute
		}

		private TimeSpan _incrementAmountTimeSpan;

		private decimal _incrementAmountNumeric;

		private IncrementType _incrementType;

		private ValueEditor _valueEditor;

		private object _origSpinIncrement;

		private int _acceleration_SpinCount;

		private DateTime? _lastSpinTime;

		private IFormatProvider _cachedCalendar_lastFormatProvider;

		private System.Globalization.Calendar _cachedCalendar;

		private SpinInfo()
		{
		}

		public bool CanSpin(bool up, object currentValue = null)
		{
			object newValue;
			return SpinHelper(up, currentValue, out newValue);
		}

		internal void CheckElapsedTimeHelper()
		{
			DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
			if (_lastSpinTime.HasValue)
			{
				DateTime value = _lastSpinTime.Value;
				if ((now - value).TotalMilliseconds > 500.0)
				{
					ResetAcceleration();
				}
			}
			_lastSpinTime = now;
		}

		private object ConvertDataValue(object val, Type type, IFormatProvider formatProvider = null)
		{
			if (formatProvider == null)
			{
				formatProvider = _valueEditor.FormatProvider;
			}
			return CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(val, type, formatProvider, null);
		}

		private object ConvertToDecimal(object val)
		{
			if (val != null && val.GetType() != typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return ConvertDataValue(val, typeof(decimal));
			}
			return null;
		}

		private object ConvertToEditorValueType(object value)
		{
			Type valueType = _valueEditor.ValueType;
			if (_valueEditor is XamMaskedEditor xamMaskedEditor && value is DateTime && typeof(string) == xamMaskedEditor.ValueType)
			{
				return MaskedEditorDefaultConverter.ValueToTextConverter.ConvertToTextBasedOnMask(xamMaskedEditor, value, useSectionsDirectly: true);
			}
			return ConvertDataValue(value, valueType);
		}

		private System.Globalization.Calendar GetCalendar()
		{
			IFormatProvider formatProviderResolved = _valueEditor.FormatProviderResolved;
			if (_cachedCalendar == null || formatProviderResolved != _cachedCalendar_lastFormatProvider)
			{
				_cachedCalendar_lastFormatProvider = formatProviderResolved;
				_cachedCalendar = XamMaskedEditor.GetCultureCalendar(formatProviderResolved);
			}
			return _cachedCalendar;
		}

		private bool GetCurrentValueAsDate(out DateTime val)
		{
			object obj = ConvertDataValue(_valueEditor.Value, typeof(DateTime));
			if (obj is DateTime)
			{
				val = (DateTime)obj;
				return true;
			}
			val = DateTime.MinValue;
			return false;
		}

		internal static DateTime GetDefaultMinMaxDate(bool min)
		{
			CalendarManager currentCulture = CalendarManager.CurrentCulture;
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = currentCulture.Calendar;
			if (calendar != null)
			{
				if (!min)
				{
					return calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime;
				}
				return calendar.MinSupportedDateTime;
			}
			if (!min)
			{
				return DateTime.MaxValue;
			}
			return DateTime.MinValue;
		}

		private void GetResolvedMinMax(out object min, out object max, ref Type valueType)
		{
			ValueConstraint valueConstraintResolved = _valueEditor.ValueConstraintResolved;
			object minConstraint = valueConstraintResolved?.MinInclusive;
			object maxConstraint = valueConstraintResolved?.MaxExclusive;
			GetResolvedMinMax(minConstraint, maxConstraint, out min, out max, ref valueType);
		}

		private void GetResolvedMinMax(object minConstraint, object maxConstraint, out object min, out object max, ref Type valueType)
		{
			min = (max = null);
			min = minConstraint;
			max = maxConstraint;
			XamMaskedEditor xamMaskedEditor = _valueEditor as XamMaskedEditor;
			if (xamMaskedEditor != null && (null == valueType || typeof(object) == valueType || typeof(string) == valueType))
			{
				Type type = XamMaskedEditor.DeduceEditAsType(xamMaskedEditor.Sections);
				if (null != type)
				{
					valueType = type;
				}
			}
			Type underlyingType = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(valueType);
			if (Utilities.IsNumericType(underlyingType))
			{
				if (xamMaskedEditor == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				NumberSection numberSection = ((xamMaskedEditor.Sections != null) ? ((NumberSection)XamMaskedEditor.GetSection(xamMaskedEditor.Sections, typeof(NumberSection))) : null);
				if (numberSection != null)
				{
					if (!numberSection.VerifyMinMaxCache(verifyMin: true))
					{
						numberSection.VerifyMinMaxCache(verifyMin: false);
					}
					min = numberSection.lastConvertedMinValWithFractionPart;
					max = numberSection.lastConvertedMaxValWithFractionPart;
				}
			}
			else if (typeof(DateTime) == underlyingType)
			{
				if (min == null)
				{
					min = GetDefaultMinMaxDate(min: true);
				}
				if (max == null)
				{
					max = GetDefaultMinMaxDate(min: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void GetResolvedMinMaxAsDecimal(out object min, out object max)
		{
			Type valueType = _valueEditor.ValueType;
			GetResolvedMinMax(out min, out max, ref valueType);
			min = ConvertToDecimal(min);
			max = ConvertToDecimal(max);
		}

		private void ResolveMinMaxInclusiveAsDecimal(out object min, out object max)
		{
			ValueConstraint valueConstraint = _valueEditor.ValueConstraint;
			object minConstraint = valueConstraint?.MinInclusive;
			object maxConstraint = valueConstraint?.MaxInclusive;
			Type valueType = _valueEditor.ValueType;
			GetResolvedMinMax(minConstraint, maxConstraint, out min, out max, ref valueType);
			min = ConvertToDecimal(min);
			max = ConvertToDecimal(max);
		}

		private object GetStartValue(bool up, bool wrapping)
		{
			Type valueType = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(_valueEditor.ValueType);
			GetResolvedMinMax(out var min, out var max, ref valueType);
			if (Utilities.IsNumericType(valueType))
			{
				object obj = ((min != null) ? ConvertDataValue(min, typeof(decimal)) : null);
				object obj2 = ((max != null) ? ConvertDataValue(max, typeof(decimal)) : null);
				if (!wrapping && (obj == null || (obj is decimal && (decimal)obj < 0m)) && (obj2 == null || (obj2 is decimal && 0m < (decimal)obj2)))
				{
					return 0m;
				}
			}
			else if (typeof(DateTime) == valueType)
			{
				object obj3 = ConvertDataValue(min, typeof(DateTime));
				object obj4 = ConvertDataValue(max, typeof(DateTime));
				if (!wrapping)
				{
					DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
					if ((Utils.IsValueEmpty(obj3) || (DateTime)obj3 <= now) && (Utils.IsValueEmpty(obj4) || now <= (DateTime)obj4))
					{
						return now;
					}
				}
			}
			object obj5 = (up ? min : max);
			if (obj5 != null && !valueType.IsInstanceOfType(obj5))
			{
				object obj6 = ConvertDataValue(obj5, valueType);
				if (obj6 != null)
				{
					obj5 = obj6;
				}
			}
			return obj5;
		}

		private bool IsIncrementTypeForDateTime()
		{
			switch (_incrementType)
			{
			case IncrementType.Day:
			case IncrementType.Month:
			case IncrementType.Year:
			case IncrementType.TimeSpan:
			case IncrementType.Hour:
			case IncrementType.Minute:
			case IncrementType.Second:
			case IncrementType.MonthOrMinute:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsSameSpinIncrement(object amount)
		{
			return Utils.AreEqual(amount, _origSpinIncrement);
		}

		private bool ValidateAgainstMinMax(object value)
		{
			if (!IsIncrementTypeForDateTime())
			{
				object obj = ConvertToDecimal(value);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					GetResolvedMinMaxAsDecimal(out var min, out var max);
					if (min != null && (decimal)obj < (decimal)min)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (max != null && (decimal)obj > (decimal)max)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsValueValid(object value)
		{
			if (!ValidateAgainstMinMax(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!_valueEditor.ValidateValue(value, out var _))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static SpinInfo Parse(ValueEditor valueEditor, object spinIncrement)
		{
			Utils.ValidateNull(valueEditor);
			SpinInfo spinInfo = new SpinInfo();
			spinInfo._valueEditor = valueEditor;
			if (spinInfo.Parse(spinIncrement))
			{
				return spinInfo;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool Parse(object spinIncrement)
		{
			_origSpinIncrement = spinIncrement;
			if (spinIncrement is string)
			{
				string input = ((string)spinIncrement).Trim();
				Match match = Regex.Match(input, "^([\\-\\+]?)(\\d+)\\s*([Dd]|[Mm]|[Yy]|[Hh]|[Ss])$");
				if (match != null && match.Success)
				{
					bool flag = "-" == match.Groups[1].Value;
					if (!decimal.TryParse(match.Groups[2].Value, out _incrementAmountNumeric))
					{
						return false;
					}
					string value = match.Groups[3].Value;
					IncrementType incrementType;
					switch (value.ToLower())
					{
					case "y":
						incrementType = IncrementType.Year;
						break;
					case "m":
						incrementType = IncrementType.MonthOrMinute;
						break;
					case "d":
						incrementType = IncrementType.Day;
						break;
					case "h":
						incrementType = IncrementType.Hour;
						break;
					case "s":
						incrementType = IncrementType.Second;
						break;
					default:
						return false;
					}
					_incrementType = incrementType;
					return true;
				}
				match = Regex.Match(input, "^log$");
				if (match != null && match.Success)
				{
					_incrementType = IncrementType.Log10;
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (spinIncrement is TimeSpan)
			{
				_incrementType = IncrementType.TimeSpan;
				_incrementAmountTimeSpan = (TimeSpan)spinIncrement;
				return true;
			}
			object obj = (obj = ConvertDataValue(spinIncrement, typeof(decimal), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
			if (obj is decimal)
			{
				_incrementType = IncrementType.NumbericAmount;
				_incrementAmountNumeric = (decimal)obj;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ResetAcceleration()
		{
			_acceleration_SpinCount = 0;
		}

		public bool Spin(bool up, object currentValue)
		{
			CheckElapsedTimeHelper();
			if (SpinHelper(up, currentValue, out var newValue))
			{
				if (_incrementType == IncrementType.NumbericAmount && newValue != null && newValue is decimal)
				{
					newValue = ConvertDataValue(newValue, typeof(string));
				}
				_valueEditor.Value = newValue;
				_acceleration_SpinCount++;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool SpinHelper(bool up, object currentValue, out object newValue)
		{
			if (currentValue == null)
			{
				currentValue = _valueEditor.Value;
			}
			newValue = null;
			if (Utils.IsValueEmpty(currentValue))
			{
				newValue = GetStartValue(up, wrapping: false);
				return true;
			}
			if (IsIncrementTypeForDateTime())
			{
				if (GetCurrentValueAsDate(out var val))
				{
					decimal num = (up ? _incrementAmountNumeric : (-_incrementAmountNumeric));
					try
					{
						System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = GetCalendar();
						DateTime dateTime = val;
						switch (_incrementType)
						{
						case IncrementType.Day:
							val = CalendarHelper.AddDays(val, (int)num, calendar);
							break;
						case IncrementType.Month:
							val = CalendarHelper.AddMonths(val, (int)num, calendar);
							break;
						case IncrementType.Year:
							val = CalendarHelper.AddYears(val, (int)num, calendar);
							break;
						case IncrementType.Hour:
							val = val.AddHours((double)num);
							break;
						case IncrementType.Minute:
							val = val.AddMinutes((double)num);
							break;
						case IncrementType.Second:
							val = val.AddSeconds((double)num);
							break;
						case IncrementType.MonthOrMinute:
						{
							bool flag = false;
							if (_valueEditor is XamMaskedEditor xamMaskedEditor)
							{
								XamMaskedEditor.DeduceEditAsType(xamMaskedEditor.Sections, out var hasDateComponents, out var hasTimeComponents);
								if (!hasDateComponents && hasTimeComponents)
								{
									flag = true;
								}
							}
							val = ((!flag) ? CalendarHelper.AddMonths(val, (int)num, calendar) : val.AddMinutes((double)num));
							break;
						}
						case IncrementType.TimeSpan:
							val = (up ? val.Add(_incrementAmountTimeSpan) : val.Subtract(_incrementAmountTimeSpan));
							break;
						}
						if (dateTime != val)
						{
							newValue = val;
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (_incrementType)
				{
				case IncrementType.NumbericAmount:
				{
					object obj5 = ConvertDataValue(currentValue, typeof(decimal));
					if (!(obj5 is decimal))
					{
						break;
					}
					try
					{
						newValue = (decimal)obj5 + (up ? _incrementAmountNumeric : (-_incrementAmountNumeric));
						ResolveMinMaxInclusiveAsDecimal(out var min, out var max);
						if (!(_incrementAmountNumeric > 1m))
						{
							break;
						}
						decimal num5 = (decimal)obj5;
						decimal num6 = (decimal)newValue;
						if (up && max is decimal num7)
						{
							if (num5 < num7 && num6 > num7)
							{
								newValue = num7;
							}
						}
						else if (!up && min is decimal num8 && num5 > num8 && num6 < num8)
						{
							newValue = num8;
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					break;
				}
				case IncrementType.Log10:
				{
					object obj2 = ConvertDataValue(currentValue, typeof(decimal));
					if (!(obj2 is decimal))
					{
						break;
					}
					try
					{
						int num2 = Math.Min(10, _acceleration_SpinCount / 40);
						decimal num4;
						object obj3;
						do
						{
							decimal num3 = (decimal)Math.Pow(10.0, num2);
							num4 = (decimal)obj2 + (up ? num3 : (-num3));
							num4 = Math.Floor(num4 / num3) * num3;
							obj3 = newValue;
							newValue = ConvertDataValue(num4, _valueEditor.ValueType);
							num2--;
						}
						while (num2 >= 0 && newValue != null && (!IsValueValid(newValue) || (num2 > 0 && 0m == num4)));
						if (newValue == null)
						{
							newValue = obj3;
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				newValue = ConvertToEditorValueType(newValue);
				if (newValue != null && IsValueValid(newValue))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (_valueEditor is XamMaskedEditor && ((XamMaskedEditor)_valueEditor).SpinWrappingAllowed)
			{
				object startValue = GetStartValue(up, wrapping: true);
				if (IsValueValid(startValue))
				{
					newValue = startValue;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public interface ISupportsSelectableText
	{

	public abstract class TextEditorBase : ValueEditor
	{
		protected static readonly DependencyPropertyKey DisplayTextPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DisplayTextProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty NullTextProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueToDisplayTextConverterProperty;

		protected virtual IValueConverter DefaultValueToDisplayTextConverter => ValueEditorDefaultConverter.ValueToDisplayTextConverter;

		[Bindable(true)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public string DisplayText => (string)GetValue(DisplayTextProperty);

		[Bindable(true)]
		public string NullText
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(NullTextProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(NullTextProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public IValueConverter ValueToDisplayTextConverter
		{
			get
			{
				return (IValueConverter)GetValue(ValueToDisplayTextConverterProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueToDisplayTextConverterProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public IValueConverter ValueToDisplayTextConverterResolved
		{
			get
			{
				IValueConverter valueConverter = ValueToDisplayTextConverter;
				if (valueConverter == null)
				{
					valueConverter = DefaultValueToDisplayTextConverter;
				}
				return valueConverter;
			}
		}

		static TextEditorBase()
		{
			DisplayTextPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("DisplayText", typeof(string), typeof(TextEditorBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null));
			DisplayTextProperty = DisplayTextPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			NullTextProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("NullText", typeof(string), typeof(TextEditorBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(string.Empty, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None));
			ValueToDisplayTextConverterProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ValueToDisplayTextConverter", typeof(IValueConverter), typeof(TextEditorBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None));
			ToolTipService.IsEnabledProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(TextEditorBase), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, CoerceToolTipIsEnabled));
		}

		protected override void DoInitialization()
		{
			base.DoInitialization();
			SyncDisplayText();
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			DependencyProperty property = e.Property;
			if (FrameworkElement.LanguageProperty == property || ValueEditor.FormatProperty == property || ValueEditor.FormatProviderProperty == property)
			{
				SyncDisplayText();
			}
			else if (NullTextProperty == property)
			{
				SyncDisplayText();
			}
		}

		internal override bool SyncValuePropertiesOverride(DependencyProperty prop, object newValue, out Exception error)
		{
			bool result = base.SyncValuePropertiesOverride(prop, newValue, out error);
			SyncDisplayText();
			return result;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeNullText()
		{
			return Utilities.ShouldSerialize(NullTextProperty, this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetNullText()
		{
			ClearValue(NullTextProperty);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ConvertDisplayTextToValue(string displayText, out object value, out Exception error)
		{
			error = null;
			value = null;
			try
			{
				value = ValueToDisplayTextConverterResolved.ConvertBack(displayText, base.ValueType, this, base.FormatProviderResolved as CultureInfo);
				if (value == null)
				{
					if (displayText != null && displayText.Length != 0 && !(displayText == NullText))
					{
						error = Utils.GetTextToValueConversionError(base.ValueType, displayText);
						return false;
					}
					value = null;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				error = ex;
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public bool ConvertValueToDisplayText(object value, out string text, out Exception error)
		{
			error = null;
			text = null;
			try
			{
				text = (string)ValueToDisplayTextConverterResolved.Convert(value, typeof(string), this, base.FormatProviderResolved as CultureInfo);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				error = ex;
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static object CoerceToolTipIsEnabled(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			TextEditorBase textEditorBase = (TextEditorBase)d;
			if (textEditorBase.HasOpenDropDown)
			{
				return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal void MouseLeftButtonDown_ToggleDropDownHelper(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = HasDropDown && ShouldToggleDropDown(e);
			if (flag && !base.IsInEditMode && !base.IsFocusWithin)
			{
				Focus();
				if (!base.IsFocusWithin)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ToggleDropDown();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		internal virtual void RaiseDropDownClosedIfPending()
		{
		}

		internal void SyncDisplayText()
		{
			string text;
			Exception error;
			bool flag = ConvertValueToDisplayText(base.Value, out text, out error);
			SetValue(DisplayTextPropertyKey, text);
		}

		internal virtual bool ShouldToggleDropDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = (GetTemplateChild("PART_DropDownButton") ?? GetTemplateChild("DropDownButton")) as FrameworkElement;
			if (frameworkElement == null && base.IsInEditMode)
			{
				frameworkElement = Utilities.GetDescendantFromName(this, "PART_DropDownButton") ?? Utilities.GetDescendantFromName(this, "DropDownButton");
				if (frameworkElement == null || frameworkElement.ActualHeight <= 0.0 || frameworkElement.ActualWidth <= 0.0)
				{
					UpdateLayout();
				}
			}
			if (frameworkElement != null && Utils.IsMouseOverElement(frameworkElement, e))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual void ToggleDropDown()
		{
		}

		internal void UpdateDropDownButtonVisibility()
		{
			UpdateDropDownButtonVisibility(base.IsEditingAllowed);
		}

		internal void UpdateDropDownButtonVisibility(bool allowButton)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (allowButton)
			{
				flag = (DropDownButtonDisplayMode)GetValue(XamComboEditor.DropDownButtonDisplayModeProperty) switch
				{
					DropDownButtonDisplayMode.Always => true, 
					DropDownButtonDisplayMode.Focused => base.IsInEditMode || base.IsFocusWithin, 
					DropDownButtonDisplayMode.OnlyInEditMode => base.IsInEditMode, 
					_ => base.IsInEditMode || base.IsMouseOver, 
				};
			}
			SetValue(XamComboEditor.DropDownButtonVisibilityPropertyKey, flag ? KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox : KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox);
		}

		protected override void OnEditModeEnding(EditModeEndingEventArgs args)
		{
			if (HasOpenDropDown)
			{
				ToggleDropDown();
			}
			RaiseDropDownClosedIfPending();
			RaiseEventHelper(args);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Host == null && base.Focusable && base.IsEnabled && !base.IsInEditMode)
			{
				MouseLeftButtonDown_ToggleDropDownHelper(e);
			}
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Host != null && base.Focusable && base.IsEnabled && base.Host._previewMouseLeftButtonDown_EnterEditMode_TimeStamp == e.Timestamp)
			{
				MouseLeftButtonDown_ToggleDropDownHelper(e);
			}
			base.OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
		}
	}

	[LicenseProvider(typeof(UltraLicenseProvider))]
	[UltraLicense("XamCheckEditor")]
	public class XamCheckEditor : ValueEditor
	{
		private UltraLicense _license;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsCheckedProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsThreeStateProperty;

		protected override bool AcceptsArrowKeysInEditModeDefault => false;

		[Bindable(true)]

				return (bool?)GetValue(IsCheckedProperty);

			}

		static XamCheckEditor()
		{
			IsCheckedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsChecked", typeof(bool?), typeof(XamCheckEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, OnIsCheckedChanged));
			IsThreeStateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsThreeState", typeof(bool), typeof(XamCheckEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null));
			ValueEditor.ValueTypeProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamCheckEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(bool)));
			Control.HorizontalContentAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamCheckEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(HorizontalAlignment.Center));
			Control.VerticalContentAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamCheckEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(VerticalAlignment.Center));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamCheckEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(XamCheckEditor)));
			KeyboardNavigation.TabNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamCheckEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.Local));
			KeyboardNavigation.ControlTabNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamCheckEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.Local));

			Infragistics.Themes.ThemeManager.RegisterControl(typeof(XamCheckEditor));
		}

		public XamCheckEditor()
		{
			try
			{
				_license = LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(XamCheckEditor), this) as UltraLicense;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
			}
		}

		internal override void InitializeValueProperties()
		{
			if (Utils.IsValuePropertySet(IsCheckedProperty, this))
			{
				DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(this, ValueEditor.ValueProperty, IsChecked);
			}
			base.InitializeValueProperties();
			SetIsCheckedHelper(base.Value);
		}

		public override bool CanEditType(Type type)
		{
			if (!(typeof(bool) == type))
			{
				return typeof(bool?) == type;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool CanRenderType(Type type)
		{
			return CanEditType(type);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool IsExtentBasedOnValue(Orientation orientation)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new XamCheckEditorAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				StartEditModeOnMouseDownHelper();
			}
		}

		protected override void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			base.SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			bool? isChecked = IsChecked;
			if (!isChecked.HasValue)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Indeterminate", useTransitions);
			}
			else if (isChecked.Value)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Checked", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Unchecked", useTransitions);
			}
		}

		internal override bool SyncValuePropertiesOverride(DependencyProperty prop, object newValue, out Exception error)
		{
			bool result = base.SyncValuePropertiesOverride(prop, newValue, out error);
			SetIsCheckedHelper(base.Value);
			return result;
		}

		private static void OnIsCheckedChanged(DependencyObject dependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamCheckEditor xamCheckEditor = (XamCheckEditor)dependencyObject;
			if (!xamCheckEditor.SyncingValueProperties)
			{
				xamCheckEditor.Value = e.NewValue;
			}
			xamCheckEditor.UpdateVisualStates();
			if (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(xamCheckEditor) is XamCheckEditorAutomationPeer xamCheckEditorAutomationPeer)
			{
				xamCheckEditorAutomationPeer.RaiseToggleStatePropertyChangedEvent((bool?)e.OldValue, (bool?)e.NewValue);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeIsThreeState()
		{
			return Utilities.ShouldSerialize(IsThreeStateProperty, this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetIsThreeState()
		{
			ClearValue(IsThreeStateProperty);
		}

		internal void ToggleIsChecked()
		{
			bool? isChecked = IsChecked;
			bool isThreeState = IsThreeState;
			isChecked = ((!isChecked.HasValue) ? new bool?(true) : (isChecked.Value ? new bool?(false) : ((!isThreeState) ? new bool?(true) : ((bool?)null))));
			IsChecked = isChecked;
		}

		private void SetIsCheckedHelper(object value)
		{
			value = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, typeof(bool), base.FormatProviderResolved, base.Format);
			if (!(value is bool))
			{
				IsChecked = null;
			}
			else
			{
				IsChecked = (bool)value;
			}
		}
	}

			if (valueEditor == null || valueEditor.IsInEditMode)
			{
				base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			}
		}
	}
