		protected internal override string GetDefaultMask(Type dataType, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			if (formatProvider is CultureInfo && ((CultureInfo)formatProvider).DateTimeFormat.Calendar is JapaneseCalendar)
			{
				return XamMaskedEditor.CalcDefaultDateMask(formatProvider);
			}
			return base.GetDefaultMask(dataType, formatProvider);
		}

		internal override void InitializeValueProperties()
		{
			if (Utils.IsValuePropertySet(DateValueProperty, this) && !Utils.IsValuePropertySet(ValueEditor.ValueProperty, this))
			{
				CoerceValue(DateValueProperty);
				SyncValueProperties(DateValueProperty, DateValue);
			}
			else
			{
				base.InitializeValueProperties();
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			if (_popup != null)
			{
				_popup.Opened -= OnPopupOpened;
				_popup.Closed -= OnPopupClosed;
			}
			_popup = GetTemplateChild("PART_Popup") as Popup;
			if (_popup != null)
			{
				_popup.Opened += OnPopupOpened;
				_popup.Closed += OnPopupClosed;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			CoerceValue(AllowDropDownProperty);
			UpdateDropDownButtonVisibility(AllowDropDown);
			UpdateComputedDates();
			base.OnInitialized(e);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			DependencyProperty property = e.Property;
			if (ValueEditor.FormatProviderProperty == property)
			{
				if (base.FormatProvider != null && base.FormatProvider is CultureInfo)
				{
					SetValue(ComputedMinDatePropertyKey, ((CultureInfo)base.FormatProvider).DateTimeFormat.Calendar.MinSupportedDateTime);
					SetValue(ComputedMaxDatePropertyKey, ((CultureInfo)base.FormatProvider).DateTimeFormat.Calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime);
				}
				else
				{
					SetValue(ComputedMinDatePropertyKey, XamMaskedEditor.DefaultCultureInfo.DateTimeFormat.Calendar.MinSupportedDateTime);
					SetValue(ComputedMaxDatePropertyKey, XamMaskedEditor.DefaultCultureInfo.DateTimeFormat.Calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime);
				}
			}
			if (UIElement.IsMouseOverProperty == property || DropDownButtonDisplayModeProperty == property || ValueEditor.IsInEditModeProperty == property)
			{
				UpdateDropDownButtonVisibility(AllowDropDown);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnSectionsChanged()
		{
			base.OnSectionsChanged();
			CalendarMode? calendarMode = null;
			bool? flag = null;
			if (base.Sections != null)
			{
				foreach (SectionBase section in base.Sections)
				{
					if (section is DaySection)
					{
						calendarMode = CalendarMode.Days;
					}
					else if (section is MonthSection)
					{
						if (!calendarMode.HasValue || calendarMode > CalendarMode.Months)
						{
							calendarMode = CalendarMode.Months;
						}
					}
					else if (section is YearSection && (!calendarMode.HasValue || calendarMode > CalendarMode.Years))
					{
						calendarMode = CalendarMode.Years;
					}
					if (section is HourSection || section is MinuteSection || section is AMPMSection || section is SecondSection)
					{
						if (!flag.HasValue)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					else if (section is EditSectionBase)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				_hasTimeSectionsOnly = flag == true;
				if (!calendarMode.HasValue)
				{
					calendarMode = CalendarMode.Days;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				calendarMode = CalendarMode.Days;
				_hasTimeSectionsOnly = false;
			}
			SetValue(ComputedMinCalendarModePropertyKey, calendarMode);
			CoerceValue(AllowDropDownProperty);
			UpdateDropDownButtonVisibility(AllowDropDown);
		}

		internal override void OnValueConstraintChanged(string valueConstraintPropertyName)
		{
			base.OnValueConstraintChanged(valueConstraintPropertyName);
			UpdateComputedDates();
		}

		internal override void RaiseDropDownClosedIfPending()
		{
			if (_isClosePending)
			{
				_isClosePending = false;
				RaiseDropDownClosed(new RoutedEventArgs());
			}
		}

		internal override bool SyncValuePropertiesOverride(DependencyProperty prop, object newValue, out Exception error)
		{
			if (DateValueProperty == prop)
			{
				DateTime? dateTime = (DateTime?)newValue;
				MaskInfo maskInfo = base.MaskInfo;
				EditInfo editInfo = base.EditInfo;
				SectionsCollection sections = maskInfo.Sections;
				if (editInfo != null)
				{
					string text = XamMaskedEditor.GetText(sections, MaskMode.IncludeBoth, maskInfo);
					if (dateTime.HasValue)
					{
						XamMaskedEditor.SetDateTimeValue(sections, dateTime.Value, editInfo.MaskInfo, retainOriginalTime: true);
					}
					else
					{
						YearSection yearSection = (YearSection)XamMaskedEditor.GetSection(sections, typeof(YearSection));
						MonthSection monthSection = (MonthSection)XamMaskedEditor.GetSection(sections, typeof(MonthSection));
						DaySection daySection = (DaySection)XamMaskedEditor.GetSection(sections, typeof(DaySection));
						yearSection?.EraseAllChars();
						monthSection?.EraseAllChars();
						daySection?.EraseAllChars();
					}
					string text2 = XamMaskedEditor.GetText(sections, MaskMode.IncludeBoth, maskInfo);
					if (text != text2)
					{
						editInfo.OnTextChanged(viaUserAction: true);
						try
						{
							DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(this, ValueEditor.ValueProperty, editInfo.Value);
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(this, ValueEditor.ValueProperty, null);
							error = ex;
							return false;
						}
						finally
						{
							SyncDisplayText();
						}
						error = null;
						return true;
					}
					error = null;
					return true;
				}
				object newValue2 = null;
				if (dateTime.HasValue)
				{
					object obj = base.Value;
					if (!Utils.IsValueEmpty(obj) && !(obj is DateTime))
					{
						obj = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(obj, typeof(DateTime), base.FormatProviderResolved, base.Format);
					}
					newValue2 = ((!(obj is DateTime dateTime2)) ? ((object)dateTime) : ((object)sections.Calendar.ToDateTime(dateTime.Value.Year, dateTime.Value.Month, dateTime.Value.Day, dateTime2.Hour, dateTime2.Minute, dateTime2.Second, dateTime2.Millisecond)));
				}
				DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(this, ValueEditor.ValueProperty, newValue2);
				return base.SyncValuePropertiesOverride(ValueEditor.ValueProperty, base.Value, out error);
			}
			bool result = base.SyncValuePropertiesOverride(prop, newValue, out error);
			SectionsCollection sections2 = base.Sections;
			object obj2;
			if (!base.IsValueValid)
			{
				obj2 = XamMaskedEditor.GetDateValue(sections2);
			}
			else
			{
				object value = base.Value;
				obj2 = ((value is DateTime) ? value : null);
				if (obj2 == null && !Utils.IsValueEmpty(value) && sections2 != null && XamMaskedEditor.IsMaskValidForDataType(typeof(DateTime), sections2) && IsInputValid(sections2, out var _))
				{
					try
					{
						obj2 = XamMaskedEditor.GetDateTimeValue(base.Sections);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				if (obj2 == null)
				{
					obj2 = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, typeof(DateTime), base.FormatProviderResolved, base.Format);
				}
			}
			DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(this, DateValueProperty, (DBNull.Value != obj2) ? obj2 : null);
			return result;
		}

		internal override void ToggleDropDown()
		{
			IsDropDownOpen = !IsDropDownOpen;
		}

		private static object CoerceAllowDropDown(DependencyObject d, object newValue)
		{
			XamDateTimeEditor xamDateTimeEditor = (XamDateTimeEditor)d;
			if (xamDateTimeEditor._hasTimeSectionsOnly)
			{
				return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
			}
			if (!xamDateTimeEditor.IsEditingAllowed)
			{
				return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private static void OnAllowDropDownChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamDateTimeEditor xamDateTimeEditor = (XamDateTimeEditor)d;
			xamDateTimeEditor.UpdateDropDownButtonVisibility(xamDateTimeEditor.AllowDropDown);
			xamDateTimeEditor.RaisePeerExpandCollapseChange();
		}

		private static void OnDateValueChanged(DependencyObject dependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamDateTimeEditor xamDateTimeEditor = (XamDateTimeEditor)dependencyObject;
			if (xamDateTimeEditor._suppressSyncValueProperties)
			{
				return;
			}
			xamDateTimeEditor.SyncValueProperties(DateValueProperty, e.NewValue);
			try
			{
				xamDateTimeEditor._suppressSyncValueProperties = true;
				if (xamDateTimeEditor.DateValue.HasValue && xamDateTimeEditor.Value is DateTime)
				{
					xamDateTimeEditor.DateValue = ((DateTime)xamDateTimeEditor.Value).Date;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				xamDateTimeEditor._suppressSyncValueProperties = false;
			}
		}

		private static void OnIsDropDownOpenChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamDateTimeEditor xamDateTimeEditor = (XamDateTimeEditor)d;
			bool flag = (bool)e.NewValue;
			xamDateTimeEditor.RaisePeerExpandCollapseChange();
			xamDateTimeEditor.ProcessIsBeingEditedAndFocusedChanged();
			if (flag)
			{
				xamDateTimeEditor.RaiseDropDownClosedIfPending();
				xamDateTimeEditor.RaiseDropDownOpened(new RoutedEventArgs());
			}
			else
			{
				if (xamDateTimeEditor.IsFocusWithin)
				{
					xamDateTimeEditor.SetFocusToFocusSite();
				}
				xamDateTimeEditor._isClosePending = true;
				if (xamDateTimeEditor._popup == null)
				{
					xamDateTimeEditor.RaiseDropDownClosedIfPending();
				}
			}
			xamDateTimeEditor.CoerceValue(ToolTipService.IsEnabledProperty);
		}

		private static object OnCoerceIsDropDownOpen(DependencyObject dependencyObject, object valueAsObject)
		{
			bool flag = (bool)valueAsObject;
			XamDateTimeEditor xamDateTimeEditor = (XamDateTimeEditor)dependencyObject;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (!xamDateTimeEditor.IsLoaded)
				{
					xamDateTimeEditor.RegisterToOpenOnLoad();
					return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
				}
				if (!xamDateTimeEditor.AllowDropDown)
				{
					return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
				}
				if (xamDateTimeEditor.IsReadOnly)
				{
					return false;
				}
				xamDateTimeEditor.StartEditMode();
				if (!xamDateTimeEditor.IsInEditMode)
				{
					return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void RegisterToOpenOnLoad()
		{
			RoutedEventHandler value = OpenOnLoad;
			base.Loaded -= value;
			base.Loaded += value;
		}

		private void OpenOnLoad(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Loaded -= OpenOnLoad;
			base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Input, (DispatcherOperationCallback)delegate
			{
				CoerceValue(IsDropDownOpenProperty);
				return (object)null;
			}, null);
		}

		private DateTime? GetDate(object value, TimeSpan adjustment)
		{
			DateTime? result = null;
			if (value != null)
			{
				MaskInfo maskInfo = base.MaskInfo;
				result = (DateTime?)CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, typeof(DateTime), maskInfo.FormatProvider, maskInfo.Format);
				if (result.HasValue)
				{
					result = result.Value.Date;
					try
					{
						result = result.Value.Add(adjustment);
					}
					catch (ArgumentException)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static void OnIsReadOnlyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			d.CoerceValue(AllowDropDownProperty);
		}

		private void OnPopupOpened(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Popup popup = (Popup)sender;
			if (popup.Child != null)
			{
				popup.Child.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First));
			}
		}

		private void OnPopupClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseDropDownClosedIfPending();
		}

		private static void OnSelectionCommitted(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamDateTimeEditor xamDateTimeEditor = sender as XamDateTimeEditor;
			if (e.OriginalSource is XamMonthCalendar xamMonthCalendar && xamMonthCalendar.TemplatedParent == xamDateTimeEditor && xamDateTimeEditor.IsDropDownOpen)
			{
				xamDateTimeEditor.ToggleDropDown();
			}
		}

		private void RaisePeerExpandCollapseChange()
		{
			if (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(this) is XamMaskedEditorAutomationPeer xamMaskedEditorAutomationPeer)
			{
				xamMaskedEditorAutomationPeer.RaiseExpandCollapseChanged();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateComputedDates()
		{
			if (!base.IsInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			ValueConstraint valueConstraint = base.ValueConstraint;
			object value = DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			object value2 = DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			if (valueConstraint != null)
			{
				MaskInfo maskInfo = base.MaskInfo;
				DateTime? date = GetDate(valueConstraint.MaxExclusive, new TimeSpan(-864000000000L));
				DateTime? date2 = GetDate(valueConstraint.MaxInclusive, TimeSpan.Zero);
				DateTime? date3 = GetDate(valueConstraint.MinExclusive, new TimeSpan(864000000000L));
				DateTime? date4 = GetDate(valueConstraint.MinInclusive, TimeSpan.Zero);
				if (date.HasValue)
				{
					value = ((!date2.HasValue || !(date2 < date)) ? ((object)date) : ((object)date2));
				}
				else if (date2.HasValue)
				{
					value = date2;
				}
				if (date3.HasValue)
				{
					value2 = ((!date4.HasValue || !(date4 > date3)) ? ((object)date3) : ((object)date4));
				}
				else if (date4.HasValue)
				{
					value2 = date4;
				}
			}
			SetValue(ComputedMaxDatePropertyKey, value);
			SetValue(ComputedMinDatePropertyKey, value2);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDropDownOpened(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEventHelper(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseDropDownOpened(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = DropDownOpenedEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnDropDownOpened(args);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDropDownClosed(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEventHelper(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseDropDownClosed(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = DropDownClosedEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnDropDownClosed(args);
		}
	}
	public abstract class DisplayCharBase : PropertyChangeNotifier
	{
		private FilterType filterType;

		private DisplayCharIncludeMethod includeMethod;

		private SectionBase section;

		private bool required;

		private int index = -1;

		internal static string PROPERTY_CHAR = "Char";

		internal static string PROPERTY_DRAWSTRING = "DrawString";

		internal static string PROPERTY_VISIBILITY = "Visibility";

		internal static string PROPERTY_DRAWSELECTED = "DrawSelected";

		internal FilterType FilterType
		{
			get
			{
				return filterType;
			}
			set
			{
				filterType = value;
			}
		}

		internal SectionBase Section => section;

		internal int Index
		{
			get
			{
				DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = Section.DisplayChars;
				int count = displayChars.Count;
				if (index >= 0 && index < count && this == displayChars[index])
				{
					return index;
				}
				index = displayChars.IndexOf(this);
				return index;
			}
		}

		internal int OverallIndexInEdit
		{
			get
			{
				if (Section.Index < 0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (Section.Index == 0)
				{
					return Index;
				}
				if (Section.PreviousSection == null)
				{
					return Index;
				}
				DisplayCharBase lastDisplayChar = Section.PreviousSection.LastDisplayChar;
				return ((lastDisplayChar != null) ? (lastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit + 1) : 0) + Index;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool IsEmpty => Char == '\0';

		internal bool IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				EditInfo editInfo = MaskedEdit?.EditInfo;
				if (editInfo != null)
				{
					int overallIndexInEdit = OverallIndexInEdit;
					if (overallIndexInEdit >= editInfo.SelectionStart)
					{
						return overallIndexInEdit < editInfo.SelectionStart + editInfo.SelectionLength;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool DrawSelected
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsSelected)
				{
					return MaskInfo.IsBeingEditedAndFocused;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal DisplayCharBase PrevDisplayChar
		{
			get
			{
				if (Section == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = Section.DisplayChars;
				if (displayChars == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (Index - 1 >= 0)
				{
					return displayChars[Index - 1];
				}
				if (Section.PreviousSection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Section.PreviousSection.LastDisplayChar;
			}
		}

		internal DisplayCharBase NextDisplayChar
		{
			get
			{
				if (Section == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = Section.DisplayChars;
				if (displayChars == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				int num = Index;
				if (1 + num < displayChars.Count)
				{
					return displayChars[1 + num];
				}
				return Section.NextSection?.FirstDisplayChar;
			}
		}

		internal DisplayCharBase NextLiteralChar
		{
			get
			{
				for (DisplayCharBase nextDisplayChar = NextDisplayChar; nextDisplayChar != null; nextDisplayChar = nextDisplayChar.NextDisplayChar)
				{
					if (!nextDisplayChar.IsEditable)
					{
						return nextDisplayChar;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal DisplayCharBase NextEditableDisplayChar
		{
			get
			{
				if (Section == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = Section.DisplayChars;
				if (displayChars == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				for (int i = 1 + Index; i < displayChars.Count; i++)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = displayChars[i];
					if (displayCharBase != null && displayCharBase.IsEditable)
					{
						return displayCharBase;
					}
				}
				if (Section.NextEditSection != null)
				{
					if (Section.NextEditSection.FirstDisplayChar.IsEditable)
					{
						return Section.NextEditSection.FirstDisplayChar;
					}
					return Section.NextEditSection.FirstDisplayChar.NextEditableDisplayChar;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal DisplayCharBase NextFilledEditableDisplayChar
		{
			get
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = this;
				do
				{
					displayCharBase = displayCharBase.NextEditableDisplayChar;
				}
				while (displayCharBase != null && displayCharBase.IsEmpty);
				return displayCharBase;
			}
		}

		public DisplayCharIncludeMethod IncludeMethod
		{
			get
			{
				return includeMethod;
			}
			set
			{
				Utils.ValidateEnum("IncludeMethod", typeof(DisplayCharIncludeMethod), value);
				includeMethod = value;
			}
		}

		public string DrawString
		{
			get
			{
				string text = GetDrawChar().ToString();
				if (DrawComma && MaskInfo != null)
				{
					text += MaskInfo.CommaChar;
				}
				return text;
			}
		}

		public Visibility Visibility
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetDrawChar() == '\0')
				{
					return Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
				return Visibility.Visible;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool DrawComma => false;

		internal XamMaskedEditor MaskedEdit => section?.MaskedEdit;

		internal MaskInfo MaskInfo => Section.MaskInfo;

		internal bool Required
		{
			get
			{
				return required;
			}
			set
			{
				required = value;
			}
		}

		public abstract bool IsEditable { get; }

		public abstract char Char { get; set; }

		internal DisplayCharBase()
		{
		}

		internal DisplayCharBase(SectionBase section)
		{
			Initialize(section);
		}

		internal void Initialize(SectionBase section)
		{
			this.section = section;
		}

		internal virtual char Filter(char c)
		{
			switch (filterType)
			{
			case FilterType.UpperCase:
				c = char.ToUpper(c, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				break;
			case FilterType.LowerCase:
				c = char.ToLower(c, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				break;
			}
			return c;
		}

		internal char GetChar(MaskMode maskMode, char promptChar, char padChar)
		{
			char c = Char;
			switch (IncludeMethod)
			{
			case DisplayCharIncludeMethod.Never:
				return '\0';
			case DisplayCharIncludeMethod.Always:
			{
				DisplayCharBase nextDisplayChar = NextDisplayChar;
				if (nextDisplayChar != null && nextDisplayChar.Section is FractionPart && Section != nextDisplayChar.Section)
				{
					FractionPart fractionPart = (FractionPart)nextDisplayChar.Section;
					bool flag = true;
					DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = fractionPart.DisplayChars;
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = displayChars.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = displayChars[i];
						if (displayCharBase != null && displayCharBase.GetChar(maskMode, promptChar, padChar) != 0)
						{
							flag = false;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						return '\0';
					}
				}
				if (c != 0)
				{
					return c;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			char c2 = '\0';
			switch (maskMode)
			{
			case MaskMode.Raw:
				if (IsEditable)
				{
					c2 = c;
				}
				break;
			case MaskMode.IncludeLiterals:
				c2 = c;
				break;
			case MaskMode.IncludePromptChars:
				if (IsEditable)
				{
					c2 = c;
					if (c2 == '\0')
					{
						c2 = promptChar;
					}
				}
				break;
			case MaskMode.IncludeBoth:
				c2 = c;
				if (c2 == '\0')
				{
					c2 = promptChar;
				}
				break;
			case MaskMode.IncludeLiteralsWithPadding:
				c2 = c;
				if (c2 == '\0')
				{
					c2 = padChar;
				}
				break;
			}
			return c2;
		}

		internal char GetChar(MaskMode maskMode)
		{
			MaskInfo maskInfo = MaskInfo;
			if (maskInfo == null)
			{
				return Char;
			}
			return GetChar(maskMode, maskInfo.PromptChar, maskInfo.PadChar);
		}

		internal virtual char GetDrawChar()
		{
			MaskInfo maskInfo = MaskInfo;
			if (maskInfo == null)
			{
				return Char;
			}
			if (maskInfo.IsBeingEditedAndFocused)
			{
				return GetChar(MaskMode.IncludeBoth);
			}
			return GetChar(maskInfo.DisplayMode);
		}

		internal void NotifyPropertyChangedEvent(string propName)
		{
			RaisePropertyChangedEvent(propName);
			if (!(PROPERTY_CHAR == propName))
			{
				return;
			}
			RaisePropertyChangedEvent(PROPERTY_VISIBILITY);
			RaisePropertyChangedEvent(PROPERTY_DRAWSTRING);
			if (section is FractionPart)
			{
				LiteralSection previousLiteralSection = section.PreviousLiteralSection;
				if (previousLiteralSection != null)
				{
					XamMaskedEditor.NotifyPropertyOnDisplayCharacters(previousLiteralSection, PROPERTY_CHAR);
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract bool MatchChar(char c);

		internal void EraseChar()
		{
			if (IsEditable)
			{
				Char = '\0';
			}
		}

		internal virtual void InternalCopy(DisplayCharBase dest)
		{
			if (GetType() != dest.GetType())
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_2"), "dest");
			}
			dest.filterType = filterType;
			dest.includeMethod = includeMethod;
			dest.required = required;
		}

		internal abstract DisplayCharBase InternalClone(SectionBase section);
	}
	public abstract class InputCharBase : DisplayCharBase
	{
		private char inputChar;

		public override bool IsEditable => true;

		public override char Char
		{
			get
			{
				return inputChar;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != 0 && !MatchChar(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_3"));
				}
				if (value != inputChar)
				{
					inputChar = Filter(value);
					NotifyPropertyChangedEvent(DisplayCharBase.PROPERTY_CHAR);
				}
			}
		}

		internal InputCharBase()
		{
		}

		internal InputCharBase(SectionBase section)
			: base(section)
		{
		}

		internal override char GetDrawChar()
		{
			char result = base.GetDrawChar();
			if (Char == '\0' && base.Section is NumberSection numberSection && SignDisplayType.ShowAlways == numberSection.SignType && !numberSection.IsNegative)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = numberSection.FirstFilledChar?.PrevDisplayChar;
				if (this == displayCharBase)
				{
					result = numberSection.PlusSignChar;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal override void InternalCopy(DisplayCharBase dest)
		{
			base.InternalCopy(dest);
			InputCharBase inputCharBase = (InputCharBase)dest;
			inputCharBase.inputChar = inputChar;
		}
	}
	internal class LiteralChar : InputCharBase
	{
		protected char literal;

		public override bool IsEditable => false;

		public override char Char
		{
			get

			set

				throw new InvalidOperationException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_3"));

		}

		internal LiteralChar(char literal, SectionBase section)

		public override bool MatchChar(char c)

		internal override void InternalCopy(DisplayCharBase dest)

		internal override DisplayCharBase InternalClone(SectionBase section)

	}
	internal sealed class DecimalSeperatorChar : LiteralChar
	{
		public override char Char
		{
			get

					return base.Section.DecimalSeperatorChar;
				}
				return base.Char;

			set

		internal DecimalSeperatorChar(char decimalSeperatorChar)

			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.MatchChar(c);
		}

		internal override DisplayCharBase InternalClone(SectionBase section)

			return decimalSeperatorChar;
		}

		internal override char GetDrawChar()
		{
			char c = base.GetDrawChar();
			if (c == '\0')
			{
				MaskInfo maskInfo = base.MaskInfo;
				if (maskInfo != null && maskInfo.IsBeingEditedAndFocused)
				{
					c = Char;
				}
			}
			return c;
		}
	}
	public class DigitChar : InputCharBase
	{
		private bool hasComma;

		internal override bool DrawComma
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.MaskInfo == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ShouldIncludeComma(base.MaskInfo.IsBeingEditedAndFocused ? MaskMode.IncludeBoth : base.MaskInfo.DisplayMode);
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool HasComma
		{
			get
			{
				return hasComma;
			}
			set
			{
				hasComma = value;
			}
		}

		internal DigitChar()
		{
		}

		internal DigitChar(SectionBase section)
			: base(section)
		{
		}

		public override bool MatchChar(char c)
		{
			char c2 = Filter(c);
			if (base.Section is NumberSection numberSection && (numberSection.SignType == SignDisplayType.ShowAlways || numberSection.SignType == SignDisplayType.ShowWhenNegative))
			{
				char plusSignChar = numberSection.PlusSignChar;
				char minusSignChar = numberSection.MinusSignChar;
				if (plusSignChar == c || minusSignChar == c)
				{
					if (!numberSection.IgnoreStrictSignChecking)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < numberSection.DisplayChars.Count; i++)
						{
							DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = numberSection.DisplayChars[i];
							if (!displayCharBase.IsEmpty && plusSignChar != displayCharBase.Char && minusSignChar != displayCharBase.Char)
							{
								return false;
							}
							if (this == displayCharBase)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (char.IsDigit(c))
				{
					if (!numberSection.IgnoreStrictSignChecking)
					{
						int num = base.Index;
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							int count = numberSection.DisplayChars.Count;
							for (int j = 1 + num; j < count; j++)
							{
								DisplayCharBase displayCharBase2 = numberSection.DisplayChars[j];
								if (displayCharBase2 != null && !displayCharBase2.IsEmpty && (plusSignChar == displayCharBase2.Char || minusSignChar == displayCharBase2.Char))
								{
									return false;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			return char.IsDigit(c2);
		}

		internal virtual bool ShouldIncludeComma(MaskMode maskMode)
		{
			if (!HasComma)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(base.Section is NumberSection numberSection))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Char == '\0')
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (numberSection.MinusSignChar == Char || numberSection.PlusSignChar == Char)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (maskMode)
			{
			case MaskMode.IncludeLiterals:
			case MaskMode.IncludeBoth:
			case MaskMode.IncludeLiteralsWithPadding:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal override void InternalCopy(DisplayCharBase dest)
		{
			base.InternalCopy(dest);
			DigitChar digitChar = (DigitChar)dest;
			digitChar.hasComma = hasComma;
		}

		internal override DisplayCharBase InternalClone(SectionBase section)
		{
			DigitChar digitChar = new DigitChar(section);
			InternalCopy(digitChar);
			return digitChar;
		}
	}

	public sealed class CharacterSet : InputCharBase
	{
		internal interface ICharSet
		{
			bool Contains(char c);
		}

		internal class RangeSet : ICharSet
		{
			private char _start;

			private char _end;

			public RangeSet(char start, char end)
			{
				if (start > end)
				{
					char c = start;
					start = end;
					end = c;
				}
				_start = start;
				_end = end;
			}

			public bool Contains(char c)
			{
				if (c >= _start)
				{
					return c <= _end;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal class CharSet : ICharSet
		{
			private char[] _set;

			public CharSet(char[] set)
			{
				_set = set;
			}

			public bool Contains(char c)
			{
				return Array.IndexOf(_set, c) >= 0;
			}
		}

		internal class AggregateSet : ICharSet
		{
			private ICharSet[] _sets;

			public AggregateSet(ICharSet[] sets)
			{
				_sets = sets;
			}

			public bool Contains(char c)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < _sets.Length; i++)
				{
					if (_sets[i].Contains(c))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private ICharSet _set;

		internal CharacterSet()
		{
		}

		internal CharacterSet(SectionBase section)
			: base(section)
		{
		}

		internal void InitializeSet(ICharSet set)
		{
			_set = set;
		}

		internal static ICharSet ParseSet(string str)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			char[] array = new char[str.Length];
			int num = 0;
			char start = '\0';
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < str.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = str[i];
				if ('\\' == c && !flag)
				{
					flag = true;
					continue;
				}
				if ('-' == c && i > 0 && 1 + i < str.Length && !flag)
				{
					num--;
					i++;
					if (str[i] == '\\' && 1 + i < str.Length)
					{
						i++;
					}
					arrayList.Add(new RangeSet(start, str[i]));
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
					array[num++] = c;
				}
				start = c;
			}
			if (num > 0 && num < array.Length)
			{
				char[] array2 = new char[num];
				Array.Copy(array, array2, num);
				array = array2;
			}
			if (array.Length != 0)
			{
				arrayList.Add(new CharSet(array));
			}
			if (1 == arrayList.Count)
			{
				return (ICharSet)arrayList[0];
			}
			if (arrayList.Count > 0)
			{
				return new AggregateSet((ICharSet[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(ICharSet)));
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override bool MatchChar(char c)
		{
			char c2 = Filter(c);
			return _set.Contains(c2);
		}

		internal override DisplayCharBase InternalClone(SectionBase section)
		{
			CharacterSet characterSet = new CharacterSet(section);
			InternalCopy(characterSet);
			characterSet._set = _set;
			return characterSet;
		}
	}
	public sealed class HexDigitChar : InputCharBase
	{
		internal const string HEX_DIGITS = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef";

		internal HexDigitChar()
		{
		}

		internal HexDigitChar(SectionBase section)
			: base(section)
		{
		}

		internal override char Filter(char c)
		{
			c = base.Filter(c);
			int num = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.CompareInfo.IndexOf("0123456789ABCDEFabcdef", c, CompareOptions.IgnoreWidth);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				c = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef"[num];
			}
			return c;
		}

		public override bool MatchChar(char c)
		{
			char value = Filter(c);
			return "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef".IndexOf(value) >= 0;
		}

		internal override DisplayCharBase InternalClone(SectionBase section)
		{
			HexDigitChar hexDigitChar = new HexDigitChar(section);
			InternalCopy(hexDigitChar);
			return hexDigitChar;
		}
	}

	internal class EditInfo
	{
		private class EditorSnapshot
		{
			internal int _caretPos;

			internal int _pivotPos;

			internal string _text;

			internal EditorSnapshot(EditInfo editInfo)
			{
				_text = editInfo.GetText(MaskMode.IncludeBoth);
				_caretPos = editInfo.CaretPosition;
				_pivotPos = editInfo.PivotPosition;
			}

			internal void Apply(EditInfo editInfo, bool validateSections = true)
			{
				editInfo.SetText(_text, validateSections);
				editInfo.PivotPosition = _pivotPos;
				editInfo.CaretPosition = _caretPos;
			}
		}

		internal class EditorValueSnapshot
		{
			internal string _text;

			internal string _textRaw;

			internal EditorValueSnapshot(EditInfo editInfo)
			{
				_text = editInfo.GetText(MaskMode.IncludeBoth);
				_textRaw = editInfo.GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
			}

			internal bool AreEqual(EditorValueSnapshot ii)
			{
				if (ii._text == _text)
				{
					return ii._textRaw == _textRaw;
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal bool IsCurrentValueSame(EditInfo editInfo)
			{
				return AreEqual(new EditorValueSnapshot(editInfo));
			}
		}

		private class TextBoxEventProxy
		{
			private WeakReference _editInfoRef;

			private InputMethod _inputMethodWired;

			private TextBox _textBoxWired;

			internal EditInfo EditInfo => CoreUtilities.GetWeakReferenceTargetSafe(_editInfoRef) as EditInfo;

			internal TextBoxEventProxy(EditInfo editInfo)
			{
				_editInfoRef = new WeakReference(editInfo);
			}

			internal void UnwireInputMethod_StateChanged()
			{
				InputMethod current = InputMethod.Current;
				if (_inputMethodWired != null && _inputMethodWired == current)
				{
					try
					{
						_inputMethodWired.StateChanged -= InputMethod_StateChanged;
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					_inputMethodWired = null;
				}
			}

			internal void UnwireTextBoxEvents()
			{
				if (_textBoxWired != null)
				{
					_textBoxWired.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty);
					_textBoxWired.PreviewTextInput -= ImeTextBox_PreviewTextInput;
					_textBoxWired.TextChanged -= ImeTextBox_TextChanged;
					_textBoxWired.SelectionChanged -= ImeTextBox_SelectionChanged;
					_textBoxWired.PreviewKeyDown -= ImeTextBox_PreviewKeyDown;
					CommandManager.RemovePreviewCanExecuteHandler(_textBoxWired, ImeTextBox_PreviewCanExecuteCommand);
					TextCompositionManager.RemoveTextInputStartHandler(_textBoxWired, ImeTextBox_TextInputStart);
					_textBoxWired = null;
				}
			}

			internal void WireInputMethod_StateChanged()
			{
				InputMethod current = InputMethod.Current;
				if (_inputMethodWired == current)
				{
					return;
				}
				UnwireInputMethod_StateChanged();
				_inputMethodWired = current;
				if (current != null)
				{
					try
					{
						_inputMethodWired.StateChanged += InputMethod_StateChanged;
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}

			internal void WireTextBoxEvents(TextBox textBox)
			{
				if (_textBoxWired != textBox)
				{
					UnwireTextBoxEvents();
					_textBoxWired = textBox;
					if (_textBoxWired != null)
					{
						_textBoxWired.PreviewTextInput += ImeTextBox_PreviewTextInput;
						_textBoxWired.TextChanged += ImeTextBox_TextChanged;
						_textBoxWired.SelectionChanged += ImeTextBox_SelectionChanged;
						_textBoxWired.PreviewKeyDown += ImeTextBox_PreviewKeyDown;
						CommandManager.AddPreviewCanExecuteHandler(_textBoxWired, ImeTextBox_PreviewCanExecuteCommand);
						TextCompositionManager.AddTextInputStartHandler(_textBoxWired, ImeTextBox_TextInputStart);
					}
				}
			}

			private void OnCleanup()
			{
				UnwireTextBoxEvents();
				UnwireInputMethod_StateChanged();
			}

			private void ImeTextBox_TextInputStart(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
			{
				EditInfo editInfo = EditInfo;
				if (editInfo != null)
				{
					editInfo.ImeTextBox_TextInputStart(sender, e);
				}
				else
				{
					OnCleanup();
				}
			}

			private void ImeTextBox_PreviewCanExecuteCommand(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				EditInfo editInfo = EditInfo;
				if (editInfo != null)
				{
					editInfo.ImeTextBox_PreviewCanExecuteCommand(sender, e);
				}
				else
				{
					OnCleanup();
				}
			}

			private void ImeTextBox_PreviewKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
			{
				EditInfo editInfo = EditInfo;
				if (editInfo != null)
				{
					editInfo.ImeTextBox_PreviewKeyDown(sender, e);
				}
				else
				{
					OnCleanup();
				}
			}

			private void ImeTextBox_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
			{
				EditInfo editInfo = EditInfo;
				if (editInfo != null)
				{
					editInfo.ImeTextBox_PreviewTextInput(sender, e);
				}
				else
				{
					OnCleanup();
				}
			}

			private void ImeTextBox_SelectionChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				EditInfo editInfo = EditInfo;
				if (editInfo != null)
				{
					editInfo.ImeTextBox_SelectionChanged(sender, e);
				}
				else
				{
					OnCleanup();
				}
			}

			private void ImeTextBox_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				EditInfo editInfo = EditInfo;
				if (editInfo != null)
				{
					editInfo.ImeTextBox_TextChanged(sender, e);
				}
				else
				{
					OnCleanup();
				}
			}

			private void InputMethod_StateChanged(object sender, InputMethodStateChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				EditInfo editInfo = EditInfo;
				if (editInfo != null)
				{
					editInfo.InputMethod_StateChanged(sender, e);
				}
				else
				{
					OnCleanup();
				}
			}
		}

		internal EditSectionBase LastEditSection

			get
			{
				SectionBase lastSection = LastSection;
				if (lastSection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (lastSection is EditSectionBase)
				{
					return (EditSectionBase)lastSection;
				}
				return lastSection.PreviousEditSection;
			}
		}

		internal SectionBase FirstSection
		{
			get
			{
				if (Sections == null || Sections.Count <= 0)
				{
					return null;

			}
		}

		internal InputCharBase FirstFilledDisplayChar
		{
			get
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int totalNumberOfDisplayChars = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars(); i < totalNumberOfDisplayChars; i++)
				{
					if (GetDisplayCharAtPosition(i) is InputCharBase { IsEditable: not false, IsEmpty: false } inputCharBase)
					{
						return inputCharBase;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal InputCharBase LastFilledDisplayChar
		{
			get
			{
				for (int num = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars() - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (GetDisplayCharAtPosition(num) is InputCharBase { IsEditable: not false, IsEmpty: false } inputCharBase)
					{
						return inputCharBase;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		{

				if (LastSection == null)

			}
		}

		internal bool InsertMode
		{
			get
			{
				return MaskedEditor?.InsertMode ?? true;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != InsertMode)
				{
					XamMaskedEditor maskedEditor = MaskedEditor;
					if (maskedEditor != null)
					{
						maskedEditor.InsertMode = value;
					}
					if (!InsertMode && IsAfterLastCharacter)
					{
						CaretPosition = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars() - 1;
					}
					maskedEditor?.ResetCaretBlinking();
					DirtyMaskElement();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInitialized => GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars() > 0;

		internal int CaretPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return _caretPosition;
			}
			set
			{
				if (IsInitialized && value != _caretPosition)
				{
					_caretPosition = CoerceCaretPosition(value);
					MaskedEditor.CaretPosition = _caretPosition;
					ScrollDisplayCharIntoView(_caretPosition);
					MaskedEditor.ResetCaretBlinking();
					InvalidateMaskElement();
				}
			}
		}

		{

				}
				return false;
			}

		internal int PivotPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return _pivotPosition;
			}
			set

				if (IsInitialized && value != _pivotPosition)

					MaskedEditor.PivotPosition = _pivotPosition;

				}
			}

		internal int SelectionStart
		{
			get
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(CaretPosition);
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition2 = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(PivotPosition);
				if (displayCharAtPosition != null && displayCharAtPosition2 != null)
				{
					int caretPosition = CaretPosition;
					int pivotPosition = PivotPosition;
					return Math.Min(caretPosition, pivotPosition);
				}
				return Math.Min(PivotPosition, CaretPosition);
			}
			set
			{
				if (IsInitialized && value != SelectionStart)
				{
					int num = value;
					int totalNumberOfDisplayChars = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars();
					if (num < 0)
					{
						num = 0;
					}
					if (num > totalNumberOfDisplayChars)
					{
						num = totalNumberOfDisplayChars;
					}
					int selectionLength = SelectionLength;
					PivotPosition = num;
					CaretPosition = PivotPosition + selectionLength;
				}
			}
		}

		internal int SelectionLength
		{
			get
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(CaretPosition);
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition2 = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(PivotPosition);
				if (displayCharAtPosition != null && displayCharAtPosition2 != null)
				{
					int caretPosition = CaretPosition;
					int pivotPosition = PivotPosition;
					return Math.Abs(pivotPosition - caretPosition);
				}
				return Math.Abs(PivotPosition - CaretPosition);
			}
			set
			{
				if (IsInitialized && value != SelectionLength)
				{
					int num = value;
					if (num < 0)
					{
						num = 0;
					}
					int totalNumberOfDisplayChars = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars();
					if (SelectionStart + num > totalNumberOfDisplayChars)
					{
						num = totalNumberOfDisplayChars - SelectionStart;
					}
					int num2 = (PivotPosition = Math.Min(CaretPosition, PivotPosition));
					CaretPosition = num2 + num;
					DirtyMaskElement();
				}
			}
		}

		private string GetTextInputText(TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			string text = e.Text;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && _lastInputTextChanged != null && _imeTextBox != null)
			{
				TextChange firstItem = CoreUtilities.GetFirstItem(_lastInputTextChanged.Changes);
				string text2 = _imeTextBox.Text;
				if (firstItem.Offset < text2.Length)
				{
					int start = firstItem.Offset;
					int length = firstItem.RemovedLength;
					if (_imeTextBox_PendingDelete != null)
					{
						start = _imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Start;
						length = _imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Length;
					}
					Select(start, length);
					text = text2.Substring(firstItem.Offset, firstItem.AddedLength);
				}
			}
			_lastInputTextChanged = null;
			return text;
		}

		private void Initialize(MaskInfo maskInfo)
		{
			Reset();
			if (maskInfo == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("maskInfo");
			}
			_maskInfo = maskInfo;
			FractionPartContinuous fractionPartContinuous = LastEditSection as FractionPartContinuous;
			int num = -1;
			if (InsertMode)
			{
				if (fractionPartContinuous != null && fractionPartContinuous.LastDisplayChar != null)
				{
					num = 1 + fractionPartContinuous.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit;
				}
				else if (FirstEditSection is NumberSection numberSection)
				{
					if (numberSection.FirstFilledChar != null)
					{
						num = numberSection.FirstFilledChar.OverallIndexInEdit;
					}
					else if (numberSection.LastDisplayChar != null)
					{
						num = 1 + numberSection.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				_caretPosition = (_pivotPosition = num);
			}
			ManageUndoHistory_TextChanged(viaUserAction: false, null);
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			_caretPosition = 0;
			_pivotPosition = 0;
			_lastIllegalChar = '\0';
			_lastIllegalDisplayChar = null;
		}

		internal void OnTextChanged(bool viaUserAction, RoutedCommand command)
		{
			XamMaskedEditor maskedEditor = MaskedEditor;
			maskedEditor.BeginSyncValueProperties();
			bool inOnTextChanged = _inOnTextChanged;
			_inOnTextChanged = true;
			try
			{
				string text = XamMaskedEditor.GetText(Sections, MaskInfo.DataMode, MaskInfo, string.Empty);
				maskedEditor.Text_CurrentValue = text;
				SyncIMETextBox();
				ManageUndoHistory_TextChanged(viaUserAction, command);
			}
			finally
			{
				_inOnTextChanged = inOnTextChanged;
				maskedEditor.EndSyncValueProperties();
			}
		}

		internal SectionBase GetCurrentSection(bool returnPrevRightToLeftSection)
		{
			DisplayCharBase currentDisplayChar = GetCurrentDisplayChar();
			if (returnPrevRightToLeftSection && (currentDisplayChar == null || (!currentDisplayChar.IsEditable && currentDisplayChar.Section.FirstDisplayChar == currentDisplayChar)))
			{
				SectionBase sectionBase = ((currentDisplayChar == null) ? LastEditSection : ((currentDisplayChar.PrevDisplayChar != null) ? currentDisplayChar.PrevDisplayChar.Section : null));
				if (sectionBase != null && IsRightToLeft(sectionBase))
				{
					return sectionBase;
				}
			}
			return currentDisplayChar?.Section;
		}

			}
			finally

				if (!valueSnapshot.IsCurrentValueSame(this))

					OnTextChanged(viaUserAction: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ImeTextBox_PreviewCanExecuteCommand(object sender, CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Command is RoutedCommand routedCommand && typeof(EditingCommands) == routedCommand.OwnerType)
			{
				bool canExecute = false;
				bool handled = true;
				bool continueRouting = true;
				if (EditingCommands.MoveLeftByCharacter == routedCommand || EditingCommands.MoveRightByCharacter == routedCommand || EditingCommands.MoveToLineStart == routedCommand || EditingCommands.MoveToLineEnd == routedCommand)
				{
					continueRouting = false;
				}
				e.CanExecute = canExecute;
				e.Handled = handled;
				e.ContinueRouting = continueRouting;
			}
		}

		private void ImeTextBox_PreviewKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			_wasImeKeyPreviewRaised = true;
			_lastInputTextChanged = null;
			if (Key.V == e.Key || Key.X == e.Key || Key.C == e.Key)
			{
				ModifierKeys modifierKeys = ((e.KeyboardDevice != null) ? e.KeyboardDevice.Modifiers : ModifierKeys.None);
				if ((ModifierKeys.Control & modifierKeys) != ModifierKeys.None)
				{
					MaskedEditor.ProcessKeyDown(e);
					return;
				}
			}
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Escape:
			case Key.End:
			case Key.Home:
			case Key.Left:
			case Key.Up:
			case Key.Right:
			case Key.Down:
				MaskedEditor.ProcessKeyDown(e);
				if (e.Key != Key.Escape)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.ImeProcessed:
				switch (e.ImeProcessedKey)
				{
				case Key.Tab:
				case Key.ImeConvert:
				case Key.ImeNonConvert:
				case Key.Space:
				case Key.Up:
				case Key.Down:
				case Key.F5:
				case Key.F6:
				case Key.F7:
				case Key.F8:
				case Key.F9:
				case Key.F10:
					_wasImeCandidateKeyProcessed = true;
					break;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ImeTextBox_PreviewTextInput(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.TextComposition is FrameworkTextComposition && (_wasImeCandidateKeyProcessed || !_wasImeKeyPreviewRaised) && _imeTextBox_PendingDelete != null)
			{
				Utils.Range old_imeTextBox_PendingDelete = _imeTextBox_PendingDelete;
				_imeTextBox_PendingDelete = null;
				_pendingTextInput = MaskedEditor.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Normal, (Action)delegate
				{
					_pendingTextInput = null;
					if (_imeTextBox != null && MaskedEditor.IsInEditMode)
					{
						bool flag = _imeTextBox_PendingDelete != null;
						_imeTextBox_PendingDelete = old_imeTextBox_PendingDelete;
						if (!flag)
						{
							ImeTextBox_PreviewTextInputImpl(sender, e);
						}
					}
				});
			}
			else
			{
				ImeTextBox_PreviewTextInputImpl(sender, e);
			}
		}

		private void ImeTextBox_PreviewTextInputImpl(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			string text = null;
			if (e.TextComposition is FrameworkTextComposition && (_wasImeCandidateKeyProcessed || !_wasImeKeyPreviewRaised) && _imeTextBox_PendingDelete != null)
			{
				string drawString = GetDrawString();
				if (_imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Start + _imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Length >= drawString.Length)
				{
					text = _imeTextBox.Text.Substring(_imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Start);
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					string value = drawString.Substring(_imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Start + _imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Length);
					int num = _imeTextBox.Text.LastIndexOf(value);
					if (num >= _imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Start)
					{
						flag = true;
						text = _imeTextBox.Text.Substring(_imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Start, num - _imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Start);
					}
				}
			}
			_wasImeKeyPreviewRaised = false;
			_wasImeCandidateKeyProcessed = false;
			if (!flag)
			{
				text = GetTextInputText(e);
			}
			if (!ReadOnly && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				if (e.TextComposition is FrameworkTextComposition frameworkTextComposition && (text == e.Text || flag))
				{
					int num2 = -1;
					try
					{
						PropertyInfo property = typeof(FrameworkTextComposition).GetProperty("ResultOffset");
						if (null != property)
						{
							num2 = (int)property.GetValue(frameworkTextComposition, null);
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					if (num2 < 0)
					{
						num2 = _imeTextBox.SelectionStart - frameworkTextComposition.Text.Length;
					}
					if (_imeTextBox_PendingDelete != null)
					{
						Utils.Range imeTextBox_PendingDelete = _imeTextBox_PendingDelete;
						_imeTextBox_PendingDelete = null;
						Select(imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Start, imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Length);
						if (IsAnyTextSelected)
						{
							Delete();
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							num2 = imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Start;
						}
						if (imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Length == 0 && num2 != imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Start)
						{
							num2 = imeTextBox_PendingDelete.Start;
						}
					}
					SetCaretPivot(Math.Max(0, num2));
				}
				else
				{
					_imeTextBox_PendingDelete = null;
				}
				if (ProcessTextInput(text, normalizeEncoding: true, out var numberOfCharsProcessed))
				{
					e.Handled = true;
					if (numberOfCharsProcessed == 0)
					{
						SyncIMETextBox();
					}
				}
			}
			_imeTextBox_PendingDelete = null;
		}

			SyncWithIMETextBox();
		}
