			}
		}

		private void ImeTextBox_TextInputStart(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			_wasImeCandidateKeyProcessed = false;
			_wasImeKeyPreviewRaised = false;
			_imeTextBox_PendingDelete = null;
			_imeTextBox_PendingDelete = new Utils.Range(SelectionStart, SelectionLength);
		}

		internal void InitializeIMETextBox(DependencyObject focusSite)
		{
			XamMaskedEditor maskedEditor = MaskedEditor;
			if (_imeTextBox != null)
			{
				EventProxy.UnwireTextBoxEvents();
				EventProxy.UnwireInputMethod_StateChanged();
				_imeTextBox = null;
			}
			TextBox imeTextBox = ((focusSite != null) ? (Utilities.GetDescendantFromName(focusSite, "PART_InputTextBox") as TextBox) : null);
			_imeTextBox = imeTextBox;
			if (_imeTextBox == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ContextMenu contextMenu = null;
			if (maskedEditor.ReadLocalValue(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty) != null)
			{
				contextMenu = maskedEditor.ContextMenu;
				if (contextMenu == null)
				{
					contextMenu = maskedEditor.CreateContextMenu();
				}
			}
			_imeTextBox.ContextMenu = contextMenu;
			SynchronizeTextBoxToInputMethodState();
			EventProxy.WireTextBoxEvents(_imeTextBox);
			SyncIMETextBox();
			InitializeInputScope();
		}

		private void InitializeInputScope()
		{
			if (!XamMaskedEditor._IsTouchEnabled || _imeTextBox == null || DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(_imeTextBox, FrameworkElement.InputScopeProperty).BaseValueSource > BaseValueSource.Default)
			{
				return;
			}
			_imeTextBox.ClearValue(FrameworkElement.InputScopeProperty);
			if (Sections == null || _imeTextBox.InputScope != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			foreach (SectionBase section in Sections)
			{
				if (section is LiteralSection)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (section is AMPMSection)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (section is NumberSection)
				{
					if (section.IsTimeSection || section.IsDateSection)
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
					else
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
				}
				else if (section is FractionPart)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
				else
				{
					flag4 = !(section is DisplayCharsEditSection) || true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag4)
			{
				InputScopeNameValue? inputScopeNameValue = null;
				if (flag3)
				{
					inputScopeNameValue = InputScopeNameValue.CurrencyAmountAndSymbol;
				}
				else if (flag2)
				{
					inputScopeNameValue = (flag ? new InputScopeNameValue?(InputScopeNameValue.Time) : new InputScopeNameValue?(InputScopeNameValue.Number));
				}
				if (inputScopeNameValue.HasValue)
				{
					InputScope inputScope = new InputScope();
					inputScope.Names.Add(new InputScopeName
					{
						NameValue = inputScopeNameValue.Value
					});
					_imeTextBox.SetCurrentValue(FrameworkElement.InputScopeProperty, inputScope);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeIsTextBoxEntryEnabled()
		{
			InputMethod current = InputMethod.Current;
			bool flag = current != null && InputMethodState.On == current.ImeState;
			if (flag && _maskInfo.MaskEditor != null)
			{
				flag = InputMethod.GetIsInputMethodEnabled(_maskInfo.MaskEditor);
			}
			flag = (flag || XamMaskedEditor._IsTouchEnabled) && !ReadOnly;
			MaskedEditor.InternalSetIsTextBoxEntryEnabled(flag);
		}

		private void InputMethod_StateChanged(object sender, InputMethodStateChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			InitializeIsTextBoxEntryEnabled();
			SynchronizeTextBoxToInputMethodState();
		}

		private void SynchronizeTextBoxToInputMethodState()
		{
			XamMaskedEditor maskedEditor = MaskedEditor;
			if (_imeTextBox != null)
			{
				InputMethod.SetIsInputMethodEnabled(_imeTextBox, maskedEditor.IsInputMethodEnabled);
			}
		}

		private int MapCaretPosFromImeTextBox(int pos)
		{
			int totalNumberOfDisplayChars = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars();
			int num = Math.Min(pos, totalNumberOfDisplayChars);
			int num2 = 0;
			do
			{
				int num3 = MapCaretPosToImeTextBox(num);
				if (num3 == pos)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (num2 == 0)
				{
					num2 = ((num3 < pos) ? 1 : (-1));
				}
				num += num2;
			}
			while (num >= 0 && num <= totalNumberOfDisplayChars);
			return Math.Max(0, Math.Min(num, totalNumberOfDisplayChars));
		}

		private int MapCaretPosToImeTextBox(int pos)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (DisplayCharBase allDisplayCharacter in Sections.AllDisplayCharacters)
			{
				if (allDisplayCharacter.OverallIndexInEdit < pos)
				{
					num += GetDrawStringHelper(allDisplayCharacter, null) - 1;
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
			return pos + num;
		}

		private int GetDrawStringHelper(DisplayCharBase dc, StringBuilder sb)
		{
			int num = 0;
			char c = dc.GetChar(MaskMode.IncludeBoth, _maskInfo.PromptChar, _maskInfo.PadChar);
			if (c == '\0' && dc is DecimalSeperatorChar)
			{
				c = dc.Char;
			}
			if (c != 0)
			{
				num++;
				sb?.Append(c);
				if (dc is DigitChar digitChar && digitChar.ShouldIncludeComma(MaskMode.IncludeBoth))
				{
					num++;
					sb?.Append(_maskInfo.CommaChar);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private string GetDrawString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(4 + GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars());
			foreach (DisplayCharBase allDisplayCharacter in Sections.AllDisplayCharacters)
			{
				GetDrawStringHelper(allDisplayCharacter, stringBuilder);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal void SyncIMETextBox()
		{
			if (IsTextInputInProgress || _inSyncIMETextBox || _inSyncWithIMETextBox)
			{
				return;
			}
			_inSyncIMETextBox = true;
			try
			{
				if (_imeTextBox != null)
				{
					string drawString = GetDrawString();
					_imeTextBox.Text = drawString;
					int selectionStart = SelectionStart;
					int num = MapCaretPosToImeTextBox(selectionStart);
					int num2 = ((SelectionLength == 0) ? num : MapCaretPosToImeTextBox(selectionStart + SelectionLength));
					_imeTextBox.SelectionStart = num;
					_imeTextBox.SelectionLength = num2 - num;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_inSyncIMETextBox = false;
			}
		}

		private void SyncWithIMETextBox()
		{
			if (_inSyncIMETextBox || _inSyncWithIMETextBox)
			{
				return;
			}
			_inSyncWithIMETextBox = true;
			try
			{
				if (_imeTextBox != null)
				{
					int selectionStart = _imeTextBox.SelectionStart;
					int num = MapCaretPosFromImeTextBox(selectionStart);
					int num2 = ((_imeTextBox.SelectionLength == 0) ? num : MapCaretPosFromImeTextBox(selectionStart + _imeTextBox.SelectionLength));
					SelectionStart = num;
					SelectionLength = num2 - num;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_inSyncWithIMETextBox = false;
			}
		}

		internal void SetValue(object val)
		{
			EditorValueSnapshot valueSnapshot = GetValueSnapshot();
			try
			{
				XamMaskedEditor.SetDataValue(Sections, MaskInfo.DataType, val, MaskInfo);
			}
			finally
			{
				DirtyMaskElement();
				if (!valueSnapshot.IsCurrentValueSame(this))
				{
					OnTextChanged(viaUserAction: false);
				}
			}
		}

		internal MaskedEditorStates GetCurrentState(MaskedEditorStates statesToQuery)
		{
			if (!IsInitialized)
			{
				return MaskedEditorStates.Uninitialized;
			}
			XamMaskedEditor maskedEditor = MaskedEditor;
			MaskedEditorStates maskedEditorStates = (MaskedEditorStates)0L;
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.Character & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L)
			{
				maskedEditorStates = ((GetCurrentDisplayChar() == null) ? (maskedEditorStates | MaskedEditorStates.AfterLastCharacter) : (maskedEditorStates | MaskedEditorStates.Character));
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.Selected & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && SelectionLength > 0)
			{
				maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.Selected;
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.FirstSection & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && FirstSection != null && CurrentSection == FirstSection)
			{
				maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.FirstSection;
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.LastSection & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && LastSection != null && CurrentSection == LastSection)
			{
				maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.LastSection;
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.FirstEditSection & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L)
			{
				if (FirstEditSection != null && CurrentSection == FirstEditSection)
				{
					maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.FirstEditSection;
				}
				else if (IsRightToLeft(FirstEditSection) && FirstEditSection.LastDisplayChar.NextDisplayChar == GetCurrentDisplayChar())
				{
					maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.FirstEditSection;
				}
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.LastEditSection & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && LastEditSection != null && CurrentSection == LastEditSection)
			{
				maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.LastEditSection;
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.FirstCharacter & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && FirstSection != null && GetCurrentDisplayChar() == FirstSection.FirstDisplayChar)
			{
				maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.FirstCharacter;
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.LastCharacter & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && LastSection != null && GetCurrentDisplayChar() == LastSection.LastDisplayChar)
			{
				maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.LastCharacter;
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.FirstCharacterInSection & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && CurrentSection != null && CurrentSection.FirstDisplayChar == GetCurrentDisplayChar())
			{
				maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.FirstCharacterInSection;
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.LastCharacterInSection & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && CurrentSection != null && CurrentSection.LastDisplayChar == GetCurrentDisplayChar())
			{
				maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.LastCharacterInSection;
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.FirstSection & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && (maskedEditorStates & MaskedEditorStates.FirstSection) == (MaskedEditorStates)0L)
			{
				DisplayCharBase currentDisplayChar = GetCurrentDisplayChar();
				if (currentDisplayChar != null && currentDisplayChar.PrevDisplayChar != null)
				{
					SectionBase section = currentDisplayChar.PrevDisplayChar.Section;
					if (section != null && section.PreviousSection == null && IsRightToLeft(section))
					{
						maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.FirstSection;
					}
				}
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.NextSectionFraction & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && CurrentSection != null && CurrentSection.NextEditSection is FractionPart)
			{
				maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.NextSectionFraction;
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.CanSpinUp & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && CanSpin(up: true))
			{
				maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.CanSpinUp;
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.CanSpinDown & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && CanSpin(up: false))
			{
				maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.CanSpinDown;
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.CanUndo & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && HasUndoHistory)
			{
				maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.CanUndo;
			}
			if ((MaskedEditorStates.CanRedo & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && HasRedoHistory)
			{
				maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.CanRedo;
			}
			if (maskedEditor != null)
			{
				if ((MaskedEditorStates.TabBySections & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && MaskedEditTabNavigation.NextSection == maskedEditor.TabNavigationResolved)
				{
					maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.TabBySections;
				}
				if (((MaskedEditorStates.HasDropDown | MaskedEditorStates.IsDropDownOpen) & statesToQuery) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L && maskedEditor.HasDropDown)
				{
					maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.HasDropDown;
					if (maskedEditor.HasOpenDropDown)
					{
						maskedEditorStates |= MaskedEditorStates.IsDropDownOpen;
					}
				}
			}
			return maskedEditorStates;
		}

		internal bool ValidateChangeSection(SectionBase from, SectionBase to)
		{
			if (from is EditSectionBase editSectionBase)
			{
				editSectionBase.ValidateSection();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool ValidateAllSections()
		{
			return ValidateAllSections(loosingFocus: false);
		}

		internal bool ValidateAllSections(bool loosingFocus)
		{
			if (!IsInitialized)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = GetText(MaskMode.IncludeBoth);
			try
			{
				return XamMaskedEditor.ValidateAllSections(Sections, loosingFocus);
			}
			finally
			{
				string text2 = GetText(MaskMode.IncludeBoth);
				if (text != text2)
				{
					OnTextChanged(viaUserAction: false);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDisplayCharSelected(DisplayCharBase dc)
		{
			int overallIndexInEdit = dc.OverallIndexInEdit;
			int selectionStart = SelectionStart;
			int num = SelectionStart + SelectionLength - 1;
			if (selectionStart <= overallIndexInEdit)
			{
				return overallIndexInEdit <= num;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool DeleteWithoutShiftingAcrrossSectionBoundaries()
		{
			if (CanDelete())
			{
				if (!IsAnyTextSelected)
				{
					DisplayCharBase currentDisplayChar = GetCurrentDisplayChar();
					if (currentDisplayChar.Section is EditSectionBase editSectionBase)
					{
						return editSectionBase.DeleteCharAndShift(currentDisplayChar.Index);
					}
					return false;
				}
				int selectionStart = SelectionStart;
				int selectionLength = SelectionLength;
				int num = selectionStart + selectionLength - 1;
				bool flag = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < Sections.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!(Sections[i] is EditSectionBase editSectionBase2) || editSectionBase2.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit < selectionStart || editSectionBase2.FirstDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit > num)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (editSectionBase2.FirstDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit >= selectionStart && editSectionBase2.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit <= num)
					{
						editSectionBase2.EraseAllChars();
						continue;
					}
					if (!IsRightToLeft(editSectionBase2) && editSectionBase2.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit <= num)
					{
						editSectionBase2.EraseChars(GetDisplayCharAtPosition(selectionStart).Index, editSectionBase2.DisplayChars.Count - 1);
						continue;
					}
					int num2 = Math.Max(selectionStart, editSectionBase2.FirstDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit);
					int num3 = Math.Min(num, editSectionBase2.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit);
					int num4 = num3 - num2 + 1;
					DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(num2);
					if (displayCharAtPosition == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (IsRightToLeft(editSectionBase2) || editSectionBase2 is FractionPart)
					{
						if (!editSectionBase2.DeleteCharsAndShift(displayCharAtPosition.Index + num4 - 1, num4))
						{
							flag = false;
						}
					}
					else if (!editSectionBase2.ShiftLeft(displayCharAtPosition.Index, num4))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (IsRightToLeft(GetSectionContainingPosition(selectionStart)))
					{
						SectionBase sectionContainingPosition = GetSectionContainingPosition(selectionStart);
						CaretPosition = Math.Min(1 + num, 1 + sectionContainingPosition.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit);
					}
					else
					{
						CaretPosition = selectionStart;
					}
					SetPivot();
				}
				return flag;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool InsertCharAtShiftGlobalHelper(char c, int from, int to)
		{
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = null;
			if (from == to)
			{
				displayCharBase = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(from);
				if (displayCharBase == null || !displayCharBase.IsEmpty || !displayCharBase.MatchChar(c))
				{
					return false;
				}
				displayCharBase.Char = c;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			for (int num = to; num >= from; num--)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(num);
				if (displayCharAtPosition.IsEmpty)
				{
					flag = true;
					to = num;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag || from == to)
			{
				displayCharBase = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(from);
				if (displayCharBase == null || !displayCharBase.IsEmpty || !displayCharBase.MatchChar(c))
				{
					return false;
				}
				displayCharBase.Char = c;
			}
			int num2 = 1;
			for (int num3 = to - 1; num3 >= from; num3--)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition2 = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(num3);
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition3 = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(num3 + num2);
				if (displayCharAtPosition2 != null && !displayCharAtPosition2.IsEditable)
				{
					num2++;
				}
				else if (displayCharAtPosition3 != null && !displayCharAtPosition3.IsEditable)
				{
					num2--;
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						num3++;
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = 1;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!displayCharAtPosition2.IsEmpty && !displayCharAtPosition3.MatchChar(displayCharAtPosition2.Char))
					{
						return InsertCharAtShiftGlobalHelper(c, from, num3 - 1);
					}
					if (num3 == from && !displayCharAtPosition2.MatchChar(c))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			num2 = 1;
			for (int num4 = to - 1; num4 >= from; num4--)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition4 = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(num4);
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition5 = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(num4 + num2);
				if (displayCharAtPosition4 != null && !displayCharAtPosition4.IsEditable)
				{
					num2++;
				}
				else if (displayCharAtPosition5 != null && !displayCharAtPosition5.IsEditable)
				{
					num2--;
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						num4++;
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = 1;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (!displayCharAtPosition4.IsEmpty && !displayCharAtPosition5.MatchChar(displayCharAtPosition4.Char))
					{
						return false;
					}
					displayCharAtPosition5.Char = displayCharAtPosition4.Char;
					if (num4 == from)
					{
						displayCharAtPosition4.Char = c;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool InsertCharAtShiftGlobal(char c, int pos)
		{
			DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(pos);
			if (displayCharAtPosition == null || IsRightToLeft(displayCharAtPosition.Section))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (displayCharAtPosition == null || displayCharAtPosition.Section is FractionPart)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int totalNumberOfDisplayChars = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars();
			if (pos < 0 || pos >= totalNumberOfDisplayChars)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = null;
			for (int num = totalNumberOfDisplayChars - 1; num >= pos; num--)
			{
				displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(num);
				if (IsRightToLeft(displayCharAtPosition.Section))
				{
					displayCharBase = null;
				}
				else if (displayCharBase == null)
				{
					displayCharBase = displayCharAtPosition;
				}
			}
			if (displayCharBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int overallIndexInEdit = displayCharBase.OverallIndexInEdit;
			return InsertCharAtShiftGlobalHelper(c, pos, overallIndexInEdit);
		}

		internal bool CanDelete()
		{
			return CanDelete(emulateDeleteKey: false);
		}

		internal bool CanDelete(bool emulateDeleteKey)
		{
			if (!IsAnyTextSelected)
			{
				if (IsAfterLastCharacter)
				{
					return false;
				}
				DisplayCharBase currentDisplayChar = GetCurrentDisplayChar();
				if (currentDisplayChar == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				EditSectionBase editSectionBase = currentDisplayChar.Section as EditSectionBase;
				if (editSectionBase == null && !emulateDeleteKey)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private int ShiftGlobalLeft(int from, int positionsToShift)
		{
			int totalNumberOfDisplayChars = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars();
			if (from < 0 || from >= totalNumberOfDisplayChars)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (positionsToShift < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (from + positionsToShift > totalNumberOfDisplayChars)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = positionsToShift;
			for (int i = from; i < totalNumberOfDisplayChars; i++)
			{
				if (positionsToShift == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(i);
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition2 = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(i + positionsToShift);
				EditSectionBase editSectionBase = displayCharAtPosition.Section as EditSectionBase;
				if (displayCharAtPosition != null && editSectionBase != null && EditOrientation.RightToLeft == editSectionBase.Orientation)
				{
					int num3 = 1 + editSectionBase.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit;
					if (num2 <= num3 - i || from + num2 < num3)
					{
						break;
					}
					positionsToShift--;
					continue;
				}
				if (displayCharAtPosition != null && !displayCharAtPosition.IsEditable)
				{
					positionsToShift--;
					continue;
				}
				if (displayCharAtPosition2 != null && !displayCharAtPosition2.IsEditable)
				{
					int num4 = 0;
					while (displayCharAtPosition2 != null && !displayCharAtPosition2.IsEditable)
					{
						num4++;
						displayCharAtPosition2 = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(i + positionsToShift + num4);
					}
					positionsToShift += num4;
				}
				char c = '\0';
				if (displayCharAtPosition2 != null)
				{
					c = displayCharAtPosition2.Char;
				}
				if (displayCharAtPosition == null || (c != 0 && !displayCharAtPosition.MatchChar(c)))
				{
					break;
				}
				displayCharAtPosition.Char = c;
				displayCharAtPosition2?.EraseChar();
				if (!displayCharAtPosition.IsEmpty)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void SetPivot()
		{
			PivotPosition = CaretPosition;
		}

		internal bool Delete()
		{
			return Delete(emulateDeleteKey: false, fireTextChanged: false);
		}

		internal bool Delete(bool emulateDeleteKey, bool fireTextChanged)
		{
			EditorValueSnapshot editorValueSnapshot = null;
			if (fireTextChanged)
			{
				editorValueSnapshot = GetValueSnapshot();
			}
			bool result = DeleteHelper(emulateDeleteKey);
			if (fireTextChanged && !editorValueSnapshot.IsCurrentValueSame(this))
			{
				OnTextChanged(viaUserAction: true);
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool DeleteHelper(bool emulateDeleteKey)
		{
			if (ReadOnly)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!MaskedEditor.AllowShiftingAcrossSections)
			{
				return DeleteWithoutShiftingAcrrossSectionBoundaries();
			}
			if (!IsAnyTextSelected)
			{
				if (CanDelete(emulateDeleteKey))
				{
					DisplayCharBase currentDisplayChar = GetCurrentDisplayChar();
					if (currentDisplayChar == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!currentDisplayChar.IsEditable)
					{
						if (!emulateDeleteKey || currentDisplayChar.NextFilledEditableDisplayChar == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						SetCaretPivot(currentDisplayChar.NextFilledEditableDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit);
					}
					else
					{
						if (!(currentDisplayChar.Section is EditSectionBase editSectionBase))
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (IsRightToLeft(editSectionBase))
						{
							if (editSectionBase.DeleteCharAndShift(currentDisplayChar.Index))
							{
								SetCaretPivot(1 + currentDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit);
								return true;
							}
							return false;
						}
						bool isEmpty = currentDisplayChar.IsEmpty;
						if (ShiftGlobalLeft(currentDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit, 1) == 0)
						{
							if (!currentDisplayChar.IsEmpty)
							{
								currentDisplayChar.EraseChar();
							}
							else if (emulateDeleteKey && isEmpty && currentDisplayChar.NextFilledEditableDisplayChar != null)
							{
								SetCaretPivot(currentDisplayChar.NextFilledEditableDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				SetPivot();
				return true;
			}
			if (CanDelete(emulateDeleteKey))
			{
				EraseSelectedText();
				int selectionStart = SelectionStart;
				int selectionLength = SelectionLength;
				int num = selectionStart + selectionLength - 1;
				ShiftGlobalLeft(selectionStart, selectionLength);
				bool flag = false;
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(selectionStart);
				EditSectionBase editSectionBase2 = displayCharAtPosition.Section as EditSectionBase;
				if (InsertMode && displayCharAtPosition != null && editSectionBase2 != null && IsRightToLeft(editSectionBase2))
				{
					displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(Math.Min(num, editSectionBase2.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit));
					if (displayCharAtPosition != null)
					{
						editSectionBase2 = displayCharAtPosition.Section as EditSectionBase;
					}
					if (displayCharAtPosition != null)
					{
						if (editSectionBase2 != null && editSectionBase2.FirstFilledChar != null && num < editSectionBase2.FirstFilledChar.OverallIndexInEdit - 1)
						{
							SetCaretPivot(editSectionBase2.FirstFilledChar.OverallIndexInEdit - 1);
						}
						else if (displayCharAtPosition != null)
						{
							int num2 = displayCharAtPosition.OverallIndexInEdit;
							if (IsRightToLeft(displayCharAtPosition.Section) && displayCharAtPosition.Section is EditSectionBase editSectionBase3)
							{
								num2 = 1 + Math.Min(num, editSectionBase3.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit);
								int num3 = editSectionBase3.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit + 1;
								if (editSectionBase3.FirstFilledChar != null)
								{
									num3 = editSectionBase3.FirstFilledChar.OverallIndexInEdit;
								}
								if (num2 < num3)
								{
									num2 = num3;
								}
							}
							SetCaretPivot(num2);
						}
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					SetCaretPivot(selectionStart);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void GotoSection(SectionBase section)
		{
			GotoSection(section, positionToRight: false);
		}

		private void GotoSection(SectionBase section, bool positionToRight)
		{
			GotoSection(section, positionToRight, positionRightAfterLastCharacter: true);
		}

		private void GotoSection(SectionBase section, bool positionToRight, bool positionRightAfterLastCharacter)
		{
			if (section == null || (section != CurrentSection && !ValidateChangeSection(CurrentSection, section)))
			{
				return;
			}
			EditSectionBase editSectionBase = section as EditSectionBase;
			if (IsRightToLeft(editSectionBase))
			{
				if (positionToRight)
				{
					CaretPosition = 1 + editSectionBase.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit;
				}
				else
				{
					CaretPosition = ((editSectionBase.FirstFilledChar != null) ? editSectionBase.FirstFilledChar.OverallIndexInEdit : (1 + editSectionBase.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit));
				}
			}
			else if (positionToRight)
			{
				CaretPosition = section.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit + (positionRightAfterLastCharacter ? 1 : 0);
			}
			else
			{
				CaretPosition = section.FirstDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit;
			}
		}

		internal void GotoNextChar()
		{
			if (IsAfterLastCharacter)
			{
				string message = ValueEditor.GetString("IllegalOperationMessageAtLastCharacter");
				IllegalOperation(message);
				return;
			}
			DisplayCharBase currentDisplayChar = GetCurrentDisplayChar();
			DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(CaretPosition + 1);
			if (currentDisplayChar != null && displayCharAtPosition != null && currentDisplayChar.Section != displayCharAtPosition.Section)
			{
				EditSectionBase editSectionBase = currentDisplayChar.Section as EditSectionBase;
				GotoSection(displayCharAtPosition.Section, positionToRight: false);
				return;
			}
			if (!InsertMode)
			{
				CaretPosition++;
				return;
			}
			if (_maskInfo.PromptChar == '\0')
			{
				CaretPosition = SkipDisplayCharsWithEmptyDrawString(CaretPosition);
			}
			CaretPosition++;
		}

		internal int SkipDisplayCharsWithEmptyDrawString(int caretPos)
		{
			while (true)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(caretPos);
				if (displayCharAtPosition == null || !displayCharAtPosition.IsEmpty || displayCharAtPosition.GetDrawChar() != 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				caretPos++;
			}
			return caretPos;
		}

		internal void GotoPrevEditSection()
		{
			SectionBase sectionBase = ((CurrentSection != null) ? CurrentSection : LastSection);
			DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(CaretPosition - 1);
			if (displayCharAtPosition != null && displayCharAtPosition.Section is EditSectionBase editSectionBase)
			{
				if (!IsRightToLeft(editSectionBase))
				{
					GotoSection(editSectionBase, positionToRight: false);
					return;
				}
				if (!displayCharAtPosition.IsEmpty)
				{
					GotoSection(editSectionBase, positionToRight: false);
					return;
				}
				if (editSectionBase.PreviousEditSection != null)
				{
					GotoSection(editSectionBase.PreviousEditSection, positionToRight: true);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (sectionBase.PreviousEditSection != null)
			{
				GotoSection(sectionBase.PreviousEditSection);
				return;
			}
			string message = ValueEditor.GetString("IllegalOperationMessageNoPrevEditSection");
			IllegalOperation(message);
		}

		internal void GotoNextEditSection()
		{
			SectionBase currentSection = CurrentSection;
			if (currentSection == null)
			{
				string message = ValueEditor.GetString("IllegalOperationMessageNoNextEditSection");
				IllegalOperation(message);
			}
			else if (currentSection.NextEditSection != null)
			{
				GotoSection(currentSection.NextEditSection, positionToRight: false);
			}
			else
			{
				string message2 = ValueEditor.GetString("IllegalOperationMessageNoNextEditSection");
				IllegalOperation(message2);
			}
		}

		internal void ManageUndoHistory_TextChanged(bool viaUserAction, RoutedCommand command)
		{
			if (!_inUndoRedoHelper && MaskedEditorCommands.Undo != command && MaskedEditorCommands.Redo != command)
			{
				ClearRedoHistory();
				if (!viaUserAction)
				{
					ClearUndoHistory();
				}
				UndoHistory.Push(new EditorSnapshot(this));
			}
		}

		internal void Undo(bool fireValueChanged)
		{
			UndoRedoHelper(undo: true, fireValueChanged);
		}

		internal void Redo(bool fireValueChanged)
		{
			UndoRedoHelper(undo: false, fireValueChanged);
		}

		internal void UndoRedoHelper(bool undo, bool fireValueChanged)
		{
			if (_inUndoRedoHelper)
			{
				return;
			}
			_inUndoRedoHelper = true;
			try
			{
				EditorValueSnapshot valueSnapshot = GetValueSnapshot();
				try
				{
					Stack<EditorSnapshot> stack = (undo ? _undoHistory : _redoHistory);
					if (stack != null && stack.Count >= 2)
					{
						EditorSnapshot item = stack.Pop();
						if (undo)
						{
							RedoHistory.Push(item);
						}
						else
						{
							UndoHistory.Push(item);
						}
						item = stack.Peek();
						item.Apply(this, validateSections: false);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (fireValueChanged && !valueSnapshot.IsCurrentValueSame(this))
					{
						OnTextChanged(viaUserAction: true);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_inUndoRedoHelper = false;
			}
		}

		internal void ClearRedoHistory()
		{
			_redoHistory = null;
		}

		internal void ClearUndoHistory()
		{
			_undoHistory = null;
		}

		internal void GotoPrevChar()
		{
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = null;
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase2 = null;
			if (IsAfterLastCharacter)
			{
				EditSectionBase editSectionBase = LastSection as EditSectionBase;
				if (IsRightToLeft(editSectionBase))
				{
					if (!editSectionBase.LastDisplayChar.IsEmpty)
					{
						CaretPosition = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars() - 1;
					}
					else if (!InsertMode && editSectionBase.PreviousEditSection == null)
					{
						SetCaretPivot(0);
					}
					else
					{
						GotoPrevEditSection();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					CaretPosition = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars() - 1;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (IsAtFirstChar)
			{
				string message = ValueEditor.GetString("IllegalOperationMessageNoPrevCharacter");
				IllegalOperation(message);
				return;
			}
			displayCharBase = GetCurrentDisplayChar();
			displayCharBase2 = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(CaretPosition - 1);
			if (displayCharBase != null && displayCharBase2 != null && displayCharBase.Section == displayCharBase2.Section)
			{
				EditSectionBase editSectionBase2 = displayCharBase.Section as EditSectionBase;
				if (IsRightToLeft(editSectionBase2))
				{
					if (displayCharBase2.IsEmpty)
					{
						if (editSectionBase2.PreviousEditSection != null)
						{
							GotoSection(editSectionBase2.PreviousEditSection, positionToRight: true);
						}
						else if (!InsertMode)
						{
							SetCaretPivot(0);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						CaretPosition--;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					CaretPosition--;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (displayCharBase == null || displayCharBase2 == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (displayCharBase2.Section is EditSectionBase editSectionBase3 && IsRightToLeft(editSectionBase3))
				{
					if (!editSectionBase3.LastDisplayChar.IsEmpty)
					{
						if (displayCharBase.Section != editSectionBase3)
						{
							ValidateChangeSection(displayCharBase.Section, editSectionBase3);
						}
						CaretPosition = editSectionBase3.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit;
					}
					else if (!InsertMode && editSectionBase3.PreviousEditSection == null)
					{
						SetCaretPivot(0);
					}
					else
					{
						GotoPrevEditSection();
					}
				}
				else if (displayCharBase2.Section != null)
				{
					GotoSection(displayCharBase2.Section, positionToRight: true, positionRightAfterLastCharacter: false);
				}
				else
				{
					string message2 = ValueEditor.GetString("IllegalOperationMessageCannotMoveToPrevCharacter");
					IllegalOperation(message2);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool Spin(bool up, object amount, bool setToLimit, bool fireValueChanged)
		{
			if (!CanSpin(up, amount))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = null;
			if (fireValueChanged)
			{
				text = GetText(MaskMode.IncludeBoth);
			}
			try
			{
				if (SelectionStart + SelectionLength >= GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars() && XamMaskedEditor.IsMaskValidForDataType(typeof(DateTime), MaskInfo.ResolvedMask, MaskInfo.FormatProvider))
				{
					string text2 = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
					if (text2 == null || text2.Length == 0)
					{
						try
						{
							Value = DateTime.Now;
						}
						catch
						{
						}
						return true;
					}
				}
				XamMaskedEditor maskedEditor = MaskedEditor;
				SpinInfo resolvedSpinInfo = GetResolvedSpinInfo(amount);
				if (amount != null || resolvedSpinInfo != null)
				{
					return resolvedSpinInfo?.Spin(up, GetText(MaskMode.Raw)) ?? false;
				}
				EditSectionBase spinSection = GetSpinSection();
				if (MaskedEditor.SpinWrapBehaviorResolved == SpinWrapBehavior.WrapAcrossSections)
				{
					int increment = (up ? 1 : (-1));
					if (spinSection != null && !(spinSection is EraSection))
					{
						if (spinSection.IsDateSection || spinSection.IsTimeSection)
						{
							DateTime? dateTime = null;
							try
							{
								dateTime = XamMaskedEditor.GetDateTimeValue(Sections);
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
								return false;
							}
							if (dateTime.HasValue)
							{
								try
								{
									if (MaskedEditor.Sections.HasEraSection() && spinSection is YearSection yearSection && (decimal)yearSection.GetYear() == yearSection.MaxValue)
									{
										return spinSection.Spin(up, setToLimit);
									}
									DateTime dateTime2 = SpinDate(spinSection, dateTime.Value, increment);
									MaskedEditor.Value = dateTime2;
									return true;
								}
								catch (Exception)
								{
									return false;
								}
							}
						}
						if (spinSection is FractionPart fractionPart)
						{
							decimal result = default(decimal);
							string text3 = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
							bool result2 = decimal.TryParse(text3.ToString(), out result);
							decimal num = (up ? 1m : (-1m));
							result += num / (decimal)Math.Pow(10.0, fractionPart.NumberOfDigits);
							result = Math.Round(result, fractionPart.NumberOfDigits);
							SetValue(result);
							return result2;
						}
					}
				}
				if (spinSection != null && spinSection.SupportsSpinning)
				{
					return spinSection.Spin(up, setToLimit);
				}
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				DirtyMaskElement();
				if (fireValueChanged)
				{
					string text4 = GetText(MaskMode.IncludeBoth);
					if (text4 != null && text != null && string.Compare(text, text4, ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) != 0)
					{
						OnTextChanged(viaUserAction: true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private DateTime SpinDate(EditSectionBase section, DateTime currentDate, int increment)
		{
			YearSection yearSection = section as YearSection;
			MonthSection monthSection = ((yearSection == null) ? (section as MonthSection) : null);
			DaySection daySection = ((yearSection == null && monthSection == null) ? (section as DaySection) : null);
			HourSection hourSection = ((yearSection == null && monthSection == null && daySection == null) ? (section as HourSection) : null);
			MinuteSection minuteSection = ((yearSection == null && monthSection == null && daySection == null && hourSection == null) ? (section as MinuteSection) : null);
			SecondSection secondSection = ((yearSection == null && monthSection == null && daySection == null && hourSection == null && minuteSection == null) ? (section as SecondSection) : null);
			DateTime dateTime = currentDate;
			bool flag = increment > 0;
			if (yearSection != null)
			{
				dateTime = yearSection.Calendar.AddYears(currentDate, increment);
			}
			else if (monthSection != null)
			{
				dateTime = monthSection.Calendar.AddMonths(currentDate, increment);
			}
			else if (daySection != null)
			{
				dateTime = daySection.Calendar.AddDays(currentDate, increment);
			}
			else if (hourSection != null)
			{
				dateTime = hourSection.Calendar.AddHours(currentDate, increment);
			}
			else if (minuteSection != null)
			{
				dateTime = minuteSection.Calendar.AddMinutes(currentDate, increment);
			}
			else if (secondSection != null)
			{
				dateTime = secondSection.Calendar.AddSeconds(currentDate, increment);
			}
			object minValue = MaskInfo.MinValue;
			object maxValue = MaskInfo.MaxValue;
			DateTime? dateTime2 = null;
			DateTime? dateTime3 = null;
			if (minValue is DateTime)
			{
				dateTime2 = (DateTime)minValue;
			}
			if (maxValue is DateTime)
			{
				dateTime3 = (DateTime)maxValue;
			}
			if (!dateTime2.HasValue || !dateTime3.HasValue)
			{
				return dateTime;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (dateTime > dateTime3.Value)
				{
					dateTime = ((!(currentDate < dateTime3.Value)) ? dateTime2.Value : dateTime3.Value);
				}
			}
			else if (dateTime < dateTime2.Value)
			{
				dateTime = ((!(currentDate > dateTime2.Value)) ? dateTime3.Value : dateTime2.Value);
			}
			return dateTime;
		}

		internal EditSectionBase GetSpinSection()
		{
			if (CurrentSection is EditSectionBase { SupportsSpinning: not false } editSectionBase)
			{
				return editSectionBase;
			}
			int num = CaretPosition - 1;
			while (0 <= num)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(num);
				if (displayCharAtPosition == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (displayCharAtPosition.Section is EditSectionBase { SupportsSpinning: not false } editSectionBase2)
				{
					return editSectionBase2;
				}
				if (!(displayCharAtPosition.Section is LiteralSection) || !char.IsWhiteSpace(displayCharAtPosition.Char))
				{
					break;
				}
				num--;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool InternalCompareNumerical(object o1, object o2, out int result)
		{
			result = 0;
			if (o1 == null || o2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (o1.GetType() != o2.GetType())
			{
				IFormatProvider formatProvider = MaskInfo.FormatProvider;
				try
				{
					if (o1 is IComparable)
					{
						o2 = Convert.ChangeType(o2, o1.GetType(), formatProvider);
					}
					else if (o2 is IComparable)
					{
						o1 = Convert.ChangeType(o1, o2.GetType(), formatProvider);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			if (o1.GetType() == o2.GetType() && o1 is IComparable)
			{
				try
				{
					result = ((IComparable)o1).CompareTo(o2);
					return true;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool CanSpin(bool up)
		{
			return CanSpin(up, null);
		}

		private SpinInfo GetResolvedSpinInfo(object amount)
		{
			XamMaskedEditor maskedEditor = MaskedEditor;
			SpinInfo spinInfo = maskedEditor._cachedSpinInfo;
			if ((amount != null || spinInfo != null) && (spinInfo == null || (amount != null && !spinInfo.IsSameSpinIncrement(amount))))
			{
				spinInfo = SpinInfo.Parse(maskedEditor, amount);
			}
			return spinInfo;
		}

		internal bool CanSpin(bool up, object amount)
		{
			if (ReadOnly)
			{
				return false;
			}
			XamMaskedEditor maskedEditor = MaskedEditor;
			SpinInfo resolvedSpinInfo = GetResolvedSpinInfo(amount);
			if (amount != null || resolvedSpinInfo != null)
			{
				return resolvedSpinInfo?.CanSpin(up, GetText(MaskMode.Raw)) ?? false;
			}
			if (XamMaskedEditor.IsMaskValidForDataType(typeof(DateTime), MaskInfo.ResolvedMask, MaskInfo.FormatProvider))
			{
				string text = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
				if (text == null || text.Length == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			EditSectionBase spinSection = GetSpinSection();
			if (spinSection != null && spinSection.SupportsSpinning)
			{
				if (!spinSection.CanSpin(up))
				{
					return false;
				}
				object minValue = MaskInfo.MinValue;
				object maxValue = MaskInfo.MaxValue;
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 9999;
				int num3 = 1;
				int num4 = 12;
				DateTime? dateTime = ((minValue is DateTime) ? ((DateTime?)minValue) : ((DateTime?)null));
				DateTime? dateTime2 = ((maxValue is DateTime) ? ((DateTime?)maxValue) : ((DateTime?)null));
				System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = Sections.Calendar;
				if (dateTime.HasValue && dateTime2.HasValue)
				{
					if (spinSection is YearSection && ((YearSection)spinSection).MaskDisplaysEraSection)
					{
						if (calendar.GetEra(dateTime.Value) == calendar.GetEra(dateTime2.Value))
						{
							num = calendar.GetYear(dateTime.Value);
							num2 = calendar.GetYear(dateTime2.Value);
						}
						else
						{
							num = 1;
							num2 = 999;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num = calendar.GetYear(dateTime.Value);
						num2 = calendar.GetYear(dateTime2.Value);
					}
					num3 = calendar.GetMonth(dateTime.Value);
					num4 = calendar.GetMonth(dateTime2.Value);
				}
				if (MaskInfo.MaskEditor.SpinWrappingAllowed && (spinSection is YearSection || spinSection is MonthSection || spinSection is DaySection))
				{
					try
					{
						XamMaskedEditor.GetDateTimeValue(Sections);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (spinSection is YearSection && num != num2)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (spinSection is MonthSection && (num != num2 || num3 != num4))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (spinSection is DaySection)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				if (up)
				{
					if (maxValue != null)
					{
						NumberSection numberSection = null;
						if (spinSection is NumberSection)
						{
							numberSection = (NumberSection)spinSection;
						}
						else if (spinSection is FractionPart)
						{
							numberSection = spinSection.PreviousEditSection as NumberSection;
						}
						bool flag = true;
						if (numberSection != null && typeof(NumberSection) == numberSection.GetType())
						{
							if (MaskInfo.MaskEditor.SpinWrappingAllowed)
							{
								return true;
							}
							try
							{
								if (!numberSection.TryToDecimal(out var value))
								{
									value = default(decimal);
								}
								if (InternalCompareNumerical(value, maxValue, out var result) && result >= 0)
								{
									return false;
								}
								flag = false;
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}
						if (flag && spinSection is FractionPart)
						{
							if (MaskInfo.MaskEditor.SpinWrappingAllowed)
							{
								return true;
							}
							numberSection = spinSection.PreviousEditSection as NumberSection;
							double fractionValue = ((FractionPart)spinSection).GetFractionValue();
							if (InternalCompareNumerical(fractionValue, maxValue, out var result2) && result2 >= 0)
							{
								return false;
							}
						}
						else if (spinSection is YearSection)
						{
							try
							{
								if (((YearSection)spinSection).TryGetYear(out var year) && dateTime2.HasValue)
								{
									YearSection yearSection = (YearSection)spinSection;
									if (yearSection.MaskDisplaysEraSection)
									{
										if (year >= num2)
										{
											return false;
										}
									}
									else if (year >= ((DateTime)maxValue).Year)
									{
										return false;
									}
								}
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}
						else if (spinSection is MonthSection)
						{
							try
							{
								if (((MonthSection)spinSection).TryToInt(out var value2) && dateTime2.HasValue && num == num2 && value2 >= calendar.GetYear(dateTime2.Value))
								{
									return false;
								}
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}
						else if (spinSection is DaySection)
						{
							try
							{
								if (((DaySection)spinSection).TryToInt(out var value3) && dateTime2.HasValue && num == num2 && num3 == num4 && value3 >= calendar.GetDayOfMonth(dateTime2.Value))
								{
									return false;
								}
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else if (minValue != null)
				{
					NumberSection numberSection2 = null;
					if (spinSection is NumberSection)
					{
						numberSection2 = (NumberSection)spinSection;
					}
					else if (spinSection is FractionPart)
					{
						numberSection2 = spinSection.PreviousEditSection as NumberSection;
					}
					bool flag2 = true;
					if (numberSection2 != null && typeof(NumberSection) == numberSection2.GetType())
					{
						if (MaskInfo.MaskEditor.SpinWrappingAllowed)
						{
							return true;
						}
						try
						{
							if (!numberSection2.TryToDecimal(out var value4))
							{
								value4 = default(decimal);
							}
							if (InternalCompareNumerical(value4, minValue, out var result3) && result3 <= 0 && spinSection == numberSection2)
							{
								return false;
							}
							flag2 = false;
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}
					if (flag2 && spinSection is FractionPart)
					{
						if (MaskInfo.MaskEditor.SpinWrappingAllowed)
						{
							return true;
						}
						numberSection2 = spinSection.PreviousEditSection as NumberSection;
						double fractionValue2 = ((FractionPart)spinSection).GetFractionValue();
						if (InternalCompareNumerical(fractionValue2, minValue, out var result4) && result4 <= 0)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					else if (spinSection is YearSection)
					{
						try
						{
							if (((YearSection)spinSection).TryGetYear(out var year2) && dateTime.HasValue)
							{
								YearSection yearSection2 = (YearSection)spinSection;
								if (yearSection2.MaskDisplaysEraSection)
								{
									if (year2 <= num)
									{
										return false;
									}
								}
								else if (year2 <= ((DateTime)minValue).Year)
								{
									return false;
								}
							}
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}
					else if (spinSection is MonthSection)
					{
						try
						{
							if (((MonthSection)spinSection).TryToInt(out var value5) && dateTime.HasValue && num == num2 && value5 <= calendar.GetMonth(dateTime.Value))
							{
								return false;
							}
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}
					else if (spinSection is DaySection)
					{
						try
						{
							if (((DaySection)spinSection).TryToInt(out var value6) && dateTime.HasValue && num == num2 && num3 == num4 && value6 <= calendar.GetDayOfMonth(dateTime.Value))
							{
								return false;
							}
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void IllegalOperation(string message)
		{
			InvalidOperationEventArgs e = new InvalidOperationEventArgs(message);
			OnInvalidOperation(e);
			if (e.Beep)
			{
				MaskInfo.MaskEditor.Beep();
			}
		}

		private void IllegalCharPressed(DisplayCharBase displayChar, char c)
		{
			InvalidCharEventArgs e = new InvalidCharEventArgs(c, displayChar);
			OnInvalidChar(e);
			if (e.Beep)
			{
				MaskInfo.MaskEditor.Beep();
			}
			_lastIllegalChar = c;
			_lastIllegalDisplayChar = displayChar;
		}

		private void EraseDisplayChars(int startIndex, int eraseCharCount)
		{
			int totalNumberOfDisplayChars = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars();
			if (startIndex < 0 || startIndex > totalNumberOfDisplayChars)
			{
				return;
			}
			int i = startIndex;
			for (int num = i + eraseCharCount; i < num; i++)
			{
				int num2 = i;
				if (num2 < totalNumberOfDisplayChars)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(num2);
					EditSectionBase editSectionBase = displayCharAtPosition.Section as EditSectionBase;
					if (InsertMode && IsRightToLeft(editSectionBase))
					{
						int position = Math.Min(num - 1, editSectionBase.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit);
						position = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(position)?.Index ?? displayCharAtPosition.Index;
						editSectionBase.DeleteCharsAndShift(position, Math.Min(num - displayCharAtPosition.OverallIndexInEdit, 1 + editSectionBase.LastDisplayChar.Index - displayCharAtPosition.Index));
						i = editSectionBase.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit;
					}
					else if (displayCharAtPosition != null && displayCharAtPosition.IsEditable)
					{
						displayCharAtPosition.Char = '\0';
					}
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void EraseSelectedText()
		{
			int totalNumberOfDisplayChars = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars();
			if (SelectionLength > 0)
			{
				EraseDisplayChars(SelectionStart, SelectionLength);
			}
		}

		internal static SectionBase GetLastSection(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			if (sections == null || sections.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return sections[sections.Count - 1];
		}

		internal DisplayCharBase GetCurrentDisplayChar()
		{
			DisplayCharBase result = null;
			int totalNumberOfDisplayChars = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars();
			if (CaretPosition >= 0 && CaretPosition < totalNumberOfDisplayChars)
			{
				result = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(CaretPosition);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void ToggleInsertMode()
		{
			InsertMode = !InsertMode;
		}

		internal bool IsRightToLeft(SectionBase section)
		{
			if (section is EditSectionBase editSectionBase)
			{
				return EditOrientation.RightToLeft == editSectionBase.Orientation;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CanInsertAt(char c, int pos)
		{
			DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(pos);
			if (displayCharAtPosition == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!displayCharAtPosition.IsEditable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SectionBase section = displayCharAtPosition.Section;
			if (section is EditSectionBase editSectionBase)
			{
				return editSectionBase.CanInsertCharAt(displayCharAtPosition.Index, c);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ScrollAllTheWayRightHelper()
		{
			ScrollDisplayCharIntoView(GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars());
		}

		internal void ScrollCaretIntoView()
		{
			ScrollDisplayCharIntoView(CaretPosition);
		}

		private void EnsureNumberSectionState()
		{
			if (!InsertMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(CaretPosition);
			DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(CaretPosition - 1);
			if (displayCharBase != null && displayCharAtPosition != null && displayCharAtPosition.Section != displayCharBase.Section && IsRightToLeft(displayCharAtPosition.Section))
			{
				if (!(displayCharAtPosition.Section.NextEditSection is FractionPartContinuous))
				{
					return;
				}
				displayCharBase = displayCharAtPosition;
			}
			if (displayCharBase == null)
			{
				displayCharBase = displayCharAtPosition;
			}
			if (displayCharBase != null && IsRightToLeft(displayCharBase.Section) && displayCharBase.IsEmpty)
			{
				EditSectionBase editSectionBase = (EditSectionBase)displayCharBase.Section;
				if (editSectionBase.IsEmpty && editSectionBase.NextEditSection is FractionPartContinuous)
				{
					FractionPartContinuous fractionPartContinuous = (FractionPartContinuous)editSectionBase.NextEditSection;
					if (fractionPartContinuous.FirstDisplayChar.IsEmpty)
					{
						editSectionBase = fractionPartContinuous;
					}
				}
				int num = ((editSectionBase.FirstFilledChar != null) ? editSectionBase.FirstFilledChar.OverallIndexInEdit : (1 + editSectionBase.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit));
				if (CaretPosition != num)
				{
					ScrollAllTheWayRightHelper();
				}
				SetCaretPivot(num);
				return;
			}
			if (displayCharBase != null && displayCharBase.Section is FractionPart && displayCharBase.IsEmpty)
			{
				EditSectionBase editSectionBase2 = (EditSectionBase)displayCharBase.Section;
				int num2 = ((editSectionBase2.LastFilledChar != null) ? (1 + editSectionBase2.LastFilledChar.OverallIndexInEdit) : editSectionBase2.FirstDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit);
				if (displayCharBase.OverallIndexInEdit > num2)
				{
					SetCaretPivot(num2);
				}
			}
			if (displayCharBase != null && displayCharBase.Section is FractionPartContinuous)
			{
				FractionPartContinuous fractionPartContinuous2 = (FractionPartContinuous)displayCharBase.Section;
				if (displayCharBase.Index == 0 && !displayCharBase.IsEmpty && IsRightToLeft(fractionPartContinuous2.PreviousEditSection) && displayCharBase.OverallIndexInEdit >= CaretPosition)
				{
					SetCaretPivot(1 + fractionPartContinuous2.PreviousEditSection.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit);
				}
			}
		}

		internal string NormalizeEncodingHelper(string text)
		{
			if (text != null)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				MaskInfo maskInfo = MaskInfo;
				if (maskInfo != null && !Utils.IsNumericType(maskInfo.DataType) && typeof(DateTime) != maskInfo.DataType && XamMaskedEditor.GetSection(maskInfo.Sections, typeof(NumberSection)) == null)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					text = text.Normalize(NormalizationForm.FormKC);
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal void ProcessTextInput(TextCompositionEventArgs e, bool normalizeEncoding)
		{
			string textInputText = GetTextInputText(e);
			if (ProcessTextInput(textInputText, normalizeEncoding, out var _))
			{
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessTextInput(string text, bool normalizeEncoding, out int numberOfCharsProcessed)
		{
			numberOfCharsProcessed = 0;
			if (ReadOnly)
			{
				return false;
			}
			_lastIllegalChar = '\0';
			int num = 0;
			if (normalizeEncoding)
			{
				text = NormalizeEncodingHelper(text);
			}
			string text2 = text;
			foreach (char c in text2)
			{
				InternalProcessChar(c);
				if (_lastIllegalChar != 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				num++;
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				OnTextChanged(viaUserAction: true);
			}
			numberOfCharsProcessed = num;
			return true;
		}

		internal int GetInputPositionInSelection(char c)
		{
			DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(SelectionStart);
			DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition2 = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(SelectionStart + SelectionLength - 1);
			DisplayCharBase nextEditableDisplayChar = displayCharAtPosition.NextEditableDisplayChar;
			if (!displayCharAtPosition.IsEditable && displayCharAtPosition.Section != displayCharAtPosition2.Section && nextEditableDisplayChar != null && nextEditableDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit <= displayCharAtPosition2.OverallIndexInEdit)
			{
				return nextEditableDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private bool ProcessRTLInputSectionOverride(DisplayCharBase dc, char c)
		{
			if (!dc.MatchChar(c))
			{
				DisplayCharBase prevDisplayChar = dc.PrevDisplayChar;
				EditSectionBase editSectionBase = ((prevDisplayChar != null) ? (prevDisplayChar.Section as EditSectionBase) : null);
				if (editSectionBase != dc.Section && IsRightToLeft(editSectionBase))
				{
					int pos = editSectionBase.DisplayChars.Count - 1;
					if (editSectionBase.CanInsertCharAt(pos, c))
					{
						return editSectionBase.InsertCharAt(pos, c);
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void InternalProcessChar(char c)
		{
			InternalProcessChar(c, disallowSignAfterDigits: false);
		}

		internal void InternalProcessChar(char c, bool disallowSignAfterDigits)
		{
			if (_skipNextDecimalKeyPress && '.' == c)
			{
				_skipNextDecimalKeyPress = false;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!IsInitialized || MaskedEditor.DesignMode)
				{
					return;
				}
				SectionBase dateTimeSection = ((CurrentSection == null) ? LastEditSection : CurrentSection);
				if (ProcessNextDateSectionChar(c, dateTimeSection, shouldMatchCurrentChar: false))
				{
					return;
				}
				EraSection eraSection = null;
				if (GetDisplayCharAtPosition(SelectionStart) != null)
				{
					eraSection = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(SelectionStart).Section as EraSection;
				}
				if (eraSection != null && EraSupportUtils.TryGetEraName(MaskInfo.FormatProvider, c.ToString(), out var eraName))
				{
					eraSection.SetText(eraName);
					eraSection.MaskedEdit.NotifyDisplayCharDrawStringsChanged();
					SectionBase sectionBase = eraSection.NextEditSection;
					if (sectionBase == null)
					{
						sectionBase = FirstEditSection;
					}
					if (sectionBase != null)
					{
						PivotPosition = sectionBase.FirstDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit;
						CaretPosition = sectionBase.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit + 1;
					}
					return;
				}
				if (MaskInfo.DecimalSeperatorChar == c)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(SelectionStart);
					if (displayCharAtPosition != null && !displayCharAtPosition.MatchChar(c))
					{
						SectionBase sectionBase2 = displayCharAtPosition.Section;
						while (sectionBase2 != null && !(sectionBase2.LastDisplayChar is DecimalSeperatorChar))
						{
							sectionBase2 = sectionBase2.NextSection;
						}
						if (sectionBase2 != null && sectionBase2.LastDisplayChar is DecimalSeperatorChar)
						{
							if (IsAnyTextSelected)
							{
								Delete();
							}
							SetCaretPivot(1 + sectionBase2.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit);
							DirtyMaskElement();
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				bool flag = false;
				if (IsAnyTextSelected)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition2 = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(SelectionStart);
					NumberSection numberSection = displayCharAtPosition2.Section as NumberSection;
					if (c == '\r' && numberSection == null)
					{
						IllegalCharPressed(displayCharAtPosition2, c);
						return;
					}
					if (char.IsDigit(c) && FirstEditSection is NumberSection && SelectionStart == 0)
					{
						Delete();
					}
					else
					{
						NumberSection numberSection2 = displayCharAtPosition2.Section as NumberSection;
						DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = numberSection2?.FirstFilledChar;
						bool flag2 = (numberSection2 != null && (c == numberSection2.PlusSignChar || c == numberSection2.MinusSignChar) && numberSection2.FirstFilledChar == displayCharAtPosition2) || (char.IsDigit(c) && displayCharBase != null && IsDisplayCharSelected(displayCharBase));
						if (displayCharAtPosition2 != null && displayCharAtPosition2.IsEditable && !displayCharAtPosition2.MatchChar(c) && !flag2)
						{
							if (!ProcessNextDateSectionChar(c, dateTimeSection, shouldMatchCurrentChar: true))
							{
								IllegalCharPressed(displayCharAtPosition2, c);
							}
							return;
						}
						int inputPositionInSelection = GetInputPositionInSelection(c);
						if (!InsertMode && displayCharAtPosition2 != null && displayCharAtPosition2.Section is NumberSection)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						Delete();
						if (inputPositionInSelection >= 0)
						{
							SetCaretPivot(inputPositionInSelection);
						}
					}
				}
				EnsureNumberSectionState();
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase2 = GetCurrentDisplayChar();
				if (!InsertMode && displayCharBase2 != null && !displayCharBase2.IsEditable)
				{
					if (displayCharBase2.MatchChar(c))
					{
						if (displayCharBase2.NextDisplayChar != null)
						{
							displayCharBase2 = displayCharBase2.NextDisplayChar;
							SetCaretPivot(displayCharBase2.OverallIndexInEdit);
							return;
						}
					}
					else if (displayCharBase2.NextEditableDisplayChar != null)
					{
						displayCharBase2 = displayCharBase2.NextEditableDisplayChar;
						SetCaretPivot(displayCharBase2.OverallIndexInEdit);
					}
				}
				if (displayCharBase2 != null)
				{
					NumberSection numberSection3 = displayCharBase2.Section as NumberSection;
					if (numberSection3 == null && displayCharBase2 is DecimalSeperatorChar)
					{
						numberSection3 = ((displayCharBase2.PrevDisplayChar != null) ? (displayCharBase2.PrevDisplayChar.Section as NumberSection) : null);
					}
					if (numberSection3 == null && displayCharBase2.Section is FractionPart)
					{
						numberSection3 = displayCharBase2.Section.PreviousEditSection as NumberSection;
					}
					if (displayCharBase2 != null && displayCharBase2.PrevDisplayChar != null && displayCharBase2.PrevDisplayChar.Section is NumberSection)
					{
						numberSection3 = displayCharBase2.PrevDisplayChar.Section as NumberSection;
					}
					if (numberSection3 != null && (numberSection3.MinValue < 0m || numberSection3.lastConvertedMinValWithFractionPart < 0m))
					{
						bool flag3 = disallowSignAfterDigits && numberSection3.FirstFilledChar != null && numberSection3.FirstFilledChar.OverallIndexInEdit < displayCharBase2.OverallIndexInEdit;
						if (numberSection3.PlusSignChar == c)
						{
							if (flag3 || !numberSection3.SetNumberSign(negative: false))
							{
								IllegalCharPressed(displayCharBase2, c);
							}
							DirtyMaskElement();
							return;
						}
						if (numberSection3.MinusSignChar == c)
						{
							if (flag3 || !numberSection3.SetNumberSign(negative: true))
							{
								IllegalCharPressed(displayCharBase2, c);
							}
							DirtyMaskElement();
							return;
						}
					}
					if (displayCharBase2.IsEditable)
					{
						if (InsertMode)
						{
							EditSectionBase editSectionBase = displayCharBase2.Section as EditSectionBase;
							if (!ProcessRTLInputSectionOverride(displayCharBase2, c))
							{
								if (IsRightToLeft(editSectionBase))
								{
									if (displayCharBase2.Index - 1 >= 0 && editSectionBase.InsertCharAt(displayCharBase2.Index - 1, c))
									{
										DirtyMaskElement();
									}
									else
									{
										DisplayCharBase displayCharBase3 = null;
										if (editSectionBase.NextLiteralSection != null)
										{
											displayCharBase3 = editSectionBase.NextLiteralSection.FirstDisplayChar;
										}
										if (displayCharBase3 == null)
										{
											IllegalCharPressed(displayCharBase2, c);
										}
										else if (displayCharBase3.MatchChar(c))
										{
											DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition3 = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(1 + displayCharBase3.OverallIndexInEdit);
											if (displayCharAtPosition3 != null && displayCharAtPosition3.IsEditable)
											{
												if (displayCharAtPosition3.Section is EditSectionBase section)
												{
													GotoSection(section, positionToRight: false);
													SetPivot();
												}
											}
											else if (displayCharAtPosition3 != null)
											{
												SetCaretPivot(displayCharAtPosition3.OverallIndexInEdit);
											}
											else
											{
												IllegalCharPressed(displayCharBase2, c);
											}

		private bool ProcessNextDateSectionChar(char c, SectionBase dateTimeSection, bool shouldMatchCurrentChar)
		{
			if (dateTimeSection != null && (dateTimeSection.IsDateTimeSeperatorSection || dateTimeSection.IsDateSection || dateTimeSection.IsTimeSection))
			{
				string text = "-/.,:";
				if (-1 < text.IndexOf(c))
				{
					bool flag = GetCurrentDisplayChar()?.MatchChar(c) ?? false;
					if (flag == shouldMatchCurrentChar)
					{
						SectionBase sectionBase = dateTimeSection.NextEditSection;
						if (sectionBase == null)
						{
							sectionBase = FirstEditSection;
						}
						if (sectionBase != null)
						{
							PivotPosition = sectionBase.FirstDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit;
							CaretPosition = sectionBase.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit + 1;
						}
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal int GetNearestDisplayChar(Point point, bool dragging)
		{
			double x = point.X;
			if (!IsInitialized)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int totalNumberOfDisplayChars = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars();
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = null;
			Rect rect = Rect.Empty;
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < totalNumberOfDisplayChars; i++)
			{
				displayCharBase = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(i);
				if (displayCharBase == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Rect displayCharLocation = MaskedEditor.GetDisplayCharLocation(displayCharBase);
				if (!displayCharLocation.IsEmpty && !Utilities.DoubleIsZero(displayCharLocation.Width) && Visibility.Collapsed != displayCharBase.Visibility)
				{
					rect = displayCharLocation;
					num = i;
					if (x <= displayCharLocation.X + displayCharLocation.Width / 2.0)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!dragging && (num < 0 || rect.IsEmpty || point.X - rect.Right > 15.0))
			{
				totalNumberOfDisplayChars = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars();
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase2 = null;
				for (int j = 0; j < totalNumberOfDisplayChars; j++)
				{
					displayCharBase = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(j);
					if (displayCharBase != null && displayCharBase.IsEditable && !displayCharBase.IsEmpty)
					{
						displayCharBase2 = displayCharBase;
					}
				}
				int val = 0;
				if (displayCharBase2 != null)
				{
					displayCharBase = displayCharBase2.NextEditableDisplayChar;
					val = ((displayCharBase == null || displayCharBase.OverallIndexInEdit < 0) ? ((num >= 0) ? (1 + num) : totalNumberOfDisplayChars) : displayCharBase.OverallIndexInEdit);
				}
				else if (FirstEditSection != null)
				{
					displayCharBase = FirstEditSection.FirstDisplayChar;
					if (displayCharBase != null && displayCharBase.OverallIndexInEdit >= 0)
					{
						val = displayCharBase.OverallIndexInEdit;
					}
				}
				return Math.Max(0, Math.Min(val, GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars()));
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars();
			}
			return 1 + num;
		}

		internal void MouseDragged(Point currentLocation)
		{
			if (IsInitialized && !MaskedEditor.DesignMode)
			{
				int nearestDisplayChar = GetNearestDisplayChar(currentLocation, dragging: true);
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(nearestDisplayChar);
				if (displayCharAtPosition != null)
				{
					nearestDisplayChar = displayCharAtPosition.OverallIndexInEdit;
					CaretPosition = nearestDisplayChar;
				}
				else
				{
					CaretPosition = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars();
				}
				InvalidateMaskElement();
			}
		}

		internal void MaskedEditUIElementMouseUp(Point point)
		{
			if (!IsAnyTextSelected)
			{
				EnsureNumberSectionState();
			}
		}

		internal void MaskedEditUIElementClicked(Point point, bool textBoxEntryEnabled = false)
		{
			if (textBoxEntryEnabled && _imeTextBox != null)
			{
				int characterIndexFromPoint = _imeTextBox.GetCharacterIndexFromPoint(point, snapToText: true);
				_imeTextBox.Select(characterIndexFromPoint, 0);
				return;
			}
			int nearestDisplayChar = GetNearestDisplayChar(point, dragging: false);
			DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(nearestDisplayChar);
			SectionBase sectionBase = GetCurrentSection(returnPrevRightToLeftSection: true);
			if (sectionBase == null)
			{
				sectionBase = LastSection;
			}
			if (displayCharAtPosition != null)
			{
				nearestDisplayChar = ((!IsRightToLeft(displayCharAtPosition.Section)) ? displayCharAtPosition.OverallIndexInEdit : displayCharAtPosition.OverallIndexInEdit);
				SetCaretPivot(nearestDisplayChar);
			}
			else
			{
				SetCaretPivot(GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars());
			}
			ScrollDisplayCharIntoView(CaretPosition);
			SectionBase currentSection = GetCurrentSection(returnPrevRightToLeftSection: true);
			if (sectionBase != null && sectionBase != currentSection && sectionBase is EditSectionBase editSectionBase)
			{
				editSectionBase.ValidateSection();
			}
		}

		{
		}

		internal void ScrollDisplayCharIntoView(int index)
		{
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(index);
			if (displayCharBase == null && index >= GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars())
			{
				displayCharBase = LastDisplayChar;
			}
			if (displayCharBase != null)
			{
				DisplayCharacterPresenter displayCharacterPresenter = MaskedEditor.GetDisplayCharacterPresenter(displayCharBase);
				if (displayCharacterPresenter != null)
				{
					displayCharacterPresenter.BringIntoView();
					MaskedEditor.UpdateLayout();
					MaskedEditor.InvalidateArrange();
				}
			}
		}

		internal SectionBase GetSectionContainingPosition(int position)
		{
			return GetSectionContainingPosition(position, Sections);
		}

		internal static SectionBase GetSectionContainingPosition(int position, SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			if (sections == null || sections.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < sections.Count; i++)
			{
				SectionBase sectionBase = sections[i];
				num += sectionBase.DisplayChars.Count;
				if (position < num)
				{
					return sectionBase;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void SetCaretPivot(int pos)
		{
			CaretPosition = pos;
			PivotPosition = pos;
		}
