		{
			MaskedEditor.CaretPosition = CaretPosition;
			MaskedEditor.PivotPosition = PivotPosition;
		}

		internal int CoerceCaretPosition(int pos)
		{
			if (pos < 0)
			{
				pos = 0;
			}
			int num = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars() - 1;
			if (ConstraintCaretToFilledCharacters)
			{
				SectionBase currentSection = GetCurrentSection(returnPrevRightToLeftSection: true);
				if (!IsRightToLeft(currentSection) && !(currentSection is FractionPart))
				{
					num = LastFilledDisplayChar?.OverallIndexInEdit ?? 0;
					DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition;
					while ((displayCharAtPosition = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(1 + num)) != null && !displayCharAtPosition.IsEmpty)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			EditSectionBase editSectionBase = LastSection as EditSectionBase;
			if (pos > num)
			{
				pos = num + 1;
			}
			return pos;
		}

		internal int CoercePivotPosition(int pos)
		{
			if (pos < 0)
			{
				pos = 0;
			}
			int num = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars() - 1;
			if (pos > num)
			{
				pos = num + 1;
			}
			return pos;
		}

		internal void SelectAll()
		{
			if (!IsInitialized || MaskedEditor.DesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (MaskedEditor != null && MaskSelectAllBehavior.SelectEnteredCharacters == MaskedEditor.SelectAllBehavior)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = FirstFilledDisplayChar;
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase2 = LastFilledDisplayChar;
				while (displayCharBase != null && displayCharBase.PrevDisplayChar != null && !displayCharBase.PrevDisplayChar.IsEmpty)
				{
					displayCharBase = displayCharBase.PrevDisplayChar;
				}
				while (displayCharBase2 != null && displayCharBase2.NextDisplayChar != null && !displayCharBase2.NextDisplayChar.IsEmpty)
				{
					displayCharBase2 = displayCharBase2.NextDisplayChar;
				}
				if (displayCharBase != null && displayCharBase2 != null)
				{
					Select(displayCharBase.OverallIndexInEdit, 1 + displayCharBase2.OverallIndexInEdit - displayCharBase.OverallIndexInEdit);
					return;
				}
			}
			SelectionStart = 0;
			SelectionLength = GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars();
		}

		internal void Select(int start, int length)
		{
			SelectionStart = start;
			SelectionLength = length;
		}

		internal void Cut()
		{
			Cut(fireValueChanged: true);
		}

		internal void Cut(bool fireValueChanged)
		{
			if (ReadOnly)
			{
				return;
			}
			string selectedText = SelectedText;
			if (selectedText == null || selectedText.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (!ClipboardHelper.SetText(selectedText))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				return;
			}
			Delete();
			SetPivot();
			if (fireValueChanged)
			{
				OnTextChanged(viaUserAction: true);
			}
			DirtyMaskElement();
		}

		internal void Paste()
		{
			Paste(fireValueChanged: true);
		}

		internal void Paste(bool fireValueChanged)
		{
			if (!ReadOnly)
			{
				string text = ClipboardHelper.GetText();
				text = NormalizeEncodingHelper(text);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					SetSelectedText(text, fireValueChanged, isPaste: true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Copy()
		{
			string text = SelectedText;
			if (text != null && text.Length > 1 && MaskInfo != null && MaskInfo.ClipMode == MaskMode.Raw)
			{
				string value = MaskInfo.DecimalSeperatorChar.ToString() ?? "";
				if (text.EndsWith(value))
				{
					text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 1);
				}
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardHelper.SetText(text);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInputNull()
		{
			string text = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
			if (text != null && text.Length != 0)
			{
				return TreatStringAsNull(text);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool TreatStringAsNull(string value)
		{
			MaskInfo maskInfo = MaskInfo;
			char decimalSeperatorChar = maskInfo.DecimalSeperatorChar;
			SectionsCollection sections = maskInfo.Sections;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = sections.Count; i + 2 < count; i++)
			{
				if (sections[i] is NumberSection && sections[i + 1] is LiteralSection literalSection && sections[i + 2] is FractionPart && literalSection.GetText() == value)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetSelectedText(string text, bool fireValueChanged, bool isPaste = false)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
			EditorValueSnapshot valueSnapshot = GetValueSnapshot();
			if (IsAnyTextSelected)
			{
				Delete();
			}
			SignDisplayType signDisplayType = Sections.GetSignDisplayType();
			if ((!isPaste || signDisplayType == SignDisplayType.None) && XamMaskedEditor.AreAllDisplayCharsEmpty(Sections))
			{
				int numberSectionCount = XamMaskedEditor.GetNumberSectionCount(Sections);
				if (1 == numberSectionCount || (2 == numberSectionCount && LastEditSection is FractionPart))
				{
					MaskedEditor.ConvertTextToValue(text, out var value, out var _);
					if (value != null)
					{
						try
						{
							Value = value;
							return;
						}
						catch
						{
							return;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (IsInputNull())
			{
				DisplayCharBase currentDisplayChar = GetCurrentDisplayChar();
				EditSectionBase firstEditSection = FirstEditSection;
				bool flag = false;
				if (firstEditSection != null)
				{
					flag = currentDisplayChar == firstEditSection.FirstDisplayChar || (IsRightToLeft(firstEditSection) && currentDisplayChar == firstEditSection.LastDisplayChar.NextDisplayChar);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					SetCaretPivot(0);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				_lastIllegalDisplayChar = null;
				DisplayCharBase currentDisplayChar2 = GetCurrentDisplayChar();
				SectionBase sectionBase = ((currentDisplayChar2 != null) ? currentDisplayChar2.Section : LastEditSection);
				if (((!(sectionBase is NumberSection) && !(currentDisplayChar2 is DecimalSeperatorChar)) || text[i] != MaskInfo.CommaChar) && (!(FirstEditSection is EraSection) || i <= 0 || i >= 3))
				{
					_lastIllegalDisplayChar = null;
					InternalProcessChar(text[i], disallowSignAfterDigits: true);
					if (_lastIllegalDisplayChar != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!valueSnapshot.IsCurrentValueSame(this))
			{
				ValidateAllSections();
				if (IsRightToLeft(CurrentSection) && CurrentSection is EditSectionBase section)
				{
					GotoSection(section);
					SetPivot();
				}
				if (fireValueChanged)
				{
					OnTextChanged(viaUserAction: true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal string GetText(MaskMode maskMode, int start, int length)
		{
			if (!IsInitialized)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return GetText(maskMode, start, length, Sections);
		}

		internal static string GetText(MaskMode maskMode, int start, int length, SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			int num = start + length;
			if (start == num)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(1 + length);
			for (int i = start; i < num; i++)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharAtPosition = XamMaskedEditor.GetDisplayCharAtPosition(sections, i);
				char c = '\0';
				if (displayCharAtPosition != null)
				{
					c = displayCharAtPosition.GetChar(maskMode);
				}
				if (c != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
					if (displayCharAtPosition is DigitChar && ((DigitChar)displayCharAtPosition).ShouldIncludeComma(maskMode))
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(displayCharAtPosition.Section.CommaChar);
					}
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal void ProcessPendingImeOperation(bool cancel)
		{
			if (_pendingTextInput != null && _pendingTextInput.Status == DispatcherOperationStatus.Pending)
			{
				if (cancel)
				{
					DispatcherOperation pendingTextInput = _pendingTextInput;
					_pendingTextInput = null;
					pendingTextInput.Abort();
				}
				else
				{
					_pendingTextInput.Wait();
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class MaskParser
	{
		internal static string LOCALIZED_ESCAPE_SEQUENCE = "{LOC}";

		private State state;

		private SectionsCollection sections;

		private IFormatProvider formatProvider;

		private bool? hasContinuousNumericMask;

		internal const char ESCAPE_CHAR = '\\';

		internal const string ESCAPE_CHAR_STRING = "\\";

		private IFormatProvider FormatProvider => formatProvider;

		private char[] DateSeperators
		{
			get
			{
				char cultureChar = XamMaskedEditor.GetCultureChar('/', FormatProvider);
				string text = "-/.";
				if (cultureChar != 0)
				{
					text = cultureChar + text;
				}
				return text.ToCharArray();
			}
		}

		private char[] TimeSeperators
		{
			get
			{
				char cultureChar = XamMaskedEditor.GetCultureChar(':', FormatProvider);
				string text = ":.";
				if (cultureChar != 0)
				{
					text = cultureChar + text;
				}
				return text.ToCharArray();
			}
		}

		private char CultureDecimalSeperator => XamMaskedEditor.GetCultureChar('.', FormatProvider);

		private SectionsCollection Sections
		{
			get
			{
				if (sections == null)
				{
					sections = new SectionsCollection();
				}
				return sections;
			}
		}

		private MaskParser(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			this.formatProvider = formatProvider;
		}

		private string SafeSubstring(string str, int startIndex, int length)
		{
			if (startIndex < 0)
			{
				startIndex = 0;
			}
			if (startIndex >= str.Length)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (length <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (startIndex + length - 1 >= str.Length)
			{
				length = str.Length - startIndex;
			}
			if (length <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return str.Substring(startIndex, length);
		}

		private int SafeIndexOfAny(string str, char[] array, int startIndex, int count)
		{
			if (startIndex < 0)
			{
				startIndex = 0;
			}
			if (startIndex >= str.Length)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (1 + startIndex + count >= str.Length)
			{
				count = str.Length - startIndex;
			}
			if (count <= 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return str.IndexOfAny(array, startIndex, count);
		}

		private int GetOffset(string mask, string currentSection, string targetSection, int index, bool moveForward)
		{
			int num = (moveForward ? currentSection.Length : targetSection.Length);
			if (moveForward)
			{
				if (index + num >= mask.Length)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (mask[index + num] == '\\')
				{
					return num + 2;
				}
				return num + 1;
			}
			if (index - 2 < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (mask[index - 2] == '\\')
			{
				return num + 2;
			}
			return num + 1;
		}

		private void AdjustNonstandardForeignDateMask(ref string mask)
		{
			string[] array = new string[24]
			{
				"dd/mm/yyyy", "dd/yyyy/mm", "mm/dd/yyyy", "mm/yyyy/dd", "yyyy/mm/dd", "yyyy/dd/mm", "dd/mm/yy", "dd/yy/mm", "mm/dd/yy", "mm/yy/dd",
				"yy/mm/dd", "yy/dd/mm", "dd/mm", "dd/yyyy", "mm/dd", "mm/yyyy", "yyyy/dd", "yyyy/mm", "dd/mm", "dd/yy",
				"mm/dd", "mm/yy", "yy/dd", "yy/mm"
			};
			int num = -1;
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text in array2)
			{
				num = mask.IndexOf(text);
				if (-1 < num)
				{
					int num2 = num + text.Length;
					if (num2 < mask.Length)
					{
						mask = mask.Insert(num2, "/");
					}
					else
					{
						mask += "/";
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal int GetNumberOfDigitsRequired(double val)
		{
			if (val < 0.0)
			{
				val = 0.0 - val;
			}
			else if (val == 0.0)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			double d = Math.Log10(val);
			return 1 + (int)Math.Floor(d);
		}

		private static int IndexOf(string str, int startIndex, int endIndex, char c, bool skipEscapedChars, char escapeChar)
		{
			for (int i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++)
			{
				char c2 = str[i];
				if (skipEscapedChars && escapeChar == c2)
				{
					i++;
				}
				else if (c2 == c)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private void Analyze(string mask)
		{
			PreProcessMask(ref mask);
			int num = 0;
			SectionBase sectionBase = null;
			FilterType filterType = FilterType.Unchanged;
			State state = this.state;
			char[] timeSeperators = TimeSeperators;
			char[] dateSeperators = DateSeperators;
			bool flag = false;
			if (mask.StartsWith("{LOC}"))
			{
				flag = true;
				num = "{LOC}".Length;
			}
			Hashtable foreignDateSymbols = null;
			XamMaskedEditor.GetNonstandardForeignDateMaskAndPostfixSymbols(FormatProvider, ref foreignDateSymbols);
			bool flag2 = foreignDateSymbols != null && flag;
			SectionBase sectionBase2 = null;
			if (flag2)
			{
				AdjustNonstandardForeignDateMask(ref mask);
			}
			bool flag3 = false;
			while (num < mask.Length)
			{
				if (this.state == State.Date)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
				if (this.state == State.Initial && flag3 && mask[num] == 'h')
				{
					string a = SafeSubstring(mask, num, 3);
					if (!string.Equals(a, "hhh"))
					{
						this.state = State.Time;
					}
				}
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = null;
				DisplayCharBase[] array = null;
				if ('\n' == mask[num] || '\r' == mask[num])
				{
					num++;
					continue;
				}
				if (State.LiteralEscape != this.state && "\\".Equals(SafeSubstring(mask, num, 1)) && mask.Length > 1 + num)
				{
					this.state = State.LiteralEscape;
					num++;
				}
				else if (State.LiteralEscape == this.state)
				{
					displayCharBase = new LiteralChar(mask[num]);
					displayCharBase.Required = false;
					num++;
					this.state = State.Initial;
				}
				else if (this.state == State.Initial && ('{' == mask[num] || '[' == mask[num]))
				{
					char c = mask[num];
					int num2 = IndexOf(mask, 1 + num, mask.Length - 1, ('{' == c) ? '}' : ']', skipEscapedChars: true, '\\');
					bool flag4 = false;
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						string input = SafeSubstring(mask, 1 + num, num2 - num - 1);
						Match match = Regex.Match(input, "^(number)(?:\\: *(-?\\d+) *- *(-?\\d+))?$");
						if (match.Success)
						{
							string value = match.Groups[1].Value;
							string value2 = match.Groups[2].Value;
							string value3 = match.Groups[3].Value;
							decimal num3 = -2147483648m;
							decimal num4 = 2147483647m;
							if (value2 != null && value3 != null && value2.Length > 0 && value3.Length > 0)
							{
								num3 = decimal.Parse(value2, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
								num4 = decimal.Parse(value3, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
							}
							int numberOfDigitsRequired = GetNumberOfDigitsRequired((double)num3);
							int numberOfDigitsRequired2 = GetNumberOfDigitsRequired((double)num4);
							int digits = Math.Max(numberOfDigitsRequired, numberOfDigitsRequired2);
							NumberSection numberSection = new NumberSection(digits, null, (num3 < 0m) ? SignDisplayType.ShowWhenNegative : SignDisplayType.None);
							numberSection.MinValue = num3;
							numberSection.MaxValue = num4;
							sectionBase = numberSection;
							flag4 = true;
						}
						if (!match.Success)
						{
							match = Regex.Match(input, "^(char)\\:(\\d+)\\:(.+)$");
							if (match.Success)
							{

		private void PreProcessMask(ref string mask)
		{
			IFormatProvider formatProvider = FormatProvider;
			if (mask.IndexOf("{date}") >= 0)
			{
				string newValue = XamMaskedEditor.CalcDefaultDateMask(formatProvider);
				mask = mask.Replace("{date}", newValue);
			}
			if (mask.IndexOf("{date:s}") >= 0)
			{
				string newValue2 = XamMaskedEditor.CalcDefaultDateMask(formatProvider, usePostfixSeparatorsFromLongDatePattern: false);
				mask = mask.Replace("{date:s}", newValue2);
			}
			if (mask.IndexOf("{time}") >= 0)
			{
				string newValue3 = XamMaskedEditor.CalcDefaultTimeMask(formatProvider);
				mask = mask.Replace("{time}", newValue3);
			}
			if (mask.IndexOf("{longtime}") >= 0)
			{
				string newValue4 = XamMaskedEditor.CalcDefaultLongTimeMask(formatProvider);
				mask = mask.Replace("{longtime}", newValue4);
			}
			Match match = Regex.Match(mask, "\\{(double|currency)(?:\\:(\\-|\\+)?(\\d+)(?:\\.(\\d+))?)?(?:\\:(c))?(?:\\:(no_symbol))?\\}");
			if (match != null && match.Success && match.Groups.Count > 4)
			{
				string value = match.Groups[1].Value;
				string value2 = match.Groups[2].Value;
				char c = ((value2 != null && value2.Length > 0) ? value2[0] : '\0');
				value2 = match.Groups[3].Value;
				int num = ((value2 != null && value2.Length > 0) ? int.Parse(value2) : (-1));
				value2 = match.Groups[4].Value;
				int num2 = ((value2 != null && value2.Length > 0) ? int.Parse(value2) : (-1));
				hasContinuousNumericMask = "c" == match.Groups[5].Value && num > 0 && num2 > 0;
				bool flag = "no_symbol" == match.Groups[6].Value;
				if (c == '\0' && -1 == num)
				{
					c = '-';
				}
				string newValue5 = (("double" == value) ? XamMaskedEditor.CalcDefaultDoubleMask(formatProvider, num, num2, c) : XamMaskedEditor.CalcDefaultCurrencyMask(formatProvider, num, num2, c, !flag));
				mask = mask.Replace(match.Value, newValue5);
			}
		}

		internal static void Parse(string mask, out SectionsCollection sections, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			MaskParser maskParser = new MaskParser(formatProvider);
			maskParser.Analyze(mask);
			sections = maskParser.sections;
		}

		internal static void EscapeLiteralsInString(string baseString, out string escapedString)
		{
			if (baseString == null || baseString.Length == 0)
			{
				escapedString = string.Empty;
				return;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(baseString.Length * 2);
			for (int i = 0; i < baseString.Length; i++)
			{
				stringBuilder.AppendFormat("\\{0}", baseString[i]);
			}
			escapedString = stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class ParsedMask
	{
		private string _mask;

		private SectionsCollection _sections;

		private char _promptChar;

		private char _padChar;

		public string Mask => _mask;

		public char PromptCharacter => _promptChar;

		public char PadCharacter => _padChar;

		public ParsedMask(string mask)
			: this(mask, null)
		{
		}

		public ParsedMask(string mask, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
			: this(mask, formatProvider, '_', ' ')
		{
		}

		public ParsedMask(string mask, IFormatProvider formatProvider, char promptCharacter, char padCharacter)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(mask))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			_mask = mask;
			_promptChar = promptCharacter;
			_padChar = padCharacter;
			MaskParser.Parse(_mask, out _sections, formatProvider);
			if (_sections != null)
			{
				MaskInfo maskInfo = new MaskInfo();
				maskInfo.Initialize(_sections, formatProvider);
				_sections.Initialize(maskInfo);
			}
		}

		public string ApplyMask(string data, MaskMode maskMode)
		{
			XamMaskedEditor.SetText(_sections, data, _promptChar, _padChar);
			return XamMaskedEditor.GetText(_sections, maskMode, _promptChar, _padChar);
		}
	}

		All = 0xFFFFFFFFL
	}

		internal class ValueConstraintResolutionCache
		{
			private object _actualMin;

			private object _actualMax;

			private object _actualMinExclusive;

			private object _actualMaxExclusive;

			private int _actualMinLength;

			private Type _dataType;

			private ValueConstraint _resolved;

			internal ValueConstraint GetValueConstraint(ValueConstraint actual, Type dataType)
			{
				if (actual == null)
				{
					return actual;
				}
				if (dataType != typeof(double) && dataType != typeof(decimal))
				{
					return actual;
				}
				if (dataType != _dataType || actual.MinLength != _actualMinLength || actual.MinInclusive != _actualMin || actual.MaxInclusive != _actualMax || actual.MinExclusive != _actualMinExclusive || actual.MaxExclusive != _actualMaxExclusive)
				{
					_resolved = null;
				}
				if (_resolved == null)
				{
					_dataType = dataType;
					_actualMinLength = actual.MinLength;
					_actualMin = actual.MinInclusive;
					_actualMinExclusive = actual.MinExclusive;
					_actualMax = actual.MaxInclusive;
					_actualMaxExclusive = actual.MaxExclusive;
					_resolved = new ValueConstraint
					{
						MinLength = actual.MinLength
					};
					double? num = null;
					num = ConvertValueConstraintValue(actual.MinInclusive, dataType);
					if (num.HasValue)
					{
						_resolved.MinInclusive = num;
					}
					else
					{
						_resolved.MinInclusive = actual.MinInclusive;
					}
					num = ConvertValueConstraintValue(actual.MaxInclusive, dataType);
					if (num.HasValue)
					{
						_resolved.MaxInclusive = num;
					}
					else
					{
						_resolved.MaxInclusive = actual.MaxInclusive;
					}
					num = ConvertValueConstraintValue(actual.MinExclusive, dataType);
					if (num.HasValue)
					{
						_resolved.MinExclusive = num;
					}
					else
					{
						_resolved.MinExclusive = actual.MinExclusive;
					}
					num = ConvertValueConstraintValue(actual.MaxExclusive, dataType);
					if (num.HasValue)
					{
						_resolved.MaxExclusive = num;
					}
					else
					{
						_resolved.MaxExclusive = actual.MaxExclusive;
					}
				}
				return _resolved;
			}

			private static double? ConvertValueConstraintValue(object value, Type dataType)
			{
				if (!(value is string text))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (dataType == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (dataType != typeof(decimal) && dataType != typeof(double))
				{
					return null;
				}
				DoubleConverter doubleConverter = new DoubleConverter();
				double num = double.NaN;
				try
				{
					object obj = doubleConverter.ConvertFromInvariantString(text);
					if (obj is double)
					{
						num = (double)obj;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal bool SpinWrappingAllowed
		{
			get
			{
				switch (SpinWrapBehaviorResolved)
				{
				case SpinWrapBehavior.NoWrapping:
					return false;
				case SpinWrapBehavior.WrapCurrentSection:
				case SpinWrapBehavior.WrapAcrossSections:
					return true;
				default:
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public static SpinWrapBehavior SpinWrapBehaviorDefault
		{
			get
			{
				return spinWrapBehaviorDefault;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != spinWrapBehaviorDefault)
				{
					spinWrapBehaviorDefault = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal SpinWrapBehavior SpinWrapBehaviorResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (SpinWrapBehavior != SpinWrapBehavior.Default)
				{
					return SpinWrapBehavior;
				}
				if (DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(this, SpinWrapProperty).BaseValueSource != BaseValueSource.Default)
				{
					if (!SpinWrap)
					{
						return SpinWrapBehavior.NoWrapping;
					}
					return SpinWrapBehavior.WrapAcrossSections;
				}
				if (SpinWrapBehaviorDefault != SpinWrapBehavior.Default)
				{
					return SpinWrapBehaviorDefault;
				}
				return SpinWrapBehavior.WrapAcrossSections;
			}
		}

		[ReadOnly(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public SectionsCollection Sections => (SectionsCollection)GetValue(SectionsProperty);

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		[Bindable(false)]
		public DisplayCharsCollection DisplayChars
		{
			get
			{
				SectionsCollection sections = Sections;
				if (_displayChars_Sections != sections)
				{
					if (_displayChars == null)
					{
						_displayChars = new DisplayCharsCollection();
					}
					_displayChars.Clear();
					if (sections != null)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < sections.Count; i++)
						{
							SectionBase sectionBase = sections[i];
							for (int j = 0; j < sectionBase.DisplayChars.Count; j++)
							{
								_displayChars.Add(sectionBase.DisplayChars[j]);
							}
						}
					}
					_displayChars_Sections = sections;
				}
				return _displayChars;
			}
		}

		{
			try
			{
				_license = LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(XamMaskedEditor), this) as UltraLicense;
			}

			}
			Infragistics.Themes.ThemeManager.RegisterControl(typeof(XamMaskedEditor));
			InitializeCachedPropertyValues();
		}

				return true;

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new XamMaskedEditorAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void DoInitialization()
		{
			base.DoInitialization();
			MaskInfo maskInfo = MaskInfo;
			maskInfo.RecreateSections(dontRefreshValue: true);
			maskInfo.InternalRefreshValue(base.Value);
			ApplyMaskToText();
		}

		protected override string OnCoerceText(string text)
		{
			text = base.OnCoerceText(text);
			if (!base.SyncingValueProperties && (_editInfo == null || !_editInfo._inOnTextChanged) && text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				MaskInfo maskInfo = MaskInfo.CreateMaskInfoForConverter(this);
				if (maskInfo != null)
				{
					try
					{
						SetText(maskInfo.Sections, text, maskInfo);
						text = GetText(maskInfo.Sections, maskInfo.DataMode, maskInfo);
					}
					finally
					{
						MaskInfo.ReleaseMaskInfoForConverter(maskInfo);
					}
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			DependencyProperty property = e.Property;
			if (ValueEditor.FormatProviderProperty == property || FrameworkElement.LanguageProperty == property)
			{
				if (_maskInfo != null)
				{
					_maskInfo.InitializeFormatProvider();
					ReparseMask();
				}
			}
			else if (ValueEditor.FormatProperty == property)
			{
				if (_maskInfo != null)
				{
					_maskInfo.Format = e.NewValue as string;
				}
			}
			else if (ValueEditor.IsInEditModeProperty == property)
			{
				ProcessIsBeingEditedAndFocusedChanged();
			}
			else if (ValueEditor.OriginalValueProperty == property && _maskInfo != null)
			{
				_maskInfo.DefaultYear = null;
			}
			if (UIElement.IsMouseOverProperty == property || SpinButtonDisplayModeProperty == property || ValueEditor.IsInEditModeProperty == property || ValueEditor.IsReadOnlyProperty == property)
			{
				UpdateSpinButtonVisibility();
			}
		}

		protected override bool ValidateCurrentValue(out Exception error)
		{
			if (!base.ValidateCurrentValue(out error))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (_skipNextMaskValidation)
			{
				error = null;
				_skipNextMaskValidation = false;
				return true;
			}
			MaskInfo maskInfo = MaskInfo;
			if (maskInfo != null && maskInfo.Sections != null && !IsInputValid(maskInfo.Sections, out var maskValidationErrorMessage))
			{
				error = new Exception(maskValidationErrorMessage);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool ValidateValue(object value, out Exception error)
		{
			if (!base.ValidateValue(value, out error))
			{
				return false;
			}
			MaskInfo maskInfo = MaskInfo.CreateMaskInfoForConverter(this);
			try
			{
				if (maskInfo != null && maskInfo.Sections != null)
				{
					if (!maskInfo.InternalRefreshValue(value, out error))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!IsInputValid(maskInfo.Sections, out var maskValidationErrorMessage))
					{
						error = new Exception(maskValidationErrorMessage);
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				MaskInfo.ReleaseMaskInfoForConverter(maskInfo);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnEditModeEnding(EditModeEndingEventArgs args)
		{
			base.OnEditModeEnding(args);
			if (!args.Cancel)
			{
				if (_editInfo != null && _editInfo._imeTextBox != null && _editInfo._imeTextBox.IsKeyboardFocused)
				{
					Focus();
				}
				if (_editInfo != null)
				{
					_editInfo.ProcessPendingImeOperation(!args.AcceptChanges);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnFocusSiteChanged()
		{
			base.OnFocusSiteChanged();
			EditInfo?.InitializeIMETextBox(base.FocusSite);
		}

		protected override void OnTouchEnter(TouchEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnTouchEnter(e);
			if (!_IsTouchEnabled)
			{
				_IsTouchEnabled = true;
				EditInfo?.InitializeIsTextBoxEntryEnabled();
			}
		}

		internal override void OnValueConstraintChanged(string valueConstraintPropertyName)
		{
			if (_maskInfo != null)
			{
				_maskInfo.InitializedCachedMinMaxValues();
			}
			base.OnValueConstraintChanged(valueConstraintPropertyName);
		}

		private void DisposeEditInfo()
		{
			if (_editInfo != null)
			{
				_editInfo.InitializeIMETextBox(null);
				if (_resetIsTextBoxEntryEnabledWhenEditModeEnds)
				{
					InternalSetIsTextBoxEntryEnabled(value: false);
				}
				_editInfo = null;
			}
		}

		private void InitializeCachedPropertyValues()
		{
			_cachedCaretVisible = (bool)CaretVisibleProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
			_cachedClipMode = (MaskMode)ClipModeProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
			_cachedDataMode = (MaskMode)DataModeProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
			_cachedDisplayMode = (MaskMode)DisplayModeProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
			_cachedMask = (string)MaskProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
			_cachedPadChar = (char)PadCharProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
			_cachedPromptChar = (char)PromptCharProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
			_cachedTrimFractionalZeros = (bool)TrimFractionalZerosProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
		}

		internal bool ResolveMask(Type dataType, IFormatProvider formatProvider, out string mask)
		{
			MaskDefaultType maskDefaultType;
			return ResolveMask(dataType, formatProvider, out mask, out maskDefaultType);
		}

		internal bool ResolveMask(Type dataType, IFormatProvider formatProvider, out string mask, out MaskDefaultType maskDefaultType)
		{
			mask = null;
			maskDefaultType = MaskDefaultType.None;
			string mask2 = Mask;
			if (mask2 != null && mask2.Length > 0)
			{
				mask = mask2;
				return true;
			}
			string defaultMask = GetDefaultMask(dataType, formatProvider);
			if (defaultMask != null && defaultMask.Length > 0)
			{
				mask = defaultMask;
				return true;
			}
			if (null == dataType)
			{
				return false;
			}
			mask = GetDefaultMaskForType(dataType, out maskDefaultType);
			if (mask != null)
			{
				return mask.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static string GetNonstandardForeignDateMaskAndPostfixSymbols(IFormatProvider formatProv, ref Hashtable foreignDateSymbols)
		{
			foreignDateSymbols = null;
			string result = null;
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = GetDateTimeFormatInfo(formatProv);
			if (dateTimeFormatInfo == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			string longDatePattern = dateTimeFormatInfo.LongDatePattern;
			if (longDatePattern == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			int num = longDatePattern.IndexOfAny(new char[2] { 'm', 'M' });
			int num2 = longDatePattern.IndexOfAny(new char[2] { 'd', 'D' });
			int num3 = longDatePattern.IndexOfAny(new char[2] { 'y', 'Y' });
			int num4 = longDatePattern.LastIndexOfAny(new char[2] { 'm', 'M' });
			int num5 = longDatePattern.LastIndexOfAny(new char[2] { 'd', 'D' });
			int num6 = longDatePattern.LastIndexOfAny(new char[2] { 'y', 'Y' });
			int num7 = num4 - num;
			int num8 = num5 - num2;
			if (num7 < 2 && num8 < 2)
			{
				char c = '\0';
				if (num4 + 2 < longDatePattern.Length)
				{
					c = longDatePattern[num4 + 2];
				}
				char c2 = '\0';
				if (num5 + 2 < longDatePattern.Length)
				{
					c2 = longDatePattern[num5 + 2];
				}
				char c3 = '\0';
				if (num6 + 2 < longDatePattern.Length)
				{
					c3 = longDatePattern[num6 + 2];
				}
				if (c != 0 && c2 != 0 && c3 != 0 && num != -1 && num2 != -1 && num3 != -1)
				{
					foreignDateSymbols = new Hashtable(3);
					foreignDateSymbols.Add(typeof(DaySection), c2);
					foreignDateSymbols.Add(typeof(MonthSection), c);
					foreignDateSymbols.Add(typeof(YearSection), c3);
					int num9 = num6 - num3 + 1;
					string text = ((num9 > 2) ? "yyyy" : "yy");
					string text2 = "mm";
					string text3 = "dd";
					if (num <= num2 && num <= num3)
					{
						result = ((num2 >= num3) ? $"{text2}{c}{text}{c3}{text3}{c2}" : $"{text2}{c}{text3}{c2}{text}{c3}");
					}
					else if (num2 <= num && num2 <= num3)
					{

		internal static string GetText(SectionsCollection sections, MaskMode maskMode, char promptChar, char padChar)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(1 + GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars(sections));
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = sections.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = sections[i].DisplayChars;
				int count2 = displayChars.Count;
				for (int j = 0; j < count2; j++)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = displayChars[j];
					char c = displayCharBase.GetChar(maskMode, promptChar, padChar);
					if (c != 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(c);
					}
					if (displayCharBase is DigitChar && ((DigitChar)displayCharBase).ShouldIncludeComma(maskMode) && displayCharBase.Section.CommaChar != 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(displayCharBase.Section.CommaChar);
					}
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal static bool AreAllDisplayCharsEmpty(SectionsCollection sections)

		}

		}

		internal static int SetText(SectionsCollection sections, string text, char promptCharacter, char padCharacter, bool skipDigitSeparator, bool validateSections = true)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = "";
			}
			EraseAllChars(sections);
			int num = 0;
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = GetDisplayCharAtPosition(sections, 0);
			MaskMode maskMode = sections.MaskInfo?.DataMode ?? MaskMode.IncludeLiterals;
			while (displayCharBase != null && num < text.Length)
			{
				char c = text[num];
				if (displayCharBase.MatchChar(c) && promptCharacter != c)
				{
					if (displayCharBase.IsEditable)
					{
						displayCharBase.Char = c;
					}
					num++;
					displayCharBase = displayCharBase.NextDisplayChar;
				}
				else if (promptCharacter == c || padCharacter == c)
				{
					bool flag = true;
					if (!displayCharBase.IsEditable && (maskMode == MaskMode.Raw || MaskMode.IncludePromptChars == maskMode))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						num++;
					}
					displayCharBase = displayCharBase.NextDisplayChar;
				}
				else if (displayCharBase is DigitChar && displayCharBase.Section is NumberSection && skipDigitSeparator && displayCharBase.Section.CommaChar == c && !MatchesNextLiteralChar(displayCharBase, c))
				{
					num++;
				}
				else
				{
					SectionBase nextSection = displayCharBase.Section.NextSection;
					if (nextSection == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					displayCharBase = nextSection.FirstDisplayChar;
				}
			}
			if (validateSections)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < sections.Count; i++)
				{
					if (sections[i] is EditSectionBase editSectionBase)
					{
						editSectionBase.ValidateSection();
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static int SetText(SectionsCollection sections, string text, MaskInfo maskInfo, bool validateSections = true)
		{
			return SetText(sections, text, maskInfo.PromptChar, maskInfo.PadChar, maskInfo.SkipDigitSeparator, validateSections);
		}

		{

			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = sections.Count; i < count; i++)

				int j = 0;
				for (int count2 = displayChars.Count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = displayChars[j];
					if (displayCharBase != null && displayCharBase.IsEditable)
					{
						displayCharBase.Char = '\0';
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal static DisplayCharBase GetDisplayCharAtPosition(SectionsCollection sections, int position)

				int count2 = sectionBase.DisplayChars.Count;
				if (position < num + count2)
				{
					return sectionBase.DisplayChars[position - num];
				}
				num += count2;
			}
			return null;
		}

		{

		private static bool IsNumericMask(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			int sectionCount = GetSectionCount(sections, typeof(NumberSection));
			int sectionCount2 = GetSectionCount(sections, typeof(FractionPart));
			int num = sectionCount + sectionCount2;
			if (sectionCount + sectionCount2 <= 2 && sectionCount2 <= 1 && sectionCount + sectionCount2 >= 1)
			{
				return sectionCount + sectionCount2 == GetEditableSectionCount(sections);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsDateTimeMask(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			Type[] array = new Type[7]
			{
				typeof(YearSection),
				typeof(MonthSection),
				typeof(DaySection),
				typeof(HourSection),
				typeof(MinuteSection),
				typeof(SecondSection),
				typeof(AMPMSection)
			};
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				int sectionCount = GetSectionCount(sections, array[i]);
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, sectionCount);
				num += sectionCount;
			}
			if (1 == num2)
			{
				return num == GetEditableSectionCount(sections);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ShouldUseValueToTextConverter(MaskInfo maskInfo)
		{
			XamMaskedEditor maskEditor = maskInfo.MaskEditor;
			if (maskEditor != null && !(maskEditor.ValueToTextConverter is MaskedEditorDefaultConverter))
			{
				Type dataType = maskInfo.DataType;
				if (typeof(DateTime) == dataType)
				{
					return !IsDateTimeMask(maskInfo.Sections);
				}
				if (Utils.IsNumericType(dataType))
				{
					return !IsNumericMask(maskInfo.Sections);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static object GetDataValue(MaskInfo maskInfo)
		{
			Type dataType = maskInfo.DataType;
			SectionsCollection sections = maskInfo.Sections;
			sections = sections.Clone(maskInfo, copyDisplayCharacterValues: true);
			ValidateAllSections(sections, loosingFocus: true);
			if (ShouldUseValueToTextConverter(maskInfo))
			{
				string text = GetText(sections, maskInfo.DataMode, maskInfo);
				IValueConverter valueToTextConverter = maskInfo.MaskEditor.ValueToTextConverter;
				if (valueToTextConverter != null)
				{
					return valueToTextConverter.ConvertBack(text, maskInfo.DataType, maskInfo.MaskEditor, maskInfo.CultureInfo);
				}
			}
			try
			{
				if (typeof(DateTime) == dataType)
				{
					return GetDateTimeValue(sections);
				}
				if (typeof(double) == dataType)
				{
					return GetDoubleValue(sections, maskInfo);
				}
				if (typeof(float) == dataType)
				{
					return GetFloatValue(sections, maskInfo);
				}
				if (typeof(byte) == dataType || typeof(sbyte) == dataType || typeof(short) == dataType || typeof(ushort) == dataType || typeof(short) == dataType || typeof(int) == dataType || typeof(uint) == dataType || typeof(int) == dataType || typeof(long) == dataType || typeof(ulong) == dataType || typeof(long) == dataType)
				{
					return GetWholeNumberValue(sections, dataType, maskInfo);
				}
				if (typeof(decimal) == dataType)
				{
					return GetCurrencyValue(sections, maskInfo);
				}
				if (typeof(string) == dataType)
				{
					return GetText(sections, maskInfo.DataMode, maskInfo);
				}
				TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(dataType);
				if (converter.CanConvertFrom(typeof(string)))
				{
					string text2 = GetText(maskInfo.Sections, maskInfo.DataMode, maskInfo);
					return converter.ConvertFromString(null, maskInfo.CultureInfo, text2);
				}
				throw new ArgumentException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_2", dataType.Name), "dataType");
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_5"), innerException);
			}
		}

		internal static SectionBase GetSection(SectionsCollection sections, Type sectionType)
		{
			int index = 0;
			return GetSection(sections, sectionType, ref index);
		}

		internal static SectionBase GetSection(SectionsCollection sections, Type sectionType, ref int index)
		{
			if (sections == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int i = index;
			for (int count = sections.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				Type type = sections[i].GetType();
				if (sectionType.IsAssignableFrom(type))
				{
					index = 2;
					return sections[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static bool HasNonDateTimeEditSections(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = sections.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (sections[i] is EditSectionBase editSection && !IsDateTimeSection(editSection))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsDateTimeSection(EditSectionBase editSection)
		{
			if (!(editSection is YearSection) && !(editSection is MonthSection) && !(editSection is DaySection) && !(editSection is HourSection) && !(editSection is MinuteSection) && !(editSection is SecondSection))
			{
				return editSection is AMPMSection;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void PadFractionPartHelper(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			FractionPart fractionPart = (FractionPart)GetSection(sections, typeof(FractionPart));
			if (fractionPart != null)
			{
				if (fractionPart is FractionPartContinuous || !TrimFractionalZeros)
				{
					fractionPart.PadWithZero();
				}
				else if (TrimFractionalZeros)
				{
					fractionPart.TrimInsignificantZeros();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void SetDateTimeValue(SectionsCollection sections, DateTime date, MaskInfo maskInfo, bool retainOriginalTime)
		{
			HourSection hourSection = null;
			MinuteSection minuteSection = null;
			SecondSection secondSection = null;
			MonthSection monthSection = null;
			DaySection daySection = null;
			YearSection yearSection = null;
			AMPMSection aMPMSection = null;
			EraSection eraSection = null;
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = sections.Calendar;
			monthSection = (MonthSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(MonthSection));
			daySection = (DaySection)GetSection(sections, typeof(DaySection));
			yearSection = (YearSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(YearSection));
			hourSection = (HourSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(HourSection));
			minuteSection = (MinuteSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(MinuteSection));
			secondSection = (SecondSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(SecondSection));
			aMPMSection = (AMPMSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(AMPMSection));
			eraSection = (EraSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(EraSection));
			if (yearSection != null || monthSection != null || daySection != null || hourSection != null || eraSection != null || minuteSection != null || secondSection != null)
			{
				if (eraSection != null)
				{
					string eraName;
					if (eraSection.DisplayChars.Count == 1)
					{
						EraSupportUtils.TryGetAbbreviatedEraName(maskInfo.FormatProvider, calendar.GetEra(date), out eraName);
					}
					else
					{
						EraSupportUtils.TryGetEraName(maskInfo.FormatProvider, calendar.GetEra(date), out eraName);
					}
					if (!eraName.Equals(eraSection.GetText()))
					{
						eraSection.SetText(eraName);
						eraSection.MaskedEdit.NotifyDisplayCharDrawStringsChanged();
					}
				}
				if (yearSection != null)
				{
					yearSection.SetText(calendar.GetYear(date).ToString().PadLeft(yearSection.NumberOfDigits, '0'));
				}
				else if (maskInfo != null)
				{
					maskInfo.DefaultYear = calendar.GetYear(date);
				}
				monthSection?.SetText(calendar.GetMonth(date).ToString().PadLeft(monthSection.NumberOfDigits, '0'));
				daySection?.SetText(calendar.GetDayOfMonth(date).ToString().PadLeft(daySection.NumberOfDigits, '0'));
				if (retainOriginalTime)
				{
					return;
				}
				aMPMSection?.SetText((date.Hour >= 12) ? aMPMSection.PMValue : aMPMSection.AMValue);
				if (hourSection != null)
				{
					if (aMPMSection != null)
					{
						int num = date.Hour;
						if (num == 0)
						{
							num = 12;
						}
						if (num > 12)
						{
							num -= 12;
						}
						hourSection.SetText(num.ToString());
					}
					else
					{
						hourSection.SetText(date.Hour.ToString());
					}
				}
				minuteSection?.SetText(date.Minute.ToString());
				secondSection?.SetText(date.Second.ToString());
				return;
			}
			if (retainOriginalTime)
			{
				try
				{
					DateTime dateTimeValue = GetDateTimeValue(sections);
					date = date.Date.Add(dateTimeValue.TimeOfDay);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			SetText(sections, date.ToString(maskInfo.Format, maskInfo.FormatProvider), maskInfo);
		}

		internal static void SetTimeSpanValue(SectionsCollection sections, TimeSpan time, MaskInfo maskInfo)
		{
			HourSection hourSection = null;
			MinuteSection minuteSection = null;
			SecondSection secondSection = null;
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = sections.Calendar;
			hourSection = (HourSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(HourSection));
			minuteSection = (MinuteSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(MinuteSection));
			secondSection = (SecondSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(SecondSection));
			if (hourSection != null || minuteSection != null || secondSection != null)
			{
				hourSection?.SetText(time.Hours.ToString());
				minuteSection?.SetText(time.Minutes.ToString());
				secondSection?.SetText(time.Seconds.ToString());
			}
			else
			{
				SetText(sections, time.ToString(maskInfo.Format, maskInfo.FormatProvider), maskInfo);
			}
		}

		private static void SetCurrencyValue(SectionsCollection sections, decimal val, MaskInfo maskInfo)
		{
			NumberSection numberSection = (NumberSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(NumberSection));
			FractionPart fractionPart = (FractionPart)GetSection(sections, typeof(FractionPart));
			if (numberSection != null || fractionPart != null)
			{
				EraseAllChars(sections);
				val = Math.Round(val, fractionPart?.DisplayChars.Count ?? 0);
				XamMaskedEditor maskEditor = maskInfo.MaskEditor;
				bool autoExpand = maskEditor != null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(maskEditor.Mask);
				decimal num = val;
				decimal num2 = 0.0m;
				if (val >= 0.0m)
				{
					num = decimal.Floor(val);
					num2 = val - num;
					numberSection?.SetText(num.ToString(), autoExpand);
					fractionPart?.SetFractionValue((double)num2);
					return;
				}
				num = decimal.Floor(val);
				if (num != val)
				{
					++num;
					num2 = -val + num;
				}
				numberSection?.SetText((0.0m == num) ? "-0" : num.ToString(), autoExpand);
				fractionPart?.SetFractionValue((double)num2);
			}
			else
			{
				string text = val.ToString(maskInfo.Format, maskInfo.FormatProvider);
				if (text.Length > 2 && text.StartsWith("0."))
				{
					text = text.Remove(0, 1);
				}
				SetText(sections, text, maskInfo);
				maskInfo.MaskEditor.PadFractionPartHelper(sections);
			}
		}

		private static void SetDoubleValue(SectionsCollection sections, double val, MaskInfo maskInfo)
		{
			NumberSection numberSection = (NumberSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(NumberSection));
			FractionPart fractionPart = (FractionPart)GetSection(sections, typeof(FractionPart));
			if (numberSection != null || fractionPart != null)
			{
				EraseAllChars(sections);
				if (Utils.IsInfinityOrNaN(val))
				{
					return;
				}
				XamMaskedEditor maskEditor = maskInfo.MaskEditor;
				bool autoExpand = maskEditor != null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(maskEditor.Mask);
				Utils.RoundAndSplitHelper(val, fractionPart?.DisplayChars.Count ?? 0, out var integerPart, out var fractionPart2);
				if (numberSection != null)
				{
					if (val >= 0.0)
					{
						numberSection.SetText(integerPart.ToString("G28"), autoExpand);
					}
					else
					{
						numberSection.SetText((0.0 == integerPart) ? "-0" : integerPart.ToString("G28"), autoExpand);
					}
				}
				fractionPart?.SetFractionValue(fractionPart2);
			}
			else
			{
				string text = val.ToString(maskInfo.Format, maskInfo.FormatProvider);
				if (text.Length > 2 && text.StartsWith("0."))
				{
					text = text.Remove(0, 1);
				}
				SetText(sections, text, maskInfo);
				maskInfo.MaskEditor.PadFractionPartHelper(sections);
			}
		}

		private static void SetFloatValue(SectionsCollection sections, float val, MaskInfo maskInfo)
		{
			SetDoubleValue(sections, val, maskInfo);
		}

		internal static bool SetDataValue(SectionsCollection sections, Type dataType, object val, MaskInfo maskInfo)
		{
			try
			{
				dataType = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(dataType);
				return SetDataValueHelper(sections, dataType, val, maskInfo);
			}
			finally
			{
				ValidateAllSections(sections);
			}
		}

		internal static bool SetDataValueHelper(SectionsCollection sections, Type dataType, object val, MaskInfo maskInfo)
		{
			if (ShouldUseValueToTextConverter(maskInfo))
			{
				IValueConverter valueToTextConverter = maskInfo.MaskEditor.ValueToTextConverter;
				if (valueToTextConverter != null)
				{
					string text = (string)valueToTextConverter.ConvertBack(val, typeof(string), maskInfo.MaskEditor, maskInfo.CultureInfo);
					SetText(sections, text, maskInfo);
					ValidateAllSections(sections);
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (val == null || val is DBNull)
			{
				SetText(sections, "", maskInfo);
				return true;
			}
			if (!SupportsDataType(dataType))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_2", dataType.Name), "dataType");
			}
			if (val.GetType() != dataType)
			{
				val = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(val, dataType, maskInfo.FormatProvider, maskInfo.Format);
			}
			bool result = true;
			if (typeof(DateTime) == dataType)
			{
				SetDateTimeValue(sections, (DateTime)val, maskInfo, retainOriginalTime: false);
			}
			else if (typeof(TimeSpan) == dataType)
			{
				SetTimeSpanValue(sections, (TimeSpan)val, maskInfo);
			}
			else if (typeof(decimal) == dataType)
			{
				SetCurrencyValue(sections, (decimal)val, maskInfo);
			}
			else if (typeof(double) == dataType)
			{
				SetDoubleValue(sections, (double)val, maskInfo);
			}
			else if (typeof(float) == dataType)
			{
				SetFloatValue(sections, (float)val, maskInfo);
			}
			else if (typeof(string) == dataType)
			{
				string text2 = (string)val;
				int num = SetText(sections, text2, maskInfo);
				if (text2 != null && num < text2.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (typeof(byte) == dataType || typeof(sbyte) == dataType || typeof(short) == dataType || typeof(ushort) == dataType || typeof(short) == dataType || typeof(int) == dataType || typeof(uint) == dataType || typeof(int) == dataType || typeof(long) == dataType || typeof(ulong) == dataType || typeof(long) == dataType)
			{
				string text3 = val.ToString();
				int num2 = SetText(sections, text3, maskInfo);
				if (text3 != null && num2 < text3.Length)
				{
					result = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(dataType);
				if (converter == null || !converter.CanConvertTo(typeof(string)))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_2", dataType.Name), "dataType");
				}
				string text4 = converter.ConvertToString(null, maskInfo.CultureInfo, val);
				int num3 = SetText(sections, text4, maskInfo.PromptChar, maskInfo.PadChar, skipDigitSeparator: false);
				if (text4 != null && num3 < text4.Length)
				{
					result = false;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static bool ValidateAllSections(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			return ValidateAllSections(sections, loosingFocus: false);
		}

		internal bool IsInputValid(SectionsCollection sections, out string maskValidationErrorMessage)
		{
			maskValidationErrorMessage = null;
			if (base.IsNullable && AreAllDisplayCharsEmpty(sections))
			{
				return true;
			}
			sections = sections.Clone(sections.MaskInfo, copyDisplayCharacterValues: true);
			ValidateAllSections(sections, loosingFocus: true);
			for (int i = 0; i < sections.Count; i++)
			{
				EditSectionBase editSectionBase = sections[i] as EditSectionBase;
				if (editSectionBase != null && typeof(NumberSection) == editSectionBase.GetType())
				{
					NumberSection numberSection = (NumberSection)editSectionBase;
					string text = numberSection.GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
					if (!numberSection.ValidateAgainstMinMaxHelper(text, out var error))
					{
						maskValidationErrorMessage = error;
						return false;
					}
					if (text == null || text.Length == 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (editSectionBase != null && !editSectionBase.ValidateSection(contentModificationsAllowed: false))
				{
					maskValidationErrorMessage = ValueEditor.GetString("MaskValidationErrorInputDoesNotMatchMask");
					return false;
				}
			}
			MonthSection monthSection = GetSection(sections, typeof(MonthSection)) as MonthSection;
			DaySection daySection = GetSection(sections, typeof(DaySection)) as DaySection;
			YearSection yearSection = GetSection(sections, typeof(YearSection)) as YearSection;
			if (monthSection != null && daySection != null)
			{
				int num = monthSection.ToInt();
				int num2 = daySection.ToInt();
				if (2 == num && num2 > 29)
				{
					maskValidationErrorMessage = ValueEditor.GetString("MaskValidationErrorInvalidDate");
					return false;
				}
				int num3 = 30 + (num + ((num >= 8) ? 1 : 0)) % 2;
				if (num2 > num3)
				{
					maskValidationErrorMessage = ValueEditor.GetString("MaskValidationErrorInvalidDayOfMonth");
					return false;
				}
				if (yearSection != null)
				{
					int year = yearSection.GetYear();
					EraSection eraSection = GetSection(sections, typeof(EraSection)) as EraSection;
					System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = sections.Calendar;
					int num4 = ((eraSection == null) ? calendar.GetDaysInMonth(year, num) : calendar.GetDaysInMonth(year, num, eraSection.GetEra()));
					if (num2 > num4)
					{
						maskValidationErrorMessage = ValueEditor.GetString("MaskValidationErrorInvalidDayOfMonth");
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			maskValidationErrorMessage = null;
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool ValidateAllSections(SectionsCollection sections, bool loosingFocus)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < sections.Count; i++)
			{
				EditSectionBase editSectionBase = sections[i] as EditSectionBase;
				if (editSectionBase != null)
				{
					flag = flag && editSectionBase.ValidateSection();
				}
				if (!(editSectionBase is FractionPart))
				{
					continue;
				}
				NumberSection numberSection = editSectionBase.PreviousEditSection as NumberSection;
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (numberSection != null)
				{
					string text = numberSection.GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
					if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					string text2 = editSectionBase.GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
					if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag2 && sections.MaskedEditor != null)
				{
					sections.MaskedEditor.PadFractionPartHelper(sections);
				}
			}
			if (loosingFocus)
			{
				AutoFillDate autoFillDate = sections.MaskedEditor.AutoFillDate;
				DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
				System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = sections.Calendar;
				MonthSection monthSection = (MonthSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(MonthSection));
				DaySection daySection = (DaySection)GetSection(sections, typeof(DaySection));
				YearSection yearSection = (YearSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(YearSection));
				if (monthSection != null && monthSection.IsEmpty && daySection != null && !daySection.IsEmpty && AutoFillDate.MonthAndYear == autoFillDate)
				{
					monthSection.SetText(calendar.GetMonth(now).ToString());
				}
				if (yearSection != null && yearSection.IsEmpty && monthSection != null && !monthSection.IsEmpty && (daySection == null || !daySection.IsEmpty) && (AutoFillDate.Year == autoFillDate || AutoFillDate.MonthAndYear == autoFillDate))
				{
					yearSection.SetText(calendar.GetYear(now).ToString());
				}
			}
			if (flag && loosingFocus && sections.MaskInfo != null && sections.MaskedEditor != null)
			{
				try
				{
					AMPMSection aMPMSection = (AMPMSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(AMPMSection));
					HourSection hourSection = (HourSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(HourSection));
					if (aMPMSection != null && hourSection != null && aMPMSection.IsEmpty && !hourSection.IsEmpty)
					{
						int num = hourSection.ToInt();
						if (num >= 12)
						{
							aMPMSection.SetText(aMPMSection.PMValue);
						}
						else
						{
							aMPMSection.SetText(aMPMSection.AMValue);
						}
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal static Type DeduceEditAsType(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			bool hasDateComponents;
			bool hasTimeComponents;
			return DeduceEditAsType(sections, out hasDateComponents, out hasTimeComponents);
		}

		internal static Type DeduceEditAsType(SectionsCollection sections, out bool hasDateComponents, out bool hasTimeComponents)
		{
			Type type = null;
			hasDateComponents = (hasTimeComponents = false);
			try
			{
				MonthSection monthSection = (MonthSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(MonthSection));
				DaySection daySection = (DaySection)GetSection(sections, typeof(DaySection));
				YearSection yearSection = (YearSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(YearSection));
				HourSection hourSection = (HourSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(HourSection));
				MinuteSection minuteSection = (MinuteSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(MinuteSection));
				SecondSection secondSection = (SecondSection)GetSection(sections, typeof(SecondSection));
				hasDateComponents = (monthSection != null && daySection != null) || (monthSection != null && yearSection != null);
				hasTimeComponents = hourSection != null && minuteSection != null;
				if (hasDateComponents | hasTimeComponents)
				{
					type = typeof(DateTime);
				}
				if (null == type)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					bool flag2 = false;
					bool flag3 = false;
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = sections.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						if (sections[i] is NumberSection || (flag3 && sections[i] is FractionPart))
						{
							if (!flag3)
							{
								if (flag)
								{
									flag = false;
									flag2 = false;
									break;
								}
								flag = true;
							}
							else
							{
								if (flag2)
								{
									flag = false;
									flag2 = false;
									break;
								}
								flag2 = true;
							}
						}
						else if (sections[i] is LiteralSection && 1 == sections[i].DisplayChars.Count)
						{
							if (sections[i].DecimalSeperatorChar == sections[i].DisplayChars[0].Char)
							{
								if (flag3)
								{
									flag = false;
									flag2 = false;
									break;
								}
								flag3 = true;
							}
							else if (sections[i].CommaChar != sections[i].DisplayChars[0].Char && flag)
							{
								flag = false;
								flag2 = false;
								break;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (flag || flag3)
							{
								flag = false;
								flag2 = false;
								break;
							}
							if (!(sections[i] is LiteralSection))
							{
								flag = false;
								flag2 = false;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					if (flag && flag2)
					{
						type = typeof(decimal);
					}
					else if (flag)
					{
						type = typeof(int);
					}
				}
				if (null == type && sections.Count > 0)
				{
					type = typeof(string);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			return type;
		}

		protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
			bool focused = (bool)e.NewValue;
			ProcessIsBeingEditedAndFocusedChanged(focused);
		}

		internal void ProcessIsBeingEditedAndFocusedChanged()
		{
			bool focused = MaskInfo?.IsBeingEditedAndFocused ?? false;
			ProcessIsBeingEditedAndFocusedChanged(focused);
		}

		private void ProcessIsBeingEditedAndFocusedChanged(bool focused)
		{
			if (base.IsInEditMode && EditInfo != null)
			{
				EditInfo.HookUnhookInputMethodHelper(focused);
				SectionsCollection sections = MaskInfo.Sections;
				if (sections != null)
				{
					foreach (SectionBase item in sections)
					{
						foreach (DisplayCharBase displayChar in item.DisplayChars)
						{
							displayChar.NotifyPropertyChangedEvent(DisplayCharBase.PROPERTY_DRAWSTRING);
							displayChar.NotifyPropertyChangedEvent(DisplayCharBase.PROPERTY_VISIBILITY);
							displayChar.NotifyPropertyChangedEvent(DisplayCharBase.PROPERTY_DRAWSELECTED);
						}
					}
					SyncDrawAsSelectedOnDisplayPresenters();
				}
				if (focused && HasOpenDropDown)
				{
					focused = false;
				}
				if (focused)
				{
					ShowHideCaretHelper();
					if (base.IsInEditMode && EditInfo != null)
					{
						EditInfo.ScrollDisplayCharIntoView(EditInfo.CaretPosition);
					}
					return;
				}
				if (EditInfo != null)
				{
					EditInfo.ValidateAllSections(loosingFocus: true);
					EditInfo.EnsureMaskEditAreaFilled();
				}
				ShowHideCaretHelper();
			}
			else
			{
				ShowHideCaretHelper();
			}
		}

		}

			}
		}

		}

		internal static NumberFormatInfo GetNumberFormatInfo(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			NumberFormatInfo numberFormatInfo = formatProvider as NumberFormatInfo;
			if (numberFormatInfo == null && formatProvider != null)
			{
				numberFormatInfo = (NumberFormatInfo)formatProvider.GetFormat(typeof(NumberFormatInfo));
			}
			if (numberFormatInfo == null)
			{
				CultureInfo defaultCultureInfo = DefaultCultureInfo;
				if (defaultCultureInfo != null)
				{
					numberFormatInfo = defaultCultureInfo.NumberFormat;
				}
			}
			return numberFormatInfo;
		}

		internal static DateTimeFormatInfo GetDateTimeFormatInfo(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = formatProvider as DateTimeFormatInfo;
			if (dateTimeFormatInfo == null && formatProvider != null)
			{
				dateTimeFormatInfo = (DateTimeFormatInfo)formatProvider.GetFormat(typeof(DateTimeFormatInfo));
			}
			if (dateTimeFormatInfo == null && DefaultCultureInfo != null)
			{
				dateTimeFormatInfo = DefaultCultureInfo.DateTimeFormat;
			}
			return dateTimeFormatInfo;
		}

		{
			if (section == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = section.DisplayChars;
			if (displayChars != null)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = displayChars.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = displayChars[i];
					displayCharBase.NotifyPropertyChangedEvent(propertyName);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static char GetCultureChar(char c, MaskInfo maskInfo)
		{
			bool useCurrencySymbols = maskInfo != null && typeof(decimal) == maskInfo.DataType;
			return GetCultureChar(c, maskInfo?.FormatProvider, useCurrencySymbols);
		}

		internal static char GetCultureChar(char c, IFormatProvider formatProvider, bool useCurrencySymbols)
		{
			NumberFormatInfo numberFormatInfo = GetNumberFormatInfo(formatProvider);
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = GetDateTimeFormatInfo(formatProvider);
			string text = null;
			switch (c)
			{
			case '.':
				text = (useCurrencySymbols ? numberFormatInfo.CurrencyDecimalSeparator : numberFormatInfo.NumberDecimalSeparator);
				break;
			case ',':
				text = (useCurrencySymbols ? numberFormatInfo.CurrencyGroupSeparator : numberFormatInfo.NumberGroupSeparator);
				break;
			case ':':
				text = dateTimeFormatInfo.TimeSeparator;
				break;
			case '/':
				text = dateTimeFormatInfo.DateSeparator;
				break;
			case '+':
				text = numberFormatInfo.PositiveSign;
				break;
			case '-':
				text = numberFormatInfo.NegativeSign;
				break;
			case '$':
				text = numberFormatInfo.CurrencySymbol;
				break;
			}
			if (text == null || text.Length <= 0)
			{
				return c;
			}
			return text[0];
		}

		private static char GetChar(string value, int position)
		{
			if (value == null || value.Length <= position)
			{
				return '\0';
			}
			return value[position];
		}

		internal static int GetNumberSectionCount(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (SectionBase section in sections)
			{
				if (IsSectionNumeric(section))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static string GetCultureAMPMDesignator(bool am, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = GetDateTimeFormatInfo(formatProvider);
			if (!am)
			{
				return dateTimeFormatInfo.PMDesignator;
			}
			return dateTimeFormatInfo.AMDesignator;
		}

		internal void IllegalOperation(string message)
		{
			InvalidOperationEventArgs e = new InvalidOperationEventArgs(message);
			OnInvalidOperation(e);

				Beep();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSpinButtonVisibility()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (!base.IsReadOnly)
			{
				switch (SpinButtonDisplayMode)
				{
				case SpinButtonDisplayMode.Always:
					flag = true;
					break;
				case SpinButtonDisplayMode.Focused:
					flag = base.IsInEditMode || base.IsFocusWithin;
					break;
				case SpinButtonDisplayMode.OnlyInEditMode:
					flag = base.IsInEditMode;
					break;
				case SpinButtonDisplayMode.MouseOver:
					flag = base.IsInEditMode || base.IsMouseOver;
					break;
				}
			}
			SetValue(SpinButtonVisibilityResolvedPropertyKey, flag ? KnownBoxes.VisibilityVisibleBox : KnownBoxes.VisibilityCollapsedBox);
		}

		private bool TryFastSyncOnValueChanged(object newValue, out Exception error)
		{
			error = null;
			MaskInfo maskInfo = MaskInfo;
			Type defaultTypeForSyncTextFromValue = maskInfo.GetDefaultTypeForSyncTextFromValue(newValue);
			if (defaultTypeForSyncTextFromValue == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BeginSyncValueProperties();
			try
			{
				bool flag = base.ValueToTextConverterResolved is MaskedEditorDefaultConverter;
				string text = null;
				if (flag || ConvertValueToText(newValue, out text, out error))
				{
					SetDataValueHelper(maskInfo.Sections, defaultTypeForSyncTextFromValue, newValue, maskInfo);
					if (flag)
					{
						text = GetText(maskInfo.Sections, maskInfo.DataMode, maskInfo);
					}
					SetValue(ValueEditor.TextProperty, text);
					if (maskInfo.Format == null && base.ValueToDisplayTextConverterResolved is MaskedEditorDefaultConverter)
					{
						string text2 = GetText(maskInfo.Sections, maskInfo.DisplayMode, maskInfo);
						SetValue(TextEditorBase.DisplayTextPropertyKey, text);
					}
					else
					{
						SyncDisplayText();
					}
					_skipNextMaskValidation = true;
					return true;
				}
				SetIsValueValid(isValueValid: false, error);
				return false;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				EndSyncValueProperties();
			}
		}

		public static void RegisterDefaultMaskForType(Type dataType, string mask)
		{
			lock (g_defaultMaskTable)
			{
				if (mask != null && mask.Length > 0)
				{
					g_defaultMaskTable[dataType] = mask;
					g_defaultMaskTableInitialized = true;
				}
				else if (g_defaultMaskTable.ContainsKey(dataType))
				{
					g_defaultMaskTable.Remove(dataType);
					if (g_defaultMaskTable.Count == 0)
					{
						g_defaultMaskTableInitialized = false;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static void ResetDefaultMaskForType(Type dataType)
		{
			RegisterDefaultMaskForType(dataType, null);
		}

		public static string GetDefaultMaskForType(Type dataType)
		{
			MaskDefaultType maskDefaultType;
			return GetDefaultMaskForType(dataType, out maskDefaultType);
		}

		private static string GetDefaultMaskForType(Type dataType, out MaskDefaultType maskDefaultType)
		{
			maskDefaultType = MaskDefaultType.None;
			if (g_defaultMaskTableInitialized)
			{
				lock (g_defaultMaskTable)
				{
					if (g_defaultMaskTable[dataType] is string { Length: >0 } text)
					{
						return text;
					}
				}
			}
			return GetDefaultMaskForTypeHelper(dataType, out maskDefaultType);
		}

		private static string GetDefaultMaskForTypeHelper(Type type, out MaskDefaultType maskDefaultType)
		{
			maskDefaultType = MaskDefaultType.None;
			type = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(type);
			string result = null;
			if (typeof(DateTime) == type)
			{
				result = "{date}";
				maskDefaultType = MaskDefaultType.DateTime;
			}
			else if (typeof(byte) == type)
			{
				result = "{number:0-255}";
				maskDefaultType = MaskDefaultType.Byte;
			}
			else if (typeof(sbyte) == type)
			{
				result = "{number:-128-127}";
				maskDefaultType = MaskDefaultType.SByte;
			}
			else if (typeof(short) == type)
			{
				result = "{number:-32768-32767}";
				maskDefaultType = MaskDefaultType.Int16;
			}
			else if (typeof(ushort) == type)
			{
				result = "{number:0-65535}";
				maskDefaultType = MaskDefaultType.UInt16;
			}
			else if (typeof(int) == type)
			{
				result = "{number:-2147483648-2147483647}";
				maskDefaultType = MaskDefaultType.Int32;
			}
			else if (typeof(uint) == type)
			{
				result = "{number:0-4294967295}";
				maskDefaultType = MaskDefaultType.UInt32;
			}
			else if (typeof(long) == type)
			{
				result = "{number:-9223372036854775808-9223372036854775807}";
				maskDefaultType = MaskDefaultType.Int64;
			}
			else if (typeof(ulong) == type)
			{
				result = "{number:0-18446744073709551615}";
				maskDefaultType = MaskDefaultType.UInt64;
			}
			else if (typeof(decimal) == type)
			{
				result = "{currency}";
				maskDefaultType = MaskDefaultType.Currency;
			}
			else if (typeof(double) == type || typeof(float) == type)
			{
				result = "{double}";
				maskDefaultType = ((typeof(double) == type) ? MaskDefaultType.Double : MaskDefaultType.Float);
			}
			else if (typeof(string) == type)
			{
				result = new string('&', 64);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool SupportsDataType(Type dataType)
		{
			bool usesConverter;
			return SupportsDataType(dataType, out usesConverter);
		}

		internal static bool SupportsDataType(Type dataType, out bool usesConverter)
		{
			usesConverter = false;
			Type type = dataType;
			if (null == type)
			{
				return false;
			}
			type = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(type);
			if (!(typeof(DateTime) == type) && !(typeof(short) == type) && !(typeof(int) == type) && !(typeof(long) == type) && !(typeof(ushort) == type) && !(typeof(uint) == type) && !(typeof(ulong) == type) && !(typeof(short) == type) && !(typeof(int) == type) && !(typeof(long) == type) && !(typeof(byte) == type) && !(typeof(sbyte) == type) && !(typeof(decimal) == type) && !(typeof(string) == type) && !(typeof(double) == type) && !(typeof(float) == type))
			{
				TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(dataType);
				if (converter.CanConvertFrom(typeof(string)) && converter.CanConvertTo(typeof(string)))
				{
					usesConverter = true;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static string CalcDefaultTimeMask(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = GetDateTimeFormatInfo(formatProvider);
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			string shortTimePattern = dateTimeFormatInfo.ShortTimePattern;
			char cultureChar = GetCultureChar(':', formatProvider);
			if (cultureChar == g_lastTimeSeparator && shortTimePattern == g_lastShortTimePattern)
			{
				return g_lastDefaultTimeMask;
			}
			if (shortTimePattern != null && shortTimePattern.Length > 0)
			{
				flag = shortTimePattern.IndexOfAny(new char[2] { 's', 'S' }) >= 0;
				flag2 = shortTimePattern.IndexOfAny(new char[2] { 't', 'T' }) >= 0;
			}
			string text = (flag ? "hh:mm:ss" : "hh:mm");
			if (flag2)
			{
				text += " tt";
			}
			text = (g_lastDefaultTimeMask = text.Replace(':', cultureChar));
			g_lastShortTimePattern = shortTimePattern;
			g_lastTimeSeparator = cultureChar;
			return text;
		}

		public static string CalcDefaultLongTimeMask(IFormatProvider formatProvider)

			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = GetDateTimeFormatInfo(formatProvider);
			bool flag = false;

			if (longTimePattern != null && longTimePattern.Length > 0)
			{
				flag = longTimePattern.IndexOfAny(new char[2] { 's', 'S' }) >= 0;
				flag2 = longTimePattern.IndexOfAny(new char[2] { 't', 'T' }) >= 0;

		}

		public static string CalcDefaultDateMask(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			return CalcDefaultDateMask(formatProvider, usePostfixSeparatorsFromLongDatePattern: true);
		}

		public static string CalcDefaultDateMask(IFormatProvider formatProvider, bool usePostfixSeparatorsFromLongDatePattern)
		{
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = GetDateTimeFormatInfo(formatProvider);
			string shortDatePattern = dateTimeFormatInfo.ShortDatePattern;
			string text = null;
			char cultureChar = GetCultureChar('/', formatProvider);
			if (cultureChar == g_lastDateSeparator && shortDatePattern == g_lastShortDatePattern && formatProvider == g_lastDateFormatProvider && usePostfixSeparatorsFromLongDatePattern == g_lastUsePostfixSeparatorsFromLongDatePattern)
			{
				return g_lastDefaultDateMask;
			}
			if (shortDatePattern != null && shortDatePattern.Length > 0)
			{
				int num = shortDatePattern.IndexOfAny(new char[2] { 'm', 'M' });
				int num2 = shortDatePattern.IndexOfAny(new char[2] { 'd', 'D' });
				int num3 = shortDatePattern.IndexOfAny(new char[2] { 'y', 'Y' });
				int num4 = shortDatePattern.LastIndexOfAny(new char[2] { 'y', 'Y' }) - num3;
				string text2 = ((num4 > 2) ? "yyyy" : "yy");
				if (usePostfixSeparatorsFromLongDatePattern)
				{
					Hashtable foreignDateSymbols = null;
					text = GetNonstandardForeignDateMaskAndPostfixSymbols(dateTimeFormatInfo, ref foreignDateSymbols);
				}
				if (text == null || text.Length == 0)
				{
					if (num <= num2 && num <= num3)
					{
						text = ((num2 >= num3) ? ("mm/" + text2 + "/dd") : ("mm/dd/" + text2));
					}
					else if (num2 <= num && num2 <= num3)
					{
						text = ((num >= num3) ? ("dd/" + text2 + "/mm") : ("dd/mm/" + text2));
					}
					else if (num3 <= num && num3 <= num2)
					{
						text = ((num >= num2) ? (text2 + "/dd/mm") : (text2 + "/mm/dd"));
					}
				}
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = "mm/dd/yyyy";
			}
			text = text.Replace('/', cultureChar);
			if (dateTimeFormatInfo.LongDatePattern.Contains("gg"))
			{
				text = text.Insert(dateTimeFormatInfo.LongDatePattern.IndexOf("gg"), "gg ");
			}
			g_lastDefaultDateMask = text;
			g_lastShortDatePattern = shortDatePattern;
			g_lastDateSeparator = cultureChar;
			g_lastDateFormatProvider = formatProvider;
			g_lastUsePostfixSeparatorsFromLongDatePattern = usePostfixSeparatorsFromLongDatePattern;
			return text;
		}

		public static string CalcDefaultCurrencyMask(IFormatProvider formatProvider, int integerDigits, int fractionDigits, char allowNegatives, bool includeCurrencySymbol)
		{
			NumberFormatInfo numberFormatInfo = GetNumberFormatInfo(formatProvider);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(15);
			int currencyPositivePattern = numberFormatInfo.CurrencyPositivePattern;
			bool flag = currencyPositivePattern > 1;
			bool flag2 = currencyPositivePattern % 2 == 0;
			if (flag2 && includeCurrencySymbol)
			{
				MaskParser.EscapeLiteralsInString(numberFormatInfo.CurrencySymbol, out var escapedString);
				stringBuilder.Append(escapedString);
				if (flag)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(' ');
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int[] currencyGroupSizes = numberFormatInfo.CurrencyGroupSizes;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = new StringBuilder(15);
			if (integerDigits < 0)
			{
				integerDigits = 9;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < integerDigits; i++)
			{
				int num3 = 0;
				num3 = ((num >= currencyGroupSizes.Length) ? currencyGroupSizes[currencyGroupSizes.Length - 1] : currencyGroupSizes[num]);
				if (i == num2 + num3)
				{
					num2 = i;
					stringBuilder2.Append(',');
					num++;
				}
				stringBuilder2.Append('n');
			}
			if ('-' == allowNegatives || '+' == allowNegatives)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(allowNegatives);
			}
			for (int num4 = stringBuilder2.Length - 1; num4 >= 0; num4--)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(stringBuilder2[num4]);
			}
			if (fractionDigits < 0)
			{
				fractionDigits = numberFormatInfo.CurrencyDecimalDigits;
			}
			if (fractionDigits > 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append('.');
				stringBuilder.Append(new string('n', fractionDigits));
			}
			if (!flag2 && includeCurrencySymbol)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(' ');
				}
				MaskParser.EscapeLiteralsInString(numberFormatInfo.CurrencySymbol, out var escapedString2);
				stringBuilder.Append(escapedString2);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
