		internal static bool IsMaskValidForDataType(Type dataType, string mask, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			if (mask == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			MaskInfo maskInfo = new MaskInfo();
			maskInfo.InitializeFormatProvider(formatProvider, null);
			MaskParser.Parse(mask, out var sections, maskInfo.FormatProvider);
			sections.Initialize(maskInfo);
			return IsMaskValidForDataType(dataType, sections);
		}

		internal static bool IsMaskValidForDataType(Type dataType, SectionsCollection parsedSections)
		{
			Type underlyingType = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(dataType);
			if (typeof(DateTime) == underlyingType)
			{
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = 0;
				int num4 = 0;
				int num5 = 0;
				int num6 = 0;
				int num7 = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < parsedSections.Count; i++)
				{
					SectionBase sectionBase = parsedSections[i];
					if (sectionBase is DaySection)
					{
						num2++;
					}
					else if (sectionBase is YearSection)
					{
						num3++;
					}
					else if (sectionBase is MonthSection)
					{
						num++;
					}
					else if (sectionBase is MinuteSection)
					{
						num4++;
					}
					else if (sectionBase is HourSection)
					{
						num5++;
					}
					else if (sectionBase is SecondSection)
					{
						num6++;
					}
					else if (sectionBase is AMPMSection)
					{
						num7++;
					}
					else if (!(sectionBase is LiteralSection))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return num <= 1 && num2 <= 1 && num3 <= 1 && num5 <= 1 && num4 <= 1 && num6 <= 1 && num7 <= 1 && (1 == num || 1 == num2 || 1 == num3 || 1 == num5);
			}
			if (typeof(byte) == underlyingType || typeof(sbyte) == underlyingType || typeof(short) == underlyingType || typeof(ushort) == underlyingType || typeof(short) == underlyingType || typeof(int) == underlyingType || typeof(uint) == underlyingType || typeof(int) == underlyingType || typeof(long) == underlyingType || typeof(ulong) == underlyingType || typeof(long) == underlyingType)
			{
				int num8 = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < parsedSections.Count; j++)
				{
					if (IsSectionNumeric(parsedSections[j]))
					{
						num8++;
					}
					if (num8 >= 2)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				return 1 == num8;
			}
			if (typeof(double) == underlyingType || typeof(float) == underlyingType || typeof(decimal) == underlyingType)
			{
				SectionBase sectionBase2 = null;
				SectionBase sectionBase3 = null;
				bool flag = false;
				for (int k = 0; k < parsedSections.Count; k++)
				{
					if (IsSectionNumeric(parsedSections[k]))
					{
						if (!flag)
						{
							sectionBase2 = parsedSections[k];
							continue;
						}
						if (sectionBase3 != null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						sectionBase3 = parsedSections[k];
					}
					else if (parsedSections[k] is LiteralSection && 1 == parsedSections[k].DisplayChars.Count && parsedSections[k].CommaChar == parsedSections[k].DisplayChars[0].Char)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return false;
						}
						sectionBase2 = null;
					}
					else if (parsedSections[k] is LiteralSection && 1 == parsedSections[k].DisplayChars.Count && parsedSections[k].DecimalSeperatorChar == parsedSections[k].DisplayChars[0].Char)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					else if ((sectionBase2 != null || sectionBase3 != null || flag) && !(parsedSections[k] is LiteralSection))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (sectionBase2 == null)
				{
					return sectionBase3 != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (typeof(string) == underlyingType)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void InternalSetIsTextBoxEntryEnabled(bool value)
		{
			if (IsTextBoxEntryEnabled == value)
			{
				return;
			}
			_resetIsTextBoxEntryEnabledWhenEditModeEnds = false;
			if (!value && base.IsInEditMode)
			{
				_resetIsTextBoxEntryEnabledWhenEditModeEnds = true;
				return;
			}
			bool isKeyboardFocusWithin = base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
			if (isKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				Focus();
			}
			SetValue(IsTextBoxEntryEnabledPropertyKey, value);
			ShowHideCaretHelper();
			isKeyboardFocusWithin = isKeyboardFocusWithin && base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
			if (base.IsInEditMode && isKeyboardFocusWithin && !_isInEndEditMode)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Input, new Utils.MethodInvoker(DelayedSetFocusToFocusSiteHelper));
				ShowHideCaretHelper();
			}
		}

		private void DelayedSetFocusToFocusSiteHelper()
		{
			if (base.IsInEditMode && !_isInEndEditMode)
			{
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(DispatcherPriority.Input, new Utils.MethodInvoker(base.SetFocusToFocusSite));
			}
		}

		}

		protected override void OnEditModeStarted(EditModeStartedEventArgs args)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			TextBox textBox = ((_editInfo != null) ? _editInfo._imeTextBox : null);
			if (textBox != null && textBox.IsKeyboardFocused)
			{
				flag = IsTextBoxEntryEnabled;
				InputMethod current = InputMethod.Current;
				if (current == null || current.ImeState == InputMethodState.Off)
				{
					Focus();
				}
			}
			EditInfo editInfo = EditInfo;
			if (editInfo != null && _transitingIntoEditModeInMouseDown)
			{
				object value = base.Value;
				bool flag2 = value == null || DBNull.Value == value || (value is string && ((string)value).Length == 0);
				bool flag3 = base.Format != null;
				if (flag3 || flag2)
				{
					editInfo.SetCaretPivot(0);
				}
				else
				{
					VerifyElementsPositioned();
					editInfo.MaskedEditUIElementClicked(_transitingIntoEditModeInMouseDownPoint, flag);
					CaptureMouse();
					if (base.IsMouseCaptured)
					{
						_isDragSelecting = true;
					}
				}
				_transitingIntoEditModeInMouseDown = false;
				ProcessIsBeingEditedAndFocusedChanged();
			}
			base.OnEditModeStarted(args);
			if (_editInfo != null)
			{
				_editInfo.SyncCaretAndPivotsWithMaskedEditor();
				ProcessSelectionChanged();
				if (flag && _editInfo._imeTextBox != null)
				{
					_editInfo._imeTextBox.Focus();
				}
			}
			if (MaskInfo != null && MaskInfo.IsBeingEditedAndFocused)
			{
				ShowHideCaretHelper();
				if (_editInfo != null)
				{
					_editInfo.ScrollCaretIntoView();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEditModeEnded(EditModeEndedEventArgs args)
		{
			EditInfo editInfo = _editInfo;
			base.OnEditModeEnded(args);
			ShowHideCaretHelper();
			if (editInfo != null && editInfo == _editInfo)
			{
				DisposeEditInfo();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnExecutingCommand(ExecutingCommandEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEventHelper(args);
		}

		internal bool RaiseExecutingCommand(ExecutingCommandEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = ExecutingCommandEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnExecutingCommand(args);
			return !args.Cancel;
		}

		protected virtual void OnExecutedCommand(ExecutedCommandEventArgs args)
		{
			RaiseEventHelper(args);
		}

		internal void RaiseExecutedCommand(ExecutedCommandEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = ExecutedCommandEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnExecutedCommand(args);
		}

		public bool ExecuteCommand(CommandWrapper commandWrapper)
		{
			if (commandWrapper == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("commandWrapper");
			}
			return ExecuteCommandImpl(commandWrapper.Command, null);
		}

		public bool ExecuteCommand(RoutedCommand command)
		{
			return ExecuteCommandImpl(command, null);
		}

		private bool ExecuteCommandImpl(RoutedCommand command, object commandParameter)
		{
			if (command == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("command");
			}
			if (!Commands<XamMaskedEditor>.IsMinimumStatePresentForCommand(this, command))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ExecutingCommandEventArgs e = new ExecutingCommandEventArgs(command);
			if (!RaiseExecutingCommand(e))
			{
				return !e.ContinueKeyRouting;
			}
			bool shift = (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) != 0;
			bool control = (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) != 0;
			bool flag = Keyboard.IsKeyDown(Key.Tab);
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (base.IsInEditMode && EditInfo != null && EditInfo.ExecuteCommandImpl(command, commandParameter, shift, control))
			{
				flag2 = true;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				RaiseExecutedCommand(new ExecutedCommandEventArgs(command));
			}
			return flag2;
		}

		protected override void OnTextInput(TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnTextInput(e);
			if (!e.Handled && base.IsInEditMode && EditInfo != null && e.Text != null && e.Text.Length > 0 && (e.Text.Length != 1 || e.Text[0] != '\t' || base.Value != null))

			}
		}

		long ICommandHost.GetCurrentState(long statesToQuery)
		{
			return (long)(EditInfo?.GetCurrentState((MaskedEditorStates)statesToQuery) ?? ((MaskedEditorStates)0L));
		}

		bool ICommandHost.CanExecute(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = commandInfo.RoutedCommand;
			object parameter = commandInfo.Parameter;
			if (base.IsInEditMode && EditInfo != null)
			{
				EditInfo editInfo = EditInfo;
				MaskedEditorStates currentState = editInfo.CurrentState;
				if (base.IsReadOnly && (MaskedEditorCommands.Delete == routedCommand || MaskedEditorCommands.Cut == routedCommand || MaskedEditorCommands.Paste == routedCommand || MaskedEditorCommands.Undo == routedCommand || MaskedEditorCommands.Redo == routedCommand))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (MaskedEditorCommands.Delete == routedCommand)
				{
					if ((MaskedEditorStates.AfterLastCharacter & currentState) == (MaskedEditorStates)0L || (MaskedEditorStates.Selected & currentState) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (MaskedEditorCommands.Copy == routedCommand)
				{
					if ((MaskedEditorStates.Selected & currentState) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (MaskedEditorCommands.Cut == routedCommand)
				{
					if ((MaskedEditorStates.Selected & currentState) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (MaskedEditorCommands.Paste == routedCommand)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (MaskedEditorCommands.SelectAll == routedCommand)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (MaskedEditorCommands.Undo == routedCommand)
					{
						if ((MaskedEditorStates.CanUndo & currentState) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					else if (MaskedEditorCommands.Redo == routedCommand)
					{
						if ((MaskedEditorStates.CanRedo & currentState) != (MaskedEditorStates)0L)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					else if ((MaskedEditorCommands.SpinDown == routedCommand || MaskedEditorCommands.SpinUp == routedCommand) && editInfo.CanSpin(MaskedEditorCommands.SpinUp == routedCommand, parameter))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				commandInfo.ContinueRouting = true;
			}
			if (MaskedEditorCommands.NotACommand == routedCommand)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (routedCommand != null)
			{
				return routedCommand.OwnerType == typeof(MaskedEditorCommands);
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool ICommandHost.Execute(ExecuteCommandInfo commandInfo)
		{
			RoutedCommand routedCommand = commandInfo.RoutedCommand;
			if (routedCommand != null)
			{
				return ExecuteCommandImpl(routedCommand, commandInfo.Parameter);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override Size MeasureOverride(Size availableSize)
		{
			s_defaultCultureInfo = null;
			if (!base.IsInEditMode && DependencyProperty.UnsetValue == ReadLocalValue(FrameworkElement.MinHeightProperty) && DependencyProperty.UnsetValue == ReadLocalValue(FrameworkElement.HeightProperty))
			{
				SimpleTextBlock simpleTextBlock = (SimpleTextBlock)Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, typeof(SimpleTextBlock), allowSubclassOfType: true);
				if (simpleTextBlock != null)
				{
					simpleTextBlock.MinHeight = Utils.GetLineHeight(this);
				}
				else
				{
					TextBlock textBlock = (TextBlock)Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, typeof(TextBlock), allowSubclassOfType: true);
					if (textBlock != null)
					{
						textBlock.MinHeight = Utils.GetLineHeight(this);
					}
				}
			}
			Size result = base.MeasureOverride(availableSize);
			if (CaretVisible)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = EditInfo.GetDisplayCharAtPosition(CaretPosition);
				if (displayCharBase == null)
				{
					displayCharBase = EditInfo.LastDisplayChar;
				}
				DisplayCharacterPresenter displayCharacterPresenter = GetDisplayCharacterPresenter(displayCharBase);
				if (displayCharacterPresenter != null)
				{
					Size desiredSize = displayCharacterPresenter.DesiredSize;
					desiredSize.Width = double.PositiveInfinity;
					CaretElement.Measure(desiredSize);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override Size ArrangeOverride(Size finalSize)
		{
			Size result = base.ArrangeOverride(finalSize);
			if (CaretVisible)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = EditInfo.GetDisplayCharAtPosition(CaretPosition);
				if (displayCharBase == null)
				{
					displayCharBase = EditInfo.LastDisplayChar;
					flag = false;
				}
				DisplayCharacterPresenter displayCharacterPresenter = GetDisplayCharacterPresenter(displayCharBase);
				if (displayCharacterPresenter != null)
				{
					Point point = new Point(0.0, 0.0);
					if (!flag)
					{
						point.X += displayCharacterPresenter.ActualWidth;
					}
					point = displayCharacterPresenter.TranslatePoint(point, this);
					Size desiredSize = CaretElement.DesiredSize;
					desiredSize.Height = displayCharacterPresenter.ActualHeight;
					Rect finalRect = new Rect(point, desiredSize);
					double num = finalSize.Height - finalRect.Top;
					if (finalRect.Height > num)
					{
						finalRect.Height = Math.Max(0.0, num);
					}
					CaretElement.Arrange(finalRect);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal Rect GetDisplayCharLocation(DisplayCharBase dc)
		{
			DisplayCharacterPresenter displayCharacterPresenter = GetDisplayCharacterPresenter(dc);
			if (displayCharacterPresenter != null)
			{
				Point location = displayCharacterPresenter.TranslatePoint(new Point(0.0, 0.0), this);
				Size size = new Size(displayCharacterPresenter.ActualWidth, displayCharacterPresenter.ActualHeight);
				return new Rect(location, size);
			}
			return Rect.Empty;
		}

		internal DisplayCharacterPresenter GetDisplayCharacterPresenter(DisplayCharBase dc)
		{
			Utilities.DependencyObjectSearchCallback<DisplayCharacterPresenter> callback = (DisplayCharacterPresenter presenter) => dc == presenter.DisplayCharacter;
			return Utilities.GetDescendantFromType(this, allowSubclassOfType: true, callback);
		}

		internal IList GetDisplayCharacterPresenters()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			if (base.IsInEditMode && MaskInfo != null)
			{
				foreach (DisplayCharBase allDisplayCharacter in MaskInfo.Sections.AllDisplayCharacters)
				{
					DisplayCharacterPresenter displayCharacterPresenter = GetDisplayCharacterPresenter(allDisplayCharacter);
					if (displayCharacterPresenter != null)
					{
						arrayList.Add(displayCharacterPresenter);
					}
				}
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		internal bool IsMouseOverTemplateChild(string templateChildName, MouseEventArgs mouseArgs, out DependencyObject templateChildElem)
		{
			templateChildElem = GetTemplateChild(templateChildName);
			if (templateChildElem != null && Utils.IsMouseOverElement(templateChildElem, mouseArgs))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void SyncDrawAsSelectedOnDisplayPresenters()
		{
			if (!base.IsInEditMode || EditInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DisplayCharacterPresenter displayCharacterPresenter in GetDisplayCharacterPresenters())
			{
				displayCharacterPresenter.SyncDrawAsSelected();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnContextMenuOpening(ContextMenuEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.IsInEditMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			ContextMenu contextMenu = base.ContextMenu;
			if (ReadLocalValue(FrameworkElement.ContextMenuProperty) == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (contextMenu != null)
			{
				contextMenu.Closed += OnContextMenuClosed;
				return;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = e.OriginalSource as UIElement;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = base.FocusSite as FrameworkElement;
			if (uIElement != null && frameworkElement != null)
			{
				Rect rect = new Rect(0.0, 0.0, frameworkElement.ActualWidth, frameworkElement.ActualHeight);
				Point point = uIElement.TranslatePoint(new Point(e.CursorLeft, e.CursorTop), frameworkElement);
				if (!rect.Contains(point))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			contextMenu = CreateContextMenu();
			contextMenu.Closed += OnContextMenuClosed;
			contextMenu.PlacementTarget = this;
			contextMenu.Placement = PlacementMode.RelativePoint;
			Point point2 = default(Point);
			if (e.OriginalSource is UIElement)
			{
				point2 = TranslatePoint(point2, e.OriginalSource as UIElement);
			}
			contextMenu.HorizontalOffset = e.CursorLeft - point2.X;
			contextMenu.VerticalOffset = e.CursorTop - point2.Y;
			contextMenu.IsOpen = true;
			e.Handled = true;
			_isDisplayingContextMenu = contextMenu.IsOpen;
			ProcessIsBeingEditedAndFocusedChanged();
		}

		private void OnContextMenuClosed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ContextMenu contextMenu = sender as ContextMenu;
			_isDisplayingContextMenu = false;
			ProcessIsBeingEditedAndFocusedChanged();
			if (contextMenu != null)
			{
				contextMenu.Closed -= OnContextMenuClosed;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDoubleClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseDoubleClick(e);
			if (EditInfo != null && Utils.IsMouseOverElement(this, e) && !Utils.IsMouseOverButton(this, e))
			{
				EditInfo.SelectAll();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool isInEditMode = base.IsInEditMode;
			if (!isInEditMode)
			{
				_transitingIntoEditModeInMouseDown = true;
				_transitingIntoEditModeInMouseDownPoint = e.GetPosition(this);
				flag = IsMouseOverTemplateChild("PART_SpinButtons", e);
			}
			try
			{
				base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
				if (isInEditMode && base.IsInEditMode && Utils.IsMouseOverElement(this, e) && (base.Host == null || base.Host._previewMouseLeftButtonDown_EnterEditMode_TimeStamp != e.Timestamp))
				{
					EditInfo editInfo = EditInfo;
					if (editInfo != null)
					{
						editInfo.MaskedEditUIElementClicked(e.GetPosition(this));
						CaptureMouse();
						if (base.IsMouseCaptured)
						{
							_isDragSelecting = true;
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag && IsMouseOverTemplateChild("PART_SpinButtons", e, out var _) && Utils.HitTest(this, e.GetPosition(this), typeof(ButtonBase), allowSubclassOfType: true) is ButtonBase elem)
				{
					Utils.SendLeftMouseButtonDownHelper(elem, e);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (_transitingIntoEditModeInMouseDown)
				{
					_transitingIntoEditModeInMouseDown = false;
					ProcessIsBeingEditedAndFocusedChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseUp(e);
			if (e.Device != null && e.Device.Target != null)
			{
				_isDragSelecting = false;
				e.Device.Target.ReleaseMouseCapture();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLostMouseCapture(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			_isDragSelecting = false;
			base.OnLostMouseCapture(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonUp(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			if (EditInfo != null)
			{
				EditInfo.MaskedEditUIElementMouseUp(e.GetPosition(this));
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseMove(e);
			if (_isDragSelecting && EditInfo != null && e.Device != null && e.Device.Target != null && e.Device.Target.IsMouseCaptured)
			{
				EditInfo.MouseDragged(e.GetPosition(this));
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		internal static List<EraSection.EraInfo> GetCultureEras(IFormatProvider formatProvider, out Type calendarType)
		{
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = GetDateTimeFormatInfo(formatProvider);
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = dateTimeFormatInfo.Calendar;
			calendarType = calendar.GetType();
			List<EraSection.EraInfo> list = new List<EraSection.EraInfo>();
			int[] eras = dateTimeFormatInfo.Calendar.Eras;
			foreach (int num in eras)
			{
				string eraName = dateTimeFormatInfo.GetEraName(num);
				string abbreviatedEraName = dateTimeFormatInfo.GetAbbreviatedEraName(num);
				DateTime eraMinDate = EraSupportUtils.GetEraMinDate(calendar, num);
				DateTime eraMaxDate = EraSupportUtils.GetEraMaxDate(calendar, num);
				EraSection.EraInfo item = new EraSection.EraInfo(eraName, num, abbreviatedEraName, eraMinDate, eraMaxDate);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class MaskedEditorDefaultConverter : ValueEditorDefaultConverter
	{
		private static MaskedEditorDefaultConverter _valueToDisplayTextConverter;

		private static MaskedEditorDefaultConverter _valueToTextConverter;

		public new static MaskedEditorDefaultConverter ValueToTextConverter
		{
			get
			{
				if (_valueToTextConverter == null)
				{
					_valueToTextConverter = new MaskedEditorDefaultConverter(isDisplayTextConverter: false);
				}
				return _valueToTextConverter;
			}
		}

		public new static MaskedEditorDefaultConverter ValueToDisplayTextConverter
		{
			get
			{
				if (_valueToDisplayTextConverter == null)
				{
					_valueToDisplayTextConverter = new MaskedEditorDefaultConverter(isDisplayTextConverter: true);
				}
				return _valueToDisplayTextConverter;
			}
		}

		private MaskedEditorDefaultConverter(bool isDisplayTextConverter)
			: base(isDisplayTextConverter)
		{
		}

		internal string ConvertToTextBasedOnMask(XamMaskedEditor editor, object value, bool useSectionsDirectly)
		{
			MaskInfo maskInfo = MaskInfo.CreateMaskInfoForConverter(editor);
			SectionsCollection sections = maskInfo.Sections;
			if (sections == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (useSectionsDirectly)
				{
					bool hasDateComponents;
					bool hasTimeComponents;
					Type type = XamMaskedEditor.DeduceEditAsType(sections, out hasDateComponents, out hasTimeComponents);
					bool flag2 = XamMaskedEditor.HasNonDateTimeEditSections(sections);
					if (value is DateTime && typeof(DateTime) == type && !flag2)
					{
						XamMaskedEditor.SetDateTimeValue(sections, (DateTime)value, maskInfo, retainOriginalTime: false);
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					maskInfo.InternalRefreshValue(value);
				}
				if (XamMaskedEditor.AreAllDisplayCharsEmpty(sections))
				{
					if (!editor.IsInEditMode && ((value is float && (float)value != 0f) || (value is double && (double)value != 0.0)))
					{
						string text = value.ToString();
						string[] array = text.Split('e', 'E');
						if (array.Length > 1)
						{
							return text;
						}
					}
					return _isDisplayTextConverter ? editor.NullText : string.Empty;
				}
				return XamMaskedEditor.GetText(sections, _isDisplayTextConverter ? maskInfo.DisplayMode : maskInfo.DataMode, maskInfo);
			}
			finally
			{
				MaskInfo.ReleaseMaskInfoForConverter(maskInfo);
			}
		}

		protected override object ConvertHelper(bool convertingBack, object value, Type targetType, ValueEditor valueEditor, IFormatProvider formatProvider, string format)
		{
			if (value != null && DBNull.Value != value && valueEditor is XamMaskedEditor xamMaskedEditor)
			{
				if (convertingBack)
				{
					if (xamMaskedEditor.IsInEditMode && !xamMaskedEditor._isEnteringEditMode && object.Equals(value, xamMaskedEditor.Text) && xamMaskedEditor.EditInfo != null && xamMaskedEditor.EditInfo._inOnTextChanged)
					{
						if (XamMaskedEditor.AreAllDisplayCharsEmpty(xamMaskedEditor.EditInfo.Sections))
						{
							return null;
						}
						return xamMaskedEditor.EditInfo.Value;
					}
					if (_isDisplayTextConverter && object.Equals(value, xamMaskedEditor.NullText))
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (format == null || !_isDisplayTextConverter)
					{
						MaskInfo maskInfo = MaskInfo.CreateMaskInfoForConverter(xamMaskedEditor);
						try
						{
							string text = ((value != null) ? value.ToString() : string.Empty);
							int num = XamMaskedEditor.SetText(maskInfo.Sections, text, maskInfo);
							if (num < text.Length)
							{
								return null;
							}
							if (XamMaskedEditor.AreAllDisplayCharsEmpty(maskInfo.Sections))
							{
								return null;
							}
							if (targetType == typeof(DateTime))
							{
								string text2 = value as string;
								if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
								{
									YearSection yearSection = null;
									foreach (SectionBase section in maskInfo.Sections)
									{
										yearSection = section as YearSection;
										if (yearSection != null)
										{
											break;
										}
									}
									if (yearSection != null && yearSection.DisplayChars.Count == 4 && yearSection.DisplayChars[0].Char == '0' && yearSection.DisplayChars[1].Char == '0' && DateTime.TryParse(text2, formatProvider, DateTimeStyles.None, out var result))
									{
										yearSection.SetText(result.Year.ToString());
									}
								}
							}
							return XamMaskedEditor.GetDataValue(maskInfo);
						}
						finally
						{
							MaskInfo.ReleaseMaskInfoForConverter(maskInfo);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (typeof(string) == targetType && (format == null || !_isDisplayTextConverter))
				{
					return ConvertToTextBasedOnMask(xamMaskedEditor, value, useSectionsDirectly: false);
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertHelper(convertingBack, value, targetType, valueEditor, formatProvider, format);
		}
	}
	internal class MaskInfo
	{
		internal class MaskCache
		{
			private string mask;

			private IFormatProvider formatProvider;

			private Type _dataType;

			internal MaskCache(string mask, IFormatProvider formatProvider, Type dataType)
			{
				if (mask == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("mask");
				}
				this.mask = mask;
				this.formatProvider = formatProvider;
				_dataType = dataType;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is MaskCache maskCache)
				{
					if (!maskCache.mask.Equals(mask))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (maskCache._dataType != _dataType)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (formatProvider == maskCache.formatProvider)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (formatProvider != null && maskCache.formatProvider != null)
					{
						return formatProvider.Equals(maskCache.formatProvider);
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return mask.GetHashCode() ^ ((null != _dataType) ? _dataType.GetHashCode() : 0) ^ ((formatProvider != null) ? formatProvider.GetHashCode() : 0);
			}
		}

		private XamMaskedEditor _maskEditor;

		private Type _dataType;

		private MaskMode _displayMode;

		private MaskMode _dataMode;

		private MaskMode _clipMode;

		private string _format;

		private IFormatProvider _formatProvider;

		private CultureInfo _cultureInfo;

		private SectionsCollection _sections;

		private string _lastParsedMask;

		private IFormatProvider _lastParsedMask_FormatProvider;

		private object _cached_minValue;

		private object _cached_maxValue;

		private object _cached_minExclusive;

		private object _cached_maxExclusive;

		private bool _skipDigitSeparator;

		private char _cachedCommaChar;

		private char _cachedDecimalSeperatorChar;

		private char _cachedMinusSignChar;

		internal static MaskInfo CreateMaskInfoForConverter(XamMaskedEditor maskEditor)
		{
			MaskInfo maskInfo = new MaskInfo();
			maskInfo.Initialize(maskEditor, setValue: false, maskInfoForConverter: true);
			return maskInfo;

		internal static void ReleaseMaskInfoForConverter(MaskInfo maskInfo)

			maskInfo.Sections?.Initialize(null);
		}

		internal void InitializeFormatProvider(IFormatProvider formatProvider, CultureInfo cultureInfo)
		{
			object formatProvider2;
			if (formatProvider == null)
			{
				formatProvider2 = cultureInfo;
			}
			else
			{
				formatProvider2 = formatProvider;
			}
			_formatProvider = (IFormatProvider)formatProvider2;
			_cultureInfo = ((cultureInfo != null) ? cultureInfo : (formatProvider as CultureInfo));
			ResetCachedCharacters();
		}

		internal void InitializeFormatProvider()
		{
			InitializeFormatProvider(_maskEditor.FormatProviderResolved, _maskEditor.CultureInfoResolved);
		}

		private void Initialize(XamMaskedEditor maskEditor, bool setValue, bool maskInfoForConverter)
		{
			Utils.ValidateNull(maskEditor);
			_maskEditor = maskEditor;
			_format = maskEditor.Format;
			InitializeFormatProvider();
			_dataType = CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(maskEditor.ValueType);
			_clipMode = maskEditor.ClipMode;
			_dataMode = maskEditor.DataMode;
			_displayMode = maskEditor.DisplayMode;
			_skipDigitSeparator = ShouldSkipDigitSeparator(_dataType);
			InitializedCachedMinMaxValues();
			CreateSections(maskInfoForConverter);
			if (setValue)
			{
				InternalRefreshValue(maskEditor.Value);
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(SectionsCollection sections, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			_sections = sections;
			InitializeFormatProvider(formatProvider, null);
		}

		internal void ClearCachedMinMaxValues()
		{
			_cached_minValue = null;
			_cached_maxValue = null;
			_cached_minExclusive = null;
			_cached_maxExclusive = null;
		}

		internal void InitializedCachedMinMaxValues()
		{
			ValueConstraint valueConstraint = ((_maskEditor != null) ? _maskEditor.ValueConstraint : null);
			if (valueConstraint != null)
			{
				_cached_maxExclusive = valueConstraint.MaxExclusive;
				_cached_maxValue = valueConstraint.MaxInclusive;
				_cached_minExclusive = valueConstraint.MinExclusive;
				_cached_minValue = valueConstraint.MinInclusive;
			}
			else
			{
				ClearCachedMinMaxValues();
			}
		}

		internal bool InternalRefreshValue(object dataValue)
		{
			Exception error;
			return InternalRefreshValue(dataValue, out error);
		}

		internal bool InternalRefreshValue(object dataValue, out Exception error)
		{
			if (Sections == null)
			{
				error = new InvalidOperationException("Invalid mask.");
				return false;
			}
			EditInfo editInfo = MaskEditor?.EditInfo;
			string text = null;
			if (editInfo != null)
			{
				text = XamMaskedEditor.GetText(Sections, MaskMode.IncludeBoth, this);
			}
			error = null;
			if (dataValue != null)
			{
				try
				{
					if (!XamMaskedEditor.SetDataValue(Sections, DataType, dataValue, this))
					{
						error = new ArgumentException(ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_EnteredValueInvalid", dataValue));
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					EraseAllChars();
					error = ex;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				EraseAllChars();
			}
			if (editInfo != null)
			{
				string text2 = XamMaskedEditor.GetText(Sections, MaskMode.IncludeBoth, this);
				if ((text == null && text2 == null) || string.Compare(text2, text, ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
				{
					return error == null;
				}
				if (editInfo != null && editInfo.MaskInfo == this)
				{
					editInfo.ManageUndoHistory_TextChanged(viaUserAction: false, null);
				}
			}
			return error == null;
		}

		private bool ShouldSkipDigitSeparator(Type dataType)
		{
			XamMaskedEditor.SupportsDataType(dataType, out var usesConverter);
			return !usesConverter;
		}

		private char GetCultureChar(char c, ref char cachedCharacter)
		{
			if (cachedCharacter == '\0')
			{
				cachedCharacter = XamMaskedEditor.GetCultureChar(c, this);
			}
			return cachedCharacter;
		}

		internal void EraseAllChars()
		{
			XamMaskedEditor.EraseAllChars(Sections);
		}

		internal void RecreateSections(bool dontRefreshValue)
		{
			CreateSections(maskInfoForConverter: false);
			if (!dontRefreshValue)
			{
				InternalRefreshValue(MaskEditor.Value);
			}
		}

		private bool CreateSections(bool maskInfoForConverter)
		{
			MaskEditor.ResolveMask(DataType, FormatProvider, out var mask, out _maskDefaultType);
			if (mask != null && mask.Length > 0 && _lastParsedMask != null && _sections != null && mask.Equals(_lastParsedMask) && _lastParsedMask_FormatProvider == FormatProvider)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (mask != null && mask.Length > 0)
			{
				_sections = GetCachedParsedMask(mask, this, !maskInfoForConverter);
			}
			else
			{
				if (CoreUtilities.IsDebuggerLogging())
				{
					CoreUtilities.DebuggerLog(40, "Global", $"No mask specified and there is no default mask for {DataType}{Environment.NewLine}");
				}
				_sections = new SectionsCollection();
				_sections.Initialize(this);
			}
			XamMaskedEditor maskEditor = MaskEditor;
			if (maskEditor != null && maskEditor.MaskInfoIfAllocated == this)
			{
				maskEditor.InternalSetSections(Sections);
			}
			if (_sections != null)
			{
				_lastParsedMask = mask;
				_lastParsedMask_FormatProvider = FormatProvider;
				Type dataType = DataType;
				if (_sections != null && (typeof(byte) == dataType || typeof(sbyte) == dataType || typeof(short) == dataType || typeof(ushort) == dataType || typeof(int) == dataType || typeof(uint) == dataType || typeof(long) == dataType || typeof(ulong) == dataType))
				{
					NumberSection numberSection = (NumberSection)XamMaskedEditor.GetSection(_sections, typeof(NumberSection));
					if (numberSection != null && numberSection.GetType() == typeof(NumberSection) && numberSection.DisplayChars.Count > 2)
					{
						decimal num = default(decimal);
						if (typeof(byte) == dataType)
						{
							num = 255m;
						}
						else if (typeof(sbyte) == dataType)
						{
							num = 127m;
						}
						else if (typeof(short) == dataType)
						{
							num = 32767m;
						}
						else if (typeof(ushort) == dataType)
						{
							num = 65535m;
						}
						else if (typeof(int) == dataType)
						{
							num = 2147483647m;
						}
						else if (typeof(uint) == dataType)
						{
							num = 4294967295m;
						}
						else if (typeof(long) == dataType)
						{
							num = 9223372036854775807m;
						}
						else if (typeof(ulong) == dataType)
						{
							num = 18446744073709551615m;
						}
						if (0m != num && numberSection.MaxValue > num)
						{
							numberSection.MaxValue = num;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static SectionsCollection GetCachedParsedMask(string mask, MaskInfo maskInfo, bool cloneSections)
		{
			IFormatProvider formatProvider = maskInfo.FormatProvider;
			SectionsCollection value = null;
			if (mask == null || mask.Length == 0)
			{
				return value;
			}
			MaskCache key = new MaskCache(mask, formatProvider, maskInfo?.DataType);
			if (g_parsedMaskCache == null)
			{
				g_parsedMaskCache = new Dictionary<MaskCache, SectionsCollection>();
			}
			if (g_parsedMaskCache.TryGetValue(key, out value) && !value._isCacheInvalid)
			{
				value = g_parsedMaskCache[key];
				if (cloneSections)
				{
					value = value.Clone(maskInfo, copyDisplayCharacterValues: false);
				}
				else
				{
					value.Initialize(maskInfo);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MaskParser.Parse(mask, out value, formatProvider);
				if (value == null)
				{
					return value;
				}
				value.Initialize(maskInfo);
				g_parsedMaskCache[key] = value.Clone(null, copyDisplayCharacterValues: false);
				if (g_parsedMaskCache.Count > 100)
				{
					try
					{
						int num = g_parsedMaskCache.Count - 100;
						List<MaskCache> list = new List<MaskCache>(num);
						foreach (MaskCache key2 in g_parsedMaskCache.Keys)
						{
							list.Add(key2);
							if (list.Count >= num)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
						foreach (MaskCache item in list)
						{
							g_parsedMaskCache.Remove(item);
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal object ValueToDataValue(object value)
		{
			return CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, MaskEditor.ValueType, FormatProvider, Format);
		}

		private void ResetCachedCharacters()
		{
			_cachedCommaChar = (_cachedDecimalSeperatorChar = (_cachedPlusSignChar = (_cachedMinusSignChar = '\0')));
		}

		internal Type GetDefaultTypeForSyncTextFromValue(object newValue)
		{
			if (newValue == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type typeFromHandle;
			int num;
			switch (_maskDefaultType)
			{
			case MaskDefaultType.None:
				return null;
			case MaskDefaultType.Byte:
				typeFromHandle = typeof(byte);
				num = 1;
				break;
			case MaskDefaultType.SByte:
				typeFromHandle = typeof(sbyte);
				num = 1;
				break;
			case MaskDefaultType.Int16:
				typeFromHandle = typeof(short);
				num = 1;
				break;
			case MaskDefaultType.UInt16:
				typeFromHandle = typeof(ushort);
				num = 1;
				break;
			case MaskDefaultType.Int32:
				typeFromHandle = typeof(int);
				num = 1;
				break;
			case MaskDefaultType.UInt32:
				typeFromHandle = typeof(uint);
				num = 1;
				break;
			case MaskDefaultType.Int64:
				typeFromHandle = typeof(long);
				num = 1;
				break;
			case MaskDefaultType.UInt64:
				typeFromHandle = typeof(ulong);
				num = 1;
				break;
			case MaskDefaultType.Float:
				typeFromHandle = typeof(float);
				num = 3;
				break;
			case MaskDefaultType.Double:
				typeFromHandle = typeof(double);
				num = 3;
				break;
			case MaskDefaultType.Currency:
				typeFromHandle = typeof(decimal);
				num = 4;
				break;
			case MaskDefaultType.DateTime:
				typeFromHandle = typeof(DateTime);
				num = Sections.Count;
				break;
			default:
				return null;
			}
			if (newValue.GetType() != typeFromHandle)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (Sections.Count != num)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return typeFromHandle;
		}
	}
	public abstract class SectionBase : PropertyChangeNotifier
	{
		private SectionsCollection sections;

		private DisplayCharsCollection _displayChars;

		private int index = -1;

		private bool isDateSeperatorSection;

		public SectionsCollection Sections => sections;

		[Bindable(true)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[ReadOnly(true)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public DisplayCharsCollection DisplayChars => _displayChars;

		internal int Index
		{
			get
			{
				SectionsCollection sectionsCollection = Sections;
				int count = sectionsCollection.Count;
				if (index >= 0 && index < count && this == sectionsCollection[index])
				{
					return index;
				}
				index = sectionsCollection.IndexOf(this);
				return index;
			}
		}

		public virtual SectionBase PreviousSection
		{
			get
			{
				if (Index <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Sections[Index - 1];
			}
		}

		public virtual LiteralSection PreviousLiteralSection
		{
			get
			{
				SectionBase previousSection = PreviousSection;
				if (previousSection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (previousSection is LiteralSection)
				{
					return (LiteralSection)previousSection;
				}
				return previousSection.PreviousLiteralSection;
			}
		}

		public virtual SectionBase NextSection
		{
			get
			{
				int num = Index;
				if (1 + num < Sections.Count)
				{
					return Sections[1 + num];
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public virtual EditSectionBase PreviousEditSection
		{
			get
			{
				SectionBase previousSection = PreviousSection;
				if (previousSection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (previousSection is EditSectionBase)
				{
					return (EditSectionBase)previousSection;
				}
				return previousSection.PreviousEditSection;
			}
		}

		internal DisplayCharBase FirstDisplayChar
		{
			get
			{
				if (DisplayChars.Count <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return DisplayChars[0];
			}
		}

		internal DisplayCharBase LastDisplayChar
		{
			get
			{
				if (DisplayChars.Count <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return DisplayChars[DisplayChars.Count - 1];
			}
		}

		public virtual EditSectionBase NextEditSection
		{
			get
			{
				SectionBase nextSection = NextSection;
				if (nextSection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (nextSection is EditSectionBase)
				{
					return (EditSectionBase)nextSection;
				}
				return nextSection.NextEditSection;
			}
		}

		public virtual LiteralSection NextLiteralSection
		{
			get
			{
				SectionBase nextSection = NextSection;
				if (nextSection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (nextSection is LiteralSection)
				{
					return (LiteralSection)nextSection;
				}
				return nextSection.NextLiteralSection;
			}
		}

		internal XamMaskedEditor MaskedEdit => Sections.MaskedEditor;

		internal MaskInfo MaskInfo => Sections.MaskInfo;

		internal char DecimalSeperatorChar => MaskInfo?.DecimalSeperatorChar ?? XamMaskedEditor.GetCultureChar('.', null, useCurrencySymbols: false);

		internal char PlusSignChar => MaskInfo?.PlusSignChar ?? XamMaskedEditor.GetCultureChar('+', null, useCurrencySymbols: false);

		internal char MinusSignChar => MaskInfo?.MinusSignChar ?? XamMaskedEditor.GetCultureChar('-', null, useCurrencySymbols: false);

		internal char CommaChar => MaskInfo?.CommaChar ?? XamMaskedEditor.GetCultureChar(',', null, useCurrencySymbols: false);

		internal bool IsDateTimeSeperatorSection
		{
			get
			{
				return isDateSeperatorSection;
			}
			set
			{
				isDateSeperatorSection = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDateSection
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(this is DaySection) && !(this is MonthSection) && !(this is YearSection))
				{
					return this is EraSection;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsTimeSection
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(this is SecondSection) && !(this is MinuteSection) && !(this is HourSection))
				{
					return this is AMPMSection;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal System.Globalization.Calendar Calendar => Sections.Calendar;

		internal SectionBase()
		{
			_displayChars = new DisplayCharsCollection(this);
		}

		internal void InitSectionsCollection(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			if (sections == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_69"));
			}
			this.sections = sections;
		}

		internal virtual void SetFilterToAllChars(FilterType filter)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < DisplayChars.Count; i++)
			{
				DisplayChars[i].FilterType = filter;
			}
		}

		public abstract bool ValidateString(ref string str);

		internal bool IsAllSpaces()
		{
			foreach (DisplayCharBase displayChar in DisplayChars)
			{
				if (' ' != displayChar.Char)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public string GetText()
		{
			string text = GetText(MaskMode.IncludeLiterals);
			if (text == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal virtual string GetText(MaskMode maskMode)
		{
			DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = DisplayChars;
			if (displayChars == null || displayChars.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = displayChars.Count;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(1 + count);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = displayChars[i];
				if (displayCharBase != null)
				{
					char c = displayCharBase.GetChar(maskMode);
					if (c != 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(c);
					}
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal virtual void InternalCopy(SectionBase dest)
		{
			if (GetType() != dest.GetType())
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_2"), "dest");
			}
			dest.isDateSeperatorSection = isDateSeperatorSection;
			if (dest._displayChars == null || dest._displayChars.Count <= 0)
			{
				dest._displayChars = _displayChars.InternalClone(dest);
			}
		}

		internal abstract SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections);
	}
	public sealed class LiteralSection : SectionBase
	{
		internal override void SetFilterToAllChars(FilterType filter)
		{
		}

		public override bool ValidateString(ref string str)
		{
			DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = base.DisplayChars;
			if (str == null || displayChars.Count != str.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < displayChars.Count; i++)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = displayChars[i];
				if (!displayCharBase.MatchChar(str[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			LiteralSection literalSection = new LiteralSection();
			InternalCopy(literalSection);
			literalSection.InitSectionsCollection(sections);
			return literalSection;
		}
	}
	public abstract class EditSectionBase : SectionBase
	{
		internal virtual DisplayCharBase FirstFilledChar
		{
			get
			{
				DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = base.DisplayChars;
				int count = displayChars.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = displayChars[i];
					if (displayCharBase.IsEditable && displayCharBase.Char != 0)
					{
						return displayCharBase;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool IsEmpty => FirstFilledChar == null;

		internal virtual DisplayCharBase LastFilledChar
		{
			get
			{
				for (int num = base.DisplayChars.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[num];
					if (displayCharBase.IsEditable && displayCharBase.Char != 0)
					{
						return displayCharBase;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public abstract EditOrientation Orientation { get; }

		internal virtual bool SupportsSpinning => false;

		internal EditSectionBase()
		{
		}

		protected DisplayCharBase SafeDisplayCharAt(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0 && index < base.DisplayChars.Count)
			{
				return base.DisplayChars[index];
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool CanShift(int from, int positionsToShift, bool left)
		{
			int count = base.DisplayChars.Count;
			if (from < 0 || from >= count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (positionsToShift < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (from + positionsToShift > count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = true;
			if (left)
			{
				for (int i = from; i < base.DisplayChars.Count; i++)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = SafeDisplayCharAt(i);
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase2 = SafeDisplayCharAt(i + positionsToShift);
					if (displayCharBase != null && !displayCharBase.IsEditable)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (displayCharBase2 != null && !displayCharBase2.IsEditable)
					{
						int num = positionsToShift + 1;
						while (displayCharBase2 != null && !displayCharBase2.IsEditable)
						{
							displayCharBase2 = SafeDisplayCharAt(i + num);
							num++;
						}
					}
					char c = '\0';
					if (displayCharBase2 != null)
					{
						c = displayCharBase2.Char;
					}
					if ((displayCharBase == null || (c != 0 && !displayCharBase.MatchChar(c))) && c != 0)
					{
						result = false;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int num2 = base.DisplayChars.Count - 1; num2 >= from; num2--)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase3 = SafeDisplayCharAt(num2);
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase4 = null;
					if (num2 - positionsToShift >= from)
					{
						displayCharBase4 = SafeDisplayCharAt(num2 - positionsToShift);
					}
					if (displayCharBase3 == null || displayCharBase3.IsEditable)
					{
						if (displayCharBase4 != null && !displayCharBase4.IsEditable)
						{
							int num3 = positionsToShift + 1;
							while (displayCharBase4 != null && !displayCharBase4.IsEditable)
							{
								displayCharBase4 = SafeDisplayCharAt(num2 - num3);
								num3++;
							}
						}
						char c2 = '\0';
						if (displayCharBase4 != null)
						{
							c2 = displayCharBase4.Char;
						}
						if ((displayCharBase3 == null || (c2 != 0 && !displayCharBase3.MatchChar(c2))) && c2 != 0)
						{
							result = false;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool Shift(int from, int positionsToShift, bool left)
		{
			if (!CanShift(from, positionsToShift, left))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int count = base.DisplayChars.Count;
			if (from < 0 || from >= count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (positionsToShift < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (from + positionsToShift > count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = true;
			if (left)
			{
				for (int i = from; i < base.DisplayChars.Count; i++)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = SafeDisplayCharAt(i);
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase2 = SafeDisplayCharAt(i + positionsToShift);
					if (displayCharBase != null && !displayCharBase.IsEditable)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (displayCharBase2 != null && !displayCharBase2.IsEditable)
					{
						int num = positionsToShift + 1;
						while (displayCharBase2 != null && !displayCharBase2.IsEditable)
						{
							displayCharBase2 = SafeDisplayCharAt(i + num);
							num++;
						}
					}
					char c = '\0';
					if (displayCharBase2 != null)
					{
						c = displayCharBase2.Char;
					}
					if (displayCharBase != null && (c == '\0' || displayCharBase.MatchChar(c)))
					{
						displayCharBase.Char = c;
					}
					else
					{
						result = false;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int num2 = base.DisplayChars.Count - 1; num2 >= from; num2--)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase3 = SafeDisplayCharAt(num2);
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase4 = null;
					if (num2 - positionsToShift >= from)
					{
						displayCharBase4 = SafeDisplayCharAt(num2 - positionsToShift);
					}
					if (displayCharBase3 == null || displayCharBase3.IsEditable)
					{
						if (displayCharBase4 != null && !displayCharBase4.IsEditable)
						{
							int num3 = positionsToShift + 1;
							while (displayCharBase4 != null && !displayCharBase4.IsEditable)
							{
								displayCharBase4 = SafeDisplayCharAt(num2 - num3);
								num3++;
							}
						}
						char c2 = '\0';
						if (displayCharBase4 != null)
						{
							c2 = displayCharBase4.Char;
						}
						if (displayCharBase3 != null && (c2 == '\0' || displayCharBase3.MatchChar(c2)))
						{
							displayCharBase3.Char = c2;
						}
						else
						{
							result = false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool IsInt(string str)
		{
			if (str.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int i = 0;
			if (base.PlusSignChar == str[i] || base.MinusSignChar == str[i])
			{
				i++;
			}
			for (; i < str.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!char.IsDigit(str, i))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public abstract void SetText(string text);

		internal virtual bool IsInputFull()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.DisplayChars.Count; i++)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[i];
				if (displayCharBase.IsEditable && displayCharBase.IsEmpty)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual bool CanShiftRight(int from, int positionsToShift)
		{
			return CanShift(from, positionsToShift, left: false);
		}

		internal virtual bool CanShiftLeft(int from, int positionsToShift)
		{
			return CanShift(from, positionsToShift, left: true);
		}

		internal virtual bool ShiftLeft(int from, int positionsToShift)
		{
			return Shift(from, positionsToShift, left: true);
		}

		internal virtual bool ShiftRight(int from, int positionsToShift)
		{
			return Shift(from, positionsToShift, left: false);
		}

		internal virtual bool DeleteCharWithNoShift(int pos)
		{
			if (pos < 0 || pos >= base.DisplayChars.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			base.DisplayChars[pos].Char = '\0';
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual bool DeleteCharsAndShift(int pos, int count)
		{
			if (pos < 0 || pos >= base.DisplayChars.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CanShiftLeft(pos, count))
			{
				ShiftLeft(pos, count);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual bool DeleteCharAndShift(int pos)
		{
			if (pos < 0 || pos >= base.DisplayChars.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CanShiftLeft(pos, 1))
			{
				ShiftLeft(pos, 1);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual bool ReplaceCharAt(int pos, char c, bool validateMinMax = false)
		{
			if (pos < 0 || pos > base.DisplayChars.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[pos];
			if (displayCharBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!displayCharBase.IsEditable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!displayCharBase.MatchChar(c))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (validateMinMax && displayCharBase.Section is NumberSection numberSection && !numberSection.IsInMinMaxRange(pos, c, overwrite: true))
			{
				return false;
			}
			displayCharBase.Char = c;
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual bool CanInsertCharAt(int pos, char c)
		{
			if (pos < 0 || pos > base.DisplayChars.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[pos];
			if (displayCharBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!displayCharBase.IsEditable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!displayCharBase.MatchChar(c))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!base.LastDisplayChar.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!CanShiftRight(pos, 1))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual bool InsertCharAt(int pos, char c)
		{
			if (CanInsertCharAt(pos, c))
			{
				Shift(pos, 1, left: false);
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = SafeDisplayCharAt(pos);
				displayCharBase.Char = c;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual void EraseChars(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			if (startIndex > endIndex)
			{
				int num = startIndex;
				startIndex = endIndex;
				endIndex = num;
			}
			DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = base.DisplayChars;
			int count = displayChars.Count;
			for (int i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++)
			{
				if (i < count)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = displayChars[i];
					if (displayCharBase.IsEditable)
					{
						displayCharBase.Char = '\0';
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void EraseAllChars()
		{
			EraseChars(0, base.DisplayChars.Count - 1);
		}

		public bool ValidateSection()
		{
			return ValidateSection(contentModificationsAllowed: true);
		}

		public abstract bool ValidateSection(bool contentModificationsAllowed);

		internal virtual bool CanSpin(bool up)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual bool Spin(bool up, bool setLimit)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class DisplayCharsEditSection : EditSectionBase
	{
		public override EditOrientation Orientation => EditOrientation.LeftToRight;

		internal DisplayCharsEditSection()
		{
		}

		public override void SetText(string text)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.DisplayChars.Count; i++)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[i];
				if (displayCharBase.IsEditable)
				{
					char c = '\0';
					if (num < text.Length)
					{
						c = text[num++];
					}
					displayCharBase.Char = c;
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool ValidateString(ref string str)
		{
			if (str == null || base.DisplayChars.Count != str.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			char padChar = base.MaskInfo.PadChar;
			char promptChar = base.MaskInfo.PromptChar;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.DisplayChars.Count; i++)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[i];
				if (!displayCharBase.MatchChar(str[i]) && ((padChar != str[i] && promptChar != str[i]) || !displayCharBase.IsEditable || displayCharBase.Required))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool ValidateSection(bool contentModificationsAllowed)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.DisplayChars.Count && this == base.DisplayChars[i].Section; i++)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[i];
				if (displayCharBase == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (displayCharBase.Char != 0)
				{
					if (!displayCharBase.MatchChar(displayCharBase.Char))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (displayCharBase.Required)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			DisplayCharsEditSection displayCharsEditSection = new DisplayCharsEditSection();
			InternalCopy(displayCharsEditSection);
			displayCharsEditSection.InitSectionsCollection(sections);
			return displayCharsEditSection;
		}
	}
	public class NumberSection : EditSectionBase

		private void InternalInitialize(int digits, int[] commaPositions, SignDisplayType signType)
		{
			if (digits <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("digits", ValueEditor.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_1"));
			}
			this.digits = digits;
			this.commaPositions = commaPositions;
			this.signType = signType;
			decimal num2;
			try
			{
				double num = Math.Pow(10.0, digits) + 1.0;
				num2 = ((!(num > 7.92281625142643E+28)) ? (-(decimal)Math.Pow(10.0, digits) + 1m) : (-79228162514264300000000000000m));
			}
			catch (OverflowException)
			{
				num2 = decimal.MinValue;
			}
			if (num2 != decimal.Floor(num2))
			{
				num2 = decimal.Floor(num2) + 1m;
			}
			defaultMinValue = num2;
			decimal num3;
			if (signType != SignDisplayType.None)
			{
				num3 = num2;
				lastConvertedMinValWithFractionPart = ((num2 == decimal.MinValue) ? num2 : (num2 - 1m));
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = default(decimal);
				lastConvertedMinValWithFractionPart = default(decimal);
			}
			decimal num5;
			try
			{
				double num4 = Math.Pow(10.0, digits) - 1.0;
				num5 = ((!(num4 > 7.92281625142643E+28)) ? decimal.Floor((decimal)Math.Pow(10.0, digits) - 1m) : decimal.MaxValue);
			}
			catch (OverflowException)
			{
				num5 = decimal.MaxValue;
			}
			minValue = num3;
			maxValue = num5;
			lastConvertedMinValWithFractionPart = maxValue;
			CreateDisplayChars();
		}

		internal bool SetNumberSign(bool negative)
		{
			if (IsNegative == negative)
			{
				return true;
			}
			DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = base.DisplayChars;
			int count = displayChars.Count;
			DisplayCharBase firstFilledChar = FirstFilledChar;
			if (firstFilledChar == null)
			{
				if (negative)
				{
					DisplayCharBase lastDisplayChar = base.LastDisplayChar;
					if (lastDisplayChar != null)
					{
						lastDisplayChar.Char = base.MinusSignChar;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (base.MinusSignChar == firstFilledChar.Char || base.PlusSignChar == firstFilledChar.Char)
			{
				if (negative)
				{
					firstFilledChar.Char = base.MinusSignChar;
				}
				else
				{
					firstFilledChar.Char = '\0';
				}
				return true;
			}
			DisplayCharBase prevDisplayChar = firstFilledChar.PrevDisplayChar;
			if (prevDisplayChar == null || this != prevDisplayChar.Section)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (negative)
			{
				prevDisplayChar.Char = base.MinusSignChar;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool VerifyMinMaxCache(bool verifyMin)
		{
			MaskInfo maskInfo = base.MaskInfo;
			bool num;
			if (DependencyProperty.UnsetValue != _lastMinValue)
			{
				if (!verifyMin)
				{
					if (object.Equals(maskInfo.MaxValue, _lastMaxValue))
					{
						num = object.Equals(maskInfo.MaxExclusive, _lastMaxValueExclusive);
						goto IL_0067;
					}
				}
				else if (object.Equals(maskInfo.MinValue, _lastMinValue))
				{
					num = object.Equals(maskInfo.MinExclusive, _lastMinValueExclusive);
					goto IL_0067;
				}
			}
			goto IL_006b;
			IL_006b:
			_lastMinValue = maskInfo.MinValue;
			_lastMaxValue = maskInfo.MaxValue;
			_lastMinValueExclusive = maskInfo.MinExclusive;
			_lastMaxValueExclusive = maskInfo.MaxExclusive;
			bool isDefaultBasedOnSection;
			decimal resolvedMinMaxValueHelper = GetResolvedMinMaxValueHelper(calculatingMin: true, _lastMinValue, _lastMinValueExclusive, out isMinValueExclusive, out isDefaultBasedOnSection);
			bool isDefaultBasedOnSection2;
			decimal resolvedMinMaxValueHelper2 = GetResolvedMinMaxValueHelper(calculatingMin: false, _lastMaxValue, _lastMaxValueExclusive, out isMaxValueExclusive, out isDefaultBasedOnSection2);
			decimal num2 = Math.Max(decimal.Truncate(resolvedMinMaxValueHelper), defaultMinValue);
			decimal num3 = Math.Min(decimal.Truncate(resolvedMinMaxValueHelper2), maxValue);
			FractionPart fractionPart = NextEditSection as FractionPart;
			if (fractionPart != null)
			{
				if (num2 == num3)
				{
					fractionPart.MinValue = (double)(Math.Abs(resolvedMinMaxValueHelper) - Math.Abs(num2));
					fractionPart.MaxValue = (double)(Math.Abs(resolvedMinMaxValueHelper2) - Math.Abs(num3));
				}
				else
				{
					fractionPart.ResetMinValue();
					fractionPart.ResetMaxValue();
				}
			}
			_lastCalculatedMinValue = num2;
			_lastCalculatedMaxValue = num3;
			lastConvertedMinValWithFractionPart = ((!isDefaultBasedOnSection) ? resolvedMinMaxValueHelper : (num2 + ((fractionPart != null) ? ((decimal)fractionPart.MinValue) : 0m)));
			double val = (double)num3 + (fractionPart?.MaxValue ?? 0.0);
			val = Math.Min(val, 7.92281625142643E+28);
			lastConvertedMaxValWithFractionPart = ((!isDefaultBasedOnSection2) ? resolvedMinMaxValueHelper2 : ((decimal)val));
			return true;
			IL_0067:
			if (num)
			{
				return false;
			}
			goto IL_006b;
		}

		private static bool EqualsHelper(object o1, object o2)
		{
			if (o1 != o2)
			{
				if (o1 != null && o2 != null && o1.GetType() == o2.GetType())
				{
					return o1.Equals(o2);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private object ConvertToDecimalHelper(object val, IFormatProvider formatProvider = null)
		{
			if (val == null || DBNull.Value == val || val is DateTime)
			{
				return null;
			}
			MaskInfo maskInfo = base.MaskInfo;
			if (formatProvider == null)
			{
				formatProvider = maskInfo.FormatProvider;
			}
			if ((val is double && (double)val < -7.922816251426434E+28) || (val is float && (float)val < -7.9228163E+28f))
			{
				val = decimal.MinValue;
			}
			else if ((val is double && (double)val > 7.922816251426434E+28) || (val is float && (float)val > 7.9228163E+28f))
			{
				val = decimal.MaxValue;
			}
			return CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(val, typeof(decimal), formatProvider, maskInfo.Format);
		}

		internal override bool CanSpin(bool up)
		{
			string text = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
			if (text == null || text.Length == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			decimal value;
			try
			{
				if (!TryToDecimal(out value))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.MaskInfo.MaskEditor.SpinWrappingAllowed)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (up)
			{
				if (!isMaxValueExclusive)
				{
					return 1m + value <= MaxValue;
				}
				return 1m + value < MaxValue;
			}
			if (!isMinValueExclusive)
			{
				return value - 1m >= MinValue;
			}
			return value - 1m > MinValue;
		}

		internal override bool Spin(bool up, bool setLimit)
		{
			return Spin(up, setLimit, MinValue, MaxValue);
		}

		internal bool Spin(bool up, bool setLimit, decimal minValue, decimal maxValue)
		{
			decimal val;
			if (setLimit)
			{
				val = (up ? maxValue : minValue);
			}
			else
			{
				string text = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
				if (text != null && text.Length > 0 && IsInt(text))
				{
					val = ToDecimal(text);
					val = (up ? (val + 1m) : (val - 1m));
				}
				else
				{
					val = (up ? minValue : maxValue);
					if (minValue < 0m && 0m < maxValue)
					{
						val = default(decimal);
					}
				}
			}
			return Spin(up, setLimit, val, minValue, maxValue);
		}

		internal bool Spin(bool up, bool setLimit, decimal val, decimal minValue, decimal maxValue)
		{
			if (up)
			{
				if (val <= maxValue)
				{
					SetText(DecimalToString(val));
				}
				else if (val > maxValue && base.MaskedEdit.SpinWrappingAllowed)
				{
					SetText(DecimalToString(minValue));
				}
			}
			else if (val >= minValue)
			{
				SetText(DecimalToString(val));
			}
			else if (val < minValue && base.MaskedEdit.SpinWrappingAllowed)
			{
				SetText(DecimalToString(maxValue));
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static string PadNumber(long n, int totalWidthOfResultingString)
		{
			string text = n.ToString();
			if (text.Length >= totalWidthOfResultingString)
			{
				return text;
			}
			return new string('0', totalWidthOfResultingString - text.Length) + text;
		}

		internal override bool IsInputFull()
		{
			if (SignType != SignDisplayType.None && base.DisplayChars.Count > 1)
			{
				DisplayCharBase nextDisplayChar = base.FirstDisplayChar.NextDisplayChar;
				if (nextDisplayChar != null && !nextDisplayChar.IsEmpty && '0' != nextDisplayChar.Char && base.PlusSignChar != nextDisplayChar.Char && base.MinusSignChar != nextDisplayChar.Char)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (!base.FirstDisplayChar.IsEmpty && '0' != base.FirstDisplayChar.Char)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsFullyPopulated()
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = base.DisplayChars.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (i != 0 || SignType == SignDisplayType.None)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[i];
					if (displayCharBase.IsEditable && displayCharBase.IsEmpty)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual bool NextSectionOnFailedInsertion()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override void SetText(string text)
		{
			int num = text.Length - 1;
			EraseAllChars();
			char commaChar = base.CommaChar;
			DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = base.DisplayChars;
			for (int num2 = displayChars.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = displayChars[num2];
				if (displayCharBase.IsEditable)
				{
					while (num >= 0 && commaChar == text[num])
					{
						num--;
					}
					char c = '\0';
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						c = text[num--];
					}
					displayCharBase.Char = c;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetText(string text, bool autoExpand)
		{
			if (autoExpand && text.Length > 0 && text.Length > base.DisplayChars.Count - 1)
			{
				char c = text[0];
				bool flag = !char.IsDigit(c) && (base.PlusSignChar == c || base.MinusSignChar == c);
				int num = text.Length - (flag ? 1 : 0);
				DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = base.DisplayChars;
				bool flag2 = MinValue < 0m;
				int num2 = displayChars.Count - (flag2 ? 1 : 0);
				if (num > num2)
				{
					IFormatProvider formatProvider = base.MaskInfo.FormatProvider;
					MaskParser.Parse(XamMaskedEditor.CalcDefaultDoubleMask(formatProvider, num, 0, '-'), out var sectionsCollection, formatProvider);
					NumberSection numberSection = ((sectionsCollection != null && sectionsCollection.Count > 0) ? (sectionsCollection[0] as NumberSection) : null);
					if (numberSection != null)
					{
						if (base.Sections != null)
						{
							base.Sections._isCacheInvalid = true;
						}
						_lastMinValue = DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
						base.DisplayChars.Clear();
						InternalInitialize(num, numberSection.commaPositions, signType);
					}
				}
			}
			SetText(text);
		}

		internal int ToInt()
		{
			return (int)ToDecimal();
		}

		internal decimal ToDecimal()
		{
			return ToDecimal(GetText(MaskMode.Raw));
		}

		internal decimal ToDecimal(string rawText)
		{
			if (!ParseToInt(rawText, out var val))
			{
				throw new FormatException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_Exception_72"));
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal bool TryToDecimal(out decimal value)
		{
			return ParseToInt(out value);
		}

		internal bool TryToInt(out int value)
		{
			if (ParseToInt(out var val))
			{
				value = (int)val;
				return true;
			}
			value = 0;
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ParseToInt(out decimal val)
		{
			return ParseToInt(GetText(MaskMode.Raw), out val);
		}

		internal virtual bool ParseToInt(string rawText, out decimal val)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(rawText))
			{
				val = default(decimal);
				return false;
			}
			if (!decimal.TryParse(rawText, out val) || val % 1m != 0m)
			{
				val = default(decimal);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static string DecimalToString(decimal val)
		{
			return val.ToString();
		}

		internal static decimal StringToDecimal(string val)
		{
			return decimal.Parse(val);
		}

		internal override string GetText(MaskMode maskMode)
		{
			if (base.DisplayChars == null || base.DisplayChars.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int count = base.DisplayChars.Count;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(string.Empty, 1 + digits);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!(base.DisplayChars[i] is DigitChar { Char: not '\0' } digitChar))
				{
					continue;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(digitChar.Char);
				if (digitChar.ShouldIncludeComma(maskMode))
				{
					char commaChar = base.CommaChar;
					if (commaChar != 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(commaChar);
					}
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal override bool CanShiftRight(int from, int positionsToShift)

			throw new InvalidOperationException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_4"));
