		}

		internal override bool ShiftRight(int from, int positionsToShift)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_7"));
		}

		internal override bool DeleteCharWithNoShift(int pos)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_8"));
		}

		internal override bool DeleteCharsAndShift(int pos, int count)
		{
			if (pos < 0 || pos >= base.DisplayChars.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ignoreStrictSignChecking = true;
			try
			{
				for (int num = pos; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = SafeDisplayCharAt(num);
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase2 = SafeDisplayCharAt(num - count);
					if (displayCharBase == null || displayCharBase.IsEditable)
					{
						if (displayCharBase2 != null && !displayCharBase2.IsEditable)
						{
							int num2 = count + 1;
							while (displayCharBase2 != null && !displayCharBase2.IsEditable)
							{
								displayCharBase2 = SafeDisplayCharAt(num - num2);
								num2++;
							}
						}
						if (displayCharBase != null)
						{
							displayCharBase.Char = displayCharBase2?.Char ?? '\0';
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ignoreStrictSignChecking = false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool DeleteCharAndShift(int pos)
		{
			return DeleteCharsAndShift(pos, 1);
		}

		private bool GetIntValueIfInserted(int pos, char c, out decimal newVal, bool overwrite = false)
		{
			int count = base.DisplayChars.Count;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (overwrite && i == pos)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
					continue;
				}
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[i];
				if (!(displayCharBase is DigitChar))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (displayCharBase.Char != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(displayCharBase.Char);
				}
				if (i == pos && c != 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
				}
			}
			if (i == pos && c != 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(c);
			}
			newVal = default(decimal);
			return decimal.TryParse(stringBuilder.ToString(), out newVal);
		}

		internal override bool CanInsertCharAt(int pos, char c)
		{
			if (pos < 0 || pos >= base.DisplayChars.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = SafeDisplayCharAt(pos);
			if (c == '\0')
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!displayCharBase.MatchChar(c))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsInputFull())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsInMinMaxRange(pos, c, overwrite: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.FirstDisplayChar.IsEmpty || displayCharBase.IsEmpty)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ('0' == base.FirstDisplayChar.Char && GetType() == typeof(NumberSection) && NextEditSection is FractionPart)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsInMinMaxRange(int pos, char c, bool overwrite)
		{
			if (!char.IsDigit(c))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!GetIntValueIfInserted(pos, c, out var newVal, overwrite))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (newVal >= 0m)
			{
				if (newVal > MaxValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (newVal < MinValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool InsertCharAt(int pos, char c)
		{
			if (pos < 0 || pos >= base.DisplayChars.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = SafeDisplayCharAt(pos);
			if (!CanInsertCharAt(pos, c))
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < pos; i++)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase2 = SafeDisplayCharAt(i);
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase3 = SafeDisplayCharAt(i + 1);
				if (!displayCharBase2.IsEditable)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!displayCharBase3.IsEditable)
				{
					int num = 2;
					while (displayCharBase3 != null && !displayCharBase3.IsEditable)
					{
						displayCharBase3 = SafeDisplayCharAt(i + num);
						num++;
					}
				}
				displayCharBase2.Char = displayCharBase3.Char;
			}
			displayCharBase.Char = c;
			return true;
		}

		internal static string StripOutPadPromptCharacters(string str, SectionBase section)
		{
			char c = ((section.Sections.MaskInfo != null) ? section.Sections.MaskInfo.PadChar : ' ');
			char c2 = ((section.Sections.MaskInfo != null) ? section.Sections.MaskInfo.PromptChar : '_');
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(str.Length);
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < str.Length; i++)
			{
				if (str[i] != c && str[i] != c2)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(str[i]);
				}
				else
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return str;
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override bool ValidateString(ref string str)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(str.Length);
			char commaChar = base.CommaChar;
			str = StripOutPadPromptCharacters(str, this);
			for (int i = 0; i < str.Length; i++)
			{
				if (commaChar != str[i])
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(str[i]);
				}
			}
			if (IsInt(stringBuilder.ToString()))
			{
				try
				{
					if (!decimal.TryParse(stringBuilder.ToString(), out var result))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (result < MinValue || result > MaxValue)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool ValidateSection(bool contentModificationsAllowed)
		{
			string text = null;
			text = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
			if (IsInt(text))
			{
				if (!ValidateAgainstMinMaxHelper(text, out var _))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (contentModificationsAllowed)
				{
					SetText(text);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ValidateAgainstMinMaxHelper(string rawText, out string error)
		{
			error = null;
			if (!ParseToInt(rawText, out var val))
			{
				val = default(decimal);
			}
			if (val < minValue)
			{
				error = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_MinInclusive", minValue);
				return false;
			}
			if (val > maxValue)
			{
				error = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_MaxInclusive", maxValue);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected void CreateDisplayChars()
		{
			DigitChar digitChar = null;
			int num = digits;
			if (signType != SignDisplayType.None)
			{
				num++;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				digitChar = new DigitChar(this);
				base.DisplayChars.Add(digitChar);
				if (commaPositions != null && -1 != Array.IndexOf(commaPositions, (signType != SignDisplayType.None) ? (i - 1) : i))
				{
					digitChar.HasComma = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void InternalCopy(SectionBase dest)
		{
			base.InternalCopy(dest);
			NumberSection numberSection = (NumberSection)dest;
			if (commaPositions != null)
			{
				numberSection.commaPositions = new int[commaPositions.Length];
				commaPositions.CopyTo(numberSection.commaPositions, 0);
			}
			numberSection.digits = digits;
			numberSection.maxValue = maxValue;
			numberSection.minValue = minValue;
			numberSection.defaultMinValue = defaultMinValue;
			numberSection.signType = signType;
		}

		internal override SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			NumberSection numberSection = new NumberSection(digits, commaPositions, signType);
			InternalCopy(numberSection);
			numberSection.InitSectionsCollection(sections);
			return numberSection;
		}

		private decimal GetResolvedMinMaxValueHelper(bool calculatingMin, object val, object exclusive, out bool isExclusive, out bool isDefaultBasedOnSection)
		{
			object obj = null;
			object obj2 = null;
			if (!XamMaskedEditor.IsDateTimeSection(this))
			{
				obj = ConvertToDecimalHelper(val, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				obj2 = ConvertToDecimalHelper(exclusive);
			}
			object obj3 = obj;
			isExclusive = false;
			if (obj2 != null && (obj == null || (calculatingMin ? ((decimal)obj2 >= (decimal)obj) : ((decimal)obj2 <= (decimal)obj))))
			{
				obj3 = obj2;
				isExclusive = true;
			}
			isDefaultBasedOnSection = obj3 == null;
			if (obj3 == null)
			{
				if (!calculatingMin)
				{
					return maxValue;
				}
				return minValue;
			}
			return (decimal)obj3;
		}
	}
	public sealed class MonthSection : NumberSection
	{
		private char MaxTrailingChar
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.MaxValue == 13m)
				{
					return '3';
				}
				return '2';
			}
		}

		public MonthSection()
			: base(2)
		{
			base.MinValue = 1m;
			base.MaxValue = 12m;
		}

		public override bool ValidateString(ref string str)
		{
			str = NumberSection.StripOutPadPromptCharacters(str, this);
			int result = -1;
			try
			{
				if (!int.TryParse(str, NumberStyles.None, NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo, out result))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (result >= 1 && (decimal)result <= base.MaxValue)
			{
				str = result.ToString();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool ValidateSection(bool contentModificationsAllowed)
		{
			if (!base.ValidateSection(contentModificationsAllowed))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ParseToInt(out var val))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (val < 1m || val > base.MaxValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void SetText(string text)
		{
			base.SetText(text.PadLeft(base.NumberOfDigits, '0'));
		}

		internal override bool CanInsertCharAt(int pos, char c)
		{
			if (!base.CanInsertCharAt(pos, c))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (pos == 0)
			{
				if (base.DisplayChars[1].Char > MaxTrailingChar && c > '0')
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.DisplayChars[1].Char != 0 && c >= '2')
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (1 == pos)
			{
				if (base.DisplayChars[1].Char > '1')
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ('1' == base.DisplayChars[1].Char && c > MaxTrailingChar)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool Spin(bool up, bool setLimit)
		{
			string text = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = base.Calendar;
			if (text == null || text.Length == 0 || !IsInt(text))
			{
				try
				{
					SetText(calendar.GetMonth(DateTime.Now).ToString());
					return true;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			decimal num = base.MinValue;
			decimal num2 = base.MaxValue;
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 9999;
			object obj = base.MaskInfo.MinValue;
			if (obj != null && obj is DateTime time)
			{
				num = calendar.GetMonth(time);
				num3 = calendar.GetYear(time);
			}
			object obj2 = base.MaskInfo.MaxValue;
			if (obj2 != null && obj2 is DateTime time2)
			{
				num2 = calendar.GetMonth(time2);
				num4 = calendar.GetYear(time2);
			}
			if (num3 == num4)
			{
				return Spin(up, setLimit, num, num2);
			}
			return Spin(up, setLimit, base.MinValue, base.MaxValue);
		}

		internal override SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			MonthSection monthSection = new MonthSection();
			InternalCopy(monthSection);
			monthSection.InitSectionsCollection(sections);
			return monthSection;
		}

		internal static void InitializeMinMax(MonthSection section, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar)
		{
			if (calendar is EastAsianLunisolarCalendar || calendar is HebrewCalendar)
			{
				section.MaxValue = 13m;
			}
		}

		internal override bool NextSectionOnFailedInsertion()
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public sealed class DaySection : NumberSection
	{
		public DaySection()
			: base(2)
		{
			base.MinValue = 1m;
			base.MaxValue = 31m;
		}

		public override bool ValidateString(ref string str)
		{
			str = NumberSection.StripOutPadPromptCharacters(str, this);
			int result = -1;
			try
			{
				if (!int.TryParse(str, NumberStyles.None, NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo, out result))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (result >= 1 && result <= 31)
			{
				str = result.ToString();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void SetText(string text)
		{
			base.SetText(text.PadLeft(base.NumberOfDigits, '0'));
		}

		internal override bool CanInsertCharAt(int pos, char c)
		{
			if (!base.CanInsertCharAt(pos, c))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (pos == 0 && base.DisplayChars[1].Char != 0)
			{
				if (base.DisplayChars[1].Char <= '1' && c > '3')
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.DisplayChars[1].Char > '1' && c > '2')
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (1 == pos)
			{
				if (base.DisplayChars[1].Char > '3')
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.DisplayChars[1].Char > '2' && c > '1')
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool ValidateSection(bool contentModificationsAllowed)
		{
			if (!base.ValidateSection(contentModificationsAllowed))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ParseToInt(out var val))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (val < 1m || val > 31m)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool Spin(bool up, bool setLimit)
		{
			string text = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = base.Calendar;
			if (text == null || text.Length == 0 || !IsInt(text))
			{
				try
				{
					SetText(calendar.GetDayOfMonth(DateTime.Now).ToString());
					return true;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			decimal num = base.MinValue;
			decimal num2 = base.MaxValue;
			int num3 = 1;
			int num4 = 12;
			int num5 = 0;
			int num6 = 9999;
			object value = base.MaskInfo.MinValue;
			value = base.MaskInfo.ValueToDataValue(value);
			if (value != null && value is DateTime time)
			{
				num = calendar.GetDayOfMonth(time);
				num3 = calendar.GetMonth(time);
				num5 = calendar.GetYear(time);
			}
			object value2 = base.MaskInfo.MaxValue;
			value2 = base.MaskInfo.ValueToDataValue(value2);
			if (value2 != null && value2 is DateTime time2)
			{
				num2 = calendar.GetDayOfMonth(time2);
				num4 = calendar.GetMonth(time2);
				num6 = calendar.GetYear(time2);
			}
			if (num5 == num6 && num3 == num4)
			{
				return Spin(up, setLimit, num, num2);
			}
			return Spin(up, setLimit, base.MinValue, base.MaxValue);
		}

		internal override SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			DaySection daySection = new DaySection();
			InternalCopy(daySection);
			daySection.InitSectionsCollection(sections);
			return daySection;
		}

		internal override bool NextSectionOnFailedInsertion()
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public sealed class YearSection : NumberSection
	{
		private bool isFourDigits = true;

		private bool maskDisplaysEra;

		internal bool MaskDisplaysEraSection
		{
			get
			{
				return maskDisplaysEra;
			}
			set
			{
				maskDisplaysEra = value;
			}
		}

		public YearSection(bool isFourDigits)
			: base(isFourDigits ? 4 : 2)
		{
			this.isFourDigits = isFourDigits;
			base.MinValue = 0m;
			base.MaxValue = 9999m;
		}

		internal int GetYear()
		{
			int num = ToInt();
			if (maskDisplaysEra)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return GetYear(num);
		}

		internal bool TryGetYear(out int year)
		{
			if (!TryToInt(out year))
			{
				return false;
			}
			year = GetYear(year);
			return true;
		}

		private int GetYear(int year)
		{
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = base.Calendar;
			if (isFourDigits)
			{
				if (base.DisplayChars[0].Char == '\0' && base.DisplayChars[1].Char == '\0')
				{
					year = XamMaskedEditor.ConvertToFourYear(year, calendar);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				year = XamMaskedEditor.ConvertToFourYear(year, calendar);
			}
			return year;
		}

		internal override bool ParseToInt(string rawText, out decimal val)
		{
			if (base.ParseToInt(rawText, out val))
			{
				DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = base.DisplayChars;
				if (!isFourDigits || (displayChars[0].Char == '\0' && displayChars[1].Char == '\0'))
				{
					val = XamMaskedEditor.ConvertToFourYear((int)val, base.Calendar);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool ValidateSection(bool contentModificationsAllowed)
		{
			if (!base.ValidateSection(contentModificationsAllowed: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (contentModificationsAllowed)
			{
				try
				{
					if (isFourDigits && TryGetYear(out var year))
					{
						SetText(NumberSection.PadNumber(year, 4));
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool Spin(bool up, bool setLimit)
		{
			string text = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = base.Calendar;
			if (text == null || text.Length == 0 || !IsInt(text))
			{
				try
				{
					SetText(calendar.GetYear(DateTime.Now).ToString());
					return true;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			decimal num = base.MinValue;
			decimal num2 = base.MaxValue;
			object obj = base.MaskInfo.MinValue;
			object obj2 = base.MaskInfo.MaxValue;
			if (MaskDisplaysEraSection)
			{
				if (obj is DateTime && obj2 is DateTime)
				{
					DateTime time = (DateTime)obj;
					DateTime time2 = (DateTime)obj2;
					if (calendar.GetEra(time) == calendar.GetEra(time2))
					{
						num = calendar.GetYear(time);
						num2 = calendar.GetYear(time2);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (obj != null)
				{
					try
					{
						if (obj is DateTime dateTime)
						{
							num = dateTime.Year;
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				if (obj2 != null)
				{
					try
					{
						if (obj2 is DateTime dateTime2)
						{
							num2 = dateTime2.Year;
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			decimal val;
			if (setLimit)
			{
				val = (up ? num : num2);
			}
			else
			{
				try
				{
					val = GetYear();
					val = (up ? (val + 1m) : (val - 1m));
				}
				catch
				{
					val = (up ? num : num2);
				}
			}
			return Spin(up, setLimit, val, num, num2);
		}

		public override void SetText(string text)
		{
			base.SetText(text.PadLeft(base.NumberOfDigits, '0'));
		}

		internal override SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			YearSection yearSection = new YearSection(isFourDigits);
			InternalCopy(yearSection);
			yearSection.InitSectionsCollection(sections);
			yearSection.maskDisplaysEra = maskDisplaysEra;
			return yearSection;
		}

		internal static void InitializeMinMax(YearSection yearSection, System.Globalization.Calendar calendar)
		{
			yearSection.MinValue = calendar.GetYear(calendar.MinSupportedDateTime);
			yearSection.MaxValue = calendar.GetYear(calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime);
		}
	}

		internal override bool CanInsertCharAt(int pos, char c)

				return false;

			if (base.MaxValue > 12m)
			{
				if (pos == 0)
				{
					if (base.DisplayChars[1].Char > '3' && c > '1')
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (base.DisplayChars[1].Char != 0 && c > '2')
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (1 == pos)
				{
					if (base.DisplayChars[1].Char > '2')
					{
						return false;
					}
					if ('2' == base.DisplayChars[1].Char && c > '3')
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (pos == 0)
				{
					if (base.DisplayChars[1].Char > '2' && c > '0')
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (base.DisplayChars[1].Char != 0 && c > '1')
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (1 == pos)
				{
					if (base.DisplayChars[1].Char > '1')
					{
						return false;
					}
					if ('1' == base.DisplayChars[1].Char && c > '2')
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			HourSection hourSection = new HourSection();
			InternalCopy(hourSection);

			return true;

	public sealed class AMPMSection : DisplayCharsEditSection
	{
		private sealed class CustomDisplayChar : InputCharBase
		{
			private char inputChar;

			public override bool IsEditable => true;

			public override char Char
			{
				get
				{
					if (!MatchChar(inputChar))
					{
						return '\0';
					}
					return inputChar;
				}
				set
				{
					char c = value;
					if (value != 0 && !MatchChar(c))
					{
						c = '\0';
					}
					if (c != 0)
					{
						c = Filter(c);
					}
					inputChar = c;
					NotifyPropertyChangedEvent(DisplayCharBase.PROPERTY_CHAR);
				}
			}

			internal CustomDisplayChar(AMPMSection section)
				: base(section)
			{
				base.IncludeMethod = DisplayCharIncludeMethod.Always;
			}

			public override bool MatchChar(char c)
			{
				char c2 = Filter(c);
				AMPMSection aMPMSection = (AMPMSection)base.Section;
				DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = aMPMSection.DisplayChars;
				int num = base.Index;
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				char c3 = char.ToLower(c, base.MaskInfo.CultureInfo);
				if (aMPMSection.amValue.Length > num && char.ToLower(aMPMSection.amValue[num], base.MaskInfo.CultureInfo) == c3)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (aMPMSection.pmValue.Length > num && char.ToLower(aMPMSection.pmValue[num], base.MaskInfo.CultureInfo) == c3)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				if (!flag && !flag2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (num == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (flag && base.PrevDisplayChar.MatchChar(aMPMSection.amValue[num - 1]))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (flag2 && base.PrevDisplayChar.MatchChar(aMPMSection.pmValue[num - 1]))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal override void InternalCopy(DisplayCharBase dest)
			{
				base.InternalCopy(dest);
				CustomDisplayChar customDisplayChar = (CustomDisplayChar)dest;
				customDisplayChar.inputChar = inputChar;
			}

			internal override DisplayCharBase InternalClone(SectionBase section)
			{
				CustomDisplayChar customDisplayChar = new CustomDisplayChar((AMPMSection)section);
				InternalCopy(customDisplayChar);
				return customDisplayChar;
			}
		}

		private string amValue;

		private string pmValue;

		internal string AMValue => amValue;

		internal string PMValue => pmValue;

		internal override bool SupportsSpinning => true;

		internal AMPMSection(string amValue, string pmValue)
		{
			Utils.ValidateNull("amValue", amValue);
			Utils.ValidateNull("pmValue", pmValue);
			this.amValue = amValue;
			this.pmValue = pmValue;
			CreateDisplayChars();
		}

		internal override bool CanSpin(bool up)
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool Spin(bool up, bool setLimit)
		{
			ToggleAMPM();
			return true;
		}

		internal void ToggleAMPM()
		{
			string text = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
			if (string.Compare(text, amValue, ignoreCase: true, base.MaskInfo.CultureInfo) == 0)
			{
				SetText(pmValue);
			}
			else if (string.Compare(text, pmValue, ignoreCase: true, base.MaskInfo.CultureInfo) == 0)
			{
				SetText(amValue);
			}
			else
			{
				SetText(amValue);
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsInputFull()
		{
			string text = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
			if (string.Compare(amValue, text, ignoreCase: true, base.MaskInfo.CultureInfo) == 0 || string.Compare(pmValue, text, ignoreCase: true, base.MaskInfo.CultureInfo) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CreateDisplayChars()
		{
			int num = Math.Max(amValue.Length, pmValue.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				base.DisplayChars.Add(new CustomDisplayChar(this));
			}
		}

		internal override SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			AMPMSection aMPMSection = new AMPMSection(amValue, pmValue);
			InternalCopy(aMPMSection);
			aMPMSection.InitSectionsCollection(sections);
			return aMPMSection;
		}

		public override bool ValidateSection(bool contentModificationsAllowed)
		{
			if (!base.ValidateSection(contentModificationsAllowed))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (contentModificationsAllowed)
			{
				string text = "";
				for (int i = 0; i < base.DisplayChars.Count; i++)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[i];
					if (displayCharBase != null && !displayCharBase.IsEmpty)
					{
						text += displayCharBase.Char;
					}
				}
				if (text.Length > 0)
				{
					text = text.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
					bool flag = AMValue.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture).StartsWith(text);
					bool flag2 = PMValue.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture).StartsWith(text);
					if (flag && !flag2)
					{
						SetText(AMValue);
					}
					else if (flag2 && !flag)
					{
						SetText(PMValue);
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public sealed class MinuteSection : NumberSection
	{
		public MinuteSection()
			: base(2)
		{
			base.MinValue = 0m;
			base.MaxValue = 59m;
		}

		public override bool ValidateString(ref string str)
		{
			str = NumberSection.StripOutPadPromptCharacters(str, this);
			int result = -1;
			try
			{
				if (!int.TryParse(str, NumberStyles.None, NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo, out result))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (result >= 0 && result <= 59)
			{
				str = result.ToString();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool ValidateSection(bool contentModificationsAllowed)
		{
			if (!base.ValidateSection(contentModificationsAllowed))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ParseToInt(out var val))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (val < 0m || val >= 60m)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void SetText(string text)
		{
			base.SetText(text.PadLeft(base.NumberOfDigits, '0'));
		}

		internal override SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			MinuteSection minuteSection = new MinuteSection();
			InternalCopy(minuteSection);
			minuteSection.InitSectionsCollection(sections);
			return minuteSection;
		}

		internal override bool NextSectionOnFailedInsertion()
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public sealed class SecondSection : NumberSection
	{
		public SecondSection()
			: base(2)
		{
			base.MinValue = 0m;
			base.MaxValue = 59m;
		}

		public override bool ValidateString(ref string str)
		{
			str = NumberSection.StripOutPadPromptCharacters(str, this);
			int result = -1;
			try
			{
				if (!int.TryParse(str, NumberStyles.None, NumberFormatInfo.CurrentInfo, out result))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((decimal)result >= base.MinValue && (decimal)result <= base.MaxValue)
			{
				str = result.ToString();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void SetText(string text)
		{
			base.SetText(text.PadLeft(base.NumberOfDigits, '0'));
		}

		public override bool ValidateSection(bool contentModificationsAllowed)
		{
			if (!base.ValidateSection(contentModificationsAllowed))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ParseToInt(out var val))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (val < base.MinValue || val > base.MaxValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			SecondSection secondSection = new SecondSection();
			InternalCopy(secondSection);
			secondSection.InitSectionsCollection(sections);
			return secondSection;
		}
	}
	public sealed class EraSection : DisplayCharsEditSection
	{
		private sealed class EraDisplayChar : DisplayCharBase
		{
			private char inputChar;

			public override bool IsEditable => true;

			public override char Char
			{
				get
				{
					if (!MatchChar(inputChar))
					{
						return '\0';
					}
					return inputChar;
				}
				set
				{
					char c = value;
					if (value != 0 && !MatchChar(c))
					{
						c = '\0';
					}
					if (c != 0)
					{
						c = Filter(c);
					}
					if (c != inputChar)
					{
						inputChar = c;
					}
				}
			}

			internal EraDisplayChar(EraSection section)
				: base(section)
			{
				if (section == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_90"), SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_89"));
				}
				base.IncludeMethod = DisplayCharIncludeMethod.Always;
			}

			public override bool MatchChar(char c)
			{
				if (c == '\0')
				{
					return false;
				}
				EraSection eraSection = (EraSection)base.Section;
				int num = base.Index;
				char c2 = char.ToLower(c, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = XamMaskedEditor.GetDateTimeFormatInfo(base.MaskInfo.FormatProvider);
				int[] eras = dateTimeFormatInfo.Calendar.Eras;
				foreach (int era in eras)
				{
					string eraName = dateTimeFormatInfo.GetEraName(era);
					if (eraName.Length > num && char.ToLower(eraName[num], CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == c2)
					{
						if (num == 0)
						{
							return true;
						}
						DisplayCharBase prevDisplayChar = base.PrevDisplayChar;
						if (prevDisplayChar.MatchChar(eraName[num - 1]))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal override void InternalCopy(DisplayCharBase dest)
			{
				base.InternalCopy(dest);
				EraDisplayChar eraDisplayChar = (EraDisplayChar)dest;
				eraDisplayChar.inputChar = inputChar;
			}

			internal override DisplayCharBase InternalClone(SectionBase section)
			{
				EraDisplayChar eraDisplayChar = new EraDisplayChar((EraSection)section);
				InternalCopy(eraDisplayChar);
				return eraDisplayChar;
			}
		}

		internal class EraInfo
		{
			internal string Name { get; private set; }

			internal int EraNumber { get; private set; }

			internal char EraNumberAsChar { get; private set; }

			internal string AbbreviatedName { get; private set; }

			internal DateTime EraMinDate { get; private set; }

			internal DateTime EraMaxDate { get; private set; }

			internal EraInfo(string name, int eraNumber, string abbreviation, DateTime eraMinDate, DateTime eraMaxDate)
			{
				Name = name;
				EraNumber = eraNumber;
				EraNumberAsChar = Convert.ToChar(eraNumber.ToString());
				AbbreviatedName = abbreviation;
				EraMinDate = eraMinDate;
				EraMaxDate = eraMaxDate;
			}
		}

		private List<EraInfo> eras;

		private Type erasCalendarType;

		internal override bool SupportsSpinning => true;

		private List<EraInfo> Eras
		{
			get
			{
				if (eras == null || erasCalendarType != XamMaskedEditor.GetDateTimeFormatInfo(base.MaskInfo.FormatProvider).Calendar.GetType())
				{
					eras = XamMaskedEditor.GetCultureEras(base.MaskInfo.FormatProvider, out erasCalendarType);
				}
				return eras;
			}
		}

		internal EraSection(List<EraInfo> eras, Type erasCalendarType, bool isAbreviated)
		{
			this.eras = eras;
			this.erasCalendarType = erasCalendarType;
			CreateDisplayChars(isAbreviated);
		}

		internal override bool CanSpin(bool up)
		{
			return SpinHelper(up, setLimit: true, performSpin: false);
		}

		internal int GetEra()
		{
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = XamMaskedEditor.GetDateTimeFormatInfo(base.Sections.FormatProvider);
			int num = EraSupportUtils.GetEra(dateTimeFormatInfo, GetText(MaskMode.Raw));
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = EraSupportUtils.GetLastEra(dateTimeFormatInfo);
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal override bool Spin(bool up, bool setLimit)
		{
			return SpinHelper(up, setLimit, performSpin: true);
		}

		private bool SpinHelper(bool up, bool setLimit, bool performSpin)
		{
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = XamMaskedEditor.GetDateTimeFormatInfo(base.MaskInfo.FormatProvider);
			if (setLimit)
			{
				if (performSpin)
				{
					SetText(up ? EraSupportUtils.GetLastEraName(dateTimeFormatInfo) : EraSupportUtils.GetFirstEraName(dateTimeFormatInfo));
				}
				return true;
			}
			int era = EraSupportUtils.GetEra(dateTimeFormatInfo, GetText(MaskMode.Raw));
			if (era > 0)
			{
				if (!up && era != 1)
				{
					era--;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!up || era >= EraSupportUtils.GetEraCount(dateTimeFormatInfo))
					{
						return false;
					}
					era++;
				}
				if (performSpin && EraSupportUtils.TryGetEraName(dateTimeFormatInfo, era, out var eraName))
				{
					SetText(eraName);
					base.MaskedEdit.NotifyDisplayCharDrawStringsChanged();
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool IsInputFull()
		{
			string text = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = XamMaskedEditor.GetDateTimeFormatInfo(base.MaskInfo.FormatProvider);
			int[] array = dateTimeFormatInfo.Calendar.Eras;
			foreach (int era in array)
			{
				if (string.Compare(dateTimeFormatInfo.GetEraName(era), text, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CreateDisplayChars(bool isAbreviated)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (EraInfo era in eras)
			{
				num = ((!isAbreviated) ? Math.Max(num, era.Name.Length) : Math.Max(num, era.AbbreviatedName.Length));
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				base.DisplayChars.Add(new EraDisplayChar(this));
			}
		}

		internal override SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			EraSection eraSection = ((base.DisplayChars.Count != 1) ? new EraSection(eras, erasCalendarType, isAbreviated: false) : new EraSection(eras, erasCalendarType, isAbreviated: true));
			InternalCopy(eraSection);
			eraSection.InitSectionsCollection(sections);
			return eraSection;
		}

		public override bool ValidateSection(bool contentModificationsAllowed)
		{
			if (!base.ValidateSection(contentModificationsAllowed))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (contentModificationsAllowed)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = base.DisplayChars.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[i];
					if (displayCharBase != null)
					{
						char value = displayCharBase.Char;
						if (!displayCharBase.IsEmpty)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(value);
						}
					}
				}
				string text = stringBuilder.ToString();
				if (text.Length > 0 && EraSupportUtils.TryGetEraName(base.MaskInfo.FormatProvider, text, out var eraName) && !GetText().Equals(eraName))
				{
					SetText(eraName);
					base.MaskedEdit.NotifyDisplayCharDrawStringsChanged();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal static class EraSupportUtils
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<System.Globalization.Calendar, Dictionary<int, DateTime>> eraMinDates;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<System.Globalization.Calendar, Dictionary<int, DateTime>> eraMaxDates;

		private static Dictionary<System.Globalization.Calendar, Dictionary<int, DateTime>> EraMinDates
		{
			get
			{
				if (eraMinDates == null)
				{
					eraMinDates = new Dictionary<System.Globalization.Calendar, Dictionary<int, DateTime>>();
				}
				return eraMinDates;
			}
		}

		internal static Dictionary<System.Globalization.Calendar, Dictionary<int, DateTime>> EraMaxDates
		{
			get
			{
				if (eraMaxDates == null)
				{
					eraMaxDates = new Dictionary<System.Globalization.Calendar, Dictionary<int, DateTime>>();
				}
				return eraMaxDates;
			}
		}

		private static DateTimeFormatInfo GetDateTimeFormatInfo(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			return XamMaskedEditor.GetDateTimeFormatInfo(formatProvider);
		}

		internal static System.Globalization.Calendar GetCalendar(DateTimeFormatInfo formatInfo)
		{
			return formatInfo.Calendar;
		}

		internal static System.Globalization.Calendar GetCalendar(IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			return GetCalendar(GetDateTimeFormatInfo(formatProvider));
		}

		internal static int GetEra(IFormatProvider provider, string searchString)
		{
			return GetEra(GetDateTimeFormatInfo(provider), searchString);
		}

		internal static int GetEra(DateTimeFormatInfo formatInfo, string searchString)
		{
			return formatInfo.GetEra(searchString);
		}

		internal static int GetEraCount(DateTimeFormatInfo formatInfo)
		{
			return GetCalendar(formatInfo).Eras.Length;
		}

		internal static int GetFirstEra(IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			return GetFirstEra(GetDateTimeFormatInfo(provider));
		}

		internal static int GetFirstEra(DateTimeFormatInfo formatInfo)
		{
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = GetCalendar(formatInfo);
			if (calendar.Eras.Length != 0)
			{
				return calendar.Eras[0];
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal static string GetFirstEraName(IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			return GetFirstEraName(GetDateTimeFormatInfo(provider));
		}

		internal static string GetFirstEraName(DateTimeFormatInfo formatInfo)
		{
			if (TryGetEraName(formatInfo, GetFirstEra(formatInfo), out var eraName))
			{
				return eraName;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal static int GetLastEra(IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			return GetLastEra(GetDateTimeFormatInfo(provider));
		}

		internal static int GetLastEra(DateTimeFormatInfo formatInfo)
		{
			System.Globalization.Calendar calendar = GetCalendar(formatInfo);
			int num = calendar.Eras.Length;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return calendar.Eras[num - 1];
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal static string GetLastEraName(IFormatProvider provider)
		{
			return GetLastEraName(GetDateTimeFormatInfo(provider));
		}

		internal static string GetLastEraName(DateTimeFormatInfo formatInfo)
		{
			if (TryGetEraName(formatInfo, GetLastEra(formatInfo), out var eraName))
			{
				return eraName;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal static bool TryGetEraName(IFormatProvider provider, string searchString, out string eraName)
		{
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = GetDateTimeFormatInfo(provider);
			return TryGetEraName(dateTimeFormatInfo, searchString, out eraName);
		}

		internal static bool TryGetEraName(DateTimeFormatInfo formatInfo, string searchString, out string eraName)
		{
			if (!int.TryParse(searchString, out var result))
			{
				result = formatInfo.GetEra(searchString);
			}
			return TryGetEraName(formatInfo, result, out eraName);
		}

		internal static bool TryGetEraName(IFormatProvider provider, int eraNumber, out string eraName)
		{
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = GetDateTimeFormatInfo(provider);
			return TryGetEraName(dateTimeFormatInfo, eraNumber, out eraName);
		}

		internal static bool TryGetEraName(DateTimeFormatInfo formatInfo, int eraNumber, out string eraName)
		{
			if (eraNumber > 0 && eraNumber <= GetEraCount(formatInfo))
			{
				eraName = formatInfo.GetEraName(eraNumber);
				return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(eraName);
			}
			eraName = string.Empty;
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool TryGetAbbreviatedEraName(IFormatProvider provider, int eraNumber, out string eraName)
		{
			DateTimeFormatInfo dateTimeFormatInfo = GetDateTimeFormatInfo(provider);
			return TryGetAbbreviatedEraName(dateTimeFormatInfo, eraNumber, out eraName);
		}

		internal static bool TryGetAbbreviatedEraName(DateTimeFormatInfo formatInfo, int eraNumber, out string eraName)
		{
			if (eraNumber > 0 && eraNumber <= GetEraCount(formatInfo))
			{
				eraName = formatInfo.GetAbbreviatedEraName(eraNumber);
				return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(eraName);
			}
			eraName = string.Empty;
			return false;
		}

		internal static DateTime GetEraMinDate(System.Globalization.Calendar calendar, int eraNumber)
		{
			if (EraMinDates.TryGetValue(calendar, out var value))
			{
				if (value.TryGetValue(eraNumber, out var value2))
				{
					return value2;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				value = new Dictionary<int, DateTime>();
				EraMinDates[calendar] = value;
			}
			DateTime dateTime = calendar.MinSupportedDateTime;
			DateTime dateTime2 = calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime;
			while (dateTime != dateTime2)
			{
				DateTime dateTime3 = FindMiddleDate(dateTime, dateTime2);
				int era = calendar.GetEra(dateTime3);
				if (era > eraNumber)
				{
					dateTime2 = dateTime3;
				}
				else if (era < eraNumber)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime3;
				}
				else if (era == eraNumber)
				{
					int era2 = calendar.GetEra(dateTime2);
					int era3 = calendar.GetEra(dateTime);
					if (era2 >= era)
					{
						dateTime2 = dateTime3;
					}
				}
				if ((dateTime2 - dateTime).TotalMilliseconds <= 1.0)
				{
					value[eraNumber] = dateTime2;
					return dateTime2;
				}
			}
			return calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime;
		}

		internal static DateTime GetEraMaxDate(System.Globalization.Calendar calendar, int eraNumber)
		{
			if (EraMaxDates.TryGetValue(calendar, out var value))
			{
				if (value.TryGetValue(eraNumber, out var value2))
				{
					return value2;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				value = new Dictionary<int, DateTime>();
				EraMaxDates[calendar] = value;
			}
			DateTime dateTime = calendar.MinSupportedDateTime;
			DateTime dateTime2 = calendar.MaxSupportedDateTime;
			while (dateTime != dateTime2)
			{
				DateTime dateTime3 = FindMiddleDate(dateTime, dateTime2);
				int era = calendar.GetEra(dateTime3);
				if (era > eraNumber)
				{
					dateTime2 = dateTime3;
				}
				else if (era < eraNumber)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime3;
				}
				else if (era == eraNumber)
				{
					int era2 = calendar.GetEra(dateTime2);
					int era3 = calendar.GetEra(dateTime);
					if (era3 <= era)
					{
						dateTime = dateTime3;
					}
				}
				if ((dateTime2 - dateTime).TotalMilliseconds <= 1.0)
				{
					value[eraNumber] = dateTime;
					return dateTime;
				}
			}
			return calendar.MinSupportedDateTime;
		}

		private static DateTime FindMiddleDate(DateTime dateTime1, DateTime dateTime2)
		{
			return dateTime1.AddMinutes(((dateTime1 < dateTime2) ? (dateTime2 - dateTime1) : (dateTime1 - dateTime2)).TotalMinutes / 2.0);
		}
	}
	public class FractionPart : EditSectionBase
	{
		private int digits = 2;

		private double minValue;

		private double maxValue;

		public int NumberOfDigits => digits;

		internal double MinValue
		{
			get
			{
				return minValue;
			}
			set
			{
				minValue = value;
			}
		}

		internal double MaxValue
		{
			get
			{
				return maxValue;
			}
			set
			{
				maxValue = value;
			}
		}

		internal double DeltaValue => Math.Pow(10.0, -digits);

		internal virtual bool ContinuousEditing => false;

		private char NumberDecimalSeparator => XamMaskedEditor.GetCultureChar('.', base.MaskInfo.FormatProvider, useCurrencySymbols: false);

		public override EditOrientation Orientation => EditOrientation.LeftToRight;

		internal override bool SupportsSpinning => true;

		internal NumberSection NumberSection => PreviousEditSection as NumberSection;

		internal FractionPart(int digits)
		{
			this.digits = digits;
			ResetMaxValue();
			CreateDisplayChars();
		}

		internal void ResetMaxValue()
		{
			maxValue = 1.0 - Math.Pow(10.0, -digits);
		}

		internal void ResetMinValue()
		{
			minValue = 0.0;
		}

		internal override bool CanInsertCharAt(int pos, char c)
		{
			if (pos < 0 || pos >= base.DisplayChars.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[pos];
			if (displayCharBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!displayCharBase.IsEditable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!displayCharBase.MatchChar(c))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!base.LastDisplayChar.IsEmpty && '0' != base.LastDisplayChar.Char)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool InsertCharAt(int pos, char c)
		{
			if (c == '\0')
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CanInsertCharAt(pos, c))
			{
				for (int num = base.DisplayChars.Count - 1; num > pos; num--)
				{
					base.DisplayChars[num].Char = base.DisplayChars[num - 1].Char;
				}
				base.DisplayChars[pos].Char = c;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool DeleteCharAndShift(int pos)
		{
			return DeleteCharsAndShift(pos, 1);
		}

		internal override bool DeleteCharsAndShift(int pos, int count)
		{
			int count2 = base.DisplayChars.Count;
			if (pos < 0 || pos >= count2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = pos; i < count2; i++)
			{
				char c = '\0';
				if (count + i < count2)
				{
					c = base.DisplayChars[count + i].Char;
				}
				base.DisplayChars[i].Char = c;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
			{
				base.DisplayChars[count2 - j - 1].Char = '\0';
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void SetText(string text)
		{
			int num = 0;
			DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = base.DisplayChars;
			int count = displayChars.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = displayChars[i];
				if (displayCharBase.IsEditable)
				{
					char c = '\0';
					if (num >= 0 && num < text.Length)
					{
						c = text[num++];
					}
					displayCharBase.Char = c;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsInputFull()
		{
			if (base.IsInputFull())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (base.LastDisplayChar.IsEmpty || '0' == base.LastDisplayChar.Char)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override void EraseChars(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			if (startIndex > endIndex)
			{
				int num = startIndex;
				startIndex = endIndex;
				endIndex = num;
			}
			int num2 = 1 + endIndex - startIndex;
			for (int i = startIndex; i < base.DisplayChars.Count; i++)
			{
				if (i < base.DisplayChars.Count)
				{
					char c = '\0';
					if (i + num2 < base.DisplayChars.Count)
					{
						c = base.DisplayChars[i + num2].Char;
					}
					if (base.DisplayChars[i].IsEditable)
					{
						base.DisplayChars[i].Char = c;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal double GetFractionValue()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("0" + base.DecimalSeperatorChar, 5 + base.DisplayChars.Count);
			DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = base.DisplayChars;
			int count = displayChars.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				char c = displayChars[i].Char;
				if (c == '\0' && ContinuousEditing)
				{
					c = '0';
				}
				if (c != 0 && char.IsDigit(c))
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Append('0');
			return double.Parse(stringBuilder.ToString(), base.MaskInfo.FormatProvider);
		}

		internal override bool CanShiftRight(int from, int positionsToShift)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool CanShiftLeft(int from, int positionsToShift)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool ShiftLeft(int from, int positionsToShift)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool ShiftRight(int from, int positionsToShift)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool DeleteCharWithNoShift(int pos)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public override bool ValidateSection(bool contentModificationsAllowed)
		{
			if (contentModificationsAllowed)
			{
				int count = base.DisplayChars.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[i];
					if (displayCharBase.IsEmpty)
					{
						if (LastFilledChar == null || displayCharBase.Index >= LastFilledChar.Index)
						{
							break;
						}
						DeleteCharAndShift(i);
						i--;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual void PadWithZero()
		{
			int count = base.DisplayChars.Count;
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[num];
				if (displayCharBase != null)
				{
					if (!displayCharBase.IsEmpty)
					{
						break;
					}
					displayCharBase.Char = '0';
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void TrimInsignificantZeros()
		{
			DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = base.DisplayChars;
			int count = displayChars.Count;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = displayChars[num];
				if (flag || !displayCharBase.IsEmpty)
				{
					flag = true;
					if ('0' != displayCharBase.Char)
					{
						break;
					}
					displayCharBase.Char = '\0';
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool ValidateString(ref string str)
		{
			str = NumberSection.StripOutPadPromptCharacters(str, this);
			for (int i = 0; i < str.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!char.IsDigit(str, i))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (str.Length > base.DisplayChars.Count)
			{
				str = str.Substring(0, base.DisplayChars.Count);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CreateDisplayChars()
		{
			base.DisplayChars.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < digits; i++)
			{
				base.DisplayChars.Add(new DigitChar(this));
			}
		}

		internal override bool CanSpin(bool up)
		{
			string text = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
			if (up && (text == null || text.Length == 0))
			{
				return true;
			}
			double fractionValue;
			try
			{
				fractionValue = GetFractionValue();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.MaskInfo.MaskEditor.SpinWrappingAllowed)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (up)
			{
				return DeltaValue + fractionValue <= MaxValue;
			}
			return fractionValue - DeltaValue >= MinValue;
		}

		internal void SetFractionValue(double fractionValue)
		{
			fractionValue -= Math.Floor(fractionValue);
			try
			{
				long n = (long)Math.Round(fractionValue * Math.Pow(10.0, digits), 0);
				string text = NumberSection.PadNumber(n, digits);
				XamMaskedEditor maskedEdit = base.MaskedEdit;
				if (maskedEdit.TrimFractionalZeros && !(this is FractionPartContinuous))
				{
					text = text.TrimEnd('0');
				}
				SetText(text);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		internal override bool Spin(bool up, bool setLimit)
		{
			try
			{
				XamMaskedEditor maskedEdit = base.MaskedEdit;
				double num;
				if (setLimit)
				{
					num = (up ? MaxValue : MinValue);
				}
				else
				{
					string text = GetText(MaskMode.Raw);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || !IsInt(text))
					{
						num = (up ? MinValue : MaxValue);
						if (up && 0.0 == num && maskedEdit.TrimFractionalZeros)
						{
							num += DeltaValue;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num = double.Parse("0" + NumberDecimalSeparator + text, base.MaskInfo.FormatProvider);
						num += (up ? DeltaValue : (0.0 - DeltaValue));
					}
				}
				if (maskedEdit.SpinWrappingAllowed)
				{
					if (up)
					{
						if (num <= MaxValue)
						{
							SetFractionValue(num);
						}
						else if (num > MaxValue)
						{
							SetFractionValue(MinValue);
						}
					}
					else if (num >= MinValue)
					{
						SetFractionValue(num);
					}
					else if (num < MinValue)
					{
						SetFractionValue(MaxValue);
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (num >= MinValue && num <= MaxValue)
				{
					SetFractionValue(num);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			FractionPart fractionPart = new FractionPart(digits);
			InternalCopy(fractionPart);
			fractionPart.InitSectionsCollection(sections);
			return fractionPart;
		}

		internal override void InternalCopy(SectionBase dest)
		{
			base.InternalCopy(dest);
			FractionPart fractionPart = (FractionPart)dest;
		}
	}
	public sealed class FractionPartContinuous : FractionPart
	{
		internal override bool ContinuousEditing => true;

		public override EditOrientation Orientation => EditOrientation.RightToLeft;

		internal FractionPartContinuous(int digits)
			: base(digits)
		{
		}

		internal override bool CanInsertCharAt(int pos, char c)
		{
			if (pos < 0 || pos > base.DisplayChars.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = SafeDisplayCharAt(pos);
			DisplayCharBase displayCharBase2 = ((displayCharBase != null) ? displayCharBase : base.LastDisplayChar);
			if (!displayCharBase2.MatchChar(c))
			{
				return false;
			}
			NumberSection numberSection = base.NumberSection;
			if (IsInputFull() && numberSection != null && !numberSection.CanInsertCharAt(numberSection.LastDisplayChar.Index, base.FirstDisplayChar.Char))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override bool InsertCharAt(int pos, char c)
		{
			if (c == '\0')
			{
				return false;
			}
			NumberSection numberSection = base.NumberSection;
			if (CanInsertCharAt(pos, c) && (base.FirstDisplayChar.IsEmpty || (numberSection != null && numberSection.InsertCharAt(numberSection.LastDisplayChar.Index, base.FirstDisplayChar.Char))))
			{
				for (int i = 1; i <= pos; i++)
				{
					base.DisplayChars[i - 1].Char = base.DisplayChars[i].Char;
				}
				base.DisplayChars[pos].Char = c;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool DeleteCharsAndShift(int pos, int count)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (!DeleteCharHelper(pos))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool DeleteCharHelper(int pos)
		{
			int count = base.DisplayChars.Count;
			if (pos < 0 || pos >= count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			NumberSection numberSection = base.NumberSection;
			for (int num = pos; num > 0; num--)
			{
				base.DisplayChars[num].Char = base.DisplayChars[num - 1].Char;
			}
			char c = numberSection?.LastDisplayChar.Char ?? '\0';
			if (c != 0 && (!base.DisplayChars[0].MatchChar(c) || !numberSection.DeleteCharAndShift(numberSection.LastDisplayChar.Index)))
			{
				c = '\0';
			}
			base.DisplayChars[0].Char = c;
			return true;
		}

		internal override string GetText(MaskMode maskMode)
		{
			DisplayCharsCollection displayChars = base.DisplayChars;
			int count = displayChars.Count;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(count);
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = displayChars[i];
				stringBuilder.Append((!displayCharBase.IsEmpty) ? displayCharBase.Char : '0');
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal override bool IsInputFull()
		{
			if (base.IsInputFull() && (base.NumberSection == null || base.NumberSection.IsInputFull()))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void EraseChars(int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			if (startIndex > endIndex)
			{
				int num = startIndex;
				startIndex = endIndex;
				endIndex = num;
			}
			int pos = endIndex;
			int count = 1 + endIndex - startIndex;
			DeleteCharsAndShift(pos, count);
		}

		public override bool ValidateSection(bool contentModificationsAllowed)
		{
			if (contentModificationsAllowed && (!IsEmpty || (base.NumberSection != null && !base.NumberSection.IsEmpty)))
			{
				PadWithZeroHelper(force: true);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override void PadWithZero()
		{
			PadWithZeroHelper(force: false);
		}

		private void PadWithZeroHelper(bool force)
		{
			int count = base.DisplayChars.Count;
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = base.DisplayChars[num];
				if (displayCharBase.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (num == count - 1 && !force)
					{
						break;
					}
					displayCharBase.Char = '0';
				}
			}
		}

		internal override SectionBase InternalClone(SectionsCollection sections)
		{
			FractionPart fractionPart = new FractionPartContinuous(base.NumberOfDigits);
			InternalCopy(fractionPart);
			fractionPart.InitSectionsCollection(sections);
			return fractionPart;
		}
	}
	public class SectionsCollection : ReadOnlyObservableCollection<SectionBase>
	{
		private class AllDisplayCharacterEnumerable : IEnumerable
		{
			private SectionsCollection _sections;

			internal AllDisplayCharacterEnumerable(SectionsCollection sections)
			{
				_sections = sections;
			}

			public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
			{
				return new AllDisplayCharacterEnumerator(_sections);
			}
		}

		private class AllDisplayCharacterEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private SectionsCollection _sections;

			private DisplayCharBase _current;

			public object Current => _current;

			internal AllDisplayCharacterEnumerator(SectionsCollection sections)
			{
				_sections = sections;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				_current = null;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				if (_current == null)
				{
					_current = ((_sections != null && _sections.Count > 0) ? _sections[0].FirstDisplayChar : null);
				}
				else
				{
					_current = _current.NextDisplayChar;
				}
				return _current != null;
			}
		}

		private MaskInfo maskInfo;

		internal bool _isCacheInvalid;

		internal MaskInfo MaskInfo => maskInfo;

		internal XamMaskedEditor MaskedEditor => maskInfo.MaskEditor;

		internal IEnumerable AllDisplayCharacters => new AllDisplayCharacterEnumerable(this);

		internal IFormatProvider FormatProvider
		{
			get
			{
				if (maskInfo == null)
				{
					return CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
				}
				return maskInfo.FormatProvider;
			}
		}

		internal System.Globalization.Calendar Calendar => XamMaskedEditor.GetCultureCalendar(FormatProvider);

		internal SectionsCollection()
			: base(new ObservableCollection<SectionBase>())
		{
		}

		internal void Initialize(MaskInfo maskInfo)
		{
			this.maskInfo = maskInfo;
		}

		internal void Add(SectionBase section)
		{
			base.Items.Add(section);
			section.InitSectionsCollection(this);
		}

		private void CopyCharacterValues(DisplayCharsCollection dest, DisplayCharsCollection src)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < src.Count; i++)
			{
				DisplayCharBase displayCharBase = dest[i];
				if (displayCharBase.IsEditable)
				{
					displayCharBase.Char = src[i].Char;
				}
			}
		}

		internal SectionsCollection Clone(MaskInfo maskInfo, bool copyDisplayCharacterValues)
		{
			SectionsCollection sectionsCollection = new SectionsCollection();
			sectionsCollection.Initialize(maskInfo);
			using IEnumerator<SectionBase> enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SectionBase current = enumerator.Current;
				SectionBase sectionBase = current.InternalClone(sectionsCollection);
				sectionsCollection.Add(sectionBase);
				if (copyDisplayCharacterValues)
				{
					CopyCharacterValues(sectionBase.DisplayChars, current.DisplayChars);
				}
			}
			return sectionsCollection;
		}

		internal bool HasEraSection()
		{
			using (IEnumerator<SectionBase> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					SectionBase current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current is EraSection)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal SignDisplayType GetSignDisplayType()
		{
			using (IEnumerator<SectionBase> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					SectionBase current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current is NumberSection { SignType: not SignDisplayType.None } numberSection)
					{
						return numberSection.SignType;
					}
				}
			}
			return SignDisplayType.None;
		}
	}

		protected ValueEditor()

		protected override HitTestResult HitTestCore(PointHitTestParameters hitTestParameters)
		{
			Rect rect = new Rect(default(Point), base.RenderSize);
			if (rect.Contains(hitTestParameters.HitPoint))
			{
				return new PointHitTestResult(this, hitTestParameters.HitPoint);
			}
			return base.HitTestCore(hitTestParameters);
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			VerifyFocusSite();
			_hasVisualStateGroups = VisualStateUtilities.GetHasVisualStateGroups(this);
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: false);
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new ValueEditorAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnGotFocus(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!_settingFocusOnTemplateChange || IsInEditMode || IsAlwaysInEditMode)
			{
				base.OnGotFocus(e);
			}
			else
			{
				RaiseEvent(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			if (!_initialized)
			{
				_initialized = true;
				DoInitialization();
				if (_host == null && IsAlwaysInEditMode)
				{
					StartEditMode(takeFocus: false);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged(e);
			if ((bool)e.NewValue)
			{
				SetFocusToFocusSite();
			}
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			if (e.Handled || (_host != null && _host.OnValueEditorKeyDown(e)))
			{
				return;
			}
			ProcessKeyDown(e);
			if (e.Handled || _host != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Escape:
			{
				if (!IsInEditMode)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (!IsAlwaysInEditMode)
				{
					_focusSelfInEndEditMode++;
					try
					{
						EndEditMode(acceptChanges: false, force: false);
					}
					finally
					{
						_focusSelfInEndEditMode--;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RevertValueBackToOriginalValue();
				}
				bool flag = true;
				if (!IsEmbedded && Utilities.GetAncestorFromType(this, typeof(ValueEditor), allowSubclassOfType: true) is ValueEditor { IsInEditMode: not false })
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			case Key.Return:
				if (!IsAlwaysInEditMode && IsInEditMode)
				{
					Focus();
					EndEditMode(acceptChanges: true, force: false);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			case Key.F2:
				if (!IsAlwaysInEditMode)
				{
					if (IsInEditMode)
					{
						Focus();
						EndEditMode(acceptChanges: true, force: false);
					}
					else
					{
						StartEditMode();
					}
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			UpdateVisualStates();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				e.Handled = StartEditModeOnMouseDownHelper();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewLostKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsInEditMode && (_host == null || !_host.BypassValidationOnLostFocus))
			{
				DependencyObject dependencyObject = e.OldFocus as DependencyObject;
				if (e.NewFocus is DependencyObject dependencyObject2 && FocusManager.GetFocusScope(dependencyObject2) == FocusManager.GetFocusScope(this) && !FocusWithinManager.IsAncestorOf(this, dependencyObject2))
				{
					ValidateInputHelper(fromLostFocus: true, forceExitEditMode: false, out var eventArgs, out var stayInEditMode);
					if (eventArgs != null && stayInEditMode)
					{
						e.Handled = true;
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnPreviewLostKeyboardFocus(e);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DependencyProperty property = e.Property;
			if (property == Control.TemplateProperty && base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && !base.IsKeyboardFocused && IsFocusWithin)
			{
				try
				{
					_settingFocusOnTemplateChange = true;
					Focus();
				}
				finally
				{
					_settingFocusOnTemplateChange = false;
				}
			}
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (property == FrameworkElement.StyleProperty)
			{
				VerifyTemplateState();
			}
			else if (property == Control.TemplateProperty)
			{
				if (_focusSite != null)
				{
					_focusSite = null;
					OnFocusSiteChanged();
				}
				VerifyTemplateState();
				VerifyFocusSite();
			}
			else if (property == IsInEditModeProperty)
			{
				VerifyTemplateState();
			}
			else if (property == ValueProperty)
			{
				if (!IsInEditMode || (IsAlwaysInEditMode && !IsFocusWithin))
				{
					InitializeOriginalValueFromValue();
				}
			}
			else if (property == IsAlwaysInEditModeProperty)
			{
				if (_host != null || !base.IsInitialized)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (IsAlwaysInEditMode)
				{
					if (!IsInEditMode)
					{
						StartEditMode(takeFocus: false);
					}
				}
				else if (IsInEditMode && !IsFocusWithin)
				{
					EndEditMode(acceptChanges: true, force: false);
				}
			}
			else if (property == EditTemplateProperty)
			{
				VerifyTemplateState();
			}
			else if (property == FocusWithinManager.IsFocusWithinProperty)
			{
				OnIsFocusWithinChanged((bool)e.NewValue);
			}
			else if (property == IsReadOnlyProperty)
			{
				if (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(this) is ValueEditorAutomationPeer valueEditorAutomationPeer)
				{
					valueEditorAutomationPeer.RaiseReadOnlyPropertyChangedEvent((bool)e.OldValue, (bool)e.NewValue);
				}
			}
			else if (property == TextProperty)
			{
				if (UIElementAutomationPeer.FromElement(this) is ValueEditorAutomationPeer valueEditorAutomationPeer2)
				{
					valueEditorAutomationPeer2.RaiseValuePropertyChangedEvent((string)e.OldValue, (string)e.NewValue);
				}
			}
			else if (property == FrameworkElement.LanguageProperty || FormatProperty == property || FormatProviderProperty == property)
			{
				_cachedFormatProviderResolved = null;
				SyncTextWithValue();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnEditModeEnded(EditModeEndedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (!RaiseEventHelper(args))
			{
				ValuePresenter.ClassHandler_EditModeEnded(this, args);
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseEditModeValidationError(EditModeValidationErrorEventArgs args)
		{
			args.RoutedEvent = EditModeValidationErrorEvent;
			args.Source = this;
			OnEditModeValidationError(args);
		}

		private static void OnValueChanged(DependencyObject dependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ValueEditor valueEditor = (ValueEditor)dependencyObject;
			if (!valueEditor._initialized || object.Equals(e.OldValue, e.NewValue))
			{
				return;
			}
			valueEditor.BeginSyncValueProperties();
			try
			{
				valueEditor.SyncValueProperties(e.Property, e.NewValue);
				valueEditor.OnValueChanged(e.OldValue, e.NewValue);
			}
			finally
			{
				valueEditor.EndSyncValueProperties();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnValueChanged(object previousValue, object currentValue)
		{
			if (_host != null && !_isEnteringEditMode)
			{
				_host.OnValueChanged();
			}
			RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<object> e = new RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<object>(previousValue, currentValue);
			e.RoutedEvent = ValueChangedEvent;
			e.Source = this;
			RaiseValuePropertyChangedEvent(e);
		}

			return valueEditor.OnCoerceValue(value);
		}

		protected virtual object OnCoerceValue(object val)
		{
			if (val != null && DBNull.Value != val && !ValueType.IsInstanceOfType(val))
			{
				val = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(val, ValueType, FormatProviderResolved, Format);
			}
			return val;
		}

		private static void OnTextChanged(DependencyObject dependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ValueEditor valueEditor = (ValueEditor)dependencyObject;

				string text2 = (string)valueEditor.GetValue(InSyncTextWithValueProperty);
				if (text2 == null || text != text2)
				{
					valueEditor.SyncValueProperties(e.Property, text);
				}
				valueEditor.OnTextChanged((string)e.OldValue, text);
			}
		}

		{
			ValueConstraint cachedValueConstraint = _cachedValueConstraint;

			_cachedValueConstraint = newVal;

			{
				PropertyChangedEventManager.AddListener(newVal, this, string.Empty);
			}
			if (_initialized)
			{
				OnValueConstraintChanged(null);
			}
		}

					ControlTemplate cachedEditTemplate = valueEditor._cachedEditTemplate;
					valueEditor._cachedEditTemplate = controlTemplate;
					valueEditor.CoerceValue(Control.TemplateProperty);
					valueEditor.OnEditTemplateChanged(cachedEditTemplate, controlTemplate);
				}
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceIsInEditMode(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			if (target is ValueEditor valueEditor && value is bool)
			{
				if (valueEditor._isInEditMode != (bool)value)
				{
					if ((bool)value)
					{
						valueEditor.StartEditMode();
					}
					else
					{
						valueEditor.EndEditMode(acceptChanges: true, force: false);
					}
				}
				return valueEditor._isInEditMode;
			}
			return KnownBoxes.FalseBox;
		}

		public void EndEditMode(bool acceptChanges, bool force)
		{
			if ((_host == null && IsAlwaysInEditMode) || !_isInEditMode || _isInEndEditMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			_isInEndEditMode = true;
			try
			{
				EditModeEndingEventArgs e = new EditModeEndingEventArgs(acceptChanges, force);
				RaiseEditModeEnding(e);
				bool flag = HasValueChangedInternal(compareWithOriginalValue: true);
				if (!e.Cancel && e.AcceptChanges && !IsValueValid && (flag || AlwaysValidateResolved))
				{
					ValidateInputHelper(fromLostFocus: false, e.Force, out var _, out var stayInEditMode);
					if (stayInEditMode && !e.Force)
					{
						e.Cancel = true;
					}
					else if (!IsValueValid)
					{
						e.AcceptChanges = false;
					}
				}
				if (!e.Cancel && flag)
				{
					if (!e.AcceptChanges)
					{
						RevertValueBackToOriginalValue();
					}
					else if (_host != null)
					{
						bool stayInEditMode2;
						bool flag2 = _host.CommitEditValue(Value, out stayInEditMode2);
						if (stayInEditMode2 && !e.Force)
						{
							e.Cancel = true;
						}
					}
				}
				if (e.Cancel && !e.Force)
				{
					if (IsFocusWithin)
					{
						SetFocusToFocusSite();
					}
					return;
				}
				if (_focusSelfInEndEditMode > 0)
				{
					Focus();
				}
				_isInEditMode = false;
				IsInEditMode = false;
				SyncTextWithValue();
				if (!flag)
				{
					SetValue(HasValueChangedPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				}
				RaiseEditModeEnded(new EditModeEndedEventArgs(e.AcceptChanges));
				if (flag)
				{
					SetValue(HasValueChangedPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_isInEndEditMode = false;
			}
		}

		public static Type GetDefaultEditorForType(Type dataType)
		{
			if (dataType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dataType");
			}
			Monitor.Enter(typeof(ValueEditor));
			try
			{
				if (g_defaultEditors == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (g_defaultEditors.ContainsKey(dataType))
				{
					return g_defaultEditors[dataType];
				}
				Type underlyingType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(dataType);
				if (null != underlyingType && dataType != underlyingType && g_defaultEditors.ContainsKey(underlyingType))
				{
					return g_defaultEditors[underlyingType];
				}
				if (typeof(ImageSource).IsAssignableFrom(dataType))
				{
					return null;
				}
				TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(dataType);
				if (converter != null && converter.CanConvertFrom(typeof(string)) && converter.CanConvertTo(typeof(string)))
				{
					return typeof(XamTextEditor);
				}
				return null;
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(ValueEditor));
			}
		}

		}

		public static void RegisterDefaultEditorForType(Type dataType, Type editorType, bool overlayExisting)
		{
			if (dataType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("dataType");
			}
			if (editorType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("editorType");
			}
			if (typeof(ValueEditor).IsAssignableFrom(dataType))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(GetString("LE_ArgumentException_6"), "dataType");
			}
			if (!typeof(ValueEditor).IsAssignableFrom(editorType))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(GetString("LE_ArgumentException_7"), "editorType");
			}
			Monitor.Enter(typeof(ValueEditor));
			try
			{
				if (g_defaultEditors == null)
				{
					g_defaultEditors = new Dictionary<Type, Type>();
				}
				if (g_defaultEditors.ContainsKey(dataType))
				{
					if (overlayExisting)
					{
						g_defaultEditors[dataType] = editorType;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					g_defaultEditors.Add(dataType, editorType);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(typeof(ValueEditor));
			}
		}

		public bool StartEditMode()
		{
			return StartEditMode(takeFocus: true);
		}

		private bool StartEditMode(bool takeFocus)
		{
			if (_isInEditMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!IsEditingAllowed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			EditModeStartingEventArgs e = new EditModeStartingEventArgs();
			RaiseEditModeStarting(e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			_isEnteringEditMode = true;
			try
			{
				InitializeOriginalValueFromValue();
				_isInEditMode = true;
				IsInEditMode = true;
				SyncTextWithValue();
				if (AlwaysValidateResolved)
				{
					RevalidateCurrentValue();
				}
				Measure(new Size(double.PositiveInfinity, double.PositiveInfinity));
				if (takeFocus)
				{
					SetFocusToFocusSite();
				}
				if (_host != null && this is ISupportsSelectableText && _isInEditMode)
				{
					((ISupportsSelectableText)this).SelectAll();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_isEnteringEditMode = false;
			}
			if (_isInEditMode)
			{
				RaiseEditModeStarted(new EditModeStartedEventArgs());
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void ValidateCurrentValue()
		{
			RevalidateCurrentValue();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual bool ValidateValue(object value, out Exception error)

		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public bool ConvertTextToValue(string text, out object value, out Exception error)
		{
			return ConvertTextToValueHelper(text, out value, out error);
		}

		internal virtual bool ConvertTextToValueHelper(string text, out object value, out Exception error)
		{
			error = null;
			value = null;
			try
			{
				value = ValueToTextConverterResolved.ConvertBack(text, ValueType, this, FormatProviderResolved as CultureInfo);
				if (value == null)
				{
					if (text != null && text.Length != 0)
					{
						error = Utils.GetTextToValueConversionError(ValueType, text);
						return false;
					}
					value = null;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				error = ex;
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public bool ConvertValueToText(object value, out string text, out Exception error)
		{
			error = null;
			text = null;
			try
			{
				text = (string)ValueToTextConverterResolved.Convert(value, typeof(string), this, FormatProviderResolved as CultureInfo);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				error = ex;
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void DoInitialization()
		{
			_isInitializing = true;
			try
			{
				InitializeValueProperties();
			}
			finally
			{
				_isInitializing = false;
			}
		}

		internal virtual void InitializeValueProperties()
		{
			if (Utils.IsValuePropertySet(ValueProperty, this))
			{
				CoerceValue(ValueProperty);
				SyncValueProperties(ValueProperty, Value);
			}
			else if (Utils.IsValuePropertySet(TextProperty, this))
			{
				CoerceValue(TextProperty);
				SyncValueProperties(TextProperty, Text);
			}
			else
			{
				RevalidateCurrentValue();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeOriginalValueFromValue()
		{
			SetValue(OriginalValuePropertyKey, Value);
		}

		protected virtual void OnFocusSiteChanged()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsFocusWithinChanged(bool gotFocus)
		{
			if (!gotFocus)
			{
				if (_host == null && IsAlwaysInEditMode && IsInEditMode)
				{
					ValidateInputHelper(fromLostFocus: true, forceExitEditMode: false, out var _, out var _);
				}
				if (_host == null && IsInEditMode && !IsAlwaysInEditMode)
				{
					EndEditMode(acceptChanges: true, force: false);
				}
			}
			else if (_host == null && !IsInEditMode && !_isEnteringEditMode)
			{
				StartEditMode();
			}
			else if (_host == null && IsInEditMode && IsAlwaysInEditMode)
			{
				InitializeOriginalValueFromValue();
			}
		}

		}

			SyncTextWithValue();
		}

		protected virtual bool ValidateFocusSite(object focusSite, out Exception errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = focusSite as FrameworkElement;
			FrameworkContentElement frameworkContentElement = focusSite as FrameworkContentElement;
			if (frameworkElement == null && frameworkContentElement == null)
			{
				errorMessage = new NotSupportedException(GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_3", focusSite.GetType().Name));
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
