		}

		protected virtual void SetVisualState(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (!base.IsEnabled)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Disabled", useTransitions);
			}
			else if (IsReadOnly || !IsEditingAllowed)
			{
				if (base.IsMouseOver)
				{
					VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "ReadOnly", "MouseOver", "Normal");
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "ReadOnly", "Normal");
				}
			}
			else if (base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "MouseOver", "Normal");
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions);
			}
			if (IsEmbedded)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Embedded", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "NotEmbedded", useTransitions);
			}
			bool isKeyboardFocusWithin = base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
			if (isKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				if (HasOpenDropDown)
				{
					VisualStateUtilities.GoToState(this, useTransitions, "FocusedDropDown", "Focused");
				}
				else
				{
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Focused", useTransitions);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Unfocused", useTransitions);
			}
			if (IsValueValid)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "ValidEx", useTransitions);
			}
			else if (isKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "InvalidFocusedEx", useTransitions);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "InvalidUnfocusedEx", useTransitions);
			}
		}

		internal static void OnVisualStatePropertyChanged(DependencyObject target, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (target is ValueEditor valueEditor)
			{
				valueEditor.UpdateVisualStates();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates()
		{
			UpdateVisualStates(useTransitions: true);
		}

		protected void UpdateVisualStates(bool useTransitions)
		{
			if (_hasVisualStateGroups)
			{
				if (!base.IsLoaded)
				{
					useTransitions = false;
				}
				SetVisualState(useTransitions);
			}
		}

		internal void BeginSyncValueProperties()
		{
			if (_pendingPropertyChangedEvents == null)
			{
				_pendingPropertyChangedEvents = new List<RoutedEventArgs>();
			}
			_syncingValueProperties++;
		}

		internal void EndSyncValueProperties()
		{
			_syncingValueProperties--;
			if (SyncingValueProperties || _pendingPropertyChangedEvents == null || _processingPendingPropertyChangedEvents)
			{
				return;
			}
			_processingPendingPropertyChangedEvents = true;
			try
			{
				List<RoutedEventArgs> pendingPropertyChangedEvents = _pendingPropertyChangedEvents;
				for (int i = 0; i < pendingPropertyChangedEvents.Count; i++)
				{
					RaiseEventHelper(pendingPropertyChangedEvents[i]);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_pendingPropertyChangedEvents.Clear();
				_pendingPropertyChangedEvents = null;
				_processingPendingPropertyChangedEvents = false;
			}
		}

		internal static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return GetString(name, null);
		}

		internal static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return SR.GetString(name, args);
		}

		internal bool HasValueChangedInternal(bool compareWithOriginalValue)
		{
			if (!HasValueChanged)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (compareWithOriginalValue && (_host != null || !IsAlwaysInEditMode))
			{
				object originalValue = OriginalValue;
				object value = Value;
				bool flag = Utils.IsValueEmpty(originalValue);
				bool flag2 = Utils.IsValueEmpty(value);
				if ((flag && flag2) || Utils.AreEqual(originalValue, value))
				{
					ConvertValueToText(originalValue, out var text, out var _);
					if (text == Text)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool RaiseEventHelper(RoutedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (_host != null && _host.ShouldSuppressEvent(args))
			{
				if (args.RoutedEvent == ValueChangedEvent)
				{
					_host.OnEditorValueChanged(args);
				}
				return false;
			}
			RaiseEvent(args);
			return true;
		}

		internal void RaiseValuePropertyChangedEvent(RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (SyncingValueProperties && _pendingPropertyChangedEvents != null)
			{
				_pendingPropertyChangedEvents.Add(e);
			}
			else
			{
				RaiseEventHelper(e);
			}
		}

		internal void SetFocusToFocusSite()
		{
			if (_focusSite != null)
			{
				if (_focusSite is FrameworkElement frameworkElement)
				{
					frameworkElement.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First));
				}
				else if (_focusSite is FrameworkContentElement frameworkContentElement)
				{
					frameworkContentElement.MoveFocus(new TraversalRequest(FocusNavigationDirection.First));
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool StartEditModeOnMouseDownHelper()
		{
			if (base.Focusable && base.IsEnabled)
			{
				bool result = _host == null;
				if ((_host == null || IsInEditMode) && !base.IsKeyboardFocused && !base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					Focus();
				}
				if (_host == null && IsFocusWithin && !IsInEditMode)
				{
					StartEditMode();
					result = true;
				}
				return result;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void UpdateOriginalValue(object newOriginalValue)
		{
			SetValue(OriginalValuePropertyKey, OnCoerceValue(newOriginalValue));
		}

		internal void ValidateInputHelper(bool fromLostFocus, bool forceExitEditMode, out EditModeValidationErrorEventArgs eventArgs, out bool stayInEditMode)
		{
			eventArgs = null;
			if (_isDisplayingErrorMsgDialog)
			{
				stayInEditMode = true;
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Utils.MethodInvoker(ReFocus));
				return;
			}
			stayInEditMode = false;
			if (IsValueValid || (!HasValueChangedInternal(compareWithOriginalValue: true) && !AlwaysValidateResolved))
			{
				return;
			}
			ValidationErrorInfo validationErrorInfo = InvalidValueErrorInfo;
			if (validationErrorInfo == null)
			{
				validationErrorInfo = new ValidationErrorInfo(new Exception(GetString("LE_Exception_1")));
			}
			eventArgs = new EditModeValidationErrorEventArgs(this, forceExitEditMode, validationErrorInfo.Exception, validationErrorInfo.ErrorMessage);
			RaiseEditModeValidationError(eventArgs);
			if (IsValueValid)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (eventArgs.InvalidValueBehavior)
			{
			case InvalidValueBehavior.Default:
			case InvalidValueBehavior.DisplayErrorMessage:
				if (eventArgs.ErrorMessage != null && eventArgs.ErrorMessage.Length > 0 && CanShowErrorMessage())
				{
					_isDisplayingErrorMsgDialog = true;
					try
					{
						Utilities.ShowMessageBox(this, eventArgs.ErrorMessage, GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_InvalidValue"), MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
					}
					finally
					{
						_isDisplayingErrorMsgDialog = false;
					}
				}
				stayInEditMode = true;
				break;
			case InvalidValueBehavior.RetainValue:
				stayInEditMode = true;
				break;
			case InvalidValueBehavior.RevertValue:
				RevertValueBackToOriginalValue();
				break;
			}
		}

		internal bool CanShowErrorMessage()
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = this;
			while (dependencyObject != null && !(dependencyObject is Page) && !(dependencyObject is Window))
			{
				dependencyObject = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject);
			}
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				return ((UIElement)dependencyObject).IsVisible;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void InitializeCachedPropertyValues()
		{
			_cachedEditTemplate = (ControlTemplate)EditTemplateProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
			_cachedFormat = (string)FormatProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
			_cachedFormatProvider = (IFormatProvider)FormatProviderProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
			_cachedInvalidValueBehavior = (InvalidValueBehavior)InvalidValueBehaviorProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
			InternalSetCachedValueConstraintHelper((ValueConstraint)ValueConstraintProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue);
			_cachedValueType = (Type)ValueTypeProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
		}

		private bool IsValueValidHelper(object value, out Exception error)
		{
			string errorMessage = null;
			error = null;
			ValueConstraint valueConstraintResolved = ValueConstraintResolved;
			if (valueConstraintResolved != null && !valueConstraintResolved.Validate(value, ValueType, ValueConstraintFlags.All, FormatProviderResolved, Format, ref errorMessage))
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(errorMessage))
				{
					error = new Exception(errorMessage);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (value == null || DBNull.Value == value)
			{
				if (!IsNullable)
				{
					error = new Exception(GetString("LMSG_EnteredValueEmpty"));
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (!ValueType.IsInstanceOfType(value))
			{
				error = new Exception(GetString("LE_InvalidValueType", ValueType.Name, value.GetType().Name));
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool SyncTextWithValue()
		{
			Exception error;
			return SyncTextWithValueHelper(Value, out error, syncDisplayText: true);
		}

		private bool SyncTextWithValueHelper(object newValue, out Exception error, bool syncDisplayText)
		{
			BeginSyncValueProperties();
			try
			{
				if (ConvertValueToText(newValue, out var text, out error))
				{
					SetValue(InSyncTextWithValueProperty, text);
					try
					{
						Text_CurrentValue = text;
					}
					finally
					{
						ClearValue(InSyncTextWithValueProperty);
					}
					if (syncDisplayText)
					{
						TextEditorBase textEditorBase = this as TextEditorBase;
						if (textEditorBase != null && syncDisplayText)
						{
							textEditorBase.SyncDisplayText();
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				SetIsValueValid(isValueValid: false, error);
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				EndSyncValueProperties();
			}
		}

		private bool SyncValueWithText(object newValue, out Exception error)
		{
			BeginSyncValueProperties();
			try
			{
				if (ConvertTextToValue((string)newValue, out var value, out error))
				{
					DependencyPropertyUtilities.SetCurrentValue(this, ValueProperty, value);
					return true;
				}
				SetIsValueValid(isValueValid: false, error);
				OnValueChanged(Value, Value);
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				EndSyncValueProperties();
			}
		}

		private static object OnCoerceTemplate(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			if (Control.TemplateProperty.DefaultMetadata.CoerceValueCallback != null)
			{
				value = Control.TemplateProperty.DefaultMetadata.CoerceValueCallback(target, value);
			}
			if (target is ValueEditor { IsInEditMode: not false, EditTemplate: not null } valueEditor)
			{
				return valueEditor.EditTemplate;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void ReFocus()
		{
			Focus();
		}

		private void RevalidateCurrentValue()
		{
			Exception error;
			bool isValueValid = ValidateCurrentValueHelper(out error);
			SetIsValueValid(isValueValid, error);
		}

		internal void SyncValueProperties(DependencyProperty prop, object newValue)
		{
			Exception error = null;
			if (_initialized && !_inSyncValueProperties)
			{
				BeginSyncValueProperties();
				_inSyncValueProperties = true;
				try
				{
					bool flag = SyncValuePropertiesOverride(prop, newValue, out error);
					if (flag && !ValidateCurrentValueHelper(out error))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					SetIsValueValid(flag, error);
				}
				finally
				{
					_inSyncValueProperties = false;
					EndSyncValueProperties();
				}
			}
			if (IsInEditMode && !_isEnteringEditMode)
			{
				SetValue(HasValueChangedPropertyKey, KnownBoxes.TrueBox);
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool SyncValuePropertiesOverride(DependencyProperty prop, object newValue, out Exception error)
		{
			if (ValueProperty == prop)
			{
				return SyncTextWithValueHelper(newValue, out error, syncDisplayText: false);
			}
			if (TextProperty == prop)
			{
				return SyncValueWithText(newValue, out error);
			}
			error = new InvalidOperationException("This should only be called for Text and Value properties. Derived classes need to handle their own properties.");
			return false;
		}

		private bool ValidateCurrentValueHelper(out Exception error)
		{
			bool flag = ValidateCurrentValue(out error);
			if (flag && _host != null)
			{
				return _host.IsCurrentValueValid(out error);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void VerifyFocusSite()
		{
			DependencyObject templateChild = GetTemplateChild("PART_FocusSite");
			if (templateChild != null)
			{
				if (!ValidateFocusSite(templateChild, out var errorMessage))
				{
					throw errorMessage;
				}
				if (templateChild != _focusSite)
				{
					_focusSite = templateChild;
					OnFocusSiteChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (typeof(PropertyChangedEventManager) == managerType && e is PropertyChangedEventArgs e2 && sender == _cachedValueConstraint)
			{
				OnValueConstraintChanged(e2.PropertyName);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class ValueEditorDefaultConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		private static ValueEditorDefaultConverter _valueToDisplayTextConverter;

		private static ValueEditorDefaultConverter _valueToTextConverter;

		protected bool _isDisplayTextConverter;

		public static ValueEditorDefaultConverter ValueToTextConverter
		{
			get
			{
				if (_valueToTextConverter == null)
				{
					_valueToTextConverter = new ValueEditorDefaultConverter(isDisplayTextConverter: false);
				}
				return _valueToTextConverter;
			}
		}

		public static ValueEditorDefaultConverter ValueToDisplayTextConverter
		{
			get
			{
				if (_valueToDisplayTextConverter == null)
				{
					_valueToDisplayTextConverter = new ValueEditorDefaultConverter(isDisplayTextConverter: true);
				}
				return _valueToDisplayTextConverter;
			}
		}

		protected ValueEditorDefaultConverter(bool isDisplayTextConverter)
		{
			_isDisplayTextConverter = isDisplayTextConverter;
		}

		private object ConvertHelper(bool convertingBack, object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ValueEditor valueEditor = parameter as ValueEditor;
			string format = null;
			IFormatProvider formatProvider;
			if (valueEditor != null)
			{
				formatProvider = valueEditor.FormatProviderResolved;
				if (_isDisplayTextConverter)
				{
					format = valueEditor.Format;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				formatProvider = culture;
			}
			if (valueEditor != null)
			{
				return ConvertHelper(convertingBack, value, targetType, valueEditor, formatProvider, format);
			}
			if (HandleNullValueHelper(convertingBack, value, targetType, valueEditor, out var convertedValue))
			{
				return convertedValue;
			}
			return CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, targetType, formatProvider, format);
		}

		private bool HandleNullValueHelper(bool convertingBack, object value, Type targetType, ValueEditor editor, out object convertedValue)
		{
			bool flag = value == null || DBNull.Value == value;
			if (convertingBack)
			{
				if (_isDisplayTextConverter && editor is TextEditorBase textEditorBase && object.Equals(value, textEditorBase.NullText))
				{
					convertedValue = null;
					return true;
				}
				if (value is string && ((string)value).Length == 0)
				{
					convertedValue = null;
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (flag)
			{
				string text = string.Empty;
				if (_isDisplayTextConverter && editor is TextEditorBase textEditorBase2)
				{
					text = textEditorBase2.NullText;
				}
				convertedValue = ((typeof(string) == targetType) ? text : null);
				return true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				convertedValue = value;
				return true;
			}
			convertedValue = null;
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual object ConvertHelper(bool convertingBack, object value, Type targetType, ValueEditor editor, IFormatProvider formatProvider, string format)
		{
			if (HandleNullValueHelper(convertingBack, value, targetType, editor, out var convertedValue))
			{
				return convertedValue;
			}
			return CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(value, targetType, formatProvider, format);
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return ConvertHelper(convertingBack: false, value, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return ConvertHelper(convertingBack: true, value, targetType, parameter, culture);
		}
	}

			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ValueEditor), ValueEditor.EditModeStartingEvent, new EventHandler<EditModeStartingEventArgs>(ClassHandler_EditModeStarting));

			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ValuePresenter), ValueEditor.EditModeEndingEvent, new EventHandler<EditModeEndingEventArgs>(ClassHandler_ValuePresenter_EditModeEnding));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ValuePresenter), ValueEditor.EditModeEndedEvent, new EventHandler<EditModeEndedEventArgs>(ClassHandler_ValuePresenter_EditModeEnded));
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeof(ValuePresenter), ValueEditor.EditModeValidationErrorEvent, new EventHandler<EditModeValidationErrorEventArgs>(ClassHandler_ValuePresenter_EditModeValidationError));

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			ValueEditor editor = Editor;
			if (editor == null)
			{
				ProcessPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
				return;
			}
			bool isInEditMode = editor.IsInEditMode;
			ProcessPreviewMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			if (editor.IsInEditMode && !isInEditMode)
			{
				_previewMouseLeftButtonDown_EnterEditMode_TimeStamp = e.Timestamp;
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceIsInEditMode(DependencyObject target, object value)
		{
			if (target is ValuePresenter valuePresenter && value is bool flag)
			{
				if (valuePresenter._editor == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (flag != valuePresenter._editor.IsInEditMode)
				{
					valuePresenter._editor.IsInEditMode = false;
				}
				return valuePresenter._editor.IsInEditMode;
			}
			return value;
		}

		}

		private void SetEditorType(Type value, bool validateEditorIsSited)
		{
			if (_editorType != value)
			{
				if (value != null && !typeof(ValueEditor).IsAssignableFrom(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_9"), "value");
				}
				_editorType = value;
				if (_editor != null && (_editorType == null || EditorTypeResolved != _editor.GetType()))
				{
					DirtyEditor(validateEditorIsSited);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetEditorStyle(Style value, bool validateEditorIsSited)
		{
			if (_editorStyle != value)
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					Utilities.ValidateTargetTypeOfStyle(value, typeof(ValueEditor), "EditorStyle");
				}
				_editorStyle = value;
				if (_editor != null && (_editorStyle != _editor.Style || EditorTypeResolved != _editor.GetType()))
				{
					_editor = null;
					_isEditorSited = false;
				}
				if (validateEditorIsSited)
				{
					ValidateEditorIsSited();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetValueType(Type value, bool validateEditorIsSited)
		{
			if (_valueType != value)
			{
				_valueType = value;
				if (_isEditorSited)
				{
					DirtyEditor(validateEditorIsSited);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ValidateEditorIsSited()
		{
			ValidateEditorIsSited(templateApplied: false);
		}

		private void ValidateEditorIsSited(bool templateApplied)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (_editorSite == null || templateApplied)
			{
				DependencyObject templateChild = GetTemplateChild("PART_EditorSite");
				ContentPresenter contentPresenter = templateChild as ContentPresenter;
				if (contentPresenter != _editorSite)
				{
					_editorSite = contentPresenter;
					_isEditorSited = false;
					flag = true;
				}
				if (_editorSite == null && templateChild != null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_4"));
				}
			}
			Type editorTypeResolved = EditorTypeResolved;
			if (_isEditorSited || editorTypeResolved == null || _editorSite == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_isEditorSited = true;
			try
			{
				if (_editor == null)
				{
					flag = true;
					if (editorTypeResolved == typeof(XamTextEditor))
					{
						_editor = new XamTextEditor();
					}
					else if (editorTypeResolved == typeof(XamMaskedEditor))
					{
						_editor = new XamMaskedEditor();
					}
					else if (editorTypeResolved == typeof(XamCheckEditor))
					{
						_editor = new XamCheckEditor();
					}
					else if (editorTypeResolved == typeof(XamNumericEditor))
					{
						_editor = new XamNumericEditor();
					}
					else if (editorTypeResolved == typeof(XamDateTimeEditor))
					{
						_editor = new XamDateTimeEditor();
					}
					else if (editorTypeResolved == typeof(XamCurrencyEditor))
					{
						_editor = new XamCurrencyEditor();
					}
					else
					{
						_editor = Activator.CreateInstance(editorTypeResolved) as ValueEditor;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					_editor.InitializeHostInfo(this, this);
					if (HasValueType)
					{
						_editor.ValueType = ValueType;
					}
					OnEditorCreated(_editor);
					if (_editorStyle != null)
					{
						_editor.Style = _editorStyle;
					}
					_editor.Value = base.Content;
					_editorSite.Content = _editor;
					VerfiyOptimizedWidthMeasurement();
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		private void ValidateHostContext(object hostContext)
		{
			if (hostContext == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("hostContext");
			}
			if (hostContext != this)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_10"), "hostContext");
			}
		}

		private void VerfiyOptimizedWidthMeasurement()
		{
			bool flag = true;
			HorizontalAlignment horizontalContentAlignment = base.HorizontalContentAlignment;
			if (horizontalContentAlignment == HorizontalAlignment.Center || horizontalContentAlignment == HorizontalAlignment.Right)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				horizontalContentAlignment = base.HorizontalAlignment;
				if (horizontalContentAlignment == HorizontalAlignment.Center || horizontalContentAlignment == HorizontalAlignment.Right)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				SetValue(SimpleTextBlock.OptimizeWidthMeasurementProperty, KnownBoxes.FalseBox);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(SimpleTextBlock.OptimizeWidthMeasurementProperty);
			}
		}
	}

		static XamTextEditor()
		{
			AcceptsReturnProperty = KeyboardNavigation.AcceptsReturnProperty.AddOwner(typeof(XamTextEditor));
			AcceptsTabProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AcceptsTab", typeof(bool), typeof(XamTextEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.FalseBox));
			HorizontalScrollBarVisibilityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HorizontalScrollBarVisibility", typeof(ScrollBarVisibility), typeof(XamTextEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.ScrollBarVisibilityHiddenBox));
			TextWrappingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("TextWrapping", typeof(TextWrapping), typeof(XamTextEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(TextWrapping.NoWrap, OnTextWrappingChanged));
			TextAlignmentProperty = Block.TextAlignmentProperty.AddOwner(typeof(XamTextEditor));
			TextAlignmentResolvedPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("TextAlignmentResolved", typeof(TextAlignment), typeof(XamTextEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(TextAlignment.Left, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.None, null));
			TextAlignmentResolvedProperty = TextAlignmentResolvedPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			VerticalScrollBarVisibilityProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("VerticalScrollBarVisibility", typeof(ScrollBarVisibility), typeof(XamTextEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KnownBoxes.ScrollBarVisibilityHiddenBox));
			FrameworkElement.DefaultStyleKeyProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamTextEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(typeof(XamTextEditor)));
			Control.HorizontalContentAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamTextEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnHorizontalContentAlignmentChanged));
			Block.TextAlignmentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamTextEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnTextAlignmentChanged));
			KeyboardNavigation.TabNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamTextEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.Local));
			KeyboardNavigation.ControlTabNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamTextEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.None));
			KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigationProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeof(XamTextEditor), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(KeyboardNavigationMode.None));
			Infragistics.Themes.ThemeManager.RegisterControl(typeof(XamTextEditor));

		public XamTextEditor()
		{
			try
			{
				_license = LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(XamTextEditor), this) as UltraLicense;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
			}
			InitializeCachedPropertyValues();
		}

		public override bool CanEditType(Type type)
		{
			return type == typeof(string);
		}

		public override bool CanRenderType(Type type)
		{
			return type == typeof(string);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public override bool IsExtentBasedOnValue(Orientation orientation)
		{
			if (orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (TextWrapping.NoWrap == TextWrapping)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool ValidateFocusSite(object focusSite, out Exception errorMessage)
		{
			if (!base.ValidateFocusSite(focusSite, out errorMessage))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(focusSite is TextBox))
			{
				errorMessage = new NotSupportedException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_5", focusSite.GetType().Name));
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override AutomationPeer OnCreateAutomationPeer()
		{
			return new XamTextEditorAutomationPeer(this);
		}

		protected override void OnFocusSiteChanged()
		{
			base.OnFocusSiteChanged();
			if (_lastTextBox != null)
			{
				_lastTextBox.SelectionChanged -= OnTextBoxSelectionChanged;
				if (_textBoxTextPvt != null)
				{
					_textBoxTextPvt.Deactivate();
					_textBoxTextPvt = null;
				}
				_lastTextBox = null;
			}
			_lastTextBox = base.FocusSite as TextBox;
			if (_lastTextBox != null)
			{
				_lastTextBox.SelectionStart = _cachedSelectionStart;
				_lastTextBox.SelectionLength = _cachedSelectionLength;
				_lastTextBox.SelectionChanged += OnTextBoxSelectionChanged;
				_textBoxTextPvt = new PropertyValueTracker(_lastTextBox, TextBox.TextProperty, OnTextBoxTextChanged);
				SyncTextBoxText();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnTextChanged(string previousValue, string currentValue)
		{
			base.OnTextChanged(previousValue, currentValue);
			SyncTextBoxText();
		}

		private static void OnTextWrappingChanged(DependencyObject dependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamTextEditor xamTextEditor = (XamTextEditor)dependencyObject;
			TextWrapping cachedTextWrapping = (TextWrapping)e.NewValue;
			xamTextEditor._cachedTextWrapping = cachedTextWrapping;
		}

		private void UpdateTextAlignmentResolved()
		{
			object obj = null;
			object obj2 = ReadLocalValue(TextAlignmentProperty);
			if (DependencyProperty.UnsetValue != obj2)
			{
				obj = obj2;
			}
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj2 = base.HorizontalContentAlignment;
				if (DependencyProperty.UnsetValue != obj2)
				{
					obj = Utils.ToTextAlignment((HorizontalAlignment)obj2);
				}
			}
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj = GetValue(TextAlignmentProperty);
			}
			if (obj != null)
			{
				SetValue(TextAlignmentResolvedPropertyKey, obj);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearValue(TextAlignmentResolvedPropertyKey);
			}
		}

		private static void OnHorizontalContentAlignmentChanged(DependencyObject dependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamTextEditor xamTextEditor = (XamTextEditor)dependencyObject;
			xamTextEditor.UpdateTextAlignmentResolved();
		}

		private static void OnTextAlignmentChanged(DependencyObject dependencyObject, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			XamTextEditor xamTextEditor = (XamTextEditor)dependencyObject;
			xamTextEditor.UpdateTextAlignmentResolved();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeTextAlignment()
		{
			return Utilities.ShouldSerialize(TextAlignmentProperty, this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetTextAlignment()
		{
			ClearValue(TextAlignmentProperty);
		}

		private void InitializeCachedPropertyValues()
		{
			_cachedTextWrapping = (TextWrapping)TextWrappingProperty.GetMetadata(this).DefaultValue;
		}

		internal void OnTextBoxSelectionChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool inOnTextBoxSelectionChanged = _inOnTextBoxSelectionChanged;
			_inOnTextBoxSelectionChanged = true;
			try
			{
				TextBox textBox = TextBox;
				if (textBox != null)
				{
					_cachedSelectionStart = textBox.SelectionStart;
					_cachedSelectionLength = textBox.SelectionLength;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				_inOnTextBoxSelectionChanged = inOnTextBoxSelectionChanged;
			}
		}

		private void OnTextBoxTextChanged()
		{
			if (!base.SyncingValueProperties)
			{
				TextBox lastTextBox = _lastTextBox;
				if (lastTextBox != null)
				{
					base.Text_CurrentValue = lastTextBox.Text;
				}
			}
		}

		private void SyncTextBoxText()
		{
			if (_lastTextBox != null)
			{
				_lastTextBox.Text = base.Text;
			}
		}

		public void SelectAll()
		{
			SelectionStart = 0;
			SelectionLength = TextLength;
		}

					_validationRules.CollectionChanged += OnValidationRules_CollectionChanged;
				}
				return _validationRules;
			}
		}

		public bool HasValidationRules
		{
			get
			{
				if (_validationRules != null)
				{
					return _validationRules.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool HasAnyConstraints
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasEnumeration && !HasFixedValue && !HasMaxExclusive && !HasMaxInclusive && !HasMaxLength && !HasMinExclusive && !HasMinInclusive && !HasMinLength && !HasNullable && !HasRegexPattern)
				{
					return ValidateAsType != ValidateAsType.Unknown;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				if (_propertyChangedDelegate == null)
				{
					_propertyChangedDelegate = value;
				}
				else
				{
					_propertyChangedDelegate = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Combine(_propertyChangedDelegate, value);
				}
			}
			remove
			{
				if (_propertyChangedDelegate != null)
				{
					_propertyChangedDelegate = (PropertyChangedEventHandler)Delegate.Remove(_propertyChangedDelegate, value);
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool ValidateRegexPattern(object objVal)
		{
			string text = (string)objVal;
			if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				try
				{
					new Regex(text);
				}
				catch
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static Type GetTypeFromValidateAsType(ValidateAsType validateAsType)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ValidateAsType), validateAsType))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)validateAsType, typeof(ValidateAsType));
			}
			Type result = null;
			switch (validateAsType)
			{
			case ValidateAsType.Boolean:
				result = typeof(bool);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.Byte:
				result = typeof(sbyte);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.DateTime:
				result = typeof(DateTime);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.Decimal:
				result = typeof(decimal);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.Double:
				result = typeof(double);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.Float:
				result = typeof(float);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.Integer16:
				result = typeof(short);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.Integer32:
				result = typeof(int);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.Integer64:
			case ValidateAsType.NegativeInteger64:
			case ValidateAsType.NonNegativeInteger64:
			case ValidateAsType.NonPositiveInteger64:
			case ValidateAsType.PositiveInteger64:
				result = typeof(long);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.Text:
				result = typeof(string);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.TimeSpan:
				result = typeof(TimeSpan);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.Unknown:
				result = typeof(object);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.UnsignedByte:
				result = typeof(byte);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.UnsignedInteger16:
				result = typeof(ushort);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.UnsignedInteger32:
				result = typeof(uint);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.UnsignedInteger64:
				result = typeof(ulong);
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.Uri:
				result = typeof(Uri);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static ValidateAsType GetValidateAsTypeFromType(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("type");
			}
			return type.FullName switch
			{
				"System.Boolean" => ValidateAsType.Boolean, 
				"System.Byte" => ValidateAsType.UnsignedByte, 
				"System.DateTime" => ValidateAsType.DateTime, 
				"System.Decimal" => ValidateAsType.Decimal, 
				"System.Double" => ValidateAsType.Double, 
				"System.Int16" => ValidateAsType.Integer16, 
				"System.Int32" => ValidateAsType.Integer32, 
				"System.Int64" => ValidateAsType.Integer64, 
				"System.SByte" => ValidateAsType.Byte, 
				"System.Single" => ValidateAsType.Float, 
				"System.String" => ValidateAsType.Text, 
				"System.TimeSpan" => ValidateAsType.TimeSpan, 
				"System.UInt16" => ValidateAsType.UnsignedInteger16, 
				"System.UInt32" => ValidateAsType.UnsignedInteger32, 
				"System.UInt64" => ValidateAsType.UnsignedInteger64, 
				"System.Uri" => ValidateAsType.Uri, 
				_ => ValidateAsType.Unknown, 
			};
		}

		public void InitializeFrom(ValueConstraint source, bool copyEnumeration)
		{
			if (copyEnumeration)
			{
				Enumeration = source.Enumeration;
			}
			FixedValue = source.FixedValue;
			FractionDigits = source.FractionDigits;
			MaxExclusive = source.MaxExclusive;
			MaxInclusive = source.MaxInclusive;
			MaxLength = source.MaxLength;
			MinExclusive = source.MinExclusive;
			MinInclusive = source.MinInclusive;
			MinLength = source.MinLength;
			Nullable = source.Nullable;
			_regex = source._regex;
			RegexPattern = source.RegexPattern;
			TotalDigits = source.TotalDigits;
			ValidateAsType = source.ValidateAsType;
		}

		public void InitializeFrom(ValueConstraint source)
		{
			InitializeFrom(source, copyEnumeration: true);
		}

		public void Merge(ValueConstraint source, ValueConstraintFlags constraintFlags)
		{
			MergeHelper(source, constraintFlags);
		}

		public void Merge(ValueConstraint source)
		{
			MergeHelper(source, ValueConstraintFlags.All);
		}

		public void Reset(ValueConstraintFlags constraintFlags)
		{
			if ((ValueConstraintFlags.Enumeration & constraintFlags) != 0)
			{
				ResetEnumeration();
			}
			if ((ValueConstraintFlags.FixedValue & constraintFlags) != 0)
			{
				ResetFixedValue();
			}
			if ((ValueConstraintFlags.MaxExclusive & constraintFlags) != 0)
			{
				ResetMaxExclusive();
			}
			if ((ValueConstraintFlags.MaxInclusive & constraintFlags) != 0)
			{
				ResetMaxInclusive();
			}
			if ((ValueConstraintFlags.MaxLength & constraintFlags) != 0)
			{
				ResetMaxLength();
			}
			if ((ValueConstraintFlags.MinExclusive & constraintFlags) != 0)
			{
				ResetMinExclusive();
			}
			if ((ValueConstraintFlags.MinInclusive & constraintFlags) != 0)
			{
				ResetMinInclusive();
			}
			if ((ValueConstraintFlags.MinLength & constraintFlags) != 0)
			{
				ResetMinLength();
			}
			if ((ValueConstraintFlags.Nullable & constraintFlags) != 0)
			{
				ResetNullable();
			}
			if ((ValueConstraintFlags.RegexPattern & constraintFlags) != 0)
			{
				ResetRegexPattern();
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			Reset(ValueConstraintFlags.All);
		}

		public bool Validate(object dataValue, Type targetType, ValueConstraintFlags constraintFlags, IFormatProvider formatProvider, string format, ref string errorMessage)
		{
			if (targetType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("targetType");
			}
			bool flag = dataValue == null || dataValue == DBNull.Value;
			bool flag2 = !flag && dataValue is string && ((string)dataValue).Length == 0;
			if (flag || flag2)
			{
				bool flag3 = Nullable ?? true;
				if (!flag3)
				{
					errorMessage = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_Nullable");
				}
				return flag3;
			}
			if ((constraintFlags & ValueConstraintFlags.ImplicitTypeParameterConstraints) != 0)
			{
				ValidateAsType validateAsTypeFromType = GetValidateAsTypeFromType(targetType);
				if (!ValidateImplicitConstraints(dataValue, validateAsTypeFromType, formatProvider, format, ref errorMessage))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if ((constraintFlags & ValueConstraintFlags.ImplicitValueAsTypeConstraints) != 0 && !ValidateImplicitConstraints(dataValue, ValidateAsType, formatProvider, format, ref errorMessage))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ValidateExplicitConstraints(dataValue, targetType, constraintFlags, formatProvider, format, ref errorMessage))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type typeFromValidateAsType = GetTypeFromValidateAsType(ValidateAsType);
			if (!ValidateExplicitConstraints(dataValue, typeFromValidateAsType, constraintFlags, formatProvider, format, ref errorMessage))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public bool Validate(object dataValue, Type targetType, ValueConstraintFlags constraintFlags)
		{
			string errorMessage = null;
			return Validate(dataValue, targetType, constraintFlags, null, null, ref errorMessage);
		}

		public bool Validate(object dataValue, Type targetType)
		{
			return Validate(dataValue, targetType, ValueConstraintFlags.All);
		}

		private void MergeHelper(ValueConstraint source, ValueConstraintFlags constraintFlags)
		{
			if (source != null && constraintFlags != 0)
			{
				if (ShouldMergeConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.Enumeration, constraintFlags, source))
				{
					Enumeration = source.Enumeration;
				}
				if (ShouldMergeConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.FixedValue, constraintFlags, source))
				{
					FixedValue = source.FixedValue;
				}
				if (ShouldMergeConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.MaxExclusive, constraintFlags, source))
				{
					MaxExclusive = source.MaxExclusive;
				}
				if (ShouldMergeConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.MaxInclusive, constraintFlags, source))
				{
					MaxInclusive = source.MaxInclusive;
				}
				if (ShouldMergeConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.MaxLength, constraintFlags, source))
				{
					MaxLength = source.MaxLength;
				}
				if (ShouldMergeConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.MinExclusive, constraintFlags, source))
				{
					MinExclusive = source.MinExclusive;
				}
				if (ShouldMergeConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.MinInclusive, constraintFlags, source))
				{
					MinInclusive = source.MinInclusive;
				}
				if (ShouldMergeConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.MinLength, constraintFlags, source))
				{
					MinLength = source.MinLength;
				}
				if (ShouldMergeConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.Nullable, constraintFlags, source))
				{
					Nullable = source.Nullable;
				}
				if (ShouldMergeConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.RegexPattern, constraintFlags, source))
				{
					RegexPattern = source.RegexPattern;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldMergeConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags targetConstraint, ValueConstraintFlags constraintFlags, ValueConstraint source)
		{
			if ((constraintFlags & targetConstraint) == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return targetConstraint switch
			{
				ValueConstraintFlags.Enumeration => !HasEnumeration && source.HasEnumeration, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.FixedValue => !HasFixedValue && source.HasFixedValue, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.MaxExclusive => !HasMaxExclusive && source.HasMaxExclusive, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.MaxInclusive => !HasMaxInclusive && source.HasMaxInclusive, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.MaxLength => !HasMaxLength && source.HasMaxLength, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.MinExclusive => !HasMinExclusive && source.HasMinExclusive, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.MinInclusive => !HasMinInclusive && source.HasMinInclusive, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.MinLength => !HasMinLength && source.HasMinLength, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.Nullable => !HasNullable && source.HasNullable, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.RegexPattern => !HasRegexPattern && source.HasRegexPattern, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		private object EnsureNumericValueIsWithinBoundsOfDecimal(object constraintValue)
		{
			if ((constraintValue is double && (double)constraintValue < -7.922816251426434E+28) || (constraintValue is float && (float)constraintValue < -7.9228163E+28f))
			{
				constraintValue = decimal.MinValue;
			}
			else if ((constraintValue is double && (double)constraintValue > 7.922816251426434E+28) || (constraintValue is float && (float)constraintValue > 7.9228163E+28f))
			{
				constraintValue = decimal.MaxValue;
			}
			return constraintValue;
		}

		private ComparisonResult PerformComparison(object dataValue, object constraintValue, Type targetType, IFormatProvider formatProvider, string formatString)
		{
			try
			{
				object obj = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(dataValue, targetType, formatProvider, formatString);
				object obj2 = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(constraintValue, targetType, formatProvider, formatString);
				if (obj == null || obj2 == null)
				{
					return ComparisonResult.Invalid;
				}
				if (obj is IComparable comparable)
				{
					int num = comparable.CompareTo(obj2);
					if (num == 0)
					{
						return ComparisonResult.Equal;
					}
					if (num < 0)
					{
						return ComparisonResult.LessThan;
					}
					return ComparisonResult.GreaterThan;
				}
				return ComparisonResult.Invalid;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return ComparisonResult.Invalid;
			}
		}

		private ComparisonResult PerformTypeSensitiveComparison(object convertedDataValue, object constraintValue, Type targetType, IFormatProvider formatProvider, string formatString)
		{
			if (Utilities.IsNumericType(convertedDataValue.GetType()) || Utilities.IsNumericType(constraintValue.GetType()))
			{
				constraintValue = EnsureNumericValueIsWithinBoundsOfDecimal(constraintValue);
				return PerformComparison(convertedDataValue, constraintValue, typeof(decimal), formatProvider, formatString);
			}
			if (convertedDataValue is DateTime || constraintValue is DateTime)
			{
				return PerformComparison(convertedDataValue, constraintValue, typeof(DateTime), formatProvider, formatString);
			}
			if (convertedDataValue is bool || constraintValue is bool)
			{
				return PerformComparison(convertedDataValue, constraintValue, typeof(bool), formatProvider, formatString);
			}
			return PerformComparison(convertedDataValue, constraintValue, targetType, formatProvider, formatString);
		}

		private bool ShouldTestConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags targetConstraint, ValueConstraintFlags constraintFlags)
		{
			if ((constraintFlags & targetConstraint) == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return targetConstraint switch
			{
				ValueConstraintFlags.Enumeration => HasEnumeration, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.FixedValue => HasFixedValue, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.MaxExclusive => HasMaxExclusive, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.MaxInclusive => HasMaxInclusive, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.MaxLength => HasMaxLength, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.MinExclusive => HasMinExclusive, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.MinInclusive => HasMinInclusive, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.MinLength => HasMinLength, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.Nullable => HasNullable, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.RegexPattern => HasRegexPattern, 
				ValueConstraintFlags.ValidationRules => HasValidationRules, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		private bool ValidateImplicitConstraints(object dataValue, ValidateAsType validateAsType, IFormatProvider formatProvider, string formatString, ref string errorMsg)
		{
			Type typeFromValidateAsType = GetTypeFromValidateAsType(validateAsType);
			object obj = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(dataValue, typeFromValidateAsType, formatProvider, formatString);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_CannotConvert", CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(typeFromValidateAsType).FullName);
				return false;
			}
			IComparable comparable = obj as IComparable;
			bool flag = true;
			switch (validateAsType)
			{
			case ValidateAsType.NegativeInteger64:
				if (comparable != null)
				{
					bool flag4 = comparable.CompareTo(0L) < 0;
					flag = flag && flag4;
					if (!flag)
					{
						errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_OutOfRange", long.MinValue.ToString(formatString, formatProvider), "-1");
					}
				}
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.NonNegativeInteger64:
				if (comparable != null)
				{
					bool flag3 = comparable.CompareTo(-1L) > 0;
					flag = flag && flag3;
					if (!flag)
					{
						errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_OutOfRange", "0", long.MaxValue.ToString(formatString, formatProvider));
					}
				}
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.NonPositiveInteger64:
				if (comparable != null)
				{
					bool flag5 = comparable.CompareTo(1L) < 0;
					flag = flag && flag5;
					if (!flag)
					{
						errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_OutOfRange", long.MinValue.ToString(formatString, formatProvider), "0");
					}
				}
				break;
			case ValidateAsType.PositiveInteger64:
				if (comparable != null)
				{
					bool flag2 = comparable.CompareTo(0L) > 0;
					flag = flag && flag2;
					if (!flag)
					{
						errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_OutOfRange", "1", long.MaxValue.ToString(formatString, formatProvider));
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool ValidateExplicitConstraints(object dataValue, Type targetType, ValueConstraintFlags constraintFlags, IFormatProvider formatProvider, string formatString, ref string errorMsg)
		{
			object obj = CoreUtilities.ConvertDataValue(dataValue, targetType, formatProvider, formatString);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_CannotConvert", CoreUtilities.GetUnderlyingType(targetType).FullName);
				return false;
			}
			string text = obj.ToString();
			bool flag = true;
			if (flag && ShouldTestConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.Enumeration, constraintFlags) && !Utils.Exists(Enumeration, obj))
			{
				flag = false;
				errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_Enumeration");
			}
			if (flag && ShouldTestConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.FixedValue, constraintFlags))
			{
				ComparisonResult comparisonResult = PerformTypeSensitiveComparison(obj, FixedValue, targetType, formatProvider, formatString);
				if (comparisonResult != ComparisonResult.Equal)
				{
					flag = false;
					errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_FixedValue", FixedValue);
				}
			}
			if (flag && ShouldTestConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.MaxExclusive, constraintFlags))
			{
				ComparisonResult comparisonResult2 = PerformTypeSensitiveComparison(obj, MaxExclusive, targetType, formatProvider, formatString);
				if (comparisonResult2 != ComparisonResult.LessThan)
				{
					flag = false;
					errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_MaxExclusive", MaxExclusive);
				}
			}
			if (flag && ShouldTestConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.MaxInclusive, constraintFlags))
			{
				ComparisonResult comparisonResult3 = PerformTypeSensitiveComparison(obj, MaxInclusive, targetType, formatProvider, formatString);
				if (comparisonResult3 != ComparisonResult.LessThan && comparisonResult3 != ComparisonResult.Equal)
				{
					flag = false;
					errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_MaxInclusive", MaxInclusive);
				}
			}
			if (flag && ShouldTestConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.MaxLength, constraintFlags) && MaxLength < text.Length)
			{
				flag = false;
				errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_MaxLength", MaxLength.ToString(formatString, formatProvider));
			}
			if (flag && ShouldTestConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.MinExclusive, constraintFlags))
			{
				ComparisonResult comparisonResult4 = PerformTypeSensitiveComparison(obj, MinExclusive, targetType, formatProvider, formatString);
				if (comparisonResult4 != ComparisonResult.GreaterThan)
				{
					flag = false;
					errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_MinExclusive", MinExclusive);
				}
			}
			if (flag && ShouldTestConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.MinInclusive, constraintFlags))
			{
				ComparisonResult comparisonResult5 = PerformTypeSensitiveComparison(obj, MinInclusive, targetType, formatProvider, formatString);
				if (comparisonResult5 != ComparisonResult.GreaterThan && comparisonResult5 != ComparisonResult.Equal)
				{
					flag = false;
					errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_MinInclusive", MinInclusive);
				}
			}
			if (flag && ShouldTestConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.MinLength, constraintFlags) && text.Length < MinLength)
			{
				flag = false;
				errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_MinLength", MinLength.ToString(formatString, formatProvider));
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				ShouldTestConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.Nullable, constraintFlags);
			}
			if (flag && ShouldTestConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.RegexPattern, constraintFlags))
			{
				if (_regex == null)
				{
					string text2 = RegexPattern;
					if (!text2.StartsWith("^") && !text2.EndsWith("$"))
					{
						text2 = "^(" + text2 + ")$";
					}
					try
					{
						_regex = new Regex(text2);
					}
					catch
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				Match match = _regex.Match(text);
				if (!match.Success || match.Index != 0 || match.Length != text.Length)
				{
					flag = false;
					errorMsg = ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_RegexPattern");
				}
			}
			if (flag && ShouldTestConstraint(ValueConstraintFlags.ValidationRules, constraintFlags))
			{
				IEnumerable<ValidationRule> validationRules = ValidationRules;
				foreach (ValidationRule item in validationRules)
				{
					ValidationResult validationResult = item.Validate(dataValue, formatProvider as CultureInfo);
					if (ValidationResult.ValidResult != validationResult)
					{
						flag = false;
						object errorContent = validationResult.ErrorContent;
						errorMsg = ((errorContent != null) ? errorContent.ToString() : ValueEditor.GetString("LMSG_ValueConstraint_ValidationRule"));
					}
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		private bool ShouldSerializeFractionDigits()
		{
			return Utilities.ShouldSerialize(FractionDigitsProperty, this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		private void ResetFractionDigits()
		{
			ClearValue(FractionDigitsProperty);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		private bool ShouldSerializeTotalDigits()
		{
			return Utilities.ShouldSerialize(TotalDigitsProperty, this);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		private void ResetTotalDigits()
		{
			ClearValue(TotalDigitsProperty);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			RaisePropertyChanged(e.Property.Name);
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propName)
		{
			if (_propertyChangedDelegate != null)
			{
				_propertyChangedDelegate(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propName));
			}
		}
	}

			_errorMessage = exception.Message;
		}
	}

	public class SelectedDatesChangedEventArgs : RoutedEventArgs
	{
		private DateTime[] _removedDates;

		private DateTime[] _addedDates;

		public IList<DateTime> RemovedDates => _removedDates;

		public IList<DateTime> AddedDates => _addedDates;

		public SelectedDatesChangedEventArgs(IList<DateTime> removedDates, IList<DateTime> addedDates)
		{
			Utils.ValidateNull("removedDates", removedDates);
			Utils.ValidateNull("addedDates", addedDates);
			_removedDates = new DateTime[removedDates.Count];
			removedDates.CopyTo(_removedDates, 0);
			_addedDates = new DateTime[addedDates.Count];
			addedDates.CopyTo(_addedDates, 0);
		}
	}

				for (int i = 0; i < calendarItemGroup.Items.Count; i++)
				{

			}
			return null;

			_xamMonthCalendar = xamMonthCalendar;
			_dateTime = dateTime;

			return AutomationControlType.Custom;

		{

		}

		protected override string GetNameCore()
		{
			string text = base.GetNameCore();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				_ = _dateTime;
				text = _dateTime.ToString("d");
			}
			return text;
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.SelectionItem)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		{
			AutomationPeer result = null;
			if (_xamMonthCalendar.IsMinCalendarMode)
			{
				Infragistics.Windows.Editors.CalendarItem item = _xamMonthCalendar.GetItem(_dateTime);
				if (item != null)
				{
					result = UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(item);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override bool IsEnabledCore()
		{
			return GetUnderlyingPeer()?.IsEnabled() ?? true;
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.AddToSelection()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			if (!_xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDates.Contains(_dateTime))
			{
				_xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDates.Add(_dateTime);
			}
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.RemoveFromSelection()

			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			_xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDates.Remove(_dateTime);
		}

		void ISelectionItemProvider.Select()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			_xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDate = _dateTime;
		}

	public class ValueEditorAutomationPeer : FrameworkElementAutomationPeer, IValueProvider
	{
		private bool _wasValueReturned;

		private ValueEditor Editor => (ValueEditor)base.Owner;

		bool IValueProvider.IsReadOnly => Editor.IsReadOnly;

		string IValueProvider.Value
		{
			get
			{
				_wasValueReturned = true;
				return Editor.Text;
			}
		}

		public ValueEditorAutomationPeer(ValueEditor owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "ValueEditor";
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			if (patternInterface == PatternInterface.Value)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return base.GetPattern(patternInterface);
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			ValueEditor editor = Editor;
			if (editor.Focusable && (editor.Focus() || editor.IsFocusWithin))
			{
				return;
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_11"));
		}

		internal void RaiseValuePropertyChangedEvent(string oldValue, string newValue)
		{
			if (_wasValueReturned)
			{
				_wasValueReturned = false;
				if (GetPattern(PatternInterface.Value) != null)
				{
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent(ValuePatternIdentifiers.ValueProperty, oldValue, newValue);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseReadOnlyPropertyChangedEvent(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			if (GetPattern(PatternInterface.Value) != null)
			{
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent(ValuePatternIdentifiers.IsReadOnlyProperty, oldValue, newValue);
			}
		}

		protected void VerifyIsInEditMode()
		{
			ValueEditor editor = Editor;
			if (!editor.IsInEditMode)
			{
				if (editor.Host != null)
				{
					editor.Host.StartEditMode();
				}
				else
				{
					editor.StartEditMode();
				}
				if (!editor.IsInEditMode)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_1"));
				}
			}
		}

		void IValueProvider.SetValue(string value)
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			VerifyIsInEditMode();
			Editor.Text_CurrentValue = value;
		}
	}
	public class XamCheckEditorAutomationPeer : ValueEditorAutomationPeer, IToggleProvider
	{
		private XamCheckEditor Editor => (XamCheckEditor)base.Owner;

		ToggleState IToggleProvider.ToggleState
		{
			get
			{
				bool? isChecked = Editor.IsChecked;
				if (!isChecked.HasValue)
				{
					return ToggleState.Indeterminate;
				}
				if (isChecked.Value)
				{
					return ToggleState.On;
				}
				return ToggleState.Off;
			}
		}

		public XamCheckEditorAutomationPeer(XamCheckEditor owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override AutomationControlType GetAutomationControlTypeCore()
		{
			return AutomationControlType.CheckBox;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "XamCheckEditor";
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			return patternInterface switch
			{
				PatternInterface.Value => null, 
				PatternInterface.Toggle => this, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal ToggleState ConvertToToggleState(bool? value)
		{
			if (!value.HasValue)
			{
				return ToggleState.Indeterminate;
			}
			if (value != true)
			{
				return ToggleState.Off;
			}
			return ToggleState.On;
		}

		internal void RaiseToggleStatePropertyChangedEvent(bool? oldValue, bool? newValue)
		{
			if (GetPattern(PatternInterface.Toggle) != null)
			{
				RaisePropertyChangedEvent(TogglePatternIdentifiers.ToggleStateProperty, ConvertToToggleState(oldValue), ConvertToToggleState(newValue));
			}
		}

		void IToggleProvider.Toggle()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			VerifyIsInEditMode();
			Editor.ToggleIsChecked();
		}
	}
	public class XamMaskedEditorAutomationPeer : ValueEditorAutomationPeer, ITextProvider, IExpandCollapseProvider
	{
		internal class MaskedEditTextRange : ITextRangeProvider
		{
			private XamMaskedEditorAutomationPeer _peer;

			private int _start;

			private int _end;

			private int EndingDisplayCharacterIndex => Math.Max(_start, _end - 1);

			internal MaskedEditTextRange(XamMaskedEditorAutomationPeer peer, int start, int end)
			{
				_peer = peer;
				_start = start;
				_end = end;
			}

			private void VerifyEndPoint(TextPatternRangeEndpoint endPoint)
			{
				if (endPoint == TextPatternRangeEndpoint.End)
				{
					_end = Math.Max(_end, _start);
				}
				else
				{
					_start = Math.Min(_end, _start);
				}
			}

			private static TextPatternRangeEndpoint GetOtherEndPoint(TextPatternRangeEndpoint endPoint)
			{
				if (endPoint != TextPatternRangeEndpoint.Start)
				{
					return TextPatternRangeEndpoint.Start;
				}
				return TextPatternRangeEndpoint.End;
			}

			void ITextRangeProvider.AddToSelection()
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}

			ITextRangeProvider ITextRangeProvider.Clone()
			{
				return new MaskedEditTextRange(_peer, _start, _end);
			}

			bool ITextRangeProvider.Compare(ITextRangeProvider range)
			{
				if (range == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("range");
				}
				if (!(range is MaskedEditTextRange maskedEditTextRange))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_1"), "range");
				}
				if (maskedEditTextRange._peer == _peer && maskedEditTextRange._start == _start)
				{
					return maskedEditTextRange._end == _end;
				}
				return false;
			}

			int ITextRangeProvider.CompareEndpoints(TextPatternRangeEndpoint endpoint, ITextRangeProvider targetRange, TextPatternRangeEndpoint targetEndpoint)
			{
				if (targetRange == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("targetRange");
				}
				if (!(targetRange is MaskedEditTextRange maskedEditTextRange))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_1"), "targetRange");
				}
				int value = ((targetEndpoint == TextPatternRangeEndpoint.Start) ? maskedEditTextRange._start : maskedEditTextRange._end);

			int ITextRangeProvider.Move(TextUnit unit, int count)
			{
				if (count == 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				int num = 0;
				bool flag = count < 0;
				switch (unit)
				{
				case TextUnit.Character:
					if (_end != _start)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							_end = _start;
							count++;
						}
						else
						{
							_start = _end;
							count--;
						}
						num++;
					}
					if (count != 0)
					{
						int num2 = ((ITextRangeProvider)this).MoveEndpointByUnit((!flag) ? TextPatternRangeEndpoint.End : TextPatternRangeEndpoint.Start, unit, count);
						num = ((num2 < 0) ? (-1) : (num + num2));
						if (flag)
						{
							_end = _start;
						}
						else
						{
							_start = _end;
						}
					}
					break;
				case TextUnit.Format:
				case TextUnit.Word:
					num = ((ITextRangeProvider)this).MoveEndpointByUnit((!flag) ? TextPatternRangeEndpoint.End : TextPatternRangeEndpoint.Start, unit, count);
					if (num == 0 && _end != _start)
					{
						num = -1;
					}
					break;
				default:
					if (flag)
					{
						if (_start != 0)
						{
							_start = 0;
							num = -1;
						}
					}
					else if (_end != _peer.LastCharacterIndex)
					{
						_end = _peer.LastCharacterIndex;
						num = -1;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (num != 0)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						_end = _start;
					}
					else
					{
						_start = _end;
					}
					if (num > 0 && (_start == 0 || _end == _peer.LastCharacterIndex))
					{
						num = -1;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}

			void ITextRangeProvider.MoveEndpointByRange(TextPatternRangeEndpoint endpoint, ITextRangeProvider targetRange, TextPatternRangeEndpoint targetEndpoint)
			{
				if (targetRange == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("targetRange");
				}
				if (!(targetRange is MaskedEditTextRange maskedEditTextRange))

					throw new ArgumentException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_1"), "range");

				int num = ((targetEndpoint == TextPatternRangeEndpoint.Start) ? maskedEditTextRange._start : maskedEditTextRange._end);
				if (endpoint == TextPatternRangeEndpoint.Start)

				VerifyEndPoint(GetOtherEndPoint(endpoint));
			}

			int ITextRangeProvider.MoveEndpointByUnit(TextPatternRangeEndpoint endpoint, TextUnit unit, int count)
			{
				if (count == 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (count < 0 && endpoint == TextPatternRangeEndpoint.Start && _start == 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (count > 0 && endpoint == TextPatternRangeEndpoint.End && _end == _peer.LastCharacterIndex)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				bool flag = count < 0;
				bool flag2 = endpoint == TextPatternRangeEndpoint.Start;
				int num = 0;
				switch (unit)
				{
				case TextUnit.Character:
				{
					int num5 = (flag2 ? _start : _end);
					int val2 = num5 + count;
					val2 = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(_peer.LastCharacterIndex, val2));
					num += Math.Abs(val2 - num5);
					if (flag2)
					{
						_start = val2;
					}
					else
					{
						_end = val2;
					}
					break;
				}
				case TextUnit.Format:
				case TextUnit.Word:
				{
					MaskInfo maskInfo = _peer.Editor.MaskInfo;
					int num2 = (flag ? _start : _end);
					int num3 = num2;
					SectionBase sectionContainingPosition = EditInfo.GetSectionContainingPosition(num2, maskInfo.Sections);
					if (sectionContainingPosition != null)
					{
						if (flag && num2 != sectionContainingPosition.FirstDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit)
						{
							num3 = sectionContainingPosition.FirstDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit;
							num++;
							count++;
						}
						else if (!flag && num2 != sectionContainingPosition.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit + 1)
						{
							num3 = sectionContainingPosition.LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit + 1;
							num++;
							count--;
						}
					}
					if (count != 0)
					{
						int num4 = sectionContainingPosition?.Index ?? maskInfo.Sections.Count;
						int val = num4 + count;
						val = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(maskInfo.Sections.Count, val));
						num += Math.Abs(val - num4);
						num3 = ((val == maskInfo.Sections.Count) ? _peer.LastCharacterIndex : ((!flag) ? (maskInfo.Sections[val].LastDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit + 1) : maskInfo.Sections[val].FirstDisplayChar.OverallIndexInEdit));
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						_start = num3;
					}
					else
					{
						_end = num3;
					}
					break;
				}
				default:
					if (flag2)
					{
						_start = ((!flag) ? _peer.LastCharacterIndex : 0);
					}
					else
					{
						_end = ((!flag) ? _peer.LastCharacterIndex : 0);
					}
					num = -1;
					break;
				}
				VerifyEndPoint(flag2 ? TextPatternRangeEndpoint.End : TextPatternRangeEndpoint.Start);
				if (num > 0 && (_start == 0 || _end == _peer.LastCharacterIndex))
				{
					num = -1;
				}
				return num;
			}

		private ExpandCollapseState? _lastReturnedExpandState;

		private XamMaskedEditor Editor => (XamMaskedEditor)base.Owner;

		private int LastCharacterIndex => XamMaskedEditor.GetTotalNumberOfDisplayChars(Editor.Sections);

		ITextRangeProvider ITextProvider.DocumentRange => new MaskedEditTextRange(this, 0, LastCharacterIndex);

		SupportedTextSelection ITextProvider.SupportedTextSelection => SupportedTextSelection.Single;

		ExpandCollapseState IExpandCollapseProvider.ExpandCollapseState
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Editor.HasDropDown)
				{
					_lastReturnedExpandState = ExpandCollapseState.LeafNode;
				}
				else if (Editor.HasOpenDropDown)
				{
					_lastReturnedExpandState = ExpandCollapseState.Expanded;
				}
				else
				{
					_lastReturnedExpandState = ExpandCollapseState.Collapsed;
				}
				return _lastReturnedExpandState.Value;
			}
		}

		public XamMaskedEditorAutomationPeer(XamMaskedEditor owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		{
			return AutomationControlType.Edit;
		}

		protected override string GetClassNameCore()
		{
			return "XamMaskedEditor";
		}

		public override object GetPattern(PatternInterface patternInterface)
		{
			return patternInterface switch
			{
				PatternInterface.Text => this, 
				PatternInterface.ExpandCollapse => this, 
				_ => base.GetPattern(patternInterface), 
			};
		}

		internal DependencyObject ElementFromProvider(IRawElementProviderSimple provider)
		{
			DependencyObject result = null;
			AutomationPeer automationPeer = PeerFromProvider(provider);
			if (automationPeer is UIElementAutomationPeer)
			{
				return ((UIElementAutomationPeer)automationPeer).Owner;
			}
			if (automationPeer is ContentElementAutomationPeer)
			{
				result = ((ContentElementAutomationPeer)automationPeer).Owner;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void RaiseExpandCollapseChanged()
		{
			if (_lastReturnedExpandState.HasValue && AutomationPeer.ListenerExists(AutomationEvents.PropertyChanged))
			{
				ExpandCollapseState expandCollapseState = ((IExpandCollapseProvider)this).ExpandCollapseState;
				if (expandCollapseState != _lastReturnedExpandState.Value)
				{
					RaisePropertyChangedEvent(ExpandCollapsePatternIdentifiers.ExpandCollapseStateProperty, _lastReturnedExpandState.Value, expandCollapseState);
				}
			}
		}

		ITextRangeProvider[] ITextProvider.GetSelection()
		{
			return new ITextRangeProvider[1]
			{
				new MaskedEditTextRange(this, Editor.SelectionStart, Editor.SelectionStart + Editor.SelectionLength)
			};
		}

		ITextRangeProvider[] ITextProvider.GetVisibleRanges()
		{
			EditInfo editInfo = Editor.EditInfo;
			if (editInfo == null)
			{
				return new ITextRangeProvider[0];
			}
			int nearestDisplayChar = editInfo.GetNearestDisplayChar(new Point(0.0, 0.0), dragging: true);
			int nearestDisplayChar2 = editInfo.GetNearestDisplayChar(new Point(Editor.ActualWidth, Editor.ActualHeight), dragging: true);
			return new ITextRangeProvider[1]
			{
				new MaskedEditTextRange(this, nearestDisplayChar, nearestDisplayChar2)
			};
		}

		ITextRangeProvider ITextProvider.RangeFromChild(IRawElementProviderSimple childElement)
		{
			if (childElement == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("childElement");
			}
			DependencyObject descendant = ElementFromProvider(childElement);
			if (!((XamMaskedEditor)base.Owner).IsAncestorOf(descendant))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(ValueEditor.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_2"));
			}
			return new MaskedEditTextRange(this, 0, LastCharacterIndex);
		}

		ITextRangeProvider ITextProvider.RangeFromPoint(Point screenLocation)
		{
			EditInfo editInfo = Editor.EditInfo;
			if (editInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Point point = Utilities.PointFromScreenSafe(Editor, screenLocation);
			int nearestDisplayChar = editInfo.GetNearestDisplayChar(point, dragging: true);
			return new MaskedEditTextRange(this, nearestDisplayChar, nearestDisplayChar);
		}

		private void VerifyCanExpandCollapse()
		{
			if (!IsEnabled())
			{
				throw new ElementNotEnabledException();
			}
			if (!Editor.HasDropDown)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		void IExpandCollapseProvider.Collapse()
		{
			VerifyCanExpandCollapse();
			if (Editor.HasOpenDropDown)
			{
				Editor.ToggleDropDown();
			}
		}

		void IExpandCollapseProvider.Expand()
		{
			VerifyCanExpandCollapse();
			if (!Editor.HasDropDown)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (!Editor.HasOpenDropDown)
			{
				Editor.ToggleDropDown();
			}
		}

		IRawElementProviderSimple[] ISelectionProvider.GetSelection()
		{
			XamMonthCalendar xamMonthCalendar = base.Owner as XamMonthCalendar;
			SelectedDateCollection selectedDates = xamMonthCalendar.SelectedDates;
			if (selectedDates != null)
			{
				List<IRawElementProviderSimple> list = new List<IRawElementProviderSimple>(selectedDates.Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < selectedDates.Count; i++)
				{
					DateTime dateTime = selectedDates[i];
					SelectedDateAutomationPeer peer = new SelectedDateAutomationPeer(xamMonthCalendar, dateTime);
					list[i] = ProviderFromPeer(peer);
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static Infragistics.Windows.Editors.CalendarMode GetMode(int viewId)
		{
			Infragistics.Windows.Editors.CalendarMode calendarMode = (Infragistics.Windows.Editors.CalendarMode)viewId;
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(Infragistics.Windows.Editors.CalendarMode), calendarMode))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(XamMonthCalendar.GetString("LE_InvalidViewId"));
			}
			return calendarMode;
		}

		int[] IMultipleViewProvider.GetSupportedViews()
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			foreach (Infragistics.Windows.Editors.CalendarMode value in Enum.GetValues(typeof(Infragistics.Windows.Editors.CalendarMode)))
			{
				XamMonthCalendar xamMonthCalendar = (XamMonthCalendar)base.Owner;
				if (value >= xamMonthCalendar.MinCalendarMode && value <= xamMonthCalendar.MaxCalendarMode)
				{
					list.Add((int)value);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		string IMultipleViewProvider.GetViewName(int viewId)
		{
			return GetMode(viewId).ToString();
		}

		void IMultipleViewProvider.SetCurrentView(int viewId)
		{
			XamMonthCalendar xamMonthCalendar = (XamMonthCalendar)base.Owner;
			Infragistics.Windows.Editors.CalendarMode mode = GetMode(viewId);
			if (mode < xamMonthCalendar.MinCalendarMode)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(XamMonthCalendar.GetString("LE_CannotSetMode", mode));
			}
			if (mode > xamMonthCalendar.MaxCalendarMode)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			xamMonthCalendar.CurrentCalendarMode = mode;
		}
	}
